+"""The dense ``kbar`` gather + the extend step's device metadata: the paged compressed-key cache, through the main block table,
+into the contiguous ``[B, n_blocks_max, 128]`` operand of the compact-logits scorer -- ONE launch, no SMEM, no mbarrier.
+
+A prefill chunk of ``T`` rows behind a cached prefix (the in-block indexer's EXTEND step) selects its blocks over the PREFIX's
+compressed keys, which live in the serving stack's PAGED cache ``index_kv_cache [num_pages, P / POOL, 1, D]`` behind the MAIN
+block table ``block_table [B, max_pages]`` -- while the scorer (``cudnn.QSA.selection.qsa_select_forward``) takes a CONTIGUOUS
+``kbar [B, n_blocks_max, D]``.  This kernel is that gather, a 16-byte-granule BIT COPY (bf16 rows of 256 B, e4m3 rows of 128 B:
+the row's dtype is a compile key, no unpack, no cast, no fp8 instruction -- one kernel body serves both), plus the three small
+metadata vectors the step needs from ``kv_lens`` ON DEVICE (a serving stack's lengths are device data; the host reads nothing
+back).  Per sequence ``b`` with ``L = kv_lens[b]`` (the KV length AFTER the chunk), ``T`` the chunk's rows, ``NB = n_blocks_max =
+ix_kbar.shape[1]`` (= the table's reach in compressed rows, ``max_pages x P / POOL``) and ``POOL = 4``::
+
+    n_keys        = clamp(floor(L / POOL), 0, NB)
+    row j < n_keys                              : ix_kbar[b, j] = cache[table[b, j // rpp], j % rpp]   (a -1 / out-of-range page -> a ZERO row:
+                                                                                                        the paged scorer's own convention)
+    row n_keys <= j < min(NB, ceil(T / POOL))   : ix_kbar[b, j] = 0     (every row a chunk row can read past n_keys is a DEFINED zero -- the
+                                                                        prefill form's memset rule: a dead / short sequence's rows, and a SERVED
+                                                                        sequence's row n_keys when its last group is partial, L // POOL == T // POOL
+                                                                        with T % POOL != 0, e.g. L = T = 37 -- never read there, n_vis <= n_keys)
+    row j past both                             : untouched
+    ix_counts[b T + i]  = clamp(floor((L - T + i + 1) / POOL), 0, NB)                  the TRUE position's visible count (0 on a negative one);
+                                                                                        computed from max(L, 0) -- the same value for every L,
+                                                                                        and no int32 wrap of L - T at L near INT_MIN
+    ix_qpos[p]          = clamp(max(L - T, 0) + r0_p, 0, POOL NB + POOL - 1 - rows_p)  p a piece of b: the scorer's non-negative first position,
+                                                                                        AND the memory guard below (from max(L, 0) - T likewise)
+    ix_seqrep[b]        = n_keys  (served: T <= L <= POOL NB) | -1 (dead: L <= 0) | -2 (0 < L < T) | -3 (L > POOL NB)
+
+**The clamp of ``ix_qpos`` is the memory guard of the compact-logits scratch.**  The scorer stores row ``i`` of a piece at
+``cand_batch_offsets[p] + G(q_pos0_p + i) - G(q_pos0_p)`` with a per-row region of ``floor((q_pos0_p + i + 1) / POOL)`` floats that
+is UNCLAMPED by the key count, so a per-piece slab sized ``rows_p x NB`` floats (the step's plan-constant, loose bases) holds every row
+only while ``floor((q_pos0_p + rows_p) / POOL) <= NB`` -- i.e. ``q_pos0_p <= POOL NB + POOL - 1 - rows_p``.  The kernel clamps there, so
+whatever ``kv_lens`` holds (a stack bug included) no scorer write leaves its slab: memory safety is never a device-value contract.
+The clamp needs ``rows_p <= T <= POOL x NB``, which the HOST guarantees before any launch (``run_qsa_kbar_gather`` refuses a chunk
+longer than the table's reach, naming both numbers).  A clamped sequence (``L > POOL NB``: ``kv_lens[b] > max_pages x P``, the block's
+existing device contract) is position-misaligned in its selection and REPORTED ``-3``; a sequence with ``0 < L < T`` is the other
+violation (``-2``: a chunk extends a sequence of at least its own length); ``ix_seqrep`` is a device REPORT the tests read and the
+block never reads; its precedence is dead > short > over > served (``-1`` over ``-2`` over ``-3`` over ``n_keys``), and short / over are
+DISJOINT under the host rule ``T <= POOL x NB`` (``0 < L < T`` and ``L > POOL NB`` cannot both hold), so the order between those two
+never decides a report.  A dead sequence (``L <= 0``) is fully defined WHATEVER ITS MAGNITUDE: zero rows up to ``ceil(T / POOL)``, counts 0,
+``q_pos0 = r0_p`` -- the positions are derived from ``max(L, 0)``, never from ``L - T`` (int32 arithmetic on ``L = INT_MIN`` would wrap
+positive and hand a dead sequence live counts and a clamped ``q_pos0``).
+
+The piece table ``piece_seq / piece_r0 / piece_rows [n_pieces]`` (int32, device; the step's plan constants, uploaded once) names the
+select windows' pieces: piece ``p`` is rows ``[r0_p, r0_p + rows_p)`` of sequence ``piece_seq[p]``.  Its VALUES are device data used in
+arithmetic and in an equality against ``b`` only -- never as an index -- so a malformed table cannot address memory.
+
+Grid ``(ceil(NB / groups_per_cta), B)``, ``threads_per_cta`` threads = ``threads / lanes`` lane groups of ``lanes = row_bytes / 16``
+lanes (16 at bf16, 8 at e4m3), ONE group per compressed row ``j``; CTA ``(b, x = 0)`` also writes the metadata: ``ix_counts`` by
+thread ``i`` in a stride-``threads`` loop over ``T``, ``ix_qpos[p]`` by the thread that finds ``piece_seq[p] == b`` (a stride-``threads``
+loop over the pieces), ``ix_seqrep[b]`` by thread 0.  Bytes: ``B x n_keys x row_bytes`` read + written (8 MiB per sequence at a
+128K reach, bf16); the roofline term is HBM bytes -- no perf claim is made here until one is measured on an exclusive GPU.
+
+**Barrier table -- EMPTY (zero rows).**  No mbarrier, no ``cp.async`` group, no CTA barrier, no TMA, no tcgen05, no cluster, and
+NO warp shuffle either: every lane's work is independent, so ``SUM(issuing lanes) == init_count`` has no row to reconcile and the
+``frost-barrier-inspect`` audit of this kernel is THIS statement (the ``cache_write.py`` precedent), not an audit skipped.
+**SMEM table -- EMPTY (zero rows):** no ``cutlass.Array(space=smem)``, no ``SmemAllocator``, no ``smem=`` at the launch; every operand
+moves register <-> global through ``ld.global.v4`` / ``st.global.v4`` (16 B per lane) or 4-B scalar ``ld.global`` / ``st.global``.
+**Per-lane stride of every global access** (the SMEM table's column, applied to global so the coalescing is justified): the cache
+rows -- lane ``l`` of a row group reads granule ``l`` at ``row + 16 l`` B, 16 (bf16) / 8 (e4m3) consecutive lanes per 256-B / 128-B row
+= whole 128-B lines, consecutive rows on consecutive groups; ``ix_kbar[b, j]`` -- the same granule mapping into a contiguous
+destination (row stride 256 / 128 B), the zero-fill the same addresses with zero words; ``block_table[b, j // rpp]`` -- one 4-B load
+per group, the ``rpp`` groups of a page on ONE word (L1 broadcast); ``kv_lens[b]`` -- one 4-B load per group; ``ix_counts[b T + i]`` --
+thread ``i`` of CTA ``(b, 0)`` in a stride-``threads`` loop, consecutive threads on consecutive 4-B words; ``ix_qpos[p]`` /
+``ix_seqrep[b]`` -- single 4-B stores by one thread each.
+**``fence_proxy`` -- NONE:** no async proxy exists in this kernel; its generic-proxy stores are consumed by LATER kernels in stream
+order (the gathered ``ix_kbar`` by the scorer's TMA loads -- a kernel boundary is a full proxy fence), so ``frost-tile-dsl.md`` § 1 has
+no site here: stated, not skipped.
+**Rule 7 / the target:** like ``cache_write.py`` the kernel carries NO arch pin (plain LDG / STG; the e4m3 bit copy needs no fp8
+instruction): any CuTe DSL device from sm_80; ``compile_qsa_kbar_gather`` gates the DSL floor first (``cutedsl_requirement_error``).
+The Rubin pin of the EXTEND form is the block's (``sm_107a`` at declaration), not this kernel's.
+
+Programmatic dependent launch (``use_pdl``): the ``griddepcontrol.wait`` precedes the first dependent read (``kv_lens``, the table,
+the cache rows the chunk compress just wrote) and the ``launch_dependents`` release sits RIGHT AFTER it (the streaming-kernel
+placement of ``cache_write.py``).
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+
+from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_requirement_error
+from cudnn.frost.compiled_cache import compile_cached, template_key
+from cudnn.frost.device import current_device
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.barrier import launch_dependent_grids, wait_on_dependent_grids
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.pointwise import opaque_i32_zero
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.tma import ld_global, ld_global_v4, st_global, st_global_v4
+
+from ..cache_write_contract import DEFAULT_POOL
+from .qk_norm_rope import ACCESS_BYTES
+from .qsa_compress import _check_int32_vector, _check_row_tensor, _fake_compact, _fake_i32_table, _fake_paged_state, check_block_table, paged_block_row
+
+DEFAULT_THREADS_PER_CTA = 128
+"""Four warps per CTA: 8 bf16 rows (16 e4m3 rows) per CTA.  A streaming bit copy; re-measure per arch before changing it."""
+
+_CACHE_DTYPES = (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+_FAKE_STREAM = None
+# Imported normally (not through the template loader), so the module names its own source identity: ``template_key`` joins it with a
+# compile site's key to name the persistent object (``compiled_cache``); the cache's environment manifest covers every other ``.py``
+# the kernel is traced from.
+FROST_SOURCE_DIGEST = hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+SEQREP_DEAD = -1
+"""``ix_seqrep`` value: a dead sequence (``kv_lens <= 0``; a padding request): zero rows, counts 0, every list ``-1`` downstream."""
+SEQREP_SHORT = -2
+"""``ix_seqrep`` value: ``0 < kv_lens < T`` -- a chunk longer than the sequence it extends (a contract violation): ``q_pos0`` clamped at
+``r0``, the live rows' selection position-misaligned; memory-safe."""
+SEQREP_OVER = -3
+"""``ix_seqrep`` value: ``kv_lens > POOL x n_blocks_max`` (= ``max_pages x P``) -- a sequence past the table's reach (a contract
+violation): ``q_pos0`` clamped so no scorer write leaves its slab, the selection position-misaligned; memory-safe by construction."""
+
+
+def validate_gather_shape(d: int, elem_bytes: int, pool: int, threads_per_cta: int) -> None:
+    """Raise on any geometry this kernel cannot address: a row of ``d x elem_bytes`` bytes is a whole number of 16-B granules, a CTA
+    holds whole lane groups, the pool is positive.  Never an ``assert``: user-facing geometry must survive ``python -O`` and name itself."""
+    if elem_bytes not in (1, 2):
+        raise ValueError(f"the compressed-key cache holds 16-bit or e4m3 rows (1 or 2 bytes per element), got {elem_bytes}")
+    row_bytes = int(d) * int(elem_bytes)
+    if d < 1 or row_bytes % ACCESS_BYTES:
+        raise ValueError(f"d x element bytes = {row_bytes} must be a positive multiple of {ACCESS_BYTES} B (one 16-B granule per lane), got d={d}")
+    lanes = row_bytes // ACCESS_BYTES
+    if threads_per_cta < lanes or threads_per_cta % lanes:
+        raise ValueError(f"threads_per_cta must be a positive multiple of the {lanes} lanes of one row, got {threads_per_cta}")
+    if int(pool) < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"pool must be >= 1, got {pool}")
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def frost_qsa_kbar_gather(
+    mCache: cute.Tensor,  # [num_pages, rpp, 1, D] the paged compressed-key cache (cache dtype): strides symbolic, D contiguous
+    mTable: cute.Tensor,  # [B, max_pages] int32: the MAIN block table (row stride symbolic, unit column stride)
+    mKvLens: cute.Tensor,  # [B] int32: the KV length AFTER the chunk
+    mPieceSeq: cute.Tensor,  # [n_pieces] int32: the sequence of every select piece
+    mPieceR0: cute.Tensor,  # [n_pieces] int32: the piece's first chunk row
+    mPieceRows: cute.Tensor,  # [n_pieces] int32: the piece's rows
+    mKbar: cute.Tensor,  # [B, NB, D] out (cache dtype), contiguous
+    mQpos: cute.Tensor,  # [n_pieces] int32 out: the clamped first position per piece
+    mCounts: cute.Tensor,  # [B * T] int32 out: the visible count per chunk row
+    mSeqRep: cute.Tensor,  # [B] int32 out: the per-sequence report
+    n_pieces: cutlass.Int32,
+    t_rows: cutlass.Int32,  # T, the chunk's rows per sequence
+    d: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    elem_bytes: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    pool: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    threads_per_cta: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    use_pdl: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+) -> None:
+    """One lane group (``row_bytes / 16`` lanes) per compressed row ``j`` of sequence ``b = block_idx.y``; CTA ``(b, 0)`` also writes
+    the sequence's metadata (module docstring).  A group past ``NB`` loads nothing and stores nothing (no shuffle anywhere, so a tail
+    group needs no clamped participation)."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(use_pdl):
+        # the wait before the first dependent read (kv_lens, the table, the cache rows the chunk compress wrote); the release right after it
+        wait_on_dependent_grids()
+        launch_dependent_grids()
+
+    row_bytes = cutlass.const_expr(d * elem_bytes)
+    lanes = cutlass.const_expr(row_bytes // ACCESS_BYTES)
+    groups_per_cta = cutlass.const_expr(threads_per_cta // lanes)
+    bpe = cutlass.Int64(elem_bytes)
+
+    tidx = cutlass.Int32(cute.arch.thread_idx()[0])
+    lane = tidx % cutlass.Int32(lanes)
+    grp = tidx // cutlass.Int32(lanes)
+    b = cutlass.Int32(cute.arch.block_idx()[1])
+    x = cutlass.Int32(cute.arch.block_idx()[0])
+    j = x * cutlass.Int32(groups_per_cta) + grp
+    b64 = b.to(cutlass.Int64)
+
+    n_blocks_max = cutlass.Int32(mKbar.shape[1])
+    length = ld_global(mKvLens.iterator.toint() + b64 * cutlass.Int64(4), cutlass.Int32)
+    length0 = length if length > cutlass.Int32(0) else cutlass.Int32(0)
+    n_keys = length0 // cutlass.Int32(pool)  # a non-negative dividend: the DSL's integer division truncates toward zero
+    n_keys = n_keys if n_keys < n_blocks_max else n_blocks_max
+    fill = (t_rows + cutlass.Int32(pool - 1)) // cutlass.Int32(pool)  # ceil(T / POOL): the rows a chunk row of a dead / short sequence can read
+    fill = fill if fill < n_blocks_max else n_blocks_max
+    fill_end = n_keys if n_keys > fill else fill
+
+    # --- the gather: row j of sequence b, a bit copy through the table; zero words for an unassigned page and for the defined-zero rows ---
+    in_grid = j < n_blocks_max
+    j_r = j if in_grid else n_blocks_max - cutlass.Int32(1)  # in-bounds (NB >= 1, host-checked); a tail group stores nothing
+    src, fits = paged_block_row(mCache, mTable, b, j_r, bpe)
+    keep = (j_r < n_keys) & fits
+    store = in_grid & (j_r < fill_end)
+    lane_off = lane.to(cutlass.Int64) * cutlass.Int64(ACCESS_BYTES)
+    if store:
+        words = ld_global_v4(src + lane_off, cutlass.Int32)  # a clamped, in-bounds row even when its words are not kept
+        zero = opaque_i32_zero()
+        out = [w if keep else zero for w in words]
+        dst = mKbar.iterator.toint() + ((b64 * n_blocks_max.to(cutlass.Int64) + j_r.to(cutlass.Int64)) * cutlass.Int64(d)) * bpe + lane_off
+        st_global_v4(dst, out, cutlass.Int32)
+
+    # --- the metadata, by CTA (b, 0) ---
+    if x == cutlass.Int32(0):
+        # the position of the chunk's row 0 from the NON-NEGATIVE length: L - T for every L >= 0 (negative on a short sequence), -T for every
+        # dead one -- L - T itself wraps int32 at L near INT_MIN (counts [NB, NB, NB, 0] and a clamped q_pos0 for a DEAD sequence)
+        pos_base = length0 - t_rows
+        for i in cutlass.range(tidx, t_rows, threads_per_cta):
+            pos1 = pos_base + i + cutlass.Int32(1)  # the TRUE position + 1
+            cnt = (pos1 // cutlass.Int32(pool)) if pos1 > cutlass.Int32(0) else cutlass.Int32(0)  # never a negative dividend
+            cnt = cnt if cnt < n_blocks_max else n_blocks_max
+            st_global(mCounts.iterator.toint() + (b64 * t_rows.to(cutlass.Int64) + i.to(cutlass.Int64)) * cutlass.Int64(4), cnt, cutlass.Int32)
+        q_base = pos_base if pos_base > cutlass.Int32(0) else cutlass.Int32(0)  # the scorer's non-negative first position
+        for p in cutlass.range(tidx, n_pieces, threads_per_cta):
+            p64 = p.to(cutlass.Int64) * cutlass.Int64(4)
+            seq = ld_global(mPieceSeq.iterator.toint() + p64, cutlass.Int32)
+            if seq == b:
+                r0 = ld_global(mPieceR0.iterator.toint() + p64, cutlass.Int32)
+                rows = ld_global(mPieceRows.iterator.toint() + p64, cutlass.Int32)
+                qpos = q_base + r0
+                # the memory guard: floor((qpos + rows) / POOL) <= NB  <=>  qpos <= POOL NB + POOL - 1 - rows
+                bound = cutlass.Int32(pool) * n_blocks_max + cutlass.Int32(pool - 1) - rows
+                qpos = qpos if qpos < bound else bound
+                qpos = qpos if qpos > cutlass.Int32(0) else cutlass.Int32(0)
+                st_global(mQpos.iterator.toint() + p64, qpos, cutlass.Int32)
+        if tidx == cutlass.Int32(0):
+            rep = n_keys
+            rep = cutlass.Int32(SEQREP_OVER) if length > cutlass.Int32(pool) * n_blocks_max else rep
+            rep = cutlass.Int32(SEQREP_SHORT) if (length > cutlass.Int32(0)) & (length < t_rows) else rep
+            rep = cutlass.Int32(SEQREP_DEAD) if length <= cutlass.Int32(0) else rep
+            st_global(mSeqRep.iterator.toint() + b64 * cutlass.Int64(4), rep, cutlass.Int32)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def qsa_kbar_gather_launch(
+    cache: cute.Tensor,
+    table: cute.Tensor,
+    kv_lens: cute.Tensor,
+    piece_seq: cute.Tensor,
+    piece_r0: cute.Tensor,
+    piece_rows: cute.Tensor,
+    kbar: cute.Tensor,
+    qpos: cute.Tensor,
+    counts: cute.Tensor,
+    seqrep: cute.Tensor,
+    n_pieces: cutlass.Int32,
+    t_rows: cutlass.Int32,
+    grid_x: cutlass.Int32,
+    grid_y: cutlass.Int32,
+    d: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    elem_bytes: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    pool: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    threads_per_cta: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    use_pdl: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    stream: cuda.CUstream,
+):
+    frost_qsa_kbar_gather(
+        cache, table, kv_lens, piece_seq, piece_r0, piece_rows, kbar, qpos, counts, seqrep, n_pieces, t_rows, d, elem_bytes, pool, threads_per_cta, use_pdl
+    ).launch(grid=(grid_x, grid_y, 1), block=(threads_per_cta, 1, 1), stream=stream, use_pdl=use_pdl)
+
+
+compiled_cache = {}
+
+
+class QsaKbarGatherRecipe(NamedTuple):
+    """Build-time facts of one gather launch -- the cache dtype, the head dim, the pool, the CTA shape, PDL (Rule 4: one artifact per
+    (dtype, d, pool, threads, use_pdl, device)); the batch, the reach, the page geometry, the chunk rows and the piece count ride in
+    as runtime shapes / scalars."""
+
+    compiled: object
+    dtype: object  # the cache's torch dtype (bf16 / f16 / float8_e4m3fn): a compile key, the runner refuses any other
+    d: int
+    elem_bytes: int
+    pool: int
+    groups_per_cta: int
+    threads_per_cta: int
+    use_pdl: bool
+    device: int = -1  # appended: the CUDA device the artifact was compiled for (part of its key); the launch selects it, operands elsewhere are refused
+
+
+def _fake_i32_vec(n):
+    """``[n]`` contiguous int32 with a symbolic (or given) length, 4-byte aligned (a slice of a wider vector binds)."""
+    return cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(cutlass.Int32, (n,), stride_order=(0,), assumed_align=4)
+
+
+def compile_qsa_kbar_gather(
+    *, dtype, d: int = 128, pool: int = DEFAULT_POOL, threads_per_cta: int = DEFAULT_THREADS_PER_CTA, use_pdl: bool = False
+) -> QsaKbarGatherRecipe:
+    """Build from SHAPES ALONE -- no allocation, no launch.  ``dtype`` is the compressed-key cache's (bf16 / f16 / float8_e4m3fn: the
+    bit copy serves every width; ``ix_kbar`` takes the same dtype); the DSL floor is gated first (Rule 7).  Every ``Constexpr`` is in
+    the persistent key, nothing bound at execute is."""
+    global _FAKE_STREAM
+    too_old = cutedsl_requirement_error("qsa_kbar_gather")
+    if too_old is not None:
+        raise NotImplementedError(too_old)
+    if dtype not in _CACHE_DTYPES:
+        raise ValueError(f"the compressed-key cache holds bf16 / f16 or torch.float8_e4m3fn rows, got {dtype}")
+    elem_bytes = 1 if dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn else 2
+    validate_gather_shape(d, elem_bytes, pool, threads_per_cta)
+    if _FAKE_STREAM is None:
+        from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+        _FAKE_STREAM = make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=False)
+    key = (str(dtype), int(d), int(pool), int(threads_per_cta), bool(use_pdl), current_device())
+    if key not in compiled_cache:
+        # The dict is the in-process memo; behind it sits the persistent compiled-plan cache (``cudnn.frost.compiled_cache``), keyed by
+        # this file's digest + the dict key's plain values: a second process reloads the object instead of re-tracing.
+        cache_key = template_key(globals(), {"key": key}, "compile_qsa_kbar_gather")
+        batch = cute.sym_int()
+        npc = cute.sym_int()
+        with torch.cuda.device(key[-1]):  # the compile and the DSL's load of the launchable run ON the artifact's device (the recipe's), whichever
+            compiled_cache[key] = compile_cached(  # device is live -- a build_device() scope names a device the live context need not be
+                qsa_kbar_gather_launch,
+                _fake_paged_state(dtype, d),
+                _fake_i32_table((batch, cute.sym_int()), (cute.sym_int(), 1)),
+                _fake_i32_vec(batch),
+                _fake_i32_vec(npc),
+                _fake_i32_vec(npc),
+                _fake_i32_vec(npc),
+                _fake_compact(dtype, (batch, cute.sym_int(), d), (2, 1, 0)),
+                _fake_i32_vec(npc),
+                _fake_i32_vec(cute.sym_int()),
+                _fake_i32_vec(batch),
+                cutlass.Int32(0),  # n_pieces ) runtime; the zeros pin the TYPE only
+                cutlass.Int32(1),  # t_rows   )
+                cutlass.Int32(1),  # grid_x   )
+                cutlass.Int32(1),  # grid_y   )
+                int(d),
+                int(elem_bytes),
+                int(pool),
+                int(threads_per_cta),
+                bool(use_pdl),
+                _FAKE_STREAM,
+                options="--enable-tvm-ffi",
+                cache_key=cache_key,
+                symbol="cudnn_block_qsa_kbar_gather",
+            )
+    return QsaKbarGatherRecipe(
+        compiled=compiled_cache[key],
+        dtype=dtype,
+        d=int(d),
+        elem_bytes=int(elem_bytes),
+        pool=int(pool),
+        groups_per_cta=threads_per_cta // ((d * elem_bytes) // ACCESS_BYTES),
+        threads_per_cta=int(threads_per_cta),
+        use_pdl=bool(use_pdl),
+        device=key[-1],
+    )
+
+
+def _check_i32(name: str, x, n: int, device) -> None:
+    _check_int32_vector(name, x, (n,))
+    if x.device != device:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must live on {device} with the cache, got {x.device}")
+
+
+def run_qsa_kbar_gather(
+    r: QsaKbarGatherRecipe,
+    index_kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    piece_seq: torch.Tensor,
+    piece_r0: torch.Tensor,
+    piece_rows: torch.Tensor,
+    ix_kbar: torch.Tensor,
+    ix_qpos: torch.Tensor,
+    ix_counts: torch.Tensor,
+    ix_seqrep: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    t_rows: int,
+    stream,
+) -> None:
+    """Launch.  Form checks only (no device read, no allocation): ``index_kv_cache [num_pages >= 1, rpp >= 1, 1, D]`` in the recipe's
+    dtype (an e4m3 cache under a 16-bit recipe and the converse are refused naming the recipe's), ``block_table [B, max_pages]`` int32
+    with unit column stride, ``kv_lens [B]`` int32, the piece table (three ``[n_pieces >= 1]`` int32 vectors), ``ix_kbar [B, NB, D]``
+    contiguous in the recipe's dtype with ``1 <= NB <= max_pages x rpp`` (the table's reach), ``ix_qpos [n_pieces]``, ``ix_counts [B x
+    T]`` (or ``[B, T]`` contiguous), ``ix_seqrep [B]`` int32; ``1 <= T <= POOL x NB`` -- a chunk longer than the table's reach is refused
+    naming the two numbers (the clamp's precondition, module docstring).  Every operand on the cache's device."""
+    if not isinstance(index_kv_cache, torch.Tensor) or index_kv_cache.dim() != 4:
+        raise ValueError(f"index_kv_cache must be a 4-D [num_pages, P / pool, 1, D={r.d}] paged compressed-key cache, got {type(index_kv_cache).__name__}")
+    c = index_kv_cache
+    if c.dtype != r.dtype:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"index_kv_cache is {c.dtype} but this artifact gathers a {r.dtype} cache (the recipe's dtype); compile the matching recipe -- no silent cast"
+        )
+    if int(c.shape[0]) < 1 or int(c.shape[1]) < 1 or int(c.shape[2]) != 1 or int(c.shape[3]) != r.d:
+        raise ValueError(f"index_kv_cache must be [num_pages >= 1, P / pool >= 1, 1, D={r.d}], got shape {tuple(c.shape)}")
+    if not c.is_cuda:
+        raise ValueError(f"index_kv_cache must be a CUDA tensor (the kernel reads every operand through a device pointer), got device {c.device}")
+    _check_row_tensor("index_kv_cache", c, dtype=r.dtype, last_dim=r.d)
+    dev = c.device
+    if not isinstance(block_table, torch.Tensor) or block_table.device != dev:
+        raise ValueError(f"block_table must be a [B, max_pages] int32 tensor on {dev}")
+    batch = int(block_table.shape[0]) if block_table.dim() == 2 else 0
+    check_block_table("block_table", block_table, batch=batch)
+    if batch < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"block_table must hold at least one sequence, got shape {tuple(block_table.shape)}")

+padded dense SDPA (one "batch" per item, the item's query-head group as the packed Q rows, ``seq_len_kv = kv_len_t``).

+token ``s`` of sequence ``b`` -- and the kernel writes, per item and per operand (K then V), the item's VISIBLE key rows
+compacted to the front of a ``[ROWS, D]`` bf16 slab plus ``kv_len_t[item]`` = the number of rows written; every row from
+``kv_len_t`` to the end of the slab is ZERO (the default; ``zero_fill="tile"`` zeroes only up to the next 128-row tile, the
+dense core's KV tile, since the core reads nothing past it).  Dequantization is ``bf16(fp32(e4m3) * scale)`` with
+``k_scale`` / ``v_scale`` fp32 device scalars MULTIPLIED IN (vLLM folds ``k_scale`` into the softmax scale and ``v_scale``
+into the output normalizer; here the core sees plain values), one fp32 rounding -- bitwise ``(pool.float() * scale).bfloat16()``.

+class QsaKvUpcastRecipe(NamedTuple):
+    """Build-time facts of one artifact (Rule 4: one artifact per (H_kv, top_k, page_size, list form, block_lens presence,
+    zero-fill mode)); the batch, the query count, the pool capacity and every stride ride in at runtime."""
+
+    compiled: object
+    h_kv: int
+    top_k: int
+    page_size: int
+    list_per_sequence: bool
+    has_block_lens: bool
+    zero_fill: str
+    sm_count: int
+    device: int

+def scratch_shape(n_items: int):
+    """The scratch the kernel fills: ``[items, 2 (K, V), ROWS, D]`` bf16 -- ``scratch[:, 0]`` / ``scratch[:, 1]`` are the
+    ``out_k`` / ``out_v`` operands (their item stride ``2 x ROWS x D``, row stride ``D``)."""
+    return (int(n_items), 2, ROWS, D)
+
+
+def scratch_bytes(n_items: int) -> int:
+    return 2 * int(n_items) * 2 * ROWS * D
+
+
+def dense_core_views(scratch: torch.Tensor, kv_len_t: torch.Tensor):
+    """The views the bf16 d256 DECODE tile consumes over the scratch as a plain PADDED dense SDPA: K / V as ``[items, H_kv' = 1,
+    ROWS, D]`` (BHSD dims over the scratch's storage) and ``seq_len_kv = kv_len_t`` as ``[items, 1, 1, 1]``; the matching Q is
+    :func:`q_items_view`.  Pure views: nothing is copied."""
+    n_items = int(scratch.shape[0])
+    if tuple(scratch.shape) != scratch_shape(n_items) or scratch.dtype != _OUT_DTYPE:
+        raise ValueError(f"scratch must be {scratch_shape(n_items)} bf16, got {tuple(scratch.shape)} {scratch.dtype}")
+    if tuple(kv_len_t.shape) != (n_items,) or kv_len_t.dtype != torch.int32:
+        raise ValueError(f"kv_len_t must be int32 [{n_items}], got {tuple(kv_len_t.shape)} {kv_len_t.dtype}")
+    return scratch[:, 0].unsqueeze(1), scratch[:, 1].unsqueeze(1), kv_len_t.view(n_items, 1, 1, 1)
+
+
+def q_items_view(q: torch.Tensor, h_kv: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``q [B, S_q, H_q, D]`` (heads contiguous within a token) as the per-item packed query group ``[items, G, 1, D]``
+    (BHSD dims: ``S_q' = 1`` row, the ``G = H_q / H_kv`` heads of the item's KV head) -- a view when the token stride is
+    ``H_q x D``, a copy otherwise (``reshape``)."""
+    B, S_q, H_q, d = (int(x) for x in q.shape)
+    if d != D or H_q % h_kv:
+        raise ValueError(f"q must be [B, S_q, H_q = k x {h_kv}, {D}], got {tuple(q.shape)}")
+    return q.reshape(B * S_q * h_kv, H_q // h_kv, D).unsqueeze(2)
+
+
+def items_to_rows(o_items: torch.Tensor, B: int, S_q: int, H_q: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The dense core's O ``[items, G, 1, D]`` back to ``[B, S_q, H_q, D]``."""
+    return o_items.reshape(B, S_q, H_q, D)

+def _fake_pool(h_kv: int, page_size: int):
+    from cudnn.datatypes import _convert_to_cutlass_data_type

+    return cute.runtime.make_fake_tensor(

+        stride=(cute.sym_int(), cute.sym_int(), cute.sym_int(), 1),
+        assumed_align=16,

+
+def _fake_out():

+def _fake_i32_2d(cols):

+
+
+def _fake_i32_1d():

+
+def _fake_f32_scalar():

+def dsl_decline_reason(device: Optional[int] = None) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Rule 7 / the arch gate: None when this device and DSL can build the kernel, else the typed reason.  The kernel is
+    bound to the Rubin line (``mul.f32x2`` / ``cvt.rn.bf16x2.e4m3x2`` are sm_100+ instructions; the block targets cc 10.7)
+    and the DSL must know the ``sm_107a`` target (the public 4.8.0 wheel)."""
+    from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_arch_requirement_error
+
+    dev = current_device() if device is None else int(device)
+    cc = compute_capability(dev)
+    if not (10, 7) <= cc <= (11, 9):
+        return f"qsa_kv_upcast targets the Rubin line (cc 10.7 .. 11.9); this device is cc {cc[0]}.{cc[1]}"
+    return cutedsl_arch_requirement_error(cc)
+

+def validate_params(*, h_kv: int, top_k: int, page_size: int, zero_fill: str) -> None:
+    """The compile-key facts, typed; never an assert."""
+    _validate_geometry()
+    if int(h_kv) < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"h_kv must be >= 1, got {h_kv}")
+    if not (TOPK_MIN <= int(top_k) <= TOPK_MAX) or int(top_k) % BLOCK_SIZE:
+        raise ValueError(f"top_k must be a multiple of {BLOCK_SIZE} in [{TOPK_MIN}, {TOPK_MAX}], got {top_k}")
+    if int(page_size) < BLOCK_SIZE or int(page_size) % BLOCK_SIZE:
+        raise ValueError(f"page_size must be a positive multiple of {BLOCK_SIZE} (a 4-token block never straddles a page), got {page_size}")
+    if zero_fill not in ZERO_FILL_MODES:
+        raise ValueError(f"zero_fill must be one of {ZERO_FILL_MODES}, got {zero_fill!r}")
+
+
+def compile_qsa_kv_upcast(
+    *,
+    h_kv: int,
+    top_k: int,
+    page_size: int,
+    list_per_sequence: bool,
+    has_block_lens: bool,
+    zero_fill: str = "full",
+    use_pdl: bool = False,
+    device: Optional[int] = None,
+) -> QsaKvUpcastRecipe:
+    """Build from SHAPES ALONE (no allocation, no launch).  The DSL / arch gate runs BEFORE the compile (Rule 7): a decline
+    is a ``NotImplementedError`` naming the device and the DSL, never a ``KeyError`` from inside the DSL."""
+    global _FAKE_STREAM
+    validate_params(h_kv=h_kv, top_k=top_k, page_size=page_size, zero_fill=zero_fill)
+    dev = current_device() if device is None else int(device)
+    why = dsl_decline_reason(dev)
+    if why is not None:
+        raise NotImplementedError(why)
+    if _FAKE_STREAM is None:
+        from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+        _FAKE_STREAM = make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=False)
+    key = (int(h_kv), int(top_k), int(page_size), bool(list_per_sequence), bool(has_block_lens), str(zero_fill), bool(use_pdl), dev)
+    if key not in compiled_cache:
+        compiled_cache[key] = cute.compile(
+            qsa_kv_upcast_launch,
+            _fake_pool(h_kv, page_size),
+            _fake_pool(h_kv, page_size),
+            _fake_i32_2d(cute.sym_int()),  # the table: [B, max_pages], both symbolic
+            _fake_i32_2d(int(top_k)),  # the lists: [rows, top_k]
+            _fake_i32_1d() if has_block_lens else None,
+            _fake_i32_1d(),  # kv_lens
+            _fake_f32_scalar(),
+            _fake_f32_scalar(),
+            _fake_out(),
+            _fake_out(),
+            _fake_i32_1d(),  # kv_len_t
+            cutlass.Int32(0),  # n_units  ) runtime; the zeros pin the TYPE only
+            cutlass.Int32(0),  # n_ctas   )
+            cutlass.Int32(0),  # s_q      )
+            int(h_kv),
+            int(top_k),
+            int(page_size),
+            bool(list_per_sequence),
+            zero_fill == "full",
+            bool(use_pdl),
+            _FAKE_STREAM,
+            options="--enable-tvm-ffi",
+        )
+    return QsaKvUpcastRecipe(
+        compiled=compiled_cache[key],
+        h_kv=int(h_kv),
+        top_k=int(top_k),
+        page_size=int(page_size),
+        list_per_sequence=bool(list_per_sequence),
+        has_block_lens=bool(has_block_lens),
+        zero_fill=str(zero_fill),
+        sm_count=multiprocessor_count(dev),
+        device=dev,
+    )

+def _check_i32(t, name, shape, *, device):
+    if not isinstance(t, torch.Tensor) or t.dtype != torch.int32:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be an int32 tensor of shape {shape}, got {getattr(t, 'dtype', type(t).__name__)}")
+    if tuple(int(x) for x in t.shape) != tuple(shape):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must have shape {shape}, got {tuple(t.shape)}")
+    if not t.is_contiguous():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be contiguous, got strides {tuple(t.stride())}")
+    if t.device != device:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must live on {device}, got {t.device}")
+

+def check_pool(pool: torch.Tensor, name: str, *, h_kv: int, page_size: int, device) -> None:
+    """One e4m3 pool against the kernel's contract (no device read): ``[num_pages >= 1, H_kv, page_size, D]`` with ``D``
+    contiguous, every other stride a whole number of 16-byte vectors, a 16-byte aligned base.  e5m2 is declined BY NAME
+    (``NotImplementedError``): the block's fp8 KV cache is e4m3 (the serving stacks' ``fp8`` = e4m3fn)."""
+    if not isinstance(pool, torch.Tensor):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a [num_pages, {h_kv}, {page_size}, {D}] e4m3 tensor, got {type(pool).__name__}")
+    if pool.dtype == torch.float8_e5m2:
+        raise NotImplementedError(f"{name} is e5m2: qsa_kv_upcast serves e4m3 (float8_e4m3fn) pools only")
+    if pool.dtype != _POOL_DTYPE:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be {_POOL_DTYPE} (the e4m3 KV cache), got {pool.dtype}")
+    if pool.dim() != 4 or tuple(int(x) for x in pool.shape[1:]) != (h_kv, page_size, D) or int(pool.shape[0]) < 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} must be [num_pages >= 1, H_kv={h_kv}, page_size={page_size}, D={D}] (HND compact, or NHD by strides), got {tuple(pool.shape)}"
+        )
+    strides = tuple(int(s) for s in pool.stride())
+    if strides[3] != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be contiguous along D, got strides {strides}")
+    for ax, st in enumerate(strides[:3]):
+        if st % 16:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} stride[{ax}] = {st} bytes must be a multiple of 16 (rows are read in 16-byte vectors)")
+    if pool.data_ptr() % 16:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 16-byte aligned, got data_ptr={pool.data_ptr():#x}")
+    if pool.device != device:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must live on {device}, got {pool.device}")

+
+def check_out(out: torch.Tensor, name: str, *, n_items: int, device) -> None:
+    """One bf16 output slab ``[items, ROWS, D]`` with ``D`` contiguous and 16-byte-aligned item / row strides."""
+    if not isinstance(out, torch.Tensor) or out.dtype != _OUT_DTYPE:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a bf16 [{n_items}, {ROWS}, {D}] tensor, got {getattr(out, 'dtype', type(out).__name__)}")
+    if tuple(int(x) for x in out.shape) != (n_items, ROWS, D):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be [{n_items}, {ROWS}, {D}], got {tuple(out.shape)}")
+    strides = tuple(int(s) for s in out.stride())
+    if strides[2] != 1 or (strides[0] * 2) % 16 or (strides[1] * 2) % 16 or strides[1] < D:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must have D contiguous and 16-byte-aligned item / row strides (row stride >= {D}), got {strides}")
+    if out.data_ptr() % 16:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 16-byte aligned, got data_ptr={out.data_ptr():#x}")
+    if out.device != device:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must live on {device}, got {out.device}")
+

+def n_units_of(n_items: int) -> int:
+    return int(n_items) * UNITS_PER_ITEM
+
+
+def n_ctas_of(n_units: int, sm_count: int) -> int:
+    """The persistent grid: the device's cap (``SMs x CTAS_PER_SM``), never more than the units, at least one."""
+    return max(1, min(int(n_units), int(sm_count) * CTAS_PER_SM))

+def run_qsa_kv_upcast(
+    r: QsaKvUpcastRecipe,
+    *,
+    k_pool: torch.Tensor,
+    v_pool: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    block_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    block_lens: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    seq_kv_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    k_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    v_scale: torch.Tensor,

+    out_v: torch.Tensor,

+

+    it) or ``[B, S_q, top_k]`` per token; ``block_lens`` ``[B]`` / ``[B, S_q]`` int32 or None (its presence is the artifact's);
+    ``seq_kv_lens`` int32 ``[B]``; ``k_scale`` / ``v_scale`` 1-element fp32 CUDA tensors; ``out_k`` / ``out_v`` bf16
+    ``[B x S_q x H_kv, ROWS, D]`` (``scratch[:, 0]`` / ``scratch[:, 1]`` of :func:`scratch_shape`); ``kv_len_t`` int32
+    ``[B x S_q x H_kv]``."""
+    dev = k_pool.device if isinstance(k_pool, torch.Tensor) else torch.device("cuda")
+    check_pool(k_pool, "k_pool", h_kv=r.h_kv, page_size=r.page_size, device=dev)
+    check_pool(v_pool, "v_pool", h_kv=r.h_kv, page_size=r.page_size, device=dev)
+    if int(k_pool.shape[0]) != int(v_pool.shape[0]):
+        raise ValueError(f"k_pool and v_pool must hold the same number of pages, got {int(k_pool.shape[0])} and {int(v_pool.shape[0])}")
+    s_q = int(s_q)
+    if s_q < 1 or (r.list_per_sequence and s_q > MTP_MAX_S_Q):
+        raise ValueError(f"s_q must be >= 1 (and <= {MTP_MAX_S_Q} under a shared per-sequence list), got {s_q}")
+    if not isinstance(block_table, torch.Tensor) or block_table.dim() != 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"block_table must be a contiguous int32 (B, max_pages) tensor, got {getattr(block_table, 'shape', type(block_table).__name__)}")
+    B, max_pages = (int(x) for x in block_table.shape)
+    _check_i32(block_table, "block_table", (B, max_pages), device=dev)
+    if max_pages < 1:
+        raise ValueError("block_table must have at least one page column")
+    _check_i32(seq_kv_lens, "seq_kv_lens", (B,), device=dev)
+    rows = B if r.list_per_sequence else B * s_q
+    ids_shape = (B, r.top_k) if r.list_per_sequence else (B, s_q, r.top_k)
+    if not isinstance(block_ids, torch.Tensor) or tuple(int(x) for x in block_ids.shape) not in (ids_shape, (rows, r.top_k)):
+        raise ValueError(f"block_ids must be int32 {ids_shape} (or [{rows}, {r.top_k}]), got {getattr(block_ids, 'shape', type(block_ids).__name__)}")
+    _check_i32(block_ids, "block_ids", tuple(int(x) for x in block_ids.shape), device=dev)
+    if r.has_block_lens != (block_lens is not None):
+        raise ValueError(f"this artifact was compiled {'with' if r.has_block_lens else 'without'} block_lens; the call must match (Rule 1: no silent fallback)")
+    if block_lens is not None:
+        lens_shape = (B,) if r.list_per_sequence else (B, s_q)
+        if tuple(int(x) for x in block_lens.shape) not in (lens_shape, (rows,)):
+            raise ValueError(f"block_lens must be int32 {lens_shape}, got {tuple(block_lens.shape)}")
+        _check_i32(block_lens, "block_lens", tuple(int(x) for x in block_lens.shape), device=dev)
+    for name, sc in (("k_scale", k_scale), ("v_scale", v_scale)):
+        if not isinstance(sc, torch.Tensor) or sc.dtype != torch.float32 or int(sc.numel()) != 1 or sc.device != dev:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 1-element fp32 tensor on {dev} (a device scalar, read by the kernel), got {sc!r}")
+    n_items = B * s_q * r.h_kv
+    check_out(out_k, "out_k", n_items=n_items, device=dev)
+    check_out(out_v, "out_v", n_items=n_items, device=dev)
+    _check_i32(kv_len_t, "kv_len_t", (n_items,), device=dev)
+    n_units = n_units_of(n_items)
+    n_ctas = n_ctas_of(n_units, r.sm_count)

+        k_pool,
+        v_pool,
+        block_table,
+        block_ids.view(rows, r.top_k),  # the artifact's 2-D [rows, top_k] (a view: contiguous)
+        None if block_lens is None else block_lens.view(rows),
+        seq_kv_lens,
+        k_scale,
+        v_scale,
+        out_k,
+        out_v,
+        kv_len_t,
+        cutlass.Int32(n_units),
+        cutlass.Int32(n_ctas),
+        cutlass.Int32(s_q),
+        cuda.CUstream(int(stream)),
+    )
+
+
+def moved_bytes(
+    n_items: int, rows_read_total: int, *, zero_fill: str = "full", rows_written_total: Optional[int] = None, top_k: int = TOPK_MAX, max_pages: int = 0
+) -> int:
+    """The HBM traffic model of one launch for a SOL number: the gathered e4m3 rows read once per operand, the slab rows
+    written once per operand (``full``: every slab row; ``tile``: the written rows rounded up to the 128-row tile), plus the
+    lists and the table.  ``rows_read_total`` = the sum of ``kv_len_t`` over the items (host arithmetic from the caller's
+    own lists; the kernel reads nothing on the host)."""
+    rows_read_total = int(rows_read_total)
+    if zero_fill == "full":
+        written = int(n_items) * ROWS
+    else:
+        written = int(rows_written_total) if rows_written_total is not None else rows_read_total
+    return 2 * rows_read_total * D + 2 * written * D * 2 + int(n_items) * top_k * 4 + int(n_items) * max_pages * 4
+

+"""The fused PREPARE launch of a block-sparse attention step: everything between the projection GEMM and attention in ONE kernel.
+
+A serving step of a block-sparse (``QsaSpec``) layer runs, between the fused ``Q | GATE | K | V | INDEX`` projection and the
+attention core, a chain of small pointwise passes over the step's ``T`` tokens -- four pointwise launches in the block's
+unfused stage list plus two more in the indexer's decode form::
+
+    qk_norm_rope        Q, K: per-head RMSNorm over D, then partial RoPE on [0, rope_dim)         (stages (2)+(3), in place)
+    cache_write (K, V)  the post-RoPE K and the V of every token into the paged pools at slot_mapping     (stage (4w))
+    cache_write (raw)   the band's raw indexer key into ITS pool at the same slots                        (stage (4w), band)
+    qsa_compress, pool 1   the band's indexer QUERIES: RMSNorm over D_i + partial RoPE at the token       (the scorer's q_i)
+    qsa_compress_step   the raw key into the per-sequence RING, the block it completes POOLED,
+                        RMSNormed and rotated at the block START into the compressed-key cache            (the indexer's keys)
+
+This kernel is that chain as ONE launch, row for row and bit for bit: every output is produced by the same fp32 operations
+in the same order as the kernel it replaces (``qk_norm_rope.py``'s ``x * rstd * w`` then ``rope_rotate_half`` for Q / K;
+``qsa_compress.py``'s ``mean -> rstd -> * (w + w_offset) -> RoPE`` for the indexer rows; a bit copy for V, the raw key and
+the ring), so the fused step is BITWISE the unfused one -- a PERFORMANCE knob of the block (``fuse_prepare``), never a
+numerics choice.  The gate split costs nothing here or there: the GATE band is addressed in place by its slab strides.
+
+Work decomposition -- a flat space of WARP UNITS, three arms, every arm warp-uniform::
+
+    [ attention rows: T x H_q Q rows | T x H_kv K rows | T x H_kv V rows ]  ->  one lane group of lanes_per_row(D) lanes per row
+    [ indexer query rows: T x H_i rows of D_i ]                              ->  one lane group of lanes_per_row(D_i) lanes per row
+    [ raw-key rows: T rows of D_i ]                                          ->  one lane group of lanes_per_row(D_i) lanes per row
+
+A warp owns ``32 // lanes_per_row`` consecutive rows of ONE arm (one 256-wide row, or two 128-wide rows), so the branch on
+the arm is uniform across the warp and every ``shfl.sync`` inside an arm is reached by all 32 lanes; a lane group past
+its arm's row count computes on clamped, in-bounds loads and stores nothing (the sibling kernels' tail rule).  Per row: the
+loads first (one ``ld.global.v4`` per lane per 16 elements), the sum of squares reduced across the group by a butterfly shuffle, the
+norm weight and the table rows consumed AFTER the reduction (``qk_norm_rope.py``'s measured register discipline), one
+``st.global.v4`` per destination.  A K row stores the SAME packed words twice -- into the slab (in place) and into the pool
+-- so a pool row IS the row attention consumes; a V row and a raw-key row are bit copies.
+
+**No shared memory, no mbarrier, no TMA, no tcgen05.**  Plain vectorized LDG / STG plus warp shuffles, so the two
+pre-development tables of a FROST kernel (barriers, SMEM buffers) are EMPTY by construction; the shuffles are the only
+cross-lane dependency, inside aligned lane groups of one warp.  Within a launch no row is read after another row writes it:
+Q / K rows are rewritten by their own lane group only (every lane holds its full row before the first store), the raw key
+band is read by the indexer arms and never written, and the ring's writes and reads of one launch never alias (host rule
+``RING >= S_q + pool - 1``, ``qsa_compress.min_ring_rows`` -- the paged ring's ``cap`` is that ``RING``: a completing row reads
+ring positions ``pos0 - pool + 1 .. pos0 - 1``, the step writes ``pos0 .. pos0 + S_q - 1``, disjoint rows of the sequence's one
+block whenever ``cap >= S_q + pool - 1``; the two tables are read, never written).  Runs on any CuTe DSL device.
+
+The arms are TRACED BY PRESENCE (``None`` folds an arm out at trace time, exactly as the weight presence folds the RMSNorm
+out of ``qk_norm_rope``):
+
+* always: Q / K norm + RoPE (RoPE-only when both weights are ``None``), the K / V pool writes at ``slot_mapping``;
+* ``index_k_raw_src`` given: the raw-key arm -- the raw key's pool when ``index_k_raw_pool`` is given, the ring + the
+  compressed-key cache when ``ring`` is given (``pos0`` and the position-indexed tables ``cos_pos`` / ``sin_pos`` come with
+  it; ``n_commit`` optional -- the decode contract of ``qsa_compress.py``'s step form, verbatim);
+* ``index_q_src`` given: the indexer-query arm into ``index_q_out`` with ``w_iq_norm``;
+* ``block_table`` given (``QsaPrepareIndexArms.paged``): the compress arm's PAGED form -- ``ring`` is the stack's ring
+  ``[num_ring_blocks, cap, 1, D_i]`` behind ``index_state_block_table [B, 1]``, ``index_k_compressed`` its compressed-key cache
+  ``[num_pages, P / pool, 1, D_i]`` behind the MAIN ``block_table [B, max_pages]``, and the positions derive in-kernel from
+  ``kv_lens [B]`` (the KV length AFTER the step: ``pos0 = kv_lens - S_q``) in place of ``pos0``, which is refused; the row
+  arithmetic is ``qsa_compress.py``'s (``step_position``, ``ring_row_address``, ``paged_block_row`` -- ONE helper per table,
+  two call sites: the step form and this launch); ``index_state_slot_mapping [T]`` (``ring_slots``) names the ring WRITE
+  rows instead of deriving them (the stack's own slots; bitwise the derived form);
+* ``cos`` / ``sin`` None (``rope_table``): the RoPE-table arm -- the Q / K and the indexer-query rows read ``cos_pos`` /
+  ``sin_pos`` at ``pos0 + j``, bitwise the per-token form, so a serving stack hands the model's position-indexed table once
+  instead of gathering per-token rows every step.  The table is the CEILING on positions, checked IN-KERNEL on the LIVE
+  (device-derived) position of every row, never on the host: a row at ``pos0 + j >= S_pos`` has no rotation, so its Q / K row, its
+  K pool row and its indexer-query row are NOT written and the compress arm reports it ``-2`` (no ring row, no block either; the V
+  row and the raw key are position-free bit copies and are stored as in the per-token form) -- never a silently clamped rotation.
+  The host also refuses BY FORM a table shorter than the positions the compress arm's cache can address (paged: ``max_pages x P``
+  rows, the block table's width times the page; dense: ``NB x pool``), so a conforming stack never meets the ceiling with a position
+  its cache holds, and the in-kernel clamp serves only the dead rows of a padding sequence (whose rotation nothing consumes).
+
+Table forms -- two, because two kinds of position are involved: ``cos`` / ``sin`` ``[T, rope_dim]`` are the attention's own
+PER-TOKEN rows (the block's contract: row ``t`` is token ``t``'s position), read by the Q / K and the indexer-query rows;
+``cos_pos`` / ``sin_pos`` ``[1 or B, S_pos, rope_dim]`` are POSITION-indexed (the step form's contract), read by the compress
+at the block START ``4 * blk`` -- a position of an EARLIER step that the per-token rows do not hold.
+
+Degenerate inputs, each with its handling: a negative slot (padding) writes no pool row and a slot past the pool's capacity
+writes none either (``live``); ``n_commit[b] = 0`` (a finished sequence) writes no ring row and no block, every slot report
+``-1``; ``pos0 < 0`` is clamped to 0; a row completing a block past the cache reports ``-2`` and writes no block; a committed row at a
+position at or past the RoPE table reports ``-2`` and writes nothing at all (the table ceiling, in both forms of the compress arm and in
+the step form); a ragged last warp computes on the last row and stores nothing; a token count below one lane group per arm still launches
+(the host never launches an empty grid: ``T >= 1`` is checked).  The paged form adds (``qsa_compress.py``, "The PAGED decode
+form"): a row at a negative position (``kv_lens[b] < S_q``; a padding sequence has ``kv_lens 0``) is dead -- no ring row, no
+block, slot ``-1`` -- so the null ring block and page 0 are never written for it; a sequence whose state-table entry is ``<= 0``
+or past the ring's blocks owns no ring: it writes no ring row and a block of its that needs ring rows (one starting below
+``pos0``) reports ``-2`` -- the null block's rows are never pooled into a live sequence's block; a completing block past the
+table's width, on a negative page or on a page past the cache reports ``-2``.
+
+The e4m3 STORE arm (``compile_qsa_prepare(index_cache_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)``; the e4m3 compressed-key cache at decode, bf16 io
+only): the indexer-query arm's ``index_q_out`` and the compress arm's ``index_k_compressed`` (dense or paged) are e4m3 -- each row the
+bf16 form's packed words rounded ONCE more by ``cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2.f32`` (``qsa_compress._store_row_chunk_e4m3``: the e4m3 cast OF
+THE bf16 ROW, one ``st.global.v2.b32`` of 8 B per lane), the SAME helper and convention as the step form and the pool-1 compress, so the
+fused launch stays bitwise the unfused chain under the attribute too.  The ring stays the io dtype (a bit copy, never quantized -- an e4m3
+ring is a form error naming that rule); the fp8 ``cvt`` needs sm_89+ (an older part is declined by name at compile time, Rule 7).
+
+The rounding attribute (``QsaPrepareIndexArms.rounding`` in ``INDEX_COMPRESS_ROUNDINGS``; 2026-10-29): the indexer-query arm and the
+compress arm are two of the FOUR kernel sites of the indexer's compress chain (``qsa_compress.py``, "The pooled-mean rounding
+attribute"): ``"single"`` is the chain above unchanged; ``"hf"`` rounds the normed row to the io dtype before its rotation and runs the
+rotation in the io dtype (``rope_rotate_half_io``) on BOTH arms, and rounds the pooled key before its norm on the compress arm (the
+identity on the query arm: ``inv_pool = 1.0`` on an io row).  A compile key through the record; the fused launch stays bitwise the
+unfused twins -- ``compile_qsa_compress(pool=1, rounding=)`` and ``compile_qsa_compress_step(rounding=)`` -- under either value.
+
+Bytes per launch (the roofline term is HBM bytes; no perf claim is made here until one is measured on an exclusive GPU):
+Q and K read once and written once, V read once and written once (the pool), the raw key read up to three times (pool,
+ring, its own block) and written to the pool and the ring, the indexer queries read once and written once, plus the slot
+and the small tables -- :func:`moved_bytes`.

+@cute.jit
+def _step_row_position(mPos0: Optional[cute.Tensor], mKvLens: Optional[cute.Tensor], token: cutlass.Int32, s_q: cutlass.Int32):
+    """The step position of token ``token`` of a ``B x S_q`` step and its sequence, ``(pos0(b) + j, b)`` with ``b = token // S_q``,
+    ``j = token % S_q`` and ``pos0`` from ``kv_lens`` or the ``pos0`` vector exactly as the compress arm derives it

+    is the ceiling on positions -- a row at or past it stores nothing rotated and the compress arm reports it ``-2``)."""

+@cute.jit
+def _rope_row_addrs(
+    mCos: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    mSin: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    mCosPos: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    mSinPos: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    pos: cutlass.Int32,
+    b_t: cutlass.Int32,

+    lane_off: cutlass.Int64,
+    bpe: cutlass.Int64,

+    stores nothing rotated (the arms gate their stores on ``pos < S_pos``) and the compress arm reports it ``-2``, so the clamped
+    row is never consumed; :func:`run_qsa_prepare` also refuses by form a table shorter than the positions the compress arm's cache

+def _check_band(name: str, x: torch.Tensor, *, t: int, h: int, d: int, dtype) -> None:
+    """A ``[T, H, D]`` band view: heads contiguous within a token (strides ``(*, D, 1)``), 16-B aligned rows, the recipe's dtype."""
+    if not isinstance(x, torch.Tensor) or x.dim() != 3 or tuple(int(s) for s in x.shape) != (t, h, d):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a [T={t}, H={h}, D={d}] tensor, got {tuple(x.shape) if isinstance(x, torch.Tensor) else type(x).__name__}")
+    if int(x.stride(2)) != 1 or int(x.stride(1)) != d:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must have contiguous heads (strides (*, {d}, 1)), got {tuple(x.stride())}")
+    _check_row_tensor(name, x, dtype=dtype, last_dim=d)
+
+
+def _given(**kw) -> list:
+    return [nm for nm, x in kw.items() if x is not None]

+    ring, its own block -- ``pool`` rows per completing row, counted as one row per token on average) and written to the

+Degenerate inputs, each with its handling: ``kv_lens[b] == 0`` (a padding sequence) -> every ``pos_t < 0``, ``n_vis = 0``: no
+logits column written, ``counts = block_lens = 0``, no warp of the sequence copies a key (its ``qi`` rows and table words ARE read
+-- valid memory, the round trip that keeps the critical path at two -- and its threads stage the query tile and reach the barrier);
+``kv_lens[b] < S_q`` (a contract violation) -> the rows at a negative position get ``n_vis = 0`` likewise; ``n_vis`` inside a page
+-> the rows past ``n_vis_max`` of a live n-tile read a real row and store nothing (their products stay in their own accumulator
+column); a ``-1`` table entry (or one at or past ``num_pages``) for a VISIBLE block -> the part's copy is zero-filled: logit exactly
+0, still written -- the sparse core's dead-page convention, never an out-of-bounds read; a dead page past ``n_vis_max`` may be
+consulted (its word read, its copy zero-filled or a real page read) and is never stored; fewer than ``top_k`` visible blocks (the
+identity region) -> ``block_lens = n_vis``, the paired top-k lists every visible id ascending then ``-1``; ``n_vis`` past
+``n_blocks_max`` -> clamped to the capacity (the host checks the table's reach ``max_pages x R >= n_blocks_max``; a lane past the
+capacity indexes the table at ``n_blocks_max - 1``).  Refused at the host before any launch: a table narrower than the capacity, a
+page size that is not a power of two (at least 8), ``S_q x next_pow2(H_i)`` past the envelope (``MAX_QUERY_ROWS``), a head dim
+other than 128, a cache whose rows are not contiguous inside a page or whose page stride is 2 GiB or more, misaligned or
+non-unit-stride operands, a mixed dtype pair or one outside ``CACHE_DTYPES`` (bf16 / e4m3), and -- by name, a typed
+``NotImplementedError`` -- the e4m3 pair below sm_89.
+
+Bytes per launch (the SOL denominator): ``sum_b n_vis_max(b) x 256 B`` of compressed rows read once (128 B under the e4m3 arm);
+``sum_t n_vis_t x 4 B`` of logits written; the query tile per live CTA (``m_tiles x 4 KiB``, 2 KiB at e4m3, L2-resident) and one table
+word per page -- ``selection_paged.moved_bytes(..., elem_bytes=)``.
+
+Rule 7: this module imports the DSL at import time like its neighbours, so the documented host entry lives in the DSL-free
+front door ``QSA/selection_paged.py`` -- ``qsa_select_decode_paged_forward`` gates the DSL floor, the ``sm_107a``
+target on cc 10.7 and the radix top-k's cc 9.0 BEFORE importing this module -- and the kernel's host-side facts (the row map,
+the compile-key validator, the knob defaults, the byte model) are defined there and imported here, never the other way round
+at module scope.  :func:`compile_qsa_score_paged`, the kernel-level entry a caller may reach directly, gates the floor and the
+target again BEFORE any compile -- then PDL's cc 9.0, then the ``l2_hint`` arm's compiler floor --, so a too-old DSL reads as a
+version decline there too; the tests skip below the floor.

+L2_HINT_MIN_COMPILER = (13, 4)
+"""The key copies carry the L2 evict-first hint (``cp.async.cg.shared.global.L2::cache_hint`` with a ``createpolicy`` register) only when
+the installed CuTe DSL compiles with CUDA 13.4 or later.  The 13.3 PTX assembler bundled with the public nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.7.0 wheel
+mis-encodes that instruction on sm_90 / sm_100: it builds the policy word and the ring base in two uniform registers and encodes all 16
+hinted ``LDGSTS`` to read two OTHER uniform registers that nothing in the kernel ever writes -- a ``Warp Illegal Instruction Parameter``
+trap (``cudaErrorIllegalInstruction``) at the first key copy; the 12.9 assembler of the wheels' cu12 flavour emits the same encoding (a
+compile-only dump), and the 13.4 assembler of the 4.8.0 wheel's cu13 toolchain encodes the operands it defined; the PTX is identical in
+all three.  So the arm is selected at trace time: below the floor the copies are the plain ``cp.async.cg.shared.global`` (the same bytes
+into the same slots, so the logits are bitwise across the arm).  The version is the DSL's bundled compiler
+(``cutlass.base_dsl.version_info.CUDA_VERSION``, present in both wheels), never the wheel's own number: the DSL binds its cu12 or its
+cu13 flavour by the driver's CUDA major (a 4.8.0 wheel reports 13.4 under a CUDA 13 driver and 12.9 under a CUDA 12 one), and a wheel
+built with a newer toolkit keeps the hint."""
+
+
+def _bundled_cuda_version() -> tuple:
+    """``(major, minor)`` of the CUDA toolkit the installed CuTe DSL compiles with (its bundled ptxas: the cu12 or the cu13 flavour the
+    DSL bound by the driver's CUDA major), from ``cutlass.base_dsl.version_info.CUDA_VERSION`` -- the ONE seam the ``l2_hint`` arm reads
+    (``torch.version.cuda``, ``CUDA_HOME`` and the wheel's own number do not identify the DSL's compiler; Rule 7); the tests model a
+    compiler by patching this function."""
+    from cutlass.base_dsl.version_info import CUDA_VERSION
+
+    return (int(CUDA_VERSION.major), int(CUDA_VERSION.minor))
+
+
+def l2_hint_available() -> bool:
+    """Whether this DSL's compiler serves the hinted key copies (``L2_HINT_MIN_COMPILER``): the arm ``l2_hint=None`` resolves to."""
+    return tuple(_bundled_cuda_version()) >= L2_HINT_MIN_COMPILER
+
+
+def l2_hint_requirement_error() -> Optional[str]:
+    """The typed reason ``l2_hint=True`` is refused on this DSL (Rule 7), else None: the floor, the defect as OBSERVED (the 13.3 assembler
+    of the public 4.7.0 cu13 wheel natively, the cu12 flavour's 12.9 assembler in a compile-only dump -- never the found version by
+    interpolation), the installed wheel with the compiler it found, and the remedy -- the cu13 flavour of 4.8.0 or later under a CUDA 13
+    driver, not a bare wheel upgrade: a 4.8.0 wheel bound to its cu12 flavour already is the wheel."""
+    cuda = tuple(_bundled_cuda_version())
+    if cuda >= L2_HINT_MIN_COMPILER:
+        return None
+    _, version = cutedsl_state()
+    wheel = "an unknown nvidia-cutlass-dsl build" if version is None else " ".join(version)
+    need = ".".join(str(x) for x in L2_HINT_MIN_COMPILER)
+    return (
+        f"qsa_score_paged with l2_hint=True (the L2 evict-first hint on the key copies: cp.async.cg.shared.global.L2::cache_hint with a "
+        f"createpolicy register) needs a CuTe DSL whose bundled CUDA compiler is {need} or later; below that floor the hint is not served: "
+        f"the 13.3 PTX assembler of the public nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.7.0 cu13 wheel mis-encodes those copies' uniform operands on sm_90 / "
+        f"sm_100 (an illegal-instruction trap at the first key copy) and the cu12 flavour's 12.9 assembler emits the same encoding. The "
+        f"installed {wheel} compiles with CUDA {cuda[0]}.{cuda[1]} -- use l2_hint=None or False (the plain copies: the same function) there, "
+        f"or install 'nvidia-cutlass-dsl[cu13]>=4.8.0' and run under a CUDA 13 compatible driver (the DSL binds its cu13 toolchain only there)"
+    )
+
+
+def _resolve_l2_hint(l2_hint: Optional[bool]) -> bool:
+    """The arm an artifact is built with: ``None`` follows the compiler (:func:`l2_hint_available`), ``False`` is the plain copy on every
+    DSL, ``True`` the hinted copy -- or, below the floor, the typed decline."""
+    if l2_hint is None:
+        return l2_hint_available()
+    if l2_hint:
+        why = l2_hint_requirement_error()
+        if why is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError(why)
+        return True
+    return False

+@cute.jit
+def _page_word(tb_row: cutlass.Int64, k: cutlass.Int32, n_blocks_max: cutlass.Int32, rows_per_page: cutlass.Constexpr[int]) -> cutlass.Int32:
+    """The table word of compressed row ``k`` (a row past the capacity indexes a real word: ``n_blocks_max - 1``)."""
+    kc = k if k < n_blocks_max else n_blocks_max - cutlass.Int32(1)
+    pg = kc >> cutlass.Int32(rows_per_page.bit_length() - 1)
+    return ld_global(tb_row + pg.to(cutlass.Int64) * cutlass.Int64(4), cutlass.Int32)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _mul_wide_s32(a: cutlass.Int32, b: cutlass.Int32) -> cutlass.Int64:
+    """``mul.wide.s32``: one IMAD.WIDE for a 32 x 32 -> 64-bit product (a page index x a page stride in bytes)."""
+    return inline_ptx("mul.wide.s32 $0, $1, $2;", write_only_types=[cutlass.Int64], read_only_args=[a, b])
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _copy_ntile(
+    dst_lane: cutlass.Int64,
+    src_lane_off: cutlass.Int32,
+    kb_base: cutlass.Int64,
+    kb_page_bytes: cutlass.Int32,
+    word: cutlass.Int32,
+    num_pages: cutlass.Int32,
+    k_tile0: cutlass.Int32,
+    policy: cutlass.Int64,
+    rows_per_page: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    rb: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    lane_row: cutlass.Int32,
+    l2_hint: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+):
+    """The n-tile's 8 compressed rows into one ring slot, PAGE PART by page part (``min(R, 8)`` rows of one page): per part ONE
+    shuffle (the part's table word from the lane that read it -- a constant source lane), one validity check, one ``mul.wide``
+    page address; then ``rows / rows_pi`` ``cp.async.cg`` of 16 B per lane at immediate offsets -- ``rows_pi = 512 / rb`` rows per
+    instruction: at bf16 (``rb`` 256) instruction ``e`` copies rows ``2 e`` (lanes 0-15) and ``2 e + 1`` (lanes 16-31), each row's two 128-B
+    halves by eight consecutive lanes (whole lines per request); at e4m3 (``rb`` 128) rows ``4 e .. 4 e + 3`` (lane ``l`` -> row ``4 e + (l
+    >> 3)``, granule ``l & 7``), one 128-B line per eight lanes.  When a part is SMALLER than one instruction (e4m3 at page 8: ``R = 2``,
+    two parts per 4-row instruction) each lane's part and its table word are PER LANE (``shfl.sync.idx`` from its own source lane), as
+    are the validity check and the page address; ``lane_row`` (a lane's row within an instruction, ``0 .. rows_pi - 1``) selects them.
+    A part on a ``-1`` / out-of-range page is ZERO-FILLED (``src-size 0``: nothing of the cache is read; the address is page 0, a
+    real row, either way).  A row at or past the visible count or the capacity reads a real row (its table word was clamped to
+    the capacity) and is never stored: its products stay in its own accumulator column.  ``l2_hint`` picks the copy's form (the module
+    docstring's arm): the ``.L2::cache_hint`` copy carrying ``policy``, or the plain copy, which takes no policy operand."""
+    rows_pi = (32 * _CHUNK_BYTES) // rb  # rows per copy instruction: 2 (bf16) / 4 (e4m3)
+    rows_pp = min(rows_per_page, KEYS_PER_NTILE)
+    zero_i = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(rows_pp >= rows_pi):
+        for part in cutlass.range_constexpr(KEYS_PER_NTILE // rows_pp):
+            w = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(word, 4 * part * rows_pp)  # the word of the part's first row sits in lanes 4 r .. 4 r + 3
+            ok = (w >= zero_i) & (w < num_pages)
+            page_c = w if ok else zero_i
+            size = cutlass.Int32(_CHUNK_BYTES) if ok else zero_i
+            row_off = ((k_tile0 + cutlass.Int32(part * rows_pp)) & cutlass.Int32(rows_per_page - 1)) * cutlass.Int32(rb)  # the part's first row inside its page
+            src = kb_base + _mul_wide_s32(page_c, kb_page_bytes) + (row_off + src_lane_off).to(cutlass.Int64)
+            dst = dst_lane + cutlass.Int64(part * rows_pp * rb)
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(rows_pp // rows_pi):
+                # every cp.async gets its OWN address registers (an opaque offset, never base + immediate): four back-to-back LDGSTS on one
+                # base register serialised on the register scoreboard under HBM latency (2x at B 32 x 128K, measured 2026-10-21)
+                off_e = opaque_i32(cutlass.Int32(e * rows_pi * rb)).to(cutlass.Int64)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(l2_hint):
+                    inline_ptx(
+                        "cp.async.cg.shared.global.L2::cache_hint [$0], [$1], 16, $2, $3;",
+                        write_only_types=[],
+                        read_only_args=[dst + off_e, src + off_e, size, policy],
+                    )
+                else:
+                    inline_ptx("cp.async.cg.shared.global [$0], [$1], 16, $2;", write_only_types=[], read_only_args=[dst + off_e, src + off_e, size])
+    else:
+        # several page parts per copy instruction (the e4m3 arm at page 8: R = 2, two 2-row parts per 4-row instruction): each lane's part
+        # = e x parts_pi + lane_row / rows_pp, its table word from the per-lane source lane 4 x rows_pp x part (every lane shuffles: the
+        # collective is warp-uniform, only the SOURCE is per lane), the check and the page address per lane
+        parts_pi = rows_pi // rows_pp
+        for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(KEYS_PER_NTILE // rows_pi):
+            part = cutlass.Int32(e * parts_pi) + (lane_row >> cutlass.Int32(rows_pp.bit_length() - 1))
+            w = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(word, part * cutlass.Int32(4 * rows_pp))
+            ok = (w >= zero_i) & (w < num_pages)
+            page_c = w if ok else zero_i
+            size = cutlass.Int32(_CHUNK_BYTES) if ok else zero_i
+            row_off = ((k_tile0 + part * cutlass.Int32(rows_pp)) & cutlass.Int32(rows_per_page - 1)) * cutlass.Int32(rb)
+            src = kb_base + _mul_wide_s32(page_c, kb_page_bytes) + (row_off + src_lane_off).to(cutlass.Int64)
+            off_e = opaque_i32(cutlass.Int32(e * rows_pi * rb)).to(cutlass.Int64)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(l2_hint):
+                inline_ptx(
+                    "cp.async.cg.shared.global.L2::cache_hint [$0], [$1], 16, $2, $3;",
+                    write_only_types=[],
+                    read_only_args=[dst_lane + off_e, src, size, policy],
+                )
+            else:
+                inline_ptx("cp.async.cg.shared.global [$0], [$1], 16, $2;", write_only_types=[], read_only_args=[dst_lane + off_e, src, size])
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _read_key_frags(sK, slot_elems: cutlass.Int32, g: cutlass.Int32, qd: cutlass.Int32, rb: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    """Lane ``(g, q)``'s B fragments of the n-tile in the ring slot: row ``g``'s granules ``q + 4 j`` (one ``ld.shared.v4`` each,
+    at the swizzled granule ``c ^ (4 x (g & 1))``) -- the 16 words the 8 k-steps consume at bf16 (``rb`` 256), the 8 words the 4
+    k-steps consume at e4m3 (``rb`` 128)."""
+    swz = (g & cutlass.Int32(1)) * cutlass.Int32(4)
+    row = slot_elems + g * cutlass.Int32(rb // 4)
+    out = []
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(rb // _CHUNK_BYTES // 4):
+        c_swz = (qd + cutlass.Int32(4 * j)) ^ swz
+        v = sK.load(row + c_swz * cutlass.Int32(_WORDS_PER_CHUNK), vector_size=4, alignment=16).to_elements()
+        for x in cutlass.range_constexpr(_WORDS_PER_CHUNK):
+            out.append(v[x])
+    return tuple(out)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _copy_query_tile(
+    sA_tile: cutlass.Int64,
+    q_base: cutlass.Int64,
+    q_s0: cutlass.Int64,
+    q_s1: cutlass.Int64,
+    t0: cutlass.Int32,
+    tidx: cutlass.Int32,
+    t: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    s_q: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    h_i: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    rb: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    """m-tile ``t`` of the padded (s, h) query tile into the CTA's SMEM staging: 16 rows x ``rb`` B by the 128 threads -- at bf16
+    (``rb`` 256) two ``cp.async.cg`` instructions (thread ``tidx`` copies granule ``tidx % 16`` of rows ``tidx / 16`` and ``8 + tidx / 16``:
+    sixteen consecutive lanes per row, whole lines), at e4m3 (``rb`` 128) ONE (granule ``tidx & 7`` of row ``tidx >> 3``: eight lanes per
+    128-B row); a padding row (``h >= H_i`` inside the power of two, ``s >= S_q``) is ZERO-FILLED (``src-size 0``; its address is a real
+    row).  The destination granule is ``c ^ (4 x (row & 1))``, the fragment reads' swizzle."""
+    rm = query_row_map(s_q, h_i)
+    zero_i = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    s_q_i = cutlass.Int32(s_q)
+    h_i_i = cutlass.Int32(h_i)
+    bpe = rb // INDEX_HEAD_DIM  # 2 / 1
+    granules = rb // _CHUNK_BYTES  # granules per row: 16 / 8
+    rows_per_pass = THREADS // granules  # rows the 128 threads cover per instruction: 8 / 16
+    c = tidx & cutlass.Int32(granules - 1)
+    g_pass = tidx >> cutlass.Int32(granules.bit_length() - 1)  # the row within the pass: 0 .. rows_per_pass - 1
+    for p in cutlass.range_constexpr(MMA_M // rows_per_pass):
+        r = cutlass.Int32(p * rows_per_pass) + g_pass  # the padded row 0..15
+        g = r & cutlass.Int32(7)  # the g row of the fragment layout (rows g / g + 8)
+        half = r >> cutlass.Int32(3)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(rm.tile_rows == 1):
+            s_row = cutlass.Int32(t * rm.queries_per_tile) + r
+            h_row = zero_i
+        else:
+            s_row = cutlass.Int32((t // rm.tiles_per_query) * rm.queries_per_tile) + (g >> cutlass.Int32(rm.stages))
+            h_row = cutlass.Int32(16 * (t % rm.tiles_per_query)) + half + (g & cutlass.Int32(rm.group - 1)) * cutlass.Int32(2)
+        valid = (s_row < s_q_i) & (h_row < h_i_i)
+        s_c = s_row if s_row < s_q_i else s_q_i - cutlass.Int32(1)
+        h_c = h_row if h_row < h_i_i else h_i_i - cutlass.Int32(1)
+        src = (
+            q_base
+            + ((t0 + s_c).to(cutlass.Int64) * q_s0 + h_c.to(cutlass.Int64) * q_s1) * cutlass.Int64(bpe)
+            + c.to(cutlass.Int64) * cutlass.Int64(_CHUNK_BYTES)
+        )
+        dst = sA_tile + (r * cutlass.Int32(rb) + (c ^ ((r & cutlass.Int32(1)) * cutlass.Int32(4))) * cutlass.Int32(_CHUNK_BYTES)).to(cutlass.Int64)
+        size = cutlass.Int32(_CHUNK_BYTES) if valid else zero_i
+        inline_ptx("cp.async.cg.shared.global [$0], [$1], 16, $2;", write_only_types=[], read_only_args=[dst, src, size])
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _read_query_frags(sA, tile_elems: cutlass.Int32, g: cutlass.Int32, qd: cutlass.Int32, half: cutlass.Constexpr[int], rb: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    """Lane ``(g, q)``'s A fragments of one half (rows ``g`` / ``g + 8``) of an m-tile: granules ``q + 4 j`` of the row (one
+    ``ld.shared.v4`` each at the swizzled granule ``c ^ (4 x (row & 1))``) -- the 16 words the 8 k-steps consume at bf16, the 8 words
+    the 4 k-steps consume at e4m3."""
+    row = cutlass.Int32(half * 8) + g
+    swz = (row & cutlass.Int32(1)) * cutlass.Int32(4)
+    base = tile_elems + row * cutlass.Int32(rb // 4)
+    out = []
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(rb // _CHUNK_BYTES // 4):
+        c_swz = (qd + cutlass.Int32(4 * j)) ^ swz
+        v = sA.load(base + c_swz * cutlass.Int32(_WORDS_PER_CHUNK), vector_size=4, alignment=16).to_elements()
+        for x in cutlass.range_constexpr(_WORDS_PER_CHUNK):
+            out.append(v[x])
+    return tuple(out)
+

+@cute.kernel
+def frost_qsa_score_paged(
+    mQ: cute.Tensor,  # [T, H_i, D] bf16 or e4m3 (the cache dtype); token / head strides symbolic (Int64), D contiguous

+def frost_amax_abs(
+    mSrc: cute.Tensor,  # [T, H, D] bf16/f16, own token/head strides (compact or a slab column slice)

+    d: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    threads_per_cta: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    rows_per_group: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+) -> None:
+    """The quantize kernel's lane layout (16 elements per lane, two ``ld.global.v4``), a ternary abs-max tree per lane
+    (``abs_max_tree``), the warp butterfly (``warp_abs_max_f32_shfl``) and ONE ``atomicMax`` per warp.  Tail rows clamp
+    their loads to the last valid row (a redundant read, never a wild one) and are SELECTED out of the fold."""
+    lanes = cutlass.const_expr(lanes_per_row(d))
+    chunks = cutlass.const_expr(chunks_per_lane(d))
+    groups_per_cta = cutlass.const_expr(threads_per_cta // lanes)
+    _h = cutlass.Int32(h_ct) if cutlass.const_expr(const_head_count) else h

+    lane = tidx % cutlass.Int32(lanes)
+    grp = tidx // cutlass.Int32(lanes)
