+    """Build from SHAPES ALONE -- no allocation, no launch. Every knob is in the cache key.
+
+    ``has_delta`` adds the fp32 ``[B, H, S_pad]`` ``delta = rowsum(O * dO)`` output in the
+    SDPA backward chain's own reduction order (module docstring); it needs ``d % 64 == 0``.
+
+    ``og_fp8`` (appended; needs ``has_og``): ``og`` is a compact ``float8_e4m3fn`` ``[T, H, D]``,
+    ``og8 = sat_e4m3(bf16(O * s) * scale_o)`` with ``scale_o`` read in-kernel -- byte-identical to
+    the forward's quantize of the bf16 ``O_gated`` (module docstring); needs the fp8 ``cvt`` (sm_89+,
+    declined by name below -- Rule 7).  ``has_amax_do`` (appended): PER-CTA PARTIALS of ``max |dO|`` over the
+    STORED dO words, live rows only, on a persistent grid of at most ``SMs x PARTIALS_CTAS_PER_SM`` CTAs (one
+    plain store each; module docstring); needs ``threads_per_cta % 32 == 0`` (a full-warp butterfly) and no fp8
+    instruction.  ``has_amax_dg`` (appended): the same over the STORED dG words into a second partials array.
+    ``has_dy_descale`` (appended): read ``descale_dy`` from a 1-element fp32 slot and multiply ``dO_gated`` by it before every use --
+    the dY descale of the two-level NVFP4 cast (module docstring); ``run_sigmoid_gate_bwd(descale_dy=)`` is then REQUIRED.  No
+    instruction gate (an fp32 multiply; every CUDA device)."""
+    global _FAKE_STREAM
+    validate_shape(d, threads_per_cta)
+    if dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16):
+        raise ValueError(f"sigmoid_gate_bwd serves bf16/f16 only, got {dtype}")
+    if has_delta and (d % DOT_CHUNK_ELEMS != 0 or lanes_per_row(d) < DOT_THREADS_PER_ROW):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"the delta output reproduces the SDPA backward's dot_do_o reduction, whose row is {DOT_THREADS_PER_ROW} threads x {DOT_CHUNK_ELEMS}-element "
+            f"chunks: it needs d_head % {DOT_CHUNK_ELEMS} == 0, got d_head={d}"
+        )
+    if og_fp8 and not has_og:
+        raise ValueError("og_fp8=True needs has_og=True: the e4m3 O_gated is the og OUTPUT's own dtype arm (sat_e4m3(bf16(O * s) * scale_o))")
+    if og_fp8 and OG8_WORDS_PER_LANE * 4 != ELEMS_PER_ACCESS:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"og_fp8 packs a lane's {ELEMS_PER_ACCESS} elements into {OG8_WORDS_PER_LANE} words for one st.global.v2; the access width changed"
+        )
+    if og_fp8:
+        require_fp8_cvt("compile_sigmoid_gate_bwd(og_fp8=True)")
+    if (has_amax_do or has_amax_dg) and threads_per_cta % 32 != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"has_amax_do / has_amax_dg need threads_per_cta % 32 == 0 (the fold ends in a full-warp butterfly), got {threads_per_cta}")
+    if _FAKE_STREAM is None:
+        from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+        _FAKE_STREAM = make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=False)
+
+    device = current_device()
+    # the persistent cap of the fold's grid: a device fact, in the key (a cap sweep re-traces nothing but still keys apart)
+    n_ctas_cap = int(multiprocessor_count(device)) * PARTIALS_CTAS_PER_SM if (has_amax_do or has_amax_dg) else 0
+    key = (
+        str(dtype),
+        int(h),
+        int(d),
+        bool(has_og),
+        bool(has_seq_lens),
+        int(threads_per_cta),
+        int(rows_per_group),
+        bool(const_head_count),
+        bool(use_pdl),
+        device,
+        bool(has_delta),
+        bool(og_fp8),
+        bool(has_amax_do),
+        bool(has_amax_dg),
+        n_ctas_cap,
+        bool(has_dy_descale),
+    )
+    if key not in compiled_cache:
+        tok = cute.sym_int()
+        # Six independent symbolic token strides: dOg / O / dO / Og are compact
+        # in the block, gate and dG are column bands of [T, N] slabs.
+        dense = [fake_rowmajor_dynamic_token_stride(dtype, tok, h, d) for _ in range(5)]
+        if og_fp8:
+            # the e4m3 Og: the quantize pass's own destination shape (compact in the block; 16-B rows)
+            og = cute.runtime.make_fake_tensor(dtype=cutlass.Float8E4M3FN, shape=(tok, h, d), stride=(cute.sym_int(), d, 1), assumed_align=16)
+        else:
+            og = fake_rowmajor_dynamic_token_stride(dtype, tok, h, d) if has_og else None
+        seq_lens = (
+            cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(dtype=cutlass.Int32, shape=(cute.sym_int(),), stride_order=(0,), assumed_align=4) if has_seq_lens else None
+        )
+        # delta: the [B, H, S_pad] fp32 buffer flattened (contiguous), indexed by the kernel's own (b, h, pos) arithmetic
+        delta = (
+            cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(dtype=cutlass.Float32, shape=(cute.sym_int(),), stride_order=(0,), assumed_align=ACCESS_BYTES)
+            if has_delta
+            else None
+        )
+        # the fp8 arm's fp32 scalar slot (1 element at 4-byte alignment: a packed 4-byte slot stride is legal) and its two
+        # partials arrays (contiguous fp32 [n] of SYMBOLIC length on a 16-byte-aligned base: quantize.py's partials contract)
+        slot = lambda: cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(dtype=cutlass.Float32, shape=(1,), stride_order=(0,), assumed_align=4)  # noqa: E731
+        parts = lambda: cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(dtype=cutlass.Float32, shape=(cute.sym_int(),), stride_order=(0,), assumed_align=16)  # noqa: E731
+        scale_o = slot() if og_fp8 else None
+        amax_do = parts() if has_amax_do else None
+        amax_dg = parts() if has_amax_dg else None
+        descale_dy = slot() if has_dy_descale else None  # the dY descale's fp32 slot (the scale_o shape), or None = folded out
+        compiled_cache[key] = cute.compile(
+            sigmoid_gate_bwd_launch,
+            *dense,
+            og,
+            seq_lens,
+            delta,
+            scale_o,
+            amax_do,
+            amax_dg,
+            descale_dy,
+            cutlass.Int32(0),  # n_rows   ) runtime; the zeros pin the TYPE only
+            cutlass.Int32(h),  # h        )
+            cutlass.Int32(0),  # s        )
+            cutlass.Int32(0),  # s_pad    )
+            cutlass.Int32(1),  # n_blocks )
+            int(h),
+            bool(const_head_count),
+            int(d),
+            int(threads_per_cta),
+            int(rows_per_group),
+            bool(use_pdl),
+            bool(og_fp8),
+            _FAKE_STREAM,
+            options="--enable-tvm-ffi",
+        )
+    return SigmoidGateBwdRecipe(
+        compiled=compiled_cache[key],
+        h=int(h),
+        d=int(d),
+        rows_per_cta=(threads_per_cta // lanes_per_row(d)) * rows_per_group,
+        has_og=bool(has_og),
+        has_seq_lens=bool(has_seq_lens),
+        dtype=dtype,
+        has_delta=bool(has_delta),
+        og_fp8=bool(og_fp8),
+        has_amax_do=bool(has_amax_do),
+        has_amax_dg=bool(has_amax_dg),
+        n_ctas_cap=n_ctas_cap,
+        has_dy_descale=bool(has_dy_descale),
+    )
+
+
+def n_partials_for(r: SigmoidGateBwdRecipe, t: int) -> int:
+    """The grid of one launch over ``t`` tokens = the partials an amax fold writes: ``ceil(t * h / rows_per_cta)`` row groups,
+    capped at ``n_ctas_cap`` under a fold (at least 1) -- the ``n_partials`` the consumer reduces and the minimum length of
+    ``amax_do`` / ``amax_dg``."""
+    groups = max(1, (int(t) * r.h + r.rows_per_cta - 1) // r.rows_per_cta)
+    cap = int(getattr(r, "n_ctas_cap", 0))
+    return min(groups, cap) if (getattr(r, "has_amax_do", False) or getattr(r, "has_amax_dg", False)) and cap > 0 else groups
+
+
+def _check_row_layout(name: str, ten, d: int) -> None:
+    """The ``[T, H, D]`` layout contract the artifact cannot check for itself.
+
+    Every such operand is traced with a SYMBOLIC token stride
+    (``fake_rowmajor_dynamic_token_stride``: strides ``(N, D, 1)``) so one artifact
+    serves the compact tensors and the slab bands alike -- and nothing past this
+    point constrains ``N``. A lane moves ``ACCESS_BYTES`` per access, so the token
+    stride must be a whole number of accesses (``N % ELEMS_PER_ACCESS == 0``; the
+    head stride ``D`` already is, ``validate_shape``) on an ``ACCESS_BYTES``-aligned
+    base: a band of a slab whose width is not a multiple of ``ELEMS_PER_ACCESS``,
+    or a view at an odd storage offset, would reach the kernel and fault on odd
+    tokens with a misaligned ``ld/st.global.v4`` -- a sticky CUDA error, not a
+    wrong number. The block's bands are safe by construction (``n_qkvg`` and every
+    ``qkvg_offsets`` entry are multiples of ``QKVG_TILE_ALIGN`` = 64 elements);
+    this names anything else. A size-1 token or head dim enters no address
+    arithmetic, so torch's normalised stride there is admitted."""
+    t, h = int(ten.shape[0]), int(ten.shape[1])
+    s_t, s_h, s_e = (int(x) for x in ten.stride())
+    base_off = ten.data_ptr() % ACCESS_BYTES
+    ok = s_e == 1 and (h == 1 or s_h == d) and (t == 1 or s_t % ELEMS_PER_ACCESS == 0) and base_off == 0
+    if not ok:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} must be a [T, H, D] view with heads contiguous within a token -- strides (N, {d}, 1) with the token stride N a multiple of "
+            f"{ELEMS_PER_ACCESS} elements -- on a {ACCESS_BYTES}-B-aligned base (a lane moves {ACCESS_BYTES} B per access; anything else is a "
+            f"misaligned access on odd tokens); got strides {(s_t, s_h, s_e)}, base {base_off} B past a {ACCESS_BYTES}-B boundary"
+        )
+
+
+def _check_operand(r: SigmoidGateBwdRecipe, name: str, ten, t: int) -> None:
+    if ten.dtype != r.dtype:
+        # The tvm-ffi boundary also rejects this on cutlass-dsl >= 4.8, indexed by
+        # argument position; name the operand here (the `run_elementwise_gate` guard).
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} is {ten.dtype} but this artifact was compiled for {r.dtype}; dtype is fixed per artifact")
+    if ten.dim() != 3 or int(ten.shape[1]) != r.h:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} has H={tuple(ten.shape)} but this artifact was compiled for H={r.h}; H is fixed per artifact (operands are [T, H, D])")
+    if int(ten.shape[2]) != r.d:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} has D={int(ten.shape[2])} but this artifact was compiled for D={r.d}; D is fixed per artifact")
+    if int(ten.shape[0]) != t:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} has T={int(ten.shape[0])} but dO_gated has T={t}; every operand covers the same tokens")
+    _check_row_layout(name, ten, r.d)
+
+
+def run_sigmoid_gate_bwd(
+    r: SigmoidGateBwdRecipe,
+    dog,
+    o,
+    gate,
+    do,
+    dg,
+    og=None,
+    seq_lens=None,
+    *,
+    s: Optional[int] = None,
+    stream,
+    delta: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    scale_o: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    amax_do: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    amax_dg: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    descale_dy: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> int:
+    """Launch. ``dog / o / gate / do / dg (/ og)`` are ``[T, H, D]`` (``T = B*S``);
+    ``do`` may alias ``dog``. ``seq_lens`` (``[B]`` int32 on the device) needs
+    ``s``, the per-batch sequence length (``T == B * s``); so does ``delta``, the
+    fp32 contiguous ``[B, H, S_pad]`` (``S_pad >= s``) output of a ``has_delta``
+    artifact (module docstring). Host-only checks, no allocation.
+
+    Appended, checked BOTH ways against the recipe (Rule 1): ``scale_o`` (an ``og_fp8``
+    artifact's 1-element fp32 CUDA scale, read in-kernel) and ``amax_do`` (a ``has_amax_do``
+    artifact's contiguous fp32 ``[>= n_partials_for(r, T)]`` CUDA partials array on a 16-byte-aligned
+    base; every one of its first ``n_partials_for(r, T)`` words is OVERWRITTEN -- no pre-zero).  Under
+    ``og_fp8`` ``og`` is a ``float8_e4m3fn`` ``[T, H, D]`` whose token stride keeps every row 16-byte
+    aligned (the quantize pass's destination rule; compact ``H*D`` satisfies it).  ``amax_dg`` (appended;
+    a ``has_amax_dg`` artifact's partials array) likewise, and the two arrays must not overlap.  ``descale_dy`` (appended; a
+    ``has_dy_descale`` artifact's 1-element fp32 CUDA slot, read in-kernel and multiplied into ``dO_gated`` before every use) is
+    checked both ways too.  Returns the grid = the partials written (``n_partials_for``)."""
+    if r.og_fp8 and scale_o is None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "this artifact was compiled WITH the e4m3 O_gated output (og_fp8=True); scale_o (1-element fp32 CUDA, read in-kernel) must be bound at "
+            "execute (Rule 1: no silent fallback)"
+        )
+    if not r.og_fp8 and scale_o is not None:
+        raise ValueError("this artifact was compiled WITHOUT the e4m3 O_gated output (og_fp8=False); passing scale_o would silently ignore it (Rule 1)")
+    if r.has_amax_do and amax_do is None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "this artifact was compiled WITH the dO amax output (has_amax_do=True); amax_do (a contiguous fp32 [>= n_partials_for(r, T)] CUDA partials "
+            "array) must be bound at execute (Rule 1: no silent fallback)"
+        )
+    if not r.has_amax_do and amax_do is not None:
+        raise ValueError("this artifact was compiled WITHOUT the dO amax output (has_amax_do=False); passing amax_do would silently ignore it (Rule 1)")
+    has_amax_dg = bool(getattr(r, "has_amax_dg", False))
+    if has_amax_dg and amax_dg is None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "this artifact was compiled WITH the dG amax output (has_amax_dg=True); amax_dg (a contiguous fp32 [>= n_partials_for(r, T)] CUDA partials "
+            "array) must be bound at execute (Rule 1: no silent fallback)"
+        )
+    if not has_amax_dg and amax_dg is not None:
+        raise ValueError("this artifact was compiled WITHOUT the dG amax output (has_amax_dg=False); passing amax_dg would silently ignore it (Rule 1)")
+    has_dy_descale = bool(getattr(r, "has_dy_descale", False))
+    if has_dy_descale and descale_dy is None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "this artifact was compiled WITH the dY descale (has_dy_descale=True); descale_dy (1-element fp32 CUDA, read in-kernel) must be bound at "
+            "execute (Rule 1: no silent unit scale)"
+        )
+    if not has_dy_descale and descale_dy is not None:
+        raise ValueError("this artifact was compiled WITHOUT the dY descale (has_dy_descale=False); passing descale_dy would silently ignore it (Rule 1)")
+    if scale_o is not None:
+        check_scalar_slot("scale_o", scale_o)
+    if descale_dy is not None:
+        check_scalar_slot("descale_dy", descale_dy)
+    t = int(dog.shape[0])
+    n_partials = n_partials_for(r, t)
+    for name, ten in (("amax_do", amax_do), ("amax_dg", amax_dg)):
+        if ten is not None:
+            check_partials(name, ten, n_partials)
+    if amax_do is not None and amax_dg is not None:
+        lo_do, lo_dg, span = amax_do.data_ptr(), amax_dg.data_ptr(), 4 * n_partials
+        if lo_do < lo_dg + span and lo_dg < lo_do + span:
+            raise ValueError("amax_do and amax_dg overlap: the two folds would write max |dO| and max |dG| partials over each other")
+    if r.has_delta and delta is None:
+        raise ValueError("this artifact was compiled WITH a delta output (has_delta=True); it must be bound at execute (Rule 1: no silent fallback)")
+    if not r.has_delta and delta is not None:
+        raise ValueError("this artifact was compiled WITHOUT a delta output (has_delta=False); passing one would silently ignore it (Rule 1)")
+    if r.has_og and og is None:
+        raise ValueError("this artifact was compiled WITH an O_gated output (has_og=True); it must be bound at execute (Rule 1: no silent fallback)")
+    if not r.has_og and og is not None:
+        raise ValueError("this artifact was compiled WITHOUT an O_gated output (has_og=False); passing one would silently ignore it (Rule 1)")
+    if r.has_seq_lens and seq_lens is None:
+        raise ValueError("this artifact was compiled WITH seq_lens (the dead-row select); it must be bound at execute (Rule 1: no silent fallback)")
+    if not r.has_seq_lens and seq_lens is not None:
+        raise ValueError("this artifact was compiled WITHOUT seq_lens (dense, the select folded out); passing one would silently ignore it (Rule 1)")
+    for name, ten in (("dog", dog), ("o", o), ("gate", gate), ("do", do), ("dg", dg)):
+        _check_operand(r, name, ten, t)
+    if og is not None:
+        if r.og_fp8:
+            _check_fp8_og(r, og, t)
+        else:
+            _check_operand(r, "og", og, t)
+    if seq_lens is not None:
+        if s is None:
+            raise ValueError("seq_lens needs s (the per-batch sequence length, T == B * s) to map a token to its batch entry")
+        if seq_lens.dtype != torch.int32 or seq_lens.dim() != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"seq_lens must be a 1-D int32 tensor, got {seq_lens.dtype} of shape {tuple(seq_lens.shape)}")
+        if int(s) <= 0 or t % int(s) != 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"s={s} must divide T={t} (T == B * s)")
+        if int(seq_lens.numel()) != t // int(s):
+            raise ValueError(f"seq_lens has {int(seq_lens.numel())} entries but T // s = {t // int(s)} batches")
+    s_pad = 0
+    if delta is not None:
+        if s is None:
+            raise ValueError("delta needs s (the per-batch sequence length, T == B * s): delta is [B, H, S_pad], indexed by (batch, head, position)")
+        if int(s) <= 0 or t % int(s) != 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"s={s} must divide T={t} (T == B * s)")
+        shape = tuple(int(x) for x in delta.shape)
+        if delta.dtype != torch.float32 or delta.dim() != 3 or not delta.is_contiguous():
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"delta must be a CONTIGUOUS fp32 [B, H, S_pad] tensor (the SDPA backward's dot_do_o layout), got {delta.dtype} of shape {shape} "
+                f"with strides {tuple(delta.stride())}"
+            )
+        if shape[:2] != (t // int(s), r.h) or shape[2] < int(s):
+            raise ValueError(f"delta must be [B={t // int(s)}, H={r.h}, S_pad >= {int(s)}] (T == B * s, S_pad the chain's padded extent), got {shape}")
+        if delta.data_ptr() % ACCESS_BYTES:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"delta base must be {ACCESS_BYTES}-B aligned (the chain reads it through a {ACCESS_BYTES}-B-aligned view), got {delta.data_ptr():#x}"
+            )
+        s_pad = shape[2]
+    _check_one_cuda_device(
+        "dog",
+        dog,
+        (
+            ("o", o),
+            ("gate", gate),
+            ("do", do),
+            ("dg", dg),
+            ("og", og),
+            ("seq_lens", seq_lens),
+            ("delta", delta),
+            ("scale_o", scale_o),
+            ("amax_do", amax_do),
+            ("amax_dg", amax_dg),
+            ("descale_dy", descale_dy),
+        ),
+    )
+    n_rows = t * r.h
+    n_blocks = n_partials  # the row groups, or the persistent cap under a fold (n_partials_for)
+    # The optional slots stay in the ABI even when they traced to None (the
+    # artifact folded out the STORES / the select, not the parameters).
+    r.compiled(
+        dog,
+        o,
+        gate,
+        do,
+        dg,
+        og,
+        seq_lens,
+        delta.view(-1) if delta is not None else None,
+        scale_o.reshape(1) if scale_o is not None else None,  # a 1-element reshape never copies (Rule 1)
+        amax_do,
+        amax_dg,
+        descale_dy.reshape(1) if descale_dy is not None else None,
+        cutlass.Int32(n_rows),
+        cutlass.Int32(r.h),
+        cutlass.Int32(int(s) if s is not None else 0),
+        cutlass.Int32(s_pad),
+        cutlass.Int32(n_blocks),
+        cuda.CUstream(int(stream)),
+    )
+    return n_blocks
+
+
+def _check_fp8_og(r: SigmoidGateBwdRecipe, og, t: int) -> None:
+    """The e4m3 ``og`` of an ``og_fp8`` artifact: ``float8_e4m3fn`` ``[T, H, D]`` with heads contiguous within a token and a
+    token stride that keeps every row 16-byte aligned -- the quantize pass's destination contract (``kernels/quantize.py``:
+    ``dst.stride(0) % 16 == 0``, 1 B per element), which compact ``H*D`` satisfies -- on a 16-B-aligned base.  A lane stores
+    8 B per chunk, so anything else is a misaligned ``st.global.v2`` on odd tokens, not a wrong number."""
+    if og.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn:
+        raise ValueError(f"og is {og.dtype} but this artifact was compiled for torch.float8_e4m3fn (og_fp8=True); dtype is fixed per artifact")
+    if og.dim() != 3 or int(og.shape[1]) != r.h or int(og.shape[2]) != r.d:
+        raise ValueError(f"og must be [T, H={r.h}, D={r.d}] (H and D are fixed per artifact), got {tuple(og.shape)}")
+    if int(og.shape[0]) != t:
+        raise ValueError(f"og has T={int(og.shape[0])} but dO_gated has T={t}; every operand covers the same tokens")
+    s_t, s_h, s_e = (int(x) for x in og.stride())
+    if s_e != 1 or (r.h != 1 and s_h != r.d) or (t != 1 and s_t % ACCESS_BYTES != 0) or og.data_ptr() % ACCESS_BYTES:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"og (e4m3) must be a [T, H, D] view with heads contiguous within a token -- strides (N, {r.d}, 1) with the token stride N a multiple "
+            f"of {ACCESS_BYTES} elements (16-B rows, the quantize pass's destination rule) -- on a {ACCESS_BYTES}-B-aligned base; got strides "
+            f"{(s_t, s_h, s_e)}, base {og.data_ptr() % ACCESS_BYTES} B past a {ACCESS_BYTES}-B boundary"
+        )
+
+
+def moved_bytes(t: int, h: int, d: int, *, elem_bytes: int = 2, has_og: bool, has_delta: bool = False, og_bytes: Optional[int] = None) -> int:
+    """HBM traffic of one launch -- the denominator for an SOL number.
+
+    Reads dO_gated, O and gate; writes dO and dG (+ O_gated at ``og_bytes`` per
+    element -- ``elem_bytes`` by default, 1 for the e4m3 arm; + the 4-B ``delta``
+    per row). In-place dO still moves all of it: a write is a write whether or
+    not it lands on the read's address. ``seq_lens`` (4 B per batch), the delta's
+    pad tail and the fp8 arm's two 4-B scalars are not counted.
+    """
+    og_bytes = elem_bytes if og_bytes is None else og_bytes
+    return 5 * t * h * d * elem_bytes + (t * h * d * og_bytes if has_og else 0) + (4 * t * h if has_delta else 0)

+    tap_ptr_binds: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    tap_constants: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    mainloop_transform_a: str = "pass"
+    mainloop_transform_b: str = "pass"
+
+
+def _aux_ptr_var(name: str) -> str:
+    return f"_aux_{name}_ptr"
+
+
+def _aux_prefetch_var(name: str) -> str:
+    return f"_aux_{name}_pre"
+
+
+def _compute_cast(var: str, dtype: Dtype, tag: str, *, source_dtype: Dtype | None = None) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+    """Cast a running vector to the op's compute dtype."""
+    new = f"_c_{tag}"
+    value = f"({var})"
+    if dtype == "int32" and source_dtype in ("int8", "uint8", "int32"):
+        value = f"cutlass.Vector({value}.ir_value(), dtype={DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[source_dtype]})"
+    lines = [f"{new} = {value}.to({DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[dtype]})"]
+    if dtype == "fp32" and source_dtype in ("int8", "uint8", "int32"):
+        lines.append(f"{new} = {new} + cutlass.full_like({new}, 0.0)")
+    return lines, new
+
+
+def _compute_literal(dtype: Dtype, value: float | int) -> str:
+    """Format a literal in the requested compute dtype."""
+    if dtype == "int32":
+        return f"cutlass.Int32({int(value)})"
+    return f"cutlass.Float32({float(value)})"
+
+
+def _elem_coord(e: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Return an epilogue element coordinate."""
+    return ("row", f"col_j + {e}")
+
+
+def tma_out_value(j: int) -> str:
+    """Return the variable for a TMA output."""
+    return "vec_out" if j == 0 else f"_tma_out_{j}"
+
+
+def tma_out_ready_marker(j: int) -> str:
+    """Codegen marker immediately after TMA output ``j`` is ready."""
+    return f"# @@FROST_TMA_OUT_{j}_READY@@"
+
+
+def _aux_reads_row(aux: TensorRef) -> bool:
+    return len(aux.dim) >= 2 and aux.dim[-2] != 1
+
+
+_LOG2E = "cutlass.Float32(1.4426950408889634)"
+
+_TWO_LOG2E = "cutlass.Float32(2.8853900817779268)"
+
+
+def _tanh_expr(v: str) -> str:
+    """Generate vector tanh."""
+    one = f"cutlass.full_like({v}, cutlass.Float32(1.0))"
+    two = f"cutlass.full_like({v}, cutlass.Float32(2.0))"
+    e2 = f"cute.math.exp2({v} * cutlass.full_like({v}, {_TWO_LOG2E}), fastmath=True)"
+    return f"({one} - {two} * cute.math.rcp({e2} + {one}, approx=True, ftz=True))"
+
+
+def _fl(var: str, c: float) -> str:
+    return f"cutlass.full_like({var}, cutlass.Float32({float(c)}))"
+
+
+def _step01(d_expr: str, tag: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+    """Generate a nonnegative indicator vector."""
+    d, v = f"_sd{tag}", f"_st{tag}"
+    lines = [
+        f"{d} = ({d_expr})",
+        f"{v} = cute.math.min(cute.math.max(cute.math.floor({d}) + {_fl(d, 1.0)}, {_fl(d, 0.0)}), {_fl(d, 1.0)})",
+    ]
+    return lines, v
+
+
+def _nonzero01(x_expr: str, tag: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+    """0/1 vector for [x != 0]."""
+    x, v = f"_nz{tag}", f"_nzv{tag}"
+    lines = [f"{x} = ({x_expr})"]
+    l1, sp = _step01(x, f"{tag}p")
+    l2, sn = _step01(f"-{x}", f"{tag}n")
+    lines += l1 + l2 + [f"{v} = {_fl(x, 1.0)} - {sp} * {sn}"]
+    return lines, v
+
+
+def _sigmoid_lines(x_var: str, tag: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+    v = f"_sg{tag}"
+    return [
+        f"{v} = cute.math.rcp({_fl(x_var, 1.0)} + cute.math.exp2(-{x_var} * cutlass.full_like({x_var}, {_LOG2E}), fastmath=True), approx=True, ftz=True)"
+    ], v
+
+
+_CMP_OPS = ("cmp_eq", "cmp_neq", "cmp_gt", "cmp_ge", "cmp_lt", "cmp_le")
+
+_CMP_PY_OPS = {"cmp_eq": "==", "cmp_neq": "!=", "cmp_gt": ">", "cmp_ge": ">=", "cmp_lt": "<", "cmp_le": "<="}
+
+_LOGIC_OPS = ("logical_and", "logical_or")
+
+_BACKWARD_OPS = (
+    "relu_backward",
+    "leaky_relu_backward",
+    "swish_backward",
+    "sigmoid_backward",
+    "tanh_backward",
+    "elu_backward",
+    "gelu_backward",
+    "gelu_tanh_backward",
+    "softplus_backward",
+)
+
+
+def _emit_binary_ext(op: FusionOp, a_expr: str, b_expr: str, idx: int, new: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+    """Generate comparison, logical, modulo, and activation-gradient operations."""
+    a, b = f"_ba{idx}", f"_bb{idx}"
+    lines = [f"{a} = ({a_expr})", f"{b} = ({b_expr})"]
+    attrs = dict(op.attrs)
+
+    if op.op in _CMP_OPS:
+        if op.compute_dtype == "fp32":
+            # Compare natively (arith.cmpf: ordered OEQ/OGT/OGE/OLT/OLE, unordered UNE) to keep IEEE
+            # semantics. The step form below gets NaN operands and equal infinities wrong: a - b is NaN
+            # there, and the NaN-ignoring max/min turn that NaN into 0. Only int32 compute still reaches
+            # the step form, and it does not build there (the DSL's floor takes floating-point types only).
+            return lines + [f"{new} = cutlass._mlir_helpers.vector.where({a} {_CMP_PY_OPS[op.op]} {b}, {_fl(a, 1.0)}, {_fl(a, 0.0)})"], new
+        if op.op == "cmp_le":
+            step, v = _step01(f"{b} - {a}", f"_{idx}")
+            return lines + step + [f"{new} = {v}"], new
+        if op.op == "cmp_ge":
+            step, v = _step01(f"{a} - {b}", f"_{idx}")
+            return lines + step + [f"{new} = {v}"], new
+        if op.op == "cmp_lt":
+            step, v = _step01(f"{a} - {b}", f"_{idx}")
+            return lines + step + [f"{new} = {_fl(a, 1.0)} - {v}"], new
+        if op.op == "cmp_gt":
+            step, v = _step01(f"{b} - {a}", f"_{idx}")
+            return lines + step + [f"{new} = {_fl(a, 1.0)} - {v}"], new
+        l1, v1 = _step01(f"{a} - {b}", f"_{idx}e1")
+        l2, v2 = _step01(f"{b} - {a}", f"_{idx}e2")
+        if op.op == "cmp_eq":
+            return lines + l1 + l2 + [f"{new} = {v1} * {v2}"], new
+        return lines + l1 + l2 + [f"{new} = {_fl(a, 1.0)} - {v1} * {v2}"], new
+
+    if op.op in _LOGIC_OPS:
+        la, na = _nonzero01(a, f"_{idx}a")
+        lb, nb = _nonzero01(b, f"_{idx}b")
+        if op.op == "logical_and":
+            return lines + la + lb + [f"{new} = {na} * {nb}"], new
+        return lines + la + lb + [f"{new} = {na} + {nb} - {na} * {nb}"], new
+
+    if op.op == "mod":
+        q = f"_mq{idx}"
+        lines.append(f"{q} = {a} / {b}")
+        lp, sp = _step01(q, f"_{idx}mp")
+        ln, sn = _step01(f"-{q}", f"_{idx}mn")
+        return (
+            lines
+            + lp
+            + ln
+            + [
+                f"_mt{idx} = cute.math.floor(cute.math.abs({q})) * ({sp} - {sn})",
+                f"{new} = {a} - {b} * _mt{idx}",
+            ],
+            new,
+        )
+
+    if op.op in ("relu_backward", "leaky_relu_backward"):
+        slope = attrs.get("negative_slope")
+        lower = attrs.get("lower_clip", 0.0)
+        upper = attrs.get("upper_clip")
+        l1, s1 = _step01(f"{_fl(b, lower)} - {b}", f"_{idx}r1")
+        lines += l1 + [f"_rm{idx} = {_fl(b, 1.0)} - {s1}"]
+        m = f"_rm{idx}"
+        if upper is not None:
+            l2, s2 = _step01(f"{b} - {_fl(b, upper)}", f"_{idx}r2")
+            lines += l2 + [f"_rmu{idx} = {m} * ({_fl(b, 1.0)} - {s2})"]
+            m = f"_rmu{idx}"
+        if slope is not None:
+            # cuDNN RELU_BWD: the slope applies only where x <= lower (s1); x >= upper has zero gradient.
+            lines.append(f"_rf{idx} = {m} + {_fl(b, slope)} * {s1}")
+            m = f"_rf{idx}"
+        return lines + [f"{new} = {a} * {m}"], new
+
+    if op.op == "sigmoid_backward":
+        ls, sg = _sigmoid_lines(b, f"_{idx}")
+        return lines + ls + [f"{new} = {a} * {sg} * ({_fl(b, 1.0)} - {sg})"], new
+
+    if op.op == "tanh_backward":
+        lines.append(f"_tb{idx} = {_tanh_expr(b)}")
+        return lines + [f"{new} = {a} * ({_fl(b, 1.0)} - _tb{idx} * _tb{idx})"], new
+
+    if op.op == "softplus_backward":
+        ls, sg = _sigmoid_lines(b, f"_{idx}")
+        return lines + ls + [f"{new} = {a} * {sg}"], new
+
+    if op.op == "elu_backward":
+        lm, m = _step01(f"-{b}", f"_{idx}")
+        return (
+            lines
+            + lm
+            + [
+                f"_ee{idx} = cute.math.exp2(cute.math.min({b}, {_fl(b, 0.0)}) * cutlass.full_like({b}, {_LOG2E}), fastmath=True)",
+                f"{new} = {a} * (({_fl(b, 1.0)} - {m}) + {m} * _ee{idx})",
+            ],
+            new,
+        )
+
+    if op.op == "gelu_backward":
+        return (
+            lines
+            + [
+                f"_gc{idx} = {_fl(b, 0.5)} * ({_fl(b, 1.0)} + cute.math.erf({b} * {_fl(b, 0.7071067811865476)}))",
+                f"_gp{idx} = {b} * cute.math.exp2(-{b} * {b} * {_fl(b, 0.7213475204444817)}, fastmath=True) * {_fl(b, 0.3989422804014327)}",
+                f"{new} = {a} * (_gc{idx} + _gp{idx})",
+            ],
+            new,
+        )
+
+    if op.op == "gelu_tanh_backward":
+        lines += [
+            f"_gu{idx} = {_fl(b, 0.7978845608028654)} * ({b} + {_fl(b, 0.044715)} * {b} * {b} * {b})",
+            f"_gt{idx} = {_tanh_expr(f'_gu{idx}')}",
+            f"_gd{idx} = {_fl(b, 0.7978845608028654)} * ({_fl(b, 1.0)} + {_fl(b, 0.134145)} * {b} * {b})",
+        ]
+        return (
+            lines + [f"{new} = {a} * ({_fl(b, 0.5)} * ({_fl(b, 1.0)} + _gt{idx}) + {_fl(b, 0.5)} * {b} * ({_fl(b, 1.0)} - _gt{idx} * _gt{idx}) * _gd{idx})"],
+            new,
+        )
+
+    if op.op == "swish_backward":
+        beta = attrs.get("swish_beta", 1.0)
+        lines.append(f"_sx{idx} = {b} * {_fl(b, beta)}")
+        ls, sg = _sigmoid_lines(f"_sx{idx}", f"_{idx}")
+        return lines + ls + [f"{new} = {a} * ({sg} + _sx{idx} * {sg} * ({_fl(b, 1.0)} - {sg}))"], new
+
+    raise AssertionError(f"unhandled binary-ext op {op.op!r}")
+
+
+def _emit_op(
+    op: FusionOp,
+    prev: str,
+    idx: int,
+    aux_loads: dict[str, str],
+    other_in_chain: str | None = None,
+    third_in_chain: str | None = None,
+    vsize: int = 32,
+) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+    """Emit lines computing this op, given the previous-step var name."""
+    new = f"_op_{idx}"
+
+    if op.op == "identity":
+        return [], prev
+
+    # relu (every slope / clip form), leaky_relu and elu keep a NaN input NaN, as torch does and as the frontend
+    # requests for RELU_FWD (CUDNN_PROPAGATE_NAN). The DSL's default max/min (maxnum/minnum) return the non-NaN
+    # operand, which turned NaN into 0 or lower_clip; propagate_nan=True lowers to arith.maximumf/minimumf. The
+    # binary max/min ops keep the default, which matches native cuDNN (eng10) MAX/MIN.
+    if op.op == "relu":
+        ra = dict(op.attrs)
+        if not ra:
+            return [f"{new} = cute.math.max({prev}, cutlass.full_like({prev}, {_compute_literal(op.compute_dtype, 0)}), propagate_nan=True)"], new
+        slope, lower, upper = ra.get("negative_slope"), ra.get("lower_clip"), ra.get("upper_clip")
+        rl = [f"_r{idx} = {prev}"]
+        rv = f"_r{idx}"
+        if slope is not None:
+            # cuDNN RELU_FWD: x < lower ? lower + slope * (x - lower) : x, with lower defaulting to 0.
+            # lower_clip is where the slope starts, not a clamp applied after it.
+            lo = 0.0 if lower is None else lower
+            shifted = rv if lo == 0.0 else f"({rv} - {_fl(rv, lo)})"
+            rl.append(
+                f"_rk{idx} = cute.math.max({rv}, {_fl(rv, lo)}, propagate_nan=True) + {_fl(rv, slope)} * cute.math.min({shifted}, {_fl(rv, 0.0)}, propagate_nan=True)"
+            )
+            cur = f"_rk{idx}"
+        else:
+            rl.append(f"_rl{idx} = cute.math.max({rv}, {_fl(rv, lower if lower is not None else 0.0)}, propagate_nan=True)")
+            cur = f"_rl{idx}"
+        if upper is not None:
+            rl.append(f"_ru{idx} = cute.math.min({cur}, {_fl(rv, upper)}, propagate_nan=True)")
+            cur = f"_ru{idx}"
+        return rl + [f"{new} = {cur}"], new
+
+    if op.op == "leaky_relu":
+        slope = dict(op.attrs).get("negative_slope", 0.0)
+        return [
+            f"_lr{idx} = {prev}",
+            f"{new} = cute.math.max(_lr{idx}, {_fl(f'_lr{idx}', 0.0)}, propagate_nan=True) + {_fl(f'_lr{idx}', slope)} * cute.math.min(_lr{idx}, {_fl(f'_lr{idx}', 0.0)}, propagate_nan=True)",
+        ], new
+
+    if op.op == "elu":
+        return [
+            f"_el{idx} = {prev}",
+            f"{new} = cute.math.max(_el{idx}, {_fl(f'_el{idx}', 0.0)}, propagate_nan=True) + cute.math.exp2(cute.math.min(_el{idx}, {_fl(f'_el{idx}', 0.0)}, propagate_nan=True) * cutlass.full_like(_el{idx}, {_LOG2E}), fastmath=True) - {_fl(f'_el{idx}', 1.0)}",
+        ], new
+
+    if op.op == "softplus":
+        return [
+            f"_sp{idx} = {prev}",
+            f"{new} = cute.math.max(_sp{idx}, {_fl(f'_sp{idx}', 0.0)}) + cute.math.log({_fl(f'_sp{idx}', 1.0)} + cute.math.exp2(-cute.math.abs(_sp{idx}) * cutlass.full_like(_sp{idx}, {_LOG2E}), fastmath=True))",
+        ], new
+
+    if op.op == "tan":
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.sin({prev}) * cute.math.rcp(cute.math.cos({prev}), approx=True, ftz=True)"], new
+
+    if op.op == "logical_not":
+        ll, nz = _nonzero01(prev, f"_{idx}")
+        return ll + [f"{new} = {_fl(nz, 1.0)} - {nz}"], new
+
+    if op.op == "gen_index":
+        axis = dict(op.attrs).get("axis")
+        # An int32-compute index comes straight from the Int32 coordinate: Float32 rounds indices above 2**24.
+        idx_t = DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[op.compute_dtype]
+        if axis == 1:
+            return [f"{new} = cutlass.full_like({prev}, {idx_t}(row))"], new
+        gl = [f"_gi{idx} = cute.make_rmem_tensor({vsize}, {idx_t})"]
+        for k in range(vsize):
+            _, col = _elem_coord(k)
+            gl.append(f"_gi{idx}[{k}] = {idx_t}({col})")
+        gl.append(f"{new} = _gi{idx}.load().to_vector()")
+        return gl, new
+
+    if op.op == "binary_select":
+        assert other_in_chain is not None and third_in_chain is not None
+        zero = _compute_literal(op.compute_dtype, 0)
+        return [f"{new} = cutlass._mlir_helpers.vector.where({third_in_chain} != cutlass.full_like({third_in_chain}, {zero}), {prev}, {other_in_chain})"], new
+
+    if op.op in _CMP_OPS or op.op in _LOGIC_OPS or op.op in _BACKWARD_OPS or op.op == "mod":
+        if op.parent_idx_b is not None:
+            assert other_in_chain is not None
+            rhs = other_in_chain
+        else:
+            assert op.aux is not None
+            rhs = f"({aux_loads[op.aux]})"
+        lhs, rhs = (prev, rhs) if op.aux_on_rhs else (rhs, prev)
+        return _emit_binary_ext(op, lhs, rhs, idx, new)
+
+    if op.op == "tanh":
+        return [f"{new} = {_tanh_expr(prev)}"], new
+
+    if op.op == "exp":
+
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.exp2({prev} * cutlass.full_like({prev}, {_LOG2E}), fastmath=True)"], new
+
+    if op.op == "abs":
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.abs({prev})"], new
+
+    if op.op == "neg":
+        if op.compute_dtype == "int32":
+            return [f"{new} = cutlass.full_like({prev}, cutlass.Int32(0)) - {prev}"], new
+        return [f"{new} = -{prev}"], new
+
+    if op.op == "cos":
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.cos({prev})"], new
+
+    if op.op == "sin":
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.sin({prev})"], new
+
+    if op.op == "ceil":
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.ceil({prev})"], new
+
+    if op.op == "floor":
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.floor({prev})"], new
+
+    if op.op == "erf":
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.erf({prev})"], new
+
+    if op.op == "log":
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.log({prev})"], new
+
+    if op.op == "reciprocal":
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.rcp({prev}, approx=True, ftz=True)"], new
+
+    if op.op == "rsqrt":
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.rsqrt({prev})"], new
+
+    if op.op == "sqrt":
+        return [f"{new} = cute.math.sqrt({prev})"], new
+
+    if op.op == "sigmoid":
+
+        return [
+            f"{new} = cute.math.rcp(cutlass.full_like({prev}, cutlass.Float32(1.0)) + "
+            f"cute.math.exp2(-{prev} * cutlass.full_like({prev}, {_LOG2E}), fastmath=True), approx=True, ftz=True)"
+        ], new
+
+    if op.op == "swish":
+        beta = dict(op.attrs).get("swish_beta")
+        if beta is not None:
+            return [
+                f"_swb{idx} = {prev} * {_fl(prev, beta)}",
+                f"{new} = {prev} * cute.math.rcp(cutlass.full_like({prev}, cutlass.Float32(1.0)) + "
+                f"cute.math.exp2(-_swb{idx} * cutlass.full_like({prev}, {_LOG2E}), fastmath=True), approx=True, ftz=True)",
+            ], new
+
+        return [
+            f"{new} = {prev} * cute.math.rcp(cutlass.full_like({prev}, cutlass.Float32(1.0)) + "
+            f"cute.math.exp2(-{prev} * cutlass.full_like({prev}, {_LOG2E}), fastmath=True), approx=True, ftz=True)"
+        ], new
+
+    if op.op == "gelu_tanh":
+
+        return [
+            f"_g_x{idx} = {prev}",
+            f"_g_inner{idx} = cutlass.full_like(_g_x{idx}, cutlass.Float32(0.7978845608028654)) * "
+            f"(_g_x{idx} + cutlass.full_like(_g_x{idx}, cutlass.Float32(0.044715)) * _g_x{idx} * _g_x{idx} * _g_x{idx})",
+            f"_g_tanh{idx} = {_tanh_expr(f'_g_inner{idx}')}",
+            f"{new} = cutlass.full_like(_g_x{idx}, cutlass.Float32(0.5)) * _g_x{idx} * (cutlass.full_like(_g_x{idx}, cutlass.Float32(1.0)) + _g_tanh{idx})",
+        ], new
+
+    if op.op == "gelu":
+
+        return [
+            f"_e_x{idx} = {prev}",
+            f"_e_erf{idx} = cute.math.erf(_e_x{idx} * cutlass.full_like(_e_x{idx}, {_compute_literal(op.compute_dtype, 0.7071067811865475)}))",
+            f"{new} = cutlass.full_like(_e_x{idx}, {_compute_literal(op.compute_dtype, 0.5)}) * _e_x{idx} * "
+            f"(cutlass.full_like(_e_x{idx}, {_compute_literal(op.compute_dtype, 1)}) + _e_erf{idx})",
+        ], new
+
+    if op.op in {"add", "mul", "sub", "div", "max", "min", "pow", "add_square"}:
+        py_op = {"add": "+", "mul": "*", "sub": "-", "div": "/"}.get(op.op)
+        if op.parent_idx_b is not None:
+
+            assert other_in_chain is not None
+            if op.op == "max":
+                return [f"{new} = cute.math.max({prev}, {other_in_chain})"], new
+            if op.op == "min":
+                return [f"{new} = cute.math.min({prev}, {other_in_chain})"], new
+            if op.op == "pow":
+                if op.aux_on_rhs:
+                    return [f"{new} = cute.math.pow({prev}, {other_in_chain})"], new
+                return [f"{new} = cute.math.pow({other_in_chain}, {prev})"], new
+            if op.op == "add_square":
+                if op.aux_on_rhs:
+                    return [f"{new} = {prev} + {other_in_chain} * {other_in_chain}"], new
+                return [f"{new} = {other_in_chain} + {prev} * {prev}"], new
+            assert py_op is not None
+            if op.aux_on_rhs:
+                return [f"{new} = {prev} {py_op} {other_in_chain}"], new
+            return [f"{new} = {other_in_chain} {py_op} {prev}"], new
+        assert op.aux is not None
+        aux_expr = aux_loads[op.aux]
+        if op.op == "max":
+            return [f"{new} = cute.math.max({prev}, ({aux_expr}))"], new
+        if op.op == "min":
+            return [f"{new} = cute.math.min({prev}, ({aux_expr}))"], new
+        if op.op == "pow":
+            if op.aux_on_rhs:
+                return [f"{new} = cute.math.pow({prev}, ({aux_expr}))"], new
+            return [f"{new} = cute.math.pow(({aux_expr}), {prev})"], new
+        if op.op == "add_square":
+            if op.aux_on_rhs:
+                return [
+                    f"_sq_aux_{idx} = ({aux_expr})",
+                    f"{new} = {prev} + _sq_aux_{idx} * _sq_aux_{idx}",
+                ], new
+            return [
+                f"_sq_aux_{idx} = ({aux_expr})",
+                f"{new} = _sq_aux_{idx} + {prev} * {prev}",
+            ], new
+        assert py_op is not None
+        if op.aux_on_rhs:
+            return [f"{new} = {prev} {py_op} ({aux_expr})"], new
+        return [f"{new} = ({aux_expr}) {py_op} {prev}"], new
+
+    raise AssertionError(f"unhandled op {op.op!r}")
+
+
+# int8 / uint8 values round to nearest even and saturate, NaN to 0 (cvt.rni.sat), as cuDNN's native engines store
+# them. A bare .to() lowers to fptosi / trunci, which round toward zero and keep the low byte (2.75 -> 2, 300 -> 44).
+_INT8_RANGES: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {"int8": (-128, 127), "uint8": (0, 255)}
+
+
+def _emit_round(var: str, out_dtype: Dtype, tag: str, *, source_dtype: Dtype = "fp32") -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+    """Round a register value to its declared dtype."""
+    if out_dtype == "fp32" and source_dtype == "fp32":
+        return [], var
+    new = f"_r_{tag}"
+    if out_dtype in _INT8_RANGES and source_dtype in ("fp32", "int32"):
+        lo, hi = _INT8_RANGES[out_dtype]
+        sat = f"_sat_{tag}"
+        if source_dtype == "int32":
+            lo_i, hi_i = _compute_literal("int32", lo), _compute_literal("int32", hi)
+            lines = [f"{sat} = cute.math.min(cute.math.max({var}, cutlass.full_like({var}, {lo_i})), cutlass.full_like({var}, {hi_i}))"]
+        else:
+            # max(x, 0) + min(x, 0) is x, or 0 for NaN: max / min return the non-NaN operand.
+            lines = [
+                f"{sat} = cute.math.max({var}, {_fl(var, 0.0)}) + cute.math.min({var}, {_fl(var, 0.0)})",
+                f"{sat} = cute.math.min(cute.math.max(cute.math.roundeven({sat}), {_fl(sat, lo)}), {_fl(sat, hi)})",
+            ]
+        return lines + [f"{new} = ({sat}).to({DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[out_dtype]})"], new
+    lines = [f"{new} = ({var}).to({DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[out_dtype]})"]
+    if out_dtype == "fp32" and source_dtype == "int32":
+        lines.append(f"{new} = {new} + cutlass.full_like({new}, 0.0)")
+    return lines, new
+

+def _store_cast_expr(var: str, dtype: Dtype) -> str:
+    """Format an output conversion expression."""
+    if dtype == "uint8":
+
+        return f"({var}).to(cutlass.Uint8).bitcast(cutlass.Int8)"
+    return f"({var}).to({DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[dtype]})"

+def _dense_store_offset(i: int, is_fp4: bool, batch: int) -> str:
+    """Generate a dense output store offset."""
+    col = "(col_j >> 1)" if is_fp4 else "col_j"
+    base = f"row * out_stride_m_{i} + {col}"
+    return f"(tile_l * out_stride_l_{i} + {base})" if batch > 1 else f"({base})"

+def _emit_mmajor_scatter(
+    tap_idx: int,
+    i: int,
+    source_var: str,
+    dtype: Dtype,
+    batch: int,
+    vsize: int,
+    *,
+    row_pred: str | None = None,
+    converted: bool = False,
+    col_bound: str = "N",
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Generate scalar stores through output strides."""
+    tap_var = f"_tap_{tap_idx}"
+    l_term = f"tile_l * out_stride_l_{i} + " if batch > 1 else ""
+    lines = [f"{tap_var} = {source_var if converted else _store_cast_expr(source_var, dtype)}"]
+    for e in range(vsize):
+        store = (
+            f"(gC_tap_{tap_idx}_ptr + {l_term}row * out_stride_m_{i} + "
+            f"(col_j + {e}) * out_stride_n_{i}).store({tap_var}[{e} : {e} + 1], "
+            f"alignment={DTYPE_BYTES[dtype]})"
+        )
+        if row_pred is not None:
+            lines.append(f"if ({row_pred}) & (col_j + {e} < {col_bound}):")
+            lines.append(f"    {store}")

+def _tap_store_elems(chain: FusionChain, dtype: Dtype, dim, stride, vsize: int) -> int:
+    """Choose the vector width for a dense output."""
+    if dtype == "fp4_e2m1":
+        return vsize
+    dim, stride = dense_output_layout(chain, dtype, dim, stride)
+    return min(vsize, _allowed_vsize(chain, dtype, dim, stride))

+def _tap_vec_bytes(chain: FusionChain, dtype: Dtype, dim, stride, vsize: int) -> int:
+    """Byte width (== required alignment) of one dense tap vector store."""
+    if dtype == "fp4_e2m1":
+        return max(vsize // 2, 4)
+    return _tap_store_elems(chain, dtype, dim, stride, vsize) * DTYPE_BYTES[dtype]

+def _emit_moe_scatter_store(tap_idx, i, src, spec, chain, vsize, row_pred, col_bound):
+    """Store FC2 fragments into distinct token/top-k slots without atomics."""
+    swapped = isinstance(chain.moe, MoeSwapAbSpec)
+    lines = [f"_scatter_value = {_store_cast_expr(src, spec.dtype)}"]
+    if not swapped:
+        lines.append("_scatter_row = moe_scatter_row(token_index, token_ks, row, group_end, M, moe_top_k)")
+        pred = "_scatter_row < M"
+        if row_pred:
+            pred = f"({row_pred}) & ({pred})"
+        if spec.major == "n":
+            lines += _emit_tap_store(
+                tap_idx,
+                "_scatter_value",
+                spec.dtype,
+                chain,
+                spec.dim,
+                spec.stride,
+                vsize,
+                f"(_scatter_row * out_stride_m_{i} + col_j)",
+                row_pred=pred,
+                converted=True,
+                col_bound=col_bound,
+            )
+            return lines
+    for e in range(vsize):
+        if swapped:
+            lines.append(f"_scatter_col = moe_scatter_row(token_index, token_ks, col_j + {e}, group_end, N, moe_top_k)")
+            pred = "(row < M) & (_scatter_col < N)"
+            offset = f"row * out_stride_m_{i} + _scatter_col * out_stride_n_{i}"
+        else:
+            pred = f"(_scatter_row < M) & (col_j + {e} < N)"
+            offset = f"_scatter_row * out_stride_m_{i} + (col_j + {e}) * out_stride_n_{i}"
+        if row_pred:
+            pred = f"({row_pred}) & ({pred})"
+        lines += [f"if {pred}:", f"    (gC_tap_{tap_idx}_ptr + {offset}).store(_scatter_value[{e}:{e+1}], alignment={DTYPE_BYTES[spec.dtype]})"]
+    return lines
+
+
+def _emit_tap_store(
+    tap_idx: int,
+    source_var: str,
+    tap_dtype: Dtype,
+    chain: FusionChain,
+    dim,
+    stride,
+    vsize: int,
+    offset_expr: str = "linear_idx",
+    *,
+    row_pred: str | None = None,
+    converted: bool = False,
+    col_bound: str = "N",
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Generate vector stores for one N-major output."""
+    tap_var = f"_tap_{tap_idx}"
+    store_elems = _tap_store_elems(chain, tap_dtype, dim, stride, vsize)
+    lines = [f"{tap_var} = {source_var if converted else _store_cast_expr(source_var, tap_dtype)}"]
+    for _s in range(0, vsize, store_elems) if store_elems < vsize else (None,):
+        span = f"{tap_var}" if _s is None else f"{tap_var}[{_s} : {_s + store_elems}]"
+        off = f"{offset_expr}" if _s is None else f"{offset_expr} + {_s}"
+        width = vsize if _s is None else store_elems
+        store = f"(gC_tap_{tap_idx}_ptr + {off}).store({span}, alignment=VEC_BYTES_TAP_{tap_idx})"
+        if row_pred is not None:
+            lines.append(f"if ({row_pred}) & (col_j + {(_s or 0) + width} <= {col_bound}):")
+            lines.append(f"    {store}")
+        else:
+            lines.append(store)
+    return lines

+def _reduction_output_offset_expr(red_idx: int, red: ReductionSpec, value_idx: str) -> str:
+    """Generate a reduction output offset."""
+    b_extent, m_extent, n_extent = red.dim
+    if red.grouped_by_moe:
+        batch = "cutlass.Int64(group_idx)"
+    else:
+        batch = "cutlass.Int64(0)" if b_extent == 1 else "tile_l"
+    m = "cutlass.Int64(0)" if m_extent == 1 else "row"
+    n = "cutlass.Int64(0)" if n_extent == 1 else f"(col_j + {value_idx})"
+    return f"(({m}) * red_stride_m_{red_idx} + " f"({n}) * red_stride_n_{red_idx} + " f"({batch}) * red_stride_l_{red_idx})"
+
+
+def _emit_reduction_local_combine(
+    red_idx: int,
+    red: ReductionSpec,
+    src: str,
+    vsize: int,
+) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+    """Fold one register vector before its output atomic."""
+    acc = f"_red_{red_idx}_acc"
+    is_int = red.compute_dtype == "int32"
+    zero = "cutlass.Int32(0)" if is_int else "cutlass.Float32(0.0)"
+
+    def elem(i: int) -> str:
+        v = f"{src}[{i}]"
+        if red.mode in ("amax", "norm1"):
+            return f"cute.math.abs({v})"
+        if red.mode == "norm2":
+            return f"{v} * {v}"
+        return v
+
+    if red.mode in ("add", "avg", "norm1", "norm2"):
+        init, combine = zero, "add"
+    elif red.mode in ("mul", "mul_no_zeros"):
+        init, combine = "cutlass.Float32(1.0)", "mul"
+    elif red.mode in ("max", "amax"):
+        init, combine = elem(0), "max"
+    else:
+        assert red.mode == "min"
+        init, combine = elem(0), "min"
+
+    lines = [f"{acc} = {init}"]
+    start = 0 if combine in ("add", "mul") else 1
+    for i in range(start, vsize):
+        if combine == "add":
+            lines.append(f"{acc} = {acc} + {elem(i)}")
+        elif combine == "mul":
+            if red.mode == "mul_no_zeros":
+                lines.append(f"if {src}[{i}] != cutlass.Float32(0.0):")
+                lines.append(f"    {acc} = {acc} * {src}[{i}]")
+            else:
+                lines.append(f"{acc} = {acc} * {src}[{i}]")
+        elif is_int:
+            op = ">" if combine == "max" else "<"
+            lines.append(f"if {elem(i)} {op} {acc}:")
+            lines.append(f"    {acc} = {elem(i)}")
+        else:
+            lines.append(f"{acc} = cute.math.{combine}({acc}, {elem(i)})")
+    return lines, acc
+

+def _quant_output_max(dtype: Dtype) -> str:
+    """Return the maximum quantized output magnitude."""
+    if dtype == "fp8_e4m3":
+        return "cutlass.Float32(448.0)"
+    if dtype == "fp8_e5m2":
+        return "cutlass.Float32(57344.0)"
+    if dtype == "fp4_e2m1":
+        return "cutlass.Float32(6.0)"
+    raise ValueError(f"block quantize output dtype {dtype!r} is not supported by codegen")
+
+
+def _scale_store_dtype(scale_dtype: Dtype) -> str:
+    """Return the storage type of a quantized scale."""
+    return "cutlass.Int8" if scale_dtype == "fp8_e5m3" else DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[scale_dtype]
+
+
+def _f8_128x4_row_scale_index_expr(row: str, scale_col: str, n_col_quads: str, *, atom_base: str | None = None) -> str:
+    """Physical byte index for one logical row scale in an F8_128x4 blob."""
+    prefix = f"{atom_base} + " if atom_base is not None else ""
+    return f"{prefix}(({row} // 128) * {n_col_quads} + ({scale_col} // 4)) * 512 + " f"({row} % 32) * 16 + (({row} % 128) // 32) * 4 + ({scale_col} % 4)"
+
+
+def _e8m0_f32(bits: str, *, reciprocal: bool = False) -> str:
+    """Widen a scale or its exact reciprocal without flushing subnormals."""
+    exponent = f"(254 - {bits})" if reciprocal else bits
+    special = f"({bits} >= 254)" if reciprocal else f"(({bits} == 0) | ({bits} == 255))"
+    return f"(({exponent} << 23) | ({special}.to(cutlass.Int32) << 22)).bitcast(cutlass.Float32)"
+
+
+def _emit_scale_quantize(p: str, sfx: str, src: str, scale_var: str, back_var: str, quant: BlockQuantizeSpec) -> list[str]:
+    """Quantize a scale and recover its stored value."""
+    scale_dtype = _scale_store_dtype(quant.scale_dtype)
+    if quant.scale_dtype == "fp8_e8m0":
+        return [
+            f"{p}_qb{sfx} = _frost_cvt_f32_to_e8m0_bits({src})",
+            f"{scale_var} = (({p}_qb{sfx}).to(cutlass.Int8)).bitcast({scale_dtype})",
+            f"{back_var} = {_e8m0_f32(f'{p}_qb{sfx}')}",
+        ]
+    if quant.scale_dtype == "fp8_e5m3":
+        return [
+            f"{p}_qb{sfx} = _frost_cvt_f32_to_e5m3_bits({src})",
+            f"{scale_var} = ({p}_qb{sfx}).to({scale_dtype})",
+            f"{back_var} = _frost_e5m3_bits_to_f32({p}_qb{sfx})",
+        ]
+    return [
+        f"{scale_var} = ({src}).to({scale_dtype})",
+        f"{back_var} = ({scale_var}).to(cutlass.Float32)",
+    ]
+
+
+def _emit_scale_quantize_pair(p: str, a: tuple[str, str, str, str], b: tuple[str, str, str, str], quant: BlockQuantizeSpec) -> list[str]:
+    """:func:`_emit_scale_quantize` for two scales at once."""
+    scale_dtype = _scale_store_dtype(quant.scale_dtype)
+    if quant.scale_dtype not in ("fp8_e8m0", "fp8_e5m3"):
+        return _emit_scale_quantize(p, *a, quant) + _emit_scale_quantize(p, *b, quant)
+    (sa, srca, scalea, backa), (sb, srcb, scaleb, backb) = a, b
+    fn = "_frost_cvt_f32_to_e8m0_bits" if quant.scale_dtype == "fp8_e8m0" else "_frost_cvt_f32_to_e5m3_bits"
+    lines = [
+        f"{p}_qw{sa} = {fn}_x2({srca}, {srcb})",
+        f"{p}_qb{sa} = {p}_qw{sa} & 0xFF",
+        f"{p}_qb{sb} = ({p}_qw{sa} >> 8) & 0xFF",
+    ]
+    if quant.scale_dtype == "fp8_e8m0":
+        return lines + [
+            f"{scalea} = (({p}_qb{sa}).to(cutlass.Int8)).bitcast({scale_dtype})",
+            f"{backa} = {_e8m0_f32(f'{p}_qb{sa}')}",
+            f"{scaleb} = (({p}_qb{sb}).to(cutlass.Int8)).bitcast({scale_dtype})",
+            f"{backb} = {_e8m0_f32(f'{p}_qb{sb}')}",
+        ]
+    return lines + [
+        f"{scalea} = ({p}_qb{sa}).to({scale_dtype})",
+        f"{scaleb} = ({p}_qb{sb}).to({scale_dtype})",
+        f"{backa}, {backb} = _frost_e5m3_bits_to_f32_x2({p}_qb{sa}, {p}_qb{sb})",
+    ]
+

+_MAINLOOP_IDX_BASE = {"a": 900, "b": 800}
+
+
+_MAINLOOP_IDENTITY_CAST_INTRINSICS: dict[tuple[Dtype, Dtype], str] = {
+    ("int8", "bf16"): "cute.arch.cvt_i8_bf16_intrinsic",
+}
+
+
+def generate_mainloop(chain: FusionChain, operand: str = "a") -> str:
+    """Generate one operand mainloop transform."""
+    ops = chain.mainloop_a_ops if operand == "a" else chain.mainloop_b_ops
+    if not ops:
+        return "pass"
+
+    src_dtype = chain.matmul.a_dtype if operand == "a" else chain.matmul.b_dtype
+    ab_dtype = DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[src_dtype]
+    vec_var = f"ml_vec_{operand}"
+    out_var = f"ml_out_{operand}"
+    base = _MAINLOOP_IDX_BASE[operand]
+    load_dtype = chain.mainloop_a_load_dtype if operand == "a" else chain.mainloop_b_load_dtype
+    identity_cast_intrinsic = (
+        _MAINLOOP_IDENTITY_CAST_INTRINSICS.get((load_dtype, src_dtype)) if len(ops) == 1 and ops[0].op == "identity" and load_dtype is not None else None
+    )
+    if identity_cast_intrinsic is not None:
+        cvt = f"{identity_cast_intrinsic}({vec_var}.ir_value(), ml_vec_elems)"
+        return f"{out_var} = cutlass.Vector({cvt}, dtype={ab_dtype})"
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    result_var: dict[int, str] = {-1: vec_var}
+    for i, op in enumerate(ops):
+        parent = op.resolved_parent_idx(i)
+        tag = f"ml_{operand}_{i}"
+        parent_dtype = (load_dtype or src_dtype) if parent < 0 else ops[parent].out_dtype
+        cast_lines, parent_var = _compute_cast(result_var[parent], op.compute_dtype, tag, source_dtype=parent_dtype)
+        lines.extend(cast_lines)
+        aux_loads = {}
+        if op.aux is not None:
+            ptr = f"{op.aux}.iterator.raw_ptr()"
+            ref = chain.aux_by_name(op.aux)
+            if ref.bcast_mode == "per_k":
+                dt = DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[op.compute_dtype]
+                # The renderer selects logical (unswizzled) vector accesses for
+                # this path. The operand is K-major, so vector lanes advance K.
+                lines.extend(
+                    [
+                        f"{tag}_scale = cute.make_rmem_tensor(ml_vec_elems, {dt})",
+                        f"{tag}_k = k_tile_idx * cta_tile_mnk[2] + ml_L % cta_tile_mnk[2]",
+                        f"for {tag}_lane in cutlass.range_constexpr(ml_vec_elems):",
+                        f"    {tag}_gk = {tag}_k + {tag}_lane",
+                        f"    {tag}_scale[{tag}_lane] = {dt}(0.0)",
+                        f"    if {tag}_gk < k:",
+                        f"        {tag}_scale[{tag}_lane] = ({ptr} + {tag}_gk).load().to({dt})",
+                    ]
+                )
+                aux_loads[op.aux] = f"{tag}_scale.load().to_vector()"
+            else:
+                aux_loads[op.aux] = f"cutlass.full_like({parent_var}, ({ptr} + 0).load().to({DTYPE_TO_CUTLASS[op.compute_dtype]}))"
+        emit_lines, cur = _emit_op(op, parent_var, base + i, aux_loads)
+        lines.extend(emit_lines)
+        if op.out_dtype in ("fp8_e4m3", "fp8_e5m2") and (op.compute_dtype == "int32" or (op.op == "identity" and parent_dtype in ("int8", "uint8", "int32"))):
+            cur = f"(({cur}).to(cutlass.Float32) + cutlass.full_like(({cur}).to(cutlass.Float32), 0.0))"
+        round_lines, cur = _emit_round(cur, op.out_dtype, tag, source_dtype=op.compute_dtype)
+        lines.extend(round_lines)
+        result_var[i] = cur
+    terminal_var = result_var[len(ops) - 1]
+    lines.append(f"{out_var} = ({terminal_var}).to({ab_dtype})")
+    major = "a_is_m_major" if operand == "a" else "b_is_n_major"
+    group = f"{operand}_tma_group_elems"
+    lines.extend(
+        [
+            "if cutlass.const_expr(mainloop_koob_fix):",
+            f"    if cutlass.const_expr({major}):",
+            f"        ml_k_of_L = (ml_L % ({group} * cta_tile_mnk[2])) // {group}",
+            "    else:",
+            "        ml_k_of_L = ml_L % cta_tile_mnk[2]",
+            f"    ml_valid = cutlass.full_like({out_var}.to(cutlass.Float32), cutlass.Float32(ml_k_of_L)) < cutlass.full_like({out_var}.to(cutlass.Float32), cutlass.Float32(k - k_tile_idx * cta_tile_mnk[2]))",
+            f"    {out_var} = cutlass._mlir_helpers.vector.where(ml_valid, {out_var}, cutlass.full_like({out_var}, 0.0))",
+        ]
+    )
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def _emit_splitk_partial_store(vsize: int) -> list[str]:
+    """Generate stores for split-K partial accumulators."""
+    chunk = min(vsize, 4)
+    lines = [f"_split_k_off = (tile_l * M + row) * N + col_j"]
+    for s in range(0, vsize, chunk):
+        lines.append(f"(gSplitK_partials_ptr + _split_k_off + {s}).store(vec_f32[{s} : {s + chunk}], alignment={chunk * 4})")
+    return lines

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _AuxCodegen:
+    wide_offsets: bool = False
+
+    def index_term(self, var: str, stride: int) -> str:
+        if stride == 1:
+            return var
+        return f"cutlass.Int64({var}) * {stride}" if self.wide_offsets else f"{var} * {stride}"
+
+    def index_expr(self, aux: TensorRef, *, row_var: str = "row", col_var: str = "col_j") -> str:

+        if len(aux.dim) == 1:
+            axes = ((aux.dim[0], aux.stride[0], col_var),)
+        elif len(aux.dim) == 2:

+        elif len(aux.dim) == 3:
+            lead_var = "group_idx" if aux.grouped_by_moe else "tile_l"
+            axes = ((aux.dim[0], aux.stride[0], lead_var), (aux.dim[1], aux.stride[1], row_var), (aux.dim[2], aux.stride[2], col_var))
+        else:

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RowBlockGeometry:
+    """The pair-tile decomposition of ``(bn, n_res)`` rows -- every number the kernel's host call needs."""
+
+    n_res: int
+    bn: int
+    n_pad: int  #: output k extent (a multiple of 8)
+    kb: int  #: k's per 256-row pair tile (power of two)
+    lkb: int  #: log2(kb)
+    r_i: int  #: bi's per pair tile (= 256 // kb)
+    n_kb: int  #: k blocks per bi row
+    n_ib: int  #: bi blocks (ceil(bn / r_i))
+    kbc: int  #: k's per CTA box (min(kb, 128))
+    rc: int  #: bi's per CTA box (128 // kbc)
+
+    @property
+    def pair_tiles(self) -> int:
+        return self.n_ib * self.n_kb
+
+    @property
+    def m_sched(self) -> int:
+        """The flat M the template's scheduler walks: one 256-row pair tile per (bi block, k block)."""
+        return self.pair_tiles * PAIR_TILE_ROWS
+
+    @property
+    def rows_computed(self) -> int:
+        return self.m_sched
+
+    @property
+    def rows_valid(self) -> int:
+        return self.bn * self.n_res
+
+
+def default_k_block(n_res: int) -> int:
+    """The rule: ``kb = 256`` for ``n_res >= 256`` (one bi per pair tile), else the next power of two >= max(n_res, 8)."""
+    n_res = int(n_res)
+    if n_res >= PAIR_TILE_ROWS:
+        return PAIR_TILE_ROWS
+    kb = MIN_K_BLOCK
+    while kb < n_res:
+        kb *= 2
+    return kb
+
+
+def validate_k_block(k_block) -> int:
+    """A caller's ``k_block``: a power of two in ``[MIN_K_BLOCK, PAIR_TILE_ROWS]`` (ValueError names the domain -- a malformed declaration)."""
+    if isinstance(k_block, bool) or not isinstance(k_block, int):
+        raise ValueError(f"k_block must be an int power of two in [{MIN_K_BLOCK}, {PAIR_TILE_ROWS}], got {k_block!r}")
+    if k_block < MIN_K_BLOCK or k_block > PAIR_TILE_ROWS or k_block & (k_block - 1):
+        raise ValueError(f"k_block must be a power of two in [{MIN_K_BLOCK}, {PAIR_TILE_ROWS}] (k's per 256-row pair tile), got {k_block}")
+    return k_block
+
+
+def row_block_geometry(n_res: int, bn: int, k_block: Optional[int] = None) -> RowBlockGeometry:
+    """The pair-tile decomposition: ``kb`` = :func:`default_k_block` (``None``) or the caller's :func:`validate_k_block`-checked ``k_block``
+    (a performance knob -- the same bits under every admitted value; the accumulators arm additionally needs ``kb >= MIN_K_BLOCK_MN_MAJOR``)."""
+    n_res, bn = int(n_res), int(bn)
+    if n_res < 1 or bn < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"n_res and bn must be >= 1, got n_res={n_res}, bn={bn}")
+    kb = default_k_block(n_res) if k_block is None else validate_k_block(k_block)
+    lkb = kb.bit_length() - 1
+    r_i = PAIR_TILE_ROWS // kb
+    n_kb = -(-n_res // kb)
+    n_ib = -(-bn // r_i)
+    kbc = min(kb, PAIR_TILE_ROWS // 2)
+    rc = (PAIR_TILE_ROWS // 2) // kbc
+    n_pad = -(-n_res // K_PAD_MULTIPLE) * K_PAD_MULTIPLE
+    return RowBlockGeometry(n_res=n_res, bn=bn, n_pad=n_pad, kb=kb, lkb=lkb, r_i=r_i, n_kb=n_kb, n_ib=n_ib, kbc=kbc, rc=rc)
+

+def interleave_value_gate(w_value, w_gate):
+    """Interleave 128-channel value and gate weight blocks."""
+    import torch
+
+    if w_value.shape != w_gate.shape or w_value.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"value / gate weights must both be [c_out, K], got {tuple(w_value.shape)} and {tuple(w_gate.shape)}")
+    c_out, k = w_value.shape
+    if c_out % CHANNEL_BLOCK != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"c_out must be a multiple of {CHANNEL_BLOCK}, got {c_out}")
+    v = w_value.reshape(c_out // CHANNEL_BLOCK, CHANNEL_BLOCK, k)
+    g = w_gate.reshape(c_out // CHANNEL_BLOCK, CHANNEL_BLOCK, k)
+    return torch.cat([v, g], dim=1).reshape(2 * c_out, k)
+
+
+def interleave_value_gate_bias(b_value, b_gate):
+    """The ``[c_out]`` value and gate biases in the interleaved ``[2 * c_out]`` order of :func:`interleave_value_gate`."""
+    return interleave_value_gate(b_value.reshape(-1, 1), b_gate.reshape(-1, 1)).reshape(-1)
+

+NUM_SCHED_CONSUMER_WARPS = NUM_COMPUTE_WARPS + 1
+
+EPI_REG_COUNT = 232
+PROD_REG_COUNT = 24
+assert NUM_COMPUTE_WARPS % 4 == 0, "the producer warps must form whole warpgroups"

+
+_ELEM_BITS = ab_dtype.width
+_ELEM_BYTES = _ELEM_BITS // 8

+_WARP_TILE_N = cta_tile_mnk[1] // WARPS_N

+_N_FRAGS = _WARP_TILE_N // 8

+_AB_SMEM_SWIZZLE_BYTES = _CTA_K_ELEMS * _ELEM_BYTES

+_AB_SWIZZLE = cutlass.Swizzle(_AB_SW_BBITS, 4, 3)
+
+_STG_EPI_LANE_QUAD = 4  # one STS.128 = 4 x 32-bit acc regs per lane
+_STG_EPI_PAD = 4  # 16B skew after each 128-element batch (sheet's X cells)
+_STG_EPI_BATCH_STRIDE = 32 * _STG_EPI_LANE_QUAD + _STG_EPI_PAD  # 132
+_STG_EPI_GROUP_FRAGS = 4  # fragments (= STS batches) per 32-column group
+_STG_EPI_WARP_ELEMS = _STG_EPI_GROUP_FRAGS * _STG_EPI_BATCH_STRIDE  # 528

+_RPL_SLABS = _M_FRAGS // _RPL_SUBPASSES

+
+def _rpl_swz(r):
+    """Return the row-major staging swizzle key."""
+    rr = r % 8
+    return ((rr & 3) << 1) | (rr >> 2)
+
+
+_STG_EPI_BYTES = 4 * _STG_EPI_WARP_ELEMS * NUM_COMPUTE_WARPS
+_AB_STAGE_BYTES = (num_a_operands * cta_tile_mnk[0] + num_b_operands * cta_tile_mnk[1]) * _CTA_K_ELEMS * _ELEM_BYTES + 16

+    f".{_MMA_C_TAG}.{_PTX_AB_TAG[mma_a_dtype]}.{_PTX_AB_TAG[mma_b_dtype]}.{_MMA_C_TAG} "

+@cute.jit

+    """One warp-wide mma.sync on a (16, 8, 32-byte-K) fragment."""
+    return cute.arch.inline_ptx(
+        _MMA_PTX,
+        write_only_types=[mma_c_dtype, mma_c_dtype, mma_c_dtype, mma_c_dtype],
+        read_only_args=[a0, a1, a2, a3, b0, b1, c0, c1, c2, c3],
+    )

+
+@cute.jit
+def _moe_auto_swizzle_w(group_rows, n, k, nt_n):
+    """N-super-block width for one routed group, resolved per group."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(tile_swizzle_n > 0):
+        return tile_swizzle_n
+    budget = cutlass.Int64(swizzle_l2_budget_bytes)
+    row_bytes = (cutlass.Int64(ab_dtype.width) * k) // 8
+    cap = cutlass.max(budget // (row_bytes * cgrp_tile_mnk[1]), cutlass.Int64(1))
+    w = cutlass.min(cutlass.Int64(nt_n), cap)
+    rows = cutlass.Int64(group_rows)
+    if cutlass.min(rows, n) * row_bytes <= budget and rows <= n:
+        w = cutlass.Int64(1)
+    return cutlass.Int32(w)

+        z_addr = z_addr + z_step * cutlass.Int64(2)
+        y_addr = y_addr + y_step * cutlass.Int64(2)
+        do_prime_addr = do_prime_addr + do_prime_step * cutlass.Int64(2)
+        dz_addr = dz_addr + dz_step * cutlass.Int64(2)
+    if idx < num_vectors:
+        do_word = ld_global_v4(do_addr, cutlass.Int32)
+        z_word = ld_global_v4(z_addr, cutlass.Int32)
+        y_word = ld_global_v4(y_addr, cutlass.Int32)
+        do_prime_values = []
+        dz_values = []
+        for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(pairs):
+            do_lo, do_hi = f16x2_to_f32(do_word[m], dtype=io_dtype)
+            z_lo, z_hi = f16x2_to_f32(z_word[m], dtype=io_dtype)
+            y_lo, y_hi = f16x2_to_f32(y_word[m], dtype=io_dtype)
+            sig_lo, sig_hi = sigmoid2(z_lo, z_hi)
+            zsig_lo, zsig_hi = fmul2(z_lo, z_hi, sig_lo, sig_hi)
+            do_prime_lo, do_prime_hi = fmul2(do_lo, do_hi, zsig_lo, zsig_hi)
+            rest_lo, rest_hi = fadd2(one, one, -sig_lo, -sig_hi)
+            inner_lo, inner_hi = ffma2(rest_lo, rest_hi, z_lo, z_hi, one, one)
+            slope_lo, slope_hi = fmul2(sig_lo, sig_hi, inner_lo, inner_hi)
+            doy_lo, doy_hi = fmul2(do_lo, do_hi, y_lo, y_hi)
+            dz_lo, dz_hi = fmul2(doy_lo, doy_hi, slope_lo, slope_hi)
+            do_prime_values += [do_prime_lo, do_prime_hi]
+            dz_values += [dz_lo, dz_hi]
+        do_prime_words = [fp32_to_fp16(do_prime_values[2 * m], do_prime_values[2 * m + 1], dtype=io_dtype) for m in range(pairs)]
+        dz_words = [fp32_to_fp16(dz_values[2 * m], dz_values[2 * m + 1], dtype=io_dtype) for m in range(pairs)]
+        st_global_v4(do_prime_addr, do_prime_words, cutlass.Int32)
+        st_global_v4(dz_addr, dz_words, cutlass.Int32)

+@cute.kernel
+def frost_mamba2_gate_bwd_partial(
+    mDotQ: cute.Tensor,
+    mDotK: cute.Tensor,
+    mExit: cute.Tensor,
+    mG: cute.Tensor,
+    mA: cute.Tensor,
+    mDtBias: cute.Tensor | None,
+    mSlots: cute.Tensor,
+    mDg: cute.Tensor,
+    mPartA: cute.Tensor,
+    mPartDt: cute.Tensor | None,
+    mSkipPart: cute.Tensor | None,
+    h_o: cutlass.Int32,
+    dt_min: cutlass.Float32,
+    dt_max: cutlass.Float32,
+    b_t: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    dt_softplus: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    skip_channels: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+) -> None:
+    """Grid (slots, ceil(HO / MAMBA2_GATE_HEADS)), block (MAMBA2_GATE_THREADS,): one chunk slot by MAMBA2_GATE_HEADS
+    heads.  The slot table names the chunk (first token, sequence end; -1 at a spare slot past its sequence's chunks,
+    where the heads' dA / d_dt_bias partials and the bprop's four dD partial rows are zeroed).  Loads run with lane =
+    head (the heads of one token are contiguous in the head-major tensors) into padded SMEM tiles; the math runs with
+    lane = token, four heads per thread: the raw-dt gradient of every token from the row dots and the exit term (the
+    reverse cumulative sum within the chunk), stored through SMEM with lane = head again, plus the per-head dA /
+    d_dt_bias partials over the chunk in a fixed bracketing."""
+    HB = cutlass.const_expr(MAMBA2_GATE_HEADS)
+    LD = cutlass.const_expr(HB + 1)
+    heads_per_thread = cutlass.const_expr(4)
+    tokens_per_warp = cutlass.const_expr(32 // HB)
+    tokens_per_pass = cutlass.const_expr(MAMBA2_GATE_THREADS // HB)
+    passes = cutlass.const_expr(b_t // tokens_per_pass)
+    quarters = cutlass.const_expr(b_t // 32)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(USE_PDL):
+        wait_on_dependent_grids()
+    tidx = cutlass.Int32(cute.arch.thread_idx()[0])
+    slot = cutlass.Int32(cute.arch.block_idx()[0])
+    h0 = cutlass.Int32(cute.arch.block_idx()[1]) * cutlass.Int32(HB)
+    lane_idx = tidx % cutlass.Int32(32)
+    warp = tidx // cutlass.Int32(32)
+    first = cutlass.Int32(mSlots[slot, 0])
+    sequence_end = cutlass.Int32(mSlots[slot, 1])
+    sDotQ = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Float32, b_t * LD, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=16)
+    sDotK = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Float32, b_t * LD, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=16)
+    sG = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Float32, b_t * LD, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=16)
+    sDg = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Float32, b_t * LD, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=16)
+    sWarp = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Float32, HB * quarters, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=16)
+    sWarpA = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Float32, HB * quarters, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=16)
+    sWarpDt = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Float32, HB * quarters, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=16)
+    if first >= cutlass.Int32(0):
+        # ---- loads with lane = head: the heads of one token are contiguous ----------------------------
+        load_head = lane_idx % cutlass.Int32(HB)
+        head = h0 + load_head
+        head_ok = head < h_o
+        head_c = head if head_ok else h_o - cutlass.Int32(1)
+        for p in cutlass.range_constexpr(passes):
+            t = cutlass.Int32(p * tokens_per_pass) + warp * cutlass.Int32(tokens_per_warp) + lane_idx // cutlass.Int32(HB)
+            token = first + t
+            valid = token < sequence_end
+            token_c = token if valid else sequence_end - cutlass.Int32(1)
+            take = valid and head_ok
+            sDotQ[t * LD + load_head] = mDotQ[token_c, head_c] if take else cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            sDotK[t * LD + load_head] = mDotK[token_c, head_c] if take else cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            sG[t * LD + load_head] = mG[token_c, head_c].to(cutlass.Float32)
+        nvvm.barrier_cta_sync()
+
+        # ---- math with lane = token, four heads per thread -------------------------------------------
+        quarter = warp % cutlass.Int32(quarters)
+        head_group = warp // cutlass.Int32(quarters)
+        t = quarter * cutlass.Int32(32) + lane_idx
+        token = first + t
+        valid = token < sequence_end
+        a_values = []
+        exit_values = []
+        dot_k_values = []
+        dt_values = []
+        slope_values = []
+        clamped_values = []
+        d_pre_values = []
+        incl_values = []
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(heads_per_thread):
+            hl = head_group * cutlass.Int32(heads_per_thread) + cutlass.Int32(i)
+            math_head = h0 + hl
+            math_head_c = math_head if math_head < h_o else h_o - cutlass.Int32(1)
+            a = mA[math_head_c].to(cutlass.Float32)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(mDtBias is not None):
+                bias = mDtBias[math_head_c].to(cutlass.Float32)
+            else:
+                bias = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            y = sG[t * LD + hl] + bias
+            dot_q = sDotQ[t * LD + hl]
+            dot_k = sDotK[t * LD + hl]
+            exit_term = mExit[slot + cutlass.Int32(1), math_head_c]
+            if cutlass.const_expr(dt_softplus):
+                dt = softplus(y)
+                slope = sigmoid(y)
+            else:
+                dt = y
+                slope = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+            clamped = dt < dt_min or dt > dt_max
+            dt_c = cutlass.max(cutlass.min(dt, dt_max), dt_min)
+            d_pre = dot_q - dot_k
+
+            # ---- reverse inclusive cumulative sum within the chunk: total - exclusive prefix ---------
+            incl = d_pre
+            for offset in [1, 2, 4, 8, 16]:
+                n = nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, incl, offset, 0, kind=nvvm.Shfl.UP)
+                if lane_idx >= offset:
+                    incl = incl + n
+            if lane_idx == 31:
+                sWarp[hl * cutlass.Int32(quarters) + quarter] = incl
+            a_values.append(a)
+            exit_values.append(exit_term)
+            dot_k_values.append(dot_k)
+            dt_values.append(dt_c)
+            slope_values.append(slope)
+            clamped_values.append(clamped)
+            d_pre_values.append(d_pre)
+            incl_values.append(incl)
+        nvvm.barrier_cta_sync()
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(heads_per_thread):
+            hl = head_group * cutlass.Int32(heads_per_thread) + cutlass.Int32(i)
+            warp_prefix = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            total = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(quarters):
+                w_sum = sWarp[hl * cutlass.Int32(quarters) + cutlass.Int32(w)]
+                total = total + w_sum
+                if cutlass.Int32(w) < quarter:
+                    warp_prefix = warp_prefix + w_sum
+            suffix = total - (warp_prefix + incl_values[i] - d_pre_values[i])
+            dl = suffix + exit_values[i]
+            dt_c = dt_values[i]
+            dbeta = dot_k_values[i] / dt_c if dt_c > cutlass.Float32(0.0) else cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            ddt = dl * a_values[i] + dbeta
+            dg = cutlass.Float32(0.0) if clamped_values[i] else ddt * slope_values[i]
+            sDg[t * LD + hl] = dg
+            part_a = dl * dt_c if valid else cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            part_dt = dg if valid else cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            for offset in [16, 8, 4, 2, 1]:
+                part_a = part_a + cutlass.Float32(nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, part_a, offset, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY))
+                part_dt = part_dt + cutlass.Float32(nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, part_dt, offset, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY))
+            if lane_idx == 0:
+                sWarpA[hl * cutlass.Int32(quarters) + quarter] = part_a
+                sWarpDt[hl * cutlass.Int32(quarters) + quarter] = part_dt
+        nvvm.barrier_cta_sync()
+
+        # ---- stores with lane = head, the partials by the first HB threads ---------------------------
+        for p in cutlass.range_constexpr(passes):
+            t = cutlass.Int32(p * tokens_per_pass) + warp * cutlass.Int32(tokens_per_warp) + lane_idx // cutlass.Int32(HB)
+            token = first + t
+            if (token < sequence_end) and head_ok:
+                mDg[token, head] = sDg[t * LD + load_head].to(mDg.element_type)
+        if tidx < cutlass.Int32(HB):
+            out_head = h0 + tidx
+            if out_head < h_o:
+                part_a = sWarpA[tidx * cutlass.Int32(quarters)]
+                part_dt = sWarpDt[tidx * cutlass.Int32(quarters)]
+                for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, quarters):
+                    part_a = part_a + sWarpA[tidx * cutlass.Int32(quarters) + cutlass.Int32(w)]
+                    part_dt = part_dt + sWarpDt[tidx * cutlass.Int32(quarters) + cutlass.Int32(w)]
+                mPartA[slot * h_o + out_head] = part_a
+                if cutlass.const_expr(mPartDt is not None):
+                    mPartDt[slot * h_o + out_head] = part_dt
+    else:
+        # ---- a spare slot past its sequence's chunks: zeros for the sums' fixed shape ----------------
+        if cutlass.const_expr(mSkipPart is not None):
+            for base in cutlass.range_constexpr(0, 4 * skip_channels * HB, MAMBA2_GATE_THREADS):
+                idx = cutlass.Int32(base) + tidx
+                if idx < cutlass.Int32(4 * skip_channels * HB):
+                    hl = idx // cutlass.Int32(4 * skip_channels)
+                    rem = idx % cutlass.Int32(4 * skip_channels)
+                    head = h0 + hl
+                    if head < h_o:
+                        row = slot * cutlass.Int32(4) + rem // cutlass.Int32(skip_channels)
+                        mSkipPart[(row * h_o + head) * cutlass.Int32(skip_channels) + rem % cutlass.Int32(skip_channels)] = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        if tidx < cutlass.Int32(HB):
+            out_head = h0 + tidx
+            if out_head < h_o:
+                mPartA[slot * h_o + out_head] = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(mPartDt is not None):
+                    mPartDt[slot * h_o + out_head] = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+
