+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TemplateParams2x2(TemplateParams):
+    """``TemplateParams`` plus the 2x2 kernel's ring levers.  A SEPARATE record on purpose: the
+    base record gains no field, so every 4x1 rendering keeps its ``FROST_SOURCE_DIGEST`` and
+    its compiled-plan cache entries.  The adapter builds this record only on the 2x2 path
+    (``api_dsl.STAGE2_2X2``), per device: ``stages_kv`` 4 / ``cast_stages`` 1 fit SM100's
+    227 KiB, 8 / 2 fill Rubin's 325 KiB.  No arch name rides here -- only resources."""
+
+    # K / V ring depth in 64-d CHUNK stages (8 KiB K + 8 KiB V per stage per CTA).
+    stages_kv: int = 4
+    # S / dS cast buffers for the workspace TMA store (16 KiB each per stage).
+    cast_stages: int = 1
+    # d columns per ring stage; 64 = one SW128 subtile of 64 kv rows per operand.
+    d_chunk: int = 64
+    # Usable dynamic SMEM of the target device (the validator's cap).
+    smem_cap_bytes: int = _SM100_MAX_DYN_SMEM
+    # S_acc / dS_acc parity slots: 2 (256 TMEM columns) or 4 (512 = the whole TMEM, the free lever that decouples
+    # compute jitter from the MMA and makes the pair's cta_group::2 alloc claim every column, as the 4x1 does).
+    stages_acc: int = 2
+    # How many PAIRS share one K / V chunk ring slot: 2 = cross-pair TMA multicast (chunk c issued by pair c & 1 to
+    # {c, c ^ 2}, ring_empty init 2 released by both leaders' commits mask 0xF); 1 = every pair loads its own K / V
+    # (self-only multicast, ring_empty init 1, commit mask = pair) -- the pairs are then decoupled, at 2x the L2 -> SMEM
+    # bytes.  A diagnostic / fallback arm, not a perf lever.
+    kv_share: int = 2
+    # DEBUG lever, default OFF (0 = the kernel traces no debug code at all).  > 0: every mbarrier wait in the kernel is
+    # bounded by this many milliseconds of %globaltimer; on timeout the warp writes one 16 x Int32 record (status, barrier
+    # id, stage, phase, kv_loop, chunk, q_block, tile#, cta_id_x, smid, block idx, raw mbarrier word) to the dump buffer
+    # at ``debug_dump_addr`` (a DEVICE-ACCESSIBLE address the driver allocates -- host-pinned so it survives the stuck
+    # process; >= 16 MiB; record slot = (linear block id * 8 + warp) * 16 words) and then KEEPS waiting, so the hang stays
+    # frozen for the host to read.  Both fields must be set for the lever to arm.  Never a production path: the address
+    # rides in the template record and is baked into the rendering.
+    debug_wait_ms: int = 0
+    debug_dump_addr: int = 0
+    # DEBUG heartbeat (needs debug_dump_addr; independent of debug_wait_ms): every warp writes its record (status WAITING,
+    # barrier id, stage, phase, kv_loop, chunk, ...) BEFORE each mbarrier wait and flips the status to RUNNING after it,
+    # with the wait itself left in its production form -- so a hang of the UNMODIFIED wait shows exactly which warps sit
+    # in which wait.  A few 4-B stores per wait; the bounded-wait lever is a different code shape and may not reproduce.
+    debug_heartbeat: int = 0
+    # The kernel's mbarrier wait forms (see CfgBwdD512x2.WAIT_FORM): 0 ships; 1-4 are diagnostic arms for the GPU-sharing hang.
+    wait_form: int = 0
+    # ATTRIBUTION lever, default OFF (0 = zero traced code; the default rendering is pinned PTX-identical by
+    # ``renderings/md5_stage2_2x2_sm100a.txt``).  1 (needs ``debug_dump_addr``, excludes the other two debug modes): every
+    # warp accumulates the %clock64 it spends INSIDE each mbarrier wait, per barrier id, plus the time of its issue segments
+    # (STG store drain, compute math / cast store, MMA chunk issue, LDG chunk issue) in a per-warp SMEM slice, and at exit
+    # writes the slice -- 32 x Int64: [0] body clk, [1..10] wait clk per DBG_BAR id, [11..15] segments, [16] q tiles,
+    # [17] role kv total, [18..27] waits per DBG_BAR id that took > DBG_CLK_BLOCKED_THRESH clk -- to the dump buffer at
+    # ``(linear block * 8 + warp) * 32`` Int64 (unchecked index: the 16 MiB buffer holds 8192 CTAs per launch -- a larger
+    # grid must be head-chunked by the host; the GPU accounting test asserts it).  The waits keep their production form;
+    # the cost is two S2R clock reads and one SMEM read-modify-write by the elected lane per wait (measured as the lever's
+    # own overhead next to its numbers).
+    debug_clk: int = 0

+@dataclass(frozen=True)

+

+    TILE_M: int = 64  # q rows per CTA (collective MMA M = TILE_M * CTA_MMA = 128)
+    TILE_N: int = 128  # kv cols per kernel tile (collective MMA N; each CTA holds N / CTA_MMA rows of K and V)

+    TILE_O: int = 512  # d_v

+    DTYPE_QKV: int = DTYPE_BF16
+    BPE: int = 2

+
+    Q_SWZ_BYTES: int = 128
+    K_SWZ_BYTES: int = 128
+    V_SWZ_BYTES: int = 128
+    DO_SWZ_BYTES: int = 128
+    S_SWZ_BYTES: int = 128

+    TILE_K_HW_BMM1: int = 16
+    TILE_K_HW_BMM2: int = 16
+
+    STAGES_KV: int = 4  # K / V chunk ring depth (SM100: 4 x 16 KiB; SM107: 8)
+    STAGES_ACC: int = 2  # S_acc / dS_acc parity slots
+    CAST_STAGES: int = 1  # S / dS cast buffers (SM100: 1; SM107: 2)
+    SCHEDULER_STAGES: int = 2
+
+    SOFTMAX_WARPGROUPS: int = 1
+    SOFTMAX_WG_WARPS: int = 4
+    CORRECTION_WARPS: int = 0
+

+    CORRECTION_REGS: int = 0
+    MMA_REGS: int = 40
+    TMALDG_REGS: int = 40
+    TMASTG_REGS: int = 40
+    SCHEDULER_REGS: int = 40
+    OTHER_REGS: int = 40
+
+    TOTAL_WARPS: int = 8
+    THREADS_PER_CTA: int = 8 * 32
+    SOFTMAX_WG0_BASE: int = 0
+    MMA_WARP_ID: int = 4
+    TMALDG_WARP_ID: int = 5
+    TMASTG_WARP_ID: int = 6
+    SCHED_WARP_ID: int = 7
+

+    ONE_WARP: int = 32  # an un-elected THREAD arrive from one warp

+class Slab2x2(NamedTuple):
+    """One SMEM slab of the 2x2 kernel: ``roots`` are every tcgen05 SMEM-descriptor ``build()`` root in it
+    (``(label, byte offset)``) -- the addresses the descriptor-version rule is judged on."""
+
+    name: str
+    nbytes: int
+    offset: int
+    roots: Tuple[Tuple[str, int], ...]
+
+
+def operand_bytes_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> Tuple[int, int, int, int]:
+    """(Q, dO, K-per-ring-stage, V-per-ring-stage) SMEM bytes for ONE CTA.
+
+    Q and dO are the CTA's whole 64 x d block (SS operands, resident per q tile); K and V are
+    the CTA's ``TILE_N / CTA_MMA`` kv rows x ``D_CHUNK`` columns of one chunk."""
+    q = cfg.TILE_M * cfg.TILE_K * cfg.BPE
+    do = cfg.TILE_M * cfg.TILE_O * cfg.BPE
+    k = (cfg.TILE_N // cfg.CTA_MMA) * cfg.D_CHUNK * cfg.BPE
+    v = (cfg.TILE_N // cfg.CTA_MMA) * cfg.D_CHUNK * cfg.BPE
+    return q, do, k, v
+
+
+def cast_bytes_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> int:
+    """io-dtype staging for one workspace tile of S (or of dS): 64 rows x TILE_N."""
+    return cfg.TILE_M * cfg.TILE_N * cfg.BPE
+
+
+def smem_layout_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> Tuple[Slab2x2, ...]:
+    """The kernel's slabs in DECLARATION (== address) order: sQ, sdO, sRingK, sRingV, sCastS, sCastDS.
+
+    Every slab is a 1024-B-aligned ``cutlass.Array`` of the io dtype.  The cast slabs are TMA-store sources
+    only (no tcgen05 descriptor), which is why they are declared LAST: on Rubin the 8-stage ring's last
+    descriptor root ends exactly at the version-0 window's last byte."""
+    q, do, k, v = operand_bytes_2x2(cfg)
+    a_subtile = cfg.TILE_M * cfg.D_CHUNK * cfg.BPE  # one Q / dO chunk = one SW128 subtile
+    cast = cast_bytes_2x2(cfg)
+    slabs = []
+    off = 0
+
+    def _push(name, nbytes, roots):
+        nonlocal off
+        slabs.append(Slab2x2(name, nbytes, off, tuple((f"{name}.{lab}", off + o) for lab, o in roots)))
+        off += nbytes
+
+    _push("sQ", q, [(f"chunk{c}", c * a_subtile) for c in range(cfg.N_CHUNKS)])
+    _push("sdO", do, [(f"chunk{c}", c * a_subtile) for c in range(cfg.N_CHUNKS)])
+    _push("sRingK", cfg.STAGES_KV * k, [(f"stage{s}", s * k) for s in range(cfg.STAGES_KV)])
+    _push("sRingV", cfg.STAGES_KV * v, [(f"stage{s}", s * v) for s in range(cfg.STAGES_KV)])
+    _push("sCastS", cfg.CAST_STAGES * cast, [])
+    _push("sCastDS", cfg.CAST_STAGES * cast, [])
+    return tuple(slabs)
+
+
+def smem_bytes_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> int:
+    """Slab bytes per CTA (the ``cutlass.Array`` allocations), scaffolding excluded."""
+    return sum(s.nbytes for s in smem_layout_2x2(cfg))
+
+
+def desc_roots_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> Tuple[Tuple[str, int], ...]:
+    """Every tcgen05 SMEM-descriptor root the kernel builds or advances to, ``(label, byte offset)``."""
+    return tuple(r for s in smem_layout_2x2(cfg) for r in s.roots)
+
+
+def desc_version_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> int:
+    """The ``desc_version=`` EVERY ``SmemTile`` of the kernel must take (bound once as the module constant
+    ``DESC_VERSION``, never per tile): 1 when any root starts at or past the 14-bit version-0 window."""
+    return 1 if any(off >= TCGEN05_V0_ADDR_LIMIT_2X2 for _, off in desc_roots_2x2(cfg)) else 0
+
+
+def acc_cols_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> int:
+    """TMEM columns of ONE 64 x TILE_N fp32 accumulator under the 2x2 D image: TILE_N / CTA_MMA."""
+    return cfg.TILE_N // cfg.CTA_MMA
+
+
+def tmem_cols_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> int:
+    """TMEM columns per CTA: two accumulators (S_acc, dS_acc) x STAGES_ACC parities x ACC_COLS; no operand columns
+    (Q and dO are SS operands from SMEM -- a 2SM M=128 TS operand is duplicated across the lane halves and saves nothing)."""
+    return 2 * cfg.STAGES_ACC * acc_cols_2x2(cfg)
+
+
+def op_tx_bytes_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> int:
+    """``mb_tma_op_full`` expect_tx: Q + dO of BOTH CTAs of the pair (a cta_group::2 TMA's bytes complete on the pair leader)."""
+    q, do, _, _ = operand_bytes_2x2(cfg)
+    return cfg.CTA_MMA * (q + do)
+
+
+def ring_tx_bytes_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> int:
+    """``mb_tma_ring_full`` expect_tx per chunk stage: the K chunk + the V chunk landing in EACH CTA of the pair, whether
+    this pair or the partner pair issued them (destination-pair-leader routing of the multicast's complete_tx)."""
+    _, _, k, v = operand_bytes_2x2(cfg)
+    return cfg.CTA_MMA * (k + v)
+
+
+def cast_subtiles_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> int:
+    """Workspace TMA subtiles per stored tile: one subtile row is exactly one swizzle atom (128 B = 64 bf16 columns)."""
+    return (cfg.TILE_N * cfg.BPE) // cfg.S_SWZ_BYTES
+
+
+def _validate_cfg_d512_2x2(cfg: CfgBwdD512x2) -> None:
+    """Consistency checks on the 2x2 stage-2 geometry (every number the kernel's ``_require``s re-check)."""
+    layout = smem_layout_2x2(cfg)
+    smem = smem_bytes_2x2(cfg)
+    tmem = tmem_cols_2x2(cfg)
+    checks = (
+        # --- register split: all four are hardware constraints -------------
+        (cfg.MMA_REGS == cfg.TMALDG_REGS == cfg.TMASTG_REGS == cfg.SCHEDULER_REGS, "bwd d512 2x2: MMA/TMALDG/TMASTG/Scheduler regs must match"),
+        (cfg.MMA_REGS + cfg.CORRECTION_REGS + cfg.SOFTMAX_WARPGROUPS * cfg.SOFTMAX_REGS <= 512, "bwd d512 2x2: register budget over 512"),
+        (
+            cfg.MMA_REGS % 8 == 0 and cfg.CORRECTION_REGS % 8 == 0 and cfg.SOFTMAX_REGS % 8 == 0,
+            "bwd d512 2x2: per-role regs must be multiples of 8",
+        ),
+        (24 <= cfg.SOFTMAX_REGS <= 256 and 24 <= cfg.MMA_REGS <= 256, "bwd d512 2x2: per-warp regs must be within [24, 256]"),
+        # --- geometry ------------------------------------------------------
+        (cfg.TILE_M == 64, "bwd d512 2x2: TILE_M must be 64 (the cta_group::2 M = 128 datapath: 64 rows per CTA)"),
+        (cfg.TILE_N == 128, "bwd d512 2x2: TILE_N must be 128 (each CTA holds 64 kv rows of K and V; a 64 x 128 fp32 accumulator is 64 TMEM columns)"),
+        (cfg.TILE_K == 512 and cfg.TILE_O == 512, "bwd d512 2x2: d_qk = d_v = 512"),

+def make_cfg_d512_2x2(params: TemplateParams) -> CfgBwdD512x2:
+    """The 2x2 config from a ``TemplateParams2x2`` (or a base ``TemplateParams``: the levers take their defaults)."""
+    _validate_params(params)
+    b = bpe(params.dtype_qkv)
+    stages_kv = int(getattr(params, "stages_kv", 4))
+    cast_stages = int(getattr(params, "cast_stages", 1))
+    d_chunk = int(getattr(params, "d_chunk", 64))
+    smem_cap = int(getattr(params, "smem_cap_bytes", _SM100_MAX_DYN_SMEM))
+    stages_acc = int(getattr(params, "stages_acc", 2))
+    kv_share = int(getattr(params, "kv_share", 2))
+    debug_wait_ms = int(getattr(params, "debug_wait_ms", 0))
+    debug_dump_addr = int(getattr(params, "debug_dump_addr", 0))
+    debug_heartbeat = int(getattr(params, "debug_heartbeat", 0))
+    wait_form = int(getattr(params, "wait_form", 0))
+    debug_clk = int(getattr(params, "debug_clk", 0))
+    if d_chunk <= 0 or 512 % d_chunk != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"bwd d512 2x2: d_chunk must be a positive divisor of 512; got {d_chunk}")
+    cfg = CfgBwdD512x2(
+        DTYPE_QKV=params.dtype_qkv,
+        BPE=b,
+        D_CHUNK=d_chunk,
+        N_CHUNKS=512 // d_chunk,
+        STAGES_KV=stages_kv,
+        STAGES_ACC=stages_acc,
+        CAST_STAGES=cast_stages,
+        KV_SHARE=kv_share,
+        RING_EMPTY_ARRIVERS=kv_share,
+        DEBUG_WAIT_MS=debug_wait_ms,
+        DEBUG_DUMP_ADDR=debug_dump_addr,
+        DEBUG_HEARTBEAT=debug_heartbeat,
+        WAIT_FORM=wait_form,
+        DEBUG_CLK=debug_clk,
+        SMEM_CAP_BYTES=smem_cap,
+        MASK_FLAGS=_mask_flags_from(params),
+        WINDOW_LEFT=params.window_left or 0,
+        WINDOW_RIGHT=params.window_right or 0,
+        BOTTOM_RIGHT=int(params.bottom_right),
+        SEQ_KV_LENS_PRESENT=int(params.seq_kv_lens_present),
+        SEQ_Q_LENS_PRESENT=int(params.seq_q_lens_present),
+        THD_VARLEN=int(params.thd_varlen),
+        SCHEDULER_POLICY=params.sched_policy,
+    )
+    _validate_cfg_d512_2x2(cfg)
+    return cfg
+
+
+def _sm100_device_clusters(device, cga_m: int) -> int:
+    """Clusters that fit the device once, for the THD persistent grid.
+
+    Occupancy-sized rather than work-sized: the work list is a device value, so
+    the grid cannot be it.  One CTA per SM is this kernel's design point, so the
+    cluster count is simply SM count / CGA width.
+    """
+    from cudnn.frost import device as _dev
+
+    idx = _dev.resolve_device(device)
+    return max(1, _dev.multiprocessor_count(idx) // cga_m)

+"""Dense d64 / d128 accumulation geometry."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+HEAD_DIMS = (64, 128)
+_SLICE_BYTES = 16384
+_BAR_BYTES = 400
+_SCHED_BYTES = 64
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Config:
+    M: int = 128
+    N: int = 128
+    D: int = 128
+    K_HW: int = 16
+    BPE: int = 2
+    HEAD_BOX: int = 64
+    DQ_BOX: int = 32
+    THREADS: int = 512
+    TMEM_COLS: int = 512
+    SMEM_BYTES: int = 231424
+    Q: int = 0
+    DO: int = 65536
+    K: int = 98304
+    V: int = 131072
+    ALIAS: int = 163840
+    STATS: int = 229376
+    DELTA: int = 229888
+    TMEM_HANDLE: int = 230800
+    SCHED_PAYLOAD: int = 230816
+    OPERAND_BYTES: int = 32768
+    SLICE_BYTES: int = 16384
+    Q_STAGES: int = 2
+    SCHED_STAGES: int = 2
+    SOFTMAX_LANES: int = 256
+    EPILOGUE_LANES: int = 128
+    STORE_LANES: int = 32
+    ONE_LANE: int = 1
+    SCHED_CONSUMER_WARPS: int = 15
+    SOFTMAX_REGS: int = 144
+    EPILOGUE_REGS: int = 144
+    SERVICE_REGS: int = 80
+    SOFTMAX_BARRIER: int = 1
+    DESC_VERSION: int = 1
+    SWIZZLE_BYTES: int = 128
+    SWIZZLE_LAYOUT: int = 2
+    # --- dkv_accum = fp32_reduce (the grouped THD kernel only): the fp32 dV / dK staging over the ALIAS slab and the TMEM planes it reads ---
+    BPE_ACC: int = 4  # fp32 accumulator bytes (the dQ image and the fp32 dK / dV staging)
+    D_HALF: int = 64  # one TMEM readout half of a 128-column accumulator plane
+    DV_COL: int = 256  # TMEM column of the dV accumulator plane (the bodies' `tmem_base + 256`)
+    DK_COL: int = 384  # TMEM column of the dK accumulator plane (the bodies' `tmem_base + 384`)
+    DKV_ACC_SLICES: int = 4  # fp32 [M x DQ_BOX] reduce-add slices per [M x D] tile = D // DQ_BOX = the dQ ring's slot count
+    DKV_ACC_SLICE_BYTES: int = 16384  # M x DQ_BOX x BPE_ACC = SLICE_BYTES: the four slices fill the 64 KiB ALIAS slab exactly
+    ALIAS_SLICES: int = 4
+    DQ_SLICES: int = 4
+    DO_SUBTILES: int = 2
+
+    def dkv_acc_slot(self, index):
+        """Byte base of fp32 staging slice ``index`` of a dV / dK round: the dQ fp32 image's slice ``index`` over the ALIAS slab."""
+        return self.ALIAS + index * self.DKV_ACC_SLICE_BYTES

+def make_config(d: int) -> Config:
+    """The slab geometry of the accumulation kernel at head dimension ``d``."""
+    if d not in HEAD_DIMS:
+        raise ValueError(f"accumulation head dimension must be one of {HEAD_DIMS}; got {d}")
+    operand = 128 * d * 2
+    dq_slices = d // 32
+    alias_slices = max(2, dq_slices, 2 * operand // _SLICE_BYTES)
+    q = 0
+    do = q + 2 * operand
+    k = do + operand
+    v = k + operand
+    alias = v + operand
+    stats = alias + alias_slices * _SLICE_BYTES
+    delta = stats + 512
+    bars = delta + 512
+    tmem_handle = bars + _BAR_BYTES
+    sched = tmem_handle + 16
+    smem = (sched + _SCHED_BYTES + 1023) // 1024 * 1024
+    return Config(
+        D=d,
+        HEAD_BOX=64,
+        SMEM_BYTES=smem,
+        Q=q,
+        DO=do,
+        K=k,
+        V=v,
+        ALIAS=alias,
+        STATS=stats,
+        DELTA=delta,
+        TMEM_HANDLE=tmem_handle,
+        SCHED_PAYLOAD=sched,
+        OPERAND_BYTES=operand,
+        ALIAS_SLICES=alias_slices,
+        DQ_SLICES=dq_slices,
+        DO_SUBTILES=d // 64,
+        D_HALF=d // 2,
+        DV_COL=256,
+        DK_COL=256 + d,
+        DKV_ACC_SLICES=d // 32,
+    )
+

+    if name is None:

+    if type(name) is not str or name not in CFG.DIAG_2CTA_NAMES:

+    name = resolve_diag_2cta(name)

+_BAR_BYTES = 400
+_SCHED_BYTES = 64

+    """The slab geometry of the FP8 accumulation kernel at head dimension ``d``."""
+    if d not in HEAD_DIMS:

+    operand = 128 * d
+    ring = 128 * 128
+    dq_slices = d // 32

+    q = 0
+    do = q + 2 * operand
+    k = do + operand
+    v = k + operand
+    alias = v + operand
+    p_ring = alias + alias_slices * _SLICE_BYTES

+    bars = delta + 512

+    smem = (sched + _SCHED_BYTES + 1023) // 1024 * 1024

+"""Host-only selection and workspace contract for dense d128 backward."""
+
+import math
+import re
+import struct
+
+ACCUMULATION = "accumulation"
+RECOMPUTE = "recompute"
+WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT = 256
+WORKSPACE_SLACK = WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT - 16
+ABI_VERSION = 3
+
+
+def validate_dense_bounds(batch, heads, sq, skv, window_left=None):
+    """Bound dense MHA declarations before either implementation is selected."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, sq, skv)):
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 dimensions must be positive integers")
+    if window_left is not None and (type(window_left) is not int or window_left < 0 or max(sq, skv) + window_left + 129 > 2**31 - 1):
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 sliding-window envelope exceeds safe Int32 tile rounding")
+    # The recompute body uses Int32 sequence coordinates, including the
+    # one-past-tile endpoint and ceil_div(endpoint, 128) in the causal bound.
+    if max(sq, skv) > 2**31 - 128:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 sequence envelope exceeds safe Int32 tile rounding")
+    # Its one-dimensional grid contains both Q and KV owners. Bounding the
+    # full grid also bounds batch/head coordinates and decoder products.
+    owners = (sq + 127) // 128 + (skv + 127) // 128
+    if batch * heads * owners > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 launch envelope exceeds the grid or Int32 work-id range")
+    # The recompute Stats coordinates do not explicitly widen before applying
+    # their compact strides; accumulation also uses an Int32 row index.
+    if batch * heads * sq > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 Stats index exceeds the Int32 range")
+    # Prepared operands normalize singleton pitches to these compact BSHD
+    # strides. Every 16-bit tensor-map byte stride must be strictly below 2**40.
+    if max(sq, skv) * heads * 128 * 2 >= 2**40:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 BSHD byte stride exceeds the tensor-map stride range")
+
+
+def _float32(value):
+    return struct.unpack("f", struct.pack("f", value))[0]
+
+
+def validate_accumulation_scale(scale):
+    """Check both FP32 scales consumed by the accumulation implementation."""
+    try:
+        if not math.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0:
+            raise ValueError
+        rounded = _float32(scale)
+        exponent = _float32(rounded * _float32(1.4426950408889634))
+        if not math.isfinite(rounded) or rounded <= 0 or not math.isfinite(exponent) or exponent <= 0:
+            raise ValueError
+    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError, struct.error):
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 accumulation requires scale and scale*log2(e) finite and positive in FP32") from None
+
+
+# Compute capabilities the accumulation chain (dense, THD and grouped) is qualified on.
+ACCUMULATION_CCS = ((10, 0), (10, 3))
+
+
+def select_implementation(cc, dsl_version, batch, heads, sq, skv, scale, d_qk=128, d_v=128, input_bytes=2):
+    """Choose from plan facts; recompute stays the fallback outside the accumulation envelope.
+
+    The accumulation kernels round both sequence lengths up to whole 128-row
+    tiles: TMA zero-fills the tail loads and clips the tail stores and dQ
+    reductions, and the tail Stats rows publish -inf, so unaligned S_q / S_kv
+    take the same path as aligned ones.
+    """
+    if tuple(cc) not in ACCUMULATION_CCS or not dsl_version or dsl_version[0] != "nvidia-cutlass-dsl":

+    match = re.match(r"^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)", dsl_version[1])

+        return RECOMPUTE

+        return RECOMPUTE

+    # work item per (batch, head, KV tile).

+    except ValueError:

+    return ACCUMULATION
+
+
+def workspace_layout(batch, heads, sq, d=128):
+    """Return aligned-payload-relative regions and advertised allocation bytes."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, sq)) or d not in (64, 128, 192):
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 workspace dimensions must be positive integers")
+    rounded = (sq + 127) // 128 * 128
+    dq_bytes = 4 * batch * rounded * heads * d
+    delta_bytes = 4 * batch * heads * rounded
+    regions = (
+        (0, (batch, rounded, heads, d), (rounded * heads * d, heads * d, d, 1)),
+        (dq_bytes, (batch, heads, rounded), (heads * rounded, rounded, 1)),
+    )
+    total = dq_bytes + delta_bytes + WORKSPACE_SLACK
+    if total > 2**63 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 workspace exceeds the signed pointer range")
+    return regions, total
+
+
+def validate_launch(pointers, spans, workspace, workspace_bytes, scale):
+    """Validate current addresses and scale before any of the three launches."""
+    validate_accumulation_scale(scale)
+    if len(pointers) != 9 or len(spans) != 9:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 accumulation requires nine bound operands")
+    if workspace <= 0 or workspace % 16 or workspace + workspace_bytes > 2**63 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 accumulation needs an aligned caller workspace within the signed pointer range")
+    for i, (ptr, span) in enumerate(zip(pointers, spans)):
+        if ptr <= 0 or span <= 0 or ptr + span > 2**63 - 1:
+            raise ValueError("dense d128 operand exceeds the signed pointer range")
+        if ptr < workspace + workspace_bytes and workspace < ptr + span:
+            raise ValueError("dense d128 caller workspace overlaps an operand")
+        if i >= 6:
+            for j in range(i):
+                if ptr < pointers[j] + spans[j] and pointers[j] < ptr + span:
+                    raise ValueError("dense d128 gradient output overlaps another operand")

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Grouped THD d128 workspace on the cta_group::2 datapath: the grouped THD layout with NINE per-sequence tensor maps.
+
+Declaration-only arithmetic shared by the adapter and the traced host (no device reads).  The 2-CTA main kernel reads
+Q / dO through 64-row boxes (its N-split operands) AND 128-row boxes (its d-split operands) and reduces dQ through a
+64-row fp32 box, so the per-sequence map array holds ``MAPS_PER_SEQUENCE`` (9) descriptors instead of the 1-CTA path's 7;
+everything else (compact FP32 dQ / Delta, metadata, origins, native dK / dV partials) is the grouped THD contract.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+from .config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta import CFG
+from .d128_contract import WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT, WORKSPACE_SLACK
+from .d128_grouped_contract import PARTIAL_ITEMSIZE
+from .d128_grouped_contract import validate_thd_bounds as _validate_grouped_thd_bounds
+from .d128_thd_contract import ORIGIN_PORTS
+
+ABI_VERSION = 2  # 2: the ``stats_form = "tma_ring"`` workspace form (the padded pre-scaled stats region + the padded row offsets; header section 14)
+THD = "accumulation_grouped_thd_2cta"
+MAPS_PER_SEQUENCE = CFG.MAPS_PER_SEQUENCE
+UNIT_ROWS = CFG.THD_UNIT_ROWS  # 256 kv rows per CLC work item (one cga2 pair)
+# --- stats_form = "tma_ring" (the s_tail body's header section 11; config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta_stail.CFG.STATS_FORMS): the delta launch
+# writes the softmax's stat words PRE-SCALED and q-tile-PADDED into ``stats2`` = fp32 [heads][PAD_TOTAL / N][STATS_KINDS][N] -- kind 0 =
+# -log2(e) * LSE (0 for an LSE of -inf), kind 1 = -scale * delta; the pad rows [S_b, ceil(S_b / N) * N) of every sequence hold 0.0 = the ldg
+# form's `stat = 0` for a row past the sequence, bit for bit -- and the main kernel's loader bulk-copies ONE (head, q tile) block = STATS_KINDS
+# x N x 4 B = 1 KiB per tile into its SMEM stats ring (no tensor map, no clip: a tile never crosses its sequence's padded block).  PAD_TOTAL =
+# rounded_q + N * batch is the host bound on sum_b ceil(S_b / N) * N; ``rowoff[b] = sum_{i < b} ceil(S_i / N) * N`` (+ the total at [batch])
+# is written by the setup kernel (tile_dsl.thd.write_thd_row_offsets) into its own Int32 [batch + 1] region -- the 4B+4 metadata tensor
+# keeps its shape (a tensor's extent is part of the kernel's mangled signature: the ldg rendering pin).  Under "ldg" the compact delta region
+# and the shipped layout are unchanged.
+STATS_KINDS = 2
+
+
+def stats2_pad_total(batch, rounded_q):
+    """The padded token total of the tma_ring stats region: every sequence rounded UP to a whole q tile (N), bounded on the host."""
+    return rounded_q + CFG.N * batch
+
+
+def stats2_shape_strides(heads, pad_total):
+    """The ``stats2`` tensor as the delta launch writes it and the loader addresses it: [heads][pad_total / N tiles][STATS_KINDS][N] fp32,
+    one (head, tile) block contiguous = STATS_KINDS * N elements = the SMEM ring stage image [LSE row | delta row]."""
+    tiles = pad_total // CFG.N
+    return (heads, tiles, STATS_KINDS, CFG.N), (tiles * STATS_KINDS * CFG.N, STATS_KINDS * CFG.N, CFG.N, 1)
+
+
+# --- the per-S HEURISTIC: which body serves a BF16 grouped THD request (the adapter's typed op-level field ``cta_pair``) --------------------
+# One place for every number the selector reads (G10 config-as-truth; test_sdpa_bwd_d128_cta_pair_heuristic.py pins each).  The selector
+# itself (:func:`select_cta_pair`) is a pure function of plan facts: the device reads (cc, the occupancy query) are handed in by the
+# prepared module, so the rule is testable without a GPU and the probe runs only when the cheaper predicates passed.
+CTA_PAIR_MODES = ("auto", "off", "on")
+CTA_PAIR_MODE_DEFAULT = "auto"
+# The smallest S where the pair body won the in-session backward step on GB200 (cc 10.0) against the one-CTA body -- 8K +4.9 %, 16K +7.9 %,
+# 32K +8.5 %, 64K +8.8 % uniform, the varlen ramps +6.5 % (16K) / +8.3 % (32K) (2026-10-27; the rows of record in the PR); below it the pair
+# LOSES on the step (2K -3.9 %, 4K -3.5 %, measured) and the one-CTA body serves.  Lowered when a shorter S wins.
+# Both declared extents (S_q and S_kv: the batch's LONGEST sequence on each side) must reach it: the measured cells have them equal, so a
+# lopsided batch serves the measured-safe one-CTA body.
+CTA_PAIR_MIN_SEQ = 8192
+# The SM100 line: GB200 (cc 10.0, the measured part) and GB300 (cc 10.3: the same tcgen05 / cta_group::2 / TMEM / CLC features, the same
+# per-S rule; the compile target follows the device -- ``--gpu-arch sm_{cc}a`` in the prepared host, as for the one-CTA body).  Hopper, SM120
+# and any other line have no pair body: ``auto`` serves the one-CTA body there and ``on`` declines by name.
+CTA_PAIR_CCS = ((10, 0), (10, 3))
+CTA_PAIR_CLUSTER = CFG.CGA_M  # the pair = one cluster of two CTAs; the device must admit at least one such cluster (the occupancy query)
+CTA_PAIR_BODY = "s_tail"  # the pair body's identity (its TMEM map: the dQ image in S^T's dead tail) = config_sm100_d128_accum_2cta_stail.CFG.TMEM_MAP
+PAIR_BODY = "2cta"
+ONE_CTA_BODY = "1cta"
+CTA_PAIR_PREDICATES = ("thd", "cc", "cluster", "seq")  # the names a decline / a fallback reason carries; ``seq`` under ``auto`` only
+
+
+class CtaPairDecline(ValueError):
+    """``cta_pair = "on"`` with a failing pair predicate: the text names the predicate and the value seen (the adapter's typed decline);
+    ``predicate`` = its ``CTA_PAIR_PREDICATES`` name (the dispatch appends the occupancy query's own failure text to a ``cluster`` decline)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, predicate, text):
+        super().__init__(text)
+        self.predicate = predicate
+
+
+def resolve_cta_pair(name=None):
+    """The adapter's ``cta_pair`` mode, typed: ``None`` -> ``CTA_PAIR_MODE_DEFAULT``; any value outside ``CTA_PAIR_MODES`` is a ``ValueError``
+    BY NAME (a selector outside its domain declines, never a silent default)."""
+    mode = CTA_PAIR_MODE_DEFAULT if name is None else name
+    if type(mode) is not str or mode not in CTA_PAIR_MODES:
+        raise ValueError(f"cta_pair must be one of {CTA_PAIR_MODES}; got {mode!r}")
+    return mode
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class CtaPairResolution:
+    """What the selector decided for one request: the mode it read, the body it chose, why, and the facts it read."""
+
+    mode: str
+    body: str  # PAIR_BODY | ONE_CTA_BODY
+    reason: str
+    s_q_max: int
+    s_kv_max: int
+    cc: Optional[tuple]
+    cluster_admitted: Optional[bool]  # None = the occupancy query was not consulted (off, or a cheaper predicate failed first)
+    pair_map: Optional[str] = None  # the pair body's identity (``CTA_PAIR_BODY``) once the dispatch chose it (None on the one-CTA body)
+
+    @property
+    def token(self):
+        """The ``resolved_impl`` token a driver pins by value: ``pair=<mode>:<body>``."""
+        return f"pair={self.mode}:{self.body}"
+
+
+def _active_pairs(max_active_pairs):
+    value = max_active_pairs() if callable(max_active_pairs) else max_active_pairs
+    if type(value) is not int or value < 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"the occupancy query must yield a non-negative int of active clusters of {CTA_PAIR_CLUSTER}; got {value!r}")
+    return value
+
+
+def select_cta_pair(mode, *, thd, s_q_max, s_kv_max, cc, max_active_pairs):
+    """The per-S heuristic as a pure function of plan facts (no device reads here: the caller hands in Q's cc -- ``None`` off CUDA -- and the
+    occupancy query as an int or a zero-argument callable, consulted LAST and only when the cheaper predicates passed, because it compiles a
+    probe kernel).
+
+    ``off`` -> the one-CTA body, nothing probed.  ``on`` -> the pair body at ANY S (the threshold is the heuristic's, not a support predicate);
+    a failing pair predicate (``thd`` / ``cc`` / ``cluster``) is a :class:`CtaPairDecline` naming it.  ``auto`` -> the pair body iff THD, cc in
+    ``CTA_PAIR_CCS``, both extents >= ``CTA_PAIR_MIN_SEQ`` and the device admits a cluster of ``CTA_PAIR_CLUSTER``; else the one-CTA body with
+    the failing predicate named in the reason.  The pair body's own support predicates (grouped heads, BF16, D 128, the pair bounds) run after
+    this in the dispatch; under ``auto`` their decline falls back to the one-CTA body."""
+    mode = resolve_cta_pair(mode)
+    for name, value in (("s_q_max", s_q_max), ("s_kv_max", s_kv_max)):
+        if type(value) is not int or value <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"sequence extents must be positive integers; got {name}={value!r}")
+    cc = None if cc is None else tuple(cc)
+    if mode == "off":
+        return CtaPairResolution(mode, ONE_CTA_BODY, "cta_pair=off", s_q_max, s_kv_max, cc, None)
+    failures = []
+    if not thd:
+        failures.append(("thd", "requires THD (the pair body has no dense twin)", "a dense declaration"))
+    if cc not in CTA_PAIR_CCS:
+        failures.append(
+            (
+                "cc",
+                f"requires cc in {CTA_PAIR_CCS} (the SM100 line; the per-S threshold was measured on GB200, cc 10.0)",
+                "a device that is not CUDA" if cc is None else str(cc),
+            )
+        )
+    if mode == "auto" and min(s_q_max, s_kv_max) < CTA_PAIR_MIN_SEQ:
+        failures.append(("seq", f"both declared S_q and S_kv >= {CTA_PAIR_MIN_SEQ}", f"({s_q_max}, {s_kv_max})"))
+    admitted = None
+    if not failures:
+        pairs = _active_pairs(max_active_pairs)
+        admitted = pairs >= 1
+        if not admitted:
+            failures.append(("cluster", f"requires a cluster of {CTA_PAIR_CLUSTER} CTAs admitted by the device's occupancy query", str(pairs)))
+    if failures:
+        name, text, got = failures[0]
+        if mode == "on":
+            raise CtaPairDecline(name, f"cta_pair 'on' {text}; got {got}")
+        return CtaPairResolution(mode, ONE_CTA_BODY, f"cta_pair=auto: the one-CTA body ({name}: {text}; got {got})", s_q_max, s_kv_max, cc, admitted)
+    if mode == "on":
+        return CtaPairResolution(mode, PAIR_BODY, "cta_pair=on", s_q_max, s_kv_max, cc, admitted)
+    reason = f"cta_pair=auto: the pair body (S_q {s_q_max}, S_kv {s_kv_max} >= {CTA_PAIR_MIN_SEQ}; cc {cc}; cluster of {CTA_PAIR_CLUSTER} admitted)"
+    return CtaPairResolution(mode, PAIR_BODY, reason, s_q_max, s_kv_max, cc, admitted)
+
+
+def _align(value):
+    return (value + WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT - 1) // WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT * WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT
+
+
+def validate_thd_bounds(batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv, tq, tkv, tq_phys, tkv_phys):
+    """The grouped THD bounds plus the pair envelope: 256-row rounding and a grid x of pairs x CGA_M."""
+    _validate_grouped_thd_bounds(batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv, tq, tkv, tq_phys, tkv_phys)
+    if max(sq, skv) > CFG.INT32_ROUNDING_BOUND:
+        raise ValueError("sequence envelope exceeds safe Int32 pair-unit rounding")
+    if batch * heads * ((skv + UNIT_ROWS - 1) // UNIT_ROWS) * CFG.CGA_M > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("pair launch envelope exceeds the grid or Int32 work-id range")
+
+
+def thd_workspace_offsets(batch, heads, tq, tkv, stats_ring=False):
+    """Shared host/trace arithmetic; no value reads from device metadata.  Byte offsets from the 256-B aligned payload.  ``stats_ring``
+    (``stats_form = "tma_ring"``): the compact delta region is replaced by the padded pre-scaled ``stats2`` region followed by the Int32
+    ``rowoff`` [batch + 1] region (``None`` under the ldg form); every later offset follows.  Returns ``(rounded_q, rounded_k, delta_or_stats2,
+    meta, origins, maps, dk, dv, regions_end, rowoff)``."""
+    rounded_q = (tq + 127) // 128 * 128
+    delta = 4 * rounded_q * heads * 128
+    if stats_ring:
+        rowoff = delta + _align(CFG.BPE_ACC * STATS_KINDS * stats2_pad_total(batch, rounded_q) * heads)
+        meta = rowoff + _align(4 * (batch + 1))
+    else:
+        rowoff = None
+        meta = delta + 4 * rounded_q * heads
+    origins = meta + _align(4 * (4 * batch + 4))
+    maps = origins + _align(8 * len(ORIGIN_PORTS) * batch)
+    prefix_end = maps + MAPS_PER_SEQUENCE * batch * 128
+    rounded_k = (tkv + 127) // 128 * 128
+    dk = _align(prefix_end)
+    size = rounded_k * heads * 128 * PARTIAL_ITEMSIZE
+    dv = dk + _align(size)
+    return rounded_q, rounded_k, delta, meta, origins, maps, dk, dv, dv + size, rowoff
+
+
+def thd_workspace_layout(batch, heads, tq, tkv, stats_ring=False):
+    """Compact FP32 dQ / Delta (or the padded pre-scaled stats region + the padded row offsets under ``stats_ring``), metadata, INT64 origins,
+    nine per-sequence maps, native compact-KV partials."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, tq, tkv)):
+        raise ValueError("grouped 2-CTA d128 packed workspace dimensions must be positive integers")
+    rounded_q, rounded_k, delta, meta, origins, maps, dk, dv, total, rowoff = thd_workspace_offsets(batch, heads, tq, tkv, stats_ring)
+    if total + WORKSPACE_SLACK > 2**63 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("grouped 2-CTA d128 packed workspace exceeds the signed pointer range")
+    kv_shape, kv_strides = (1, rounded_k, heads, 128), (rounded_k * heads * 128, heads * 128, 128, 1)
+    if stats_ring:
+        stats_shape, stats_strides = stats2_shape_strides(heads, stats2_pad_total(batch, rounded_q))
+        stats_regions = ((delta, stats_shape, stats_strides), (rowoff, (batch + 1,), (1,)))
+    else:
+        stats_regions = ((delta, (1, heads, rounded_q), (heads * rounded_q, rounded_q, 1)),)
+    regions = (
+        (0, (1, rounded_q, heads, 128), (rounded_q * heads * 128, heads * 128, 128, 1)),
+        *stats_regions,
+        (meta, (4 * batch + 4,), (1,)),
+        (origins, (len(ORIGIN_PORTS), batch), (batch, 1)),
+        (maps, (MAPS_PER_SEQUENCE * batch * 16,), (1,)),
+        (dk, kv_shape, kv_strides),
+        (dv, kv_shape, kv_strides),
+    )
+    return regions, total + WORKSPACE_SLACK

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Grouped d128 workspace: FP32 dQ/Delta and native per-Q-head dK/dV partials."""
+
+import re
+
+from .d128_contract import WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT, WORKSPACE_SLACK, workspace_layout as dense_mha_workspace_layout
+from .d128_thd_contract import workspace_layout as thd_mha_workspace_layout, workspace_offsets as thd_mha_workspace_offsets
+
+ABI_VERSION = 1
+DENSE = "accumulation_grouped_dense"
+THD = "accumulation_grouped_thd"
+PARTIAL_ITEMSIZE = 2  # BF16 for BF16 IO, FP16 for FP16 IO; final group accumulation is FP32.
+ACCUM_ITEMSIZE = 4  # the fp32 dK / dV accumulation workspace under dkv_accum = "fp32_reduce" (one buffer per KV head)
+# The CuTe DSL floor of the grouped d128 chain (both bodies): the public wheel from which the chain's hosts trace and from which the pair
+# dispatch's cluster occupancy query (``cutlass.utils.HardwareInfo.get_max_active_clusters``) exists.  Above the FROST-wide floor
+# ``cudnn.frost.buffers.CUTEDSL_MIN_VERSION`` (4.7.0), so every grouped route gates it BY NAME at ``check_support`` before any DSL import:
+# an absent or older wheel is a typed decline carrying the installed and the required version, never a raw ImportError / AttributeError.
+DSL_MIN_VERSION = (4, 8, 0)
+
+
+def dsl_version_decline(installed, version):
+    """The decline text for a CuTe DSL state ``(installed, version)`` (``cudnn.frost.buffers.cutedsl_state()``) that is absent, not the public
+    wheel or below ``DSL_MIN_VERSION``; ``None`` when the chain can trace.  Internal builds number themselves differently and are declined like
+    the chain's hosts always did (the public floor is the measured one)."""
+    match = re.match(r"^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)", version[1]) if installed and version and version[0] == "nvidia-cutlass-dsl" else None
+    if match is not None and tuple(map(int, match.groups())) >= DSL_MIN_VERSION:
+        return None
+    return f"requires nvidia-cutlass-dsl >= {'.'.join(map(str, DSL_MIN_VERSION))}; found {version}"
+
+
+# The typed op-level field ``SdpaBwdDslSm100D128.dkv_accum``: how the GQA group's dK / dV are accumulated on the THD chain.
+# A ROUNDING CHANGE between the two forms, hence an op ATTRIBUTE the caller sets (never a knob): "bf16_partials" = one bf16 partial per Q
+# head + the fp32 ``dkv_reduce`` fold launch (a FIXED summation order; the shipping chain, byte-identical when the field is unset);
+# "fp32_reduce" = every Q-head owner reduce-adds its fp32 dK / dV tile (``cp.reduce.async.bulk.tensor`` add.f32) into ONE per-KV-head fp32
+# workspace (hardware order, non-deterministic: `use_deterministic_algorithm` is declined on this route anyway), the fold launch gone, ONE bf16
+# rounding at the output in ``cast_dq_thd``.  Served by the 1-CTA grouped THD body and the cta_group::2 pair body; declined BY NAME on the
+# dense grouped chain and on the MHA routes.
+DKV_ACCUM_FORMS = ("bf16_partials", "fp32_reduce")
+DKV_ACCUM_DEFAULT = DKV_ACCUM_FORMS[0]
+
+
+def resolve_dkv_accum(value=None):
+    """``None`` -> ``DKV_ACCUM_DEFAULT``; a value outside ``DKV_ACCUM_FORMS`` is a ``ValueError`` BY NAME (a selector outside its domain declines,
+    never a silent default)."""
+    form = DKV_ACCUM_DEFAULT if value is None else value
+    if type(form) is not str or form not in DKV_ACCUM_FORMS:
+        raise ValueError(f"dkv_accum must be one of {DKV_ACCUM_FORMS}; got {form!r}")
+    return form
+
+
+def dkv_accum_fp32(value=None):
+    """The chain's ``Constexpr[bool]`` for a (resolved) form: True under ``fp32_reduce``; declines exactly as :func:`resolve_dkv_accum`."""
+    return resolve_dkv_accum(value) == "fp32_reduce"
+
+
+def thd_fp32_accum_bytes(rounded_k, kv_heads):
+    """Bytes of ONE fp32 dK / dV accumulation buffer ``[1, rounded_k, kv_heads, 128]`` (shared host / trace arithmetic; accepts Int64)."""
+    return rounded_k * kv_heads * 128 * ACCUM_ITEMSIZE
+
+
+def validate_fp32_accum_fits(heads, kv_heads):
+    """The fp32 per-KV-head buffer is carved INSIDE the bf16 per-Q-head partial region of the same tensor, so the advertised workspace is
+    unchanged: ``rounded_k x kv_heads x 128 x 4 <= rounded_k x heads x 128 x 2`` holds on every grouped ratio (``heads >= 2 x kv_heads``)."""
+    if kv_heads * ACCUM_ITEMSIZE > heads * PARTIAL_ITEMSIZE:
+        raise ValueError(f"dkv_accum 'fp32_reduce' needs Hq >= 2 x Hkv for the fp32 accumulator to fit the partial region; got Hq {heads}, Hkv {kv_heads}")
+
+
+def validate_dimensions(batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv):
+    """Shared declaration-only launch checks for the adapter and row matcher."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv)):
+        raise ValueError("grouped dimensions must be positive integers")
+    if heads <= kv_heads or heads % kv_heads:
+        raise ValueError("requires Hq > Hkv and Hq divisible by Hkv")
+    if max(sq, skv) > 2**31 - 128:
+        raise ValueError("sequence envelope exceeds safe Int32 tile rounding")
+    if batch > 65535 or heads > 65535 or batch * heads * ((skv + 127) // 128) > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("launch envelope exceeds the grid or Int32 work-id range")
+
+
+def validate_dense_bounds(batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv):
+    validate_dimensions(batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv)
+    if sq % 128 or skv % 128:
+        raise ValueError("dense sequence lengths must be multiples of 128")
+    # The main kernel indexes dense Stats and Delta with Int32 row offsets.
+    if batch * heads * sq > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense Stats/Delta span exceeds the Int32 index range")
+    # The shared fold computes bidx*256+tidx in Int32 before its widened
+    # element-address math. Aligned Skv makes this vector count block-aligned.
+    if batch * skv * kv_heads * 16 > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense KV reduction exceeds the Int32 vector index range")
+    if max(sq, skv) * heads * 128 * 2 >= 2**40:
+        raise ValueError("native BSHD byte stride exceeds the tensor-map stride range")
+    if sq * heads * 128 * 4 >= 2**40:
+        raise ValueError("FP32 dQ byte stride exceeds the tensor-map stride range")
+
+
+def validate_thd_bounds(batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv, tq, tkv, tq_phys, tkv_phys):
+    validate_dimensions(batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv)
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (tq, tkv, tq_phys, tkv_phys)):
+        raise ValueError("THD declared packed capacities must be positive integers")
+    if max(tq, tkv) > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("compact packed capacity exceeds the Int32 prefix ABI")
+    if max(tq_phys, tkv_phys) > 2**32 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("physical token capacity exceeds the tensor-map dimension range")

+ABI_VERSION = 1
+IMPLEMENTATION = "accumulation_thd"

+RAGGED_ROLES = tuple("ragged_" + port for port in ORIGIN_PORTS)
+Q_PORTS = frozenset({"q", "o", "do", "dq", "stats"})
+KV_PORTS = frozenset({"k", "v", "dk", "dv"})
+MAPS_PER_SEQUENCE = 7
+
+
+def _align(value):
+    return (value + WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT - 1) // WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT * WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT
+
+
+def workspace_offsets(batch, heads, t_q):
+    """Byte offsets shared with the traced host; arithmetic also accepts Int64."""
+    rounded = (t_q + 127) // 128 * 128
+    delta = 4 * rounded * heads * 128
+    meta = delta + 4 * rounded * heads
+    origins = meta + _align(4 * (4 * batch + 4))
+    maps = origins + _align(8 * len(ORIGIN_PORTS) * batch)
+    total = maps + MAPS_PER_SEQUENCE * batch * 128
+    return rounded, delta, meta, origins, maps, total
+
+
+def workspace_layout(batch, heads, t_q):
+    """Packed FP32 dQ/Delta, metadata, INT64 origins and per-sequence maps."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, t_q)):
+        raise ValueError("d128 THD workspace dimensions must be positive integers")
+    rounded, delta, meta, origins, maps, total = workspace_offsets(batch, heads, t_q)
+    if total + WORKSPACE_SLACK > 2**63 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("d128 THD workspace exceeds the signed pointer range")
+    regions = (
+        (0, (1, rounded, heads, 128), (rounded * heads * 128, heads * 128, 128, 1)),
+        (delta, (1, heads, rounded), (heads * rounded, rounded, 1)),
+        (meta, (4 * batch + 4,), (1,)),
+        (origins, (len(ORIGIN_PORTS), batch), (batch, 1)),
+        (maps, (MAPS_PER_SEQUENCE * batch * 16,), (1,)),
+    )
+    return regions, total + WORKSPACE_SLACK
+
+
+def validate_stats_span(heads, row_capacity):
+    """Match the full FP32 [T,H] or [1,H,pitch] prepared carrier span.
+
+    Positive dimensions and packing are validated by the callers. HN pitch
+    remains Int64; only the existing signed-pointer storage bound applies.
+    """
+    if heads * row_capacity * 4 > 2**63 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("packed FP32 Stats span exceeds the signed pointer range")
+
+

+    """Validate all pointer relationships before setup can write any scratch."""
+    validate_accumulation_scale(scale)

+    if workspace <= 0 or workspace % 16 or workspace + workspace_bytes > 2**63 - 1:

+            extents.append(None)

+        for j, extent in enumerate(extents):
+            if i != j and extent is not None and lo < extent[1] and extent[0] < hi:
+                raise ValueError("d128 THD gradient output overlaps another operand or metadata")

+"""Origin-aware THD fold of compact per-Q-head dK/dV partials.
+
+The shared vector reducer owns accumulation and conversion. This module only
+maps sequence-local live rows to compact scratch and each output's independent
+ragged origin; it adds no architecture-specific instructions or repacking.
+"""
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.thd import thd_port_origin
+from .bprop_chain_common import _reduce_group_vec
+
+REDUCE_THREADS = 256
+REDUCE_VECTOR = 8
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _reduce_thd_port(
+    part,
+    out,
+    origins,
+    local_pos,
+    batch,
+    kv_head,
+    start,
+    length,
+    origin: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    D: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    group: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    """Decode a vector in this port's width before applying its physical origin."""
+    row, col = local_pos // D, local_pos % D
+    if row < length:
+        h_kv, h_q = out.shape[2], part.shape[2]
+        index = ((row * h_kv + cutlass.Int64(kv_head)) * D + col) // REDUCE_VECTOR
+        token = thd_port_origin(origins, origin, batch, start)
+        bias = (
+            token * cutlass.Int64(out.stride[1]) + row * (cutlass.Int64(out.stride[1]) - h_kv * D) + cutlass.Int64(kv_head) * (cutlass.Int64(out.stride[2]) - D)
+        )
+        _reduce_group_vec(
+            part.iterator.raw_ptr() + start * cutlass.Int64(part.stride[1]),
+            out.iterator.raw_ptr() + bias,
+            index,
+            h_kv,
+            h_q,
+            D=D,
+            group=group,
+            io_dtype=io_dtype,
+            wide=True,
+        )
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def dkv_reduce_thd_origins_kernel(
+    dk_part: cute.Tensor,
+    dv_part: cute.Tensor,
+    dk: cute.Tensor,
+    dv: cute.Tensor,
+    meta: cute.Tensor,
+    origins: cute.Tensor,
+    n_batch: cutlass.Int32,
+    dk_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    dv_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    D: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    group: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    """Each live 16-byte output vector has one owner; both sums are FP32."""
+    block, batch, kv_head = cute.arch.block_idx()
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    local_vec = cutlass.Int64(block) * REDUCE_THREADS + cutlass.Int64(tid)
+    local_pos = local_vec * REDUCE_VECTOR
+    data = cutlass.make_array_view(meta)
+    length = cutlass.Int64(data[batch])
+    start = cutlass.Int64(data[2 * n_batch + 1 + batch])
+    # Compact dK and dV partials have their own feature widths. Reusing dK's
+    # row/column decode for dV would cross rows and miss the final live tokens.
+    _reduce_thd_port(dk_part, dk, origins, local_pos, batch, kv_head, start, length, dk_origin, D, group, io_dtype)
+    _reduce_thd_port(dv_part, dv, origins, local_pos, batch, kv_head, start, length, dv_origin, dv.shape[3], group, io_dtype)
+
+
+dkv_reduce_thd_origins_kernel.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def dkv_reduce_thd_origins_host(
+    dk_part,
+    dv_part,
+    dk,
+    dv,
+    meta,
+    origins,
+    n_batch,
+    max_skv,
+    dk_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    dv_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    D: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    group: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    stream,
+):
+    """One fold launch; device lengths guard every input read and output write.
+
+    Partials are compact [1,T,Hq,D] and outputs [1,Tphys,Hkv,D] with unit
+    feature stride and vector-aligned token/head strides. D is the dK width;
+    dV retains its own declared width. Both are divisible by eight. The output
+    origins may differ independently.
+    """
+    width = cutlass.const_expr(max(D, dv.shape[3]))
+    blocks = cute.math.max((cutlass.Int64(max_skv) * (width // REDUCE_VECTOR) + REDUCE_THREADS - 1) // REDUCE_THREADS, cutlass.Int64(1))
+    dkv_reduce_thd_origins_kernel(dk_part, dv_part, dk, dv, meta, origins, n_batch, dk_origin, dv_origin, D, group, io_dtype).launch(
+        grid=(blocks, n_batch, dk.shape[2]), block=(REDUCE_THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
+    )

+        return 4
+    if dtype in HALF_DTYPES:
+        return 2
+    return 1
+
+
+def _box(dtype):
+    return CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES // _bpe(dtype)
+
+
+def _dk_stage(grad_dtype):
+    return CFG.SLICE_BYTES * ((CFG.M * CFG.D * _bpe(grad_dtype) + CFG.SLICE_BYTES - 1) // CFG.SLICE_BYTES)
+
+
+def _out_swz(grad_dtype):
+    return min(CFG.D * _bpe(grad_dtype), CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES)
+
+
+def _operand(slab, offset, dtype, rows, cols, *, transpose=False, swz=CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES):
+    box = swz // _bpe(dtype)
+    return SmemTile(
+        base=_view(slab, offset, dtype, rows * cols, alignment=1024),
+        elems_per_stage=rows * cols,
+        leading_byte_offset=rows * swz if transpose else 16,
+        stride_byte_offset=8 * swz,
+        layout=CFG.SWIZZLE_LAYOUT if swz == CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES else CFG.NARROW_SWIZZLE_LAYOUT,
+        tma_loads_per_tile=cols // box,
+        tma_granu_elems=box,
+        tma_subtile_stride_elems=rows * box,
+        desc_version=CFG.DESC_VERSION,
+    )
+
+
+def _mma_desc(m, n, k, *, atranspose=False, btranspose=False):
+    return MmaDesc(
+        M=m,
+        N=n,
+        K=k,
+        bpe_a=CFG.BPE,
+        bpe_b=CFG.BPE,
+        tile_k_hw=CFG.K_HW,
+        atranspose=atranspose,
+        btranspose=btranspose,
+        cta_group=1,
+        idesc=nvvm.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+            c_dtype=cutlass.Float32, a_dtype=FP8, b_dtype=FP8, m_dim=m, n_dim=n, a_major=int(atranspose), b_major=int(btranspose)
+        ),
+        kind=nvvm.Tcgen05MMAKind.F8F6F4,
+    )

+@cute.jit
+def _wait(bar, phase):
+    bar.wait(phase)
+    nvvm.bar_warp_sync(cute.arch.FULL_MASK)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _wait_tcgen(bar, phase):
+    _wait(bar, phase)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _commit(bar):
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        bar.arrive(cta_group=1)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _credit(bar):
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        bar.arrive()

+@cute.jit
+def _tmem_load(address, n: cutlass.Constexpr[int], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr = cutlass.Float32):
+    return nvvm.tcgen05_ld("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(address, dtype), num=n)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tmem_store(address, values):
+    nvvm.tcgen05_st("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(address, cutlass.Int32), values)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _scalar(tensor):
+    return cutlass.Float32(cutlass.make_array_view(tensor)[0])
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _fold_amax(value, tensor):
+    for step in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        peer = nvvm.shfl_sync(thread_mask=0xFFFFFFFF, val=value, offset=1 << step, mask_and_clamp=0x1F, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY)
+        value = fmax_f32(value, peer)
+    if cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % 32 == 0:
+        nvvm.atomicrmw(nvvm.AtomicOp.MAX, Pointer(tensor.iterator.raw_ptr(), dtype=cutlass.Int32), value.bitcast(cutlass.Int32))
+
+
+def _pack_fp8(values):
+    words = []
+    for chunk in range(len(values) // 16):
+        packed = fp32_to_fp8_pack(values[chunk * 16 : chunk * 16 + 16], dtype=FP8)
+        words.extend(packed[j] for j in range(4))
+    return cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(words), cutlass.Int32)
+
+
+def _scale_pairs(values, factor):
+    scaled = []
+    for i in range(0, len(values), 2):
+        a, b = fmul2(values[i], values[i + 1], factor, factor)
+        scaled.extend((a, b))
+    return scaled
+

+@cute.jit
+def tma_reduce_subtile(smem_tile, gmem_slice, subtile: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    """One elected source-sized FP32 add; caller owns commit and wait/credit."""
+    desc = gmem_slice.tma_desc.get_ptr()
+    coords = [gmem_slice.coord_d + cutlass.Int32(subtile * smem_tile.tma_granu_elems)] + list(gmem_slice.coords[1:])
+    src = smem_tile.base.subview(subtile * smem_tile.tma_subtile_stride_elems)
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        nvvm.cp_async_bulk_tensor_reduce(desc, src, "add", coords)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _decode_flat(tile, nheads, nk, swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int], batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    group = tile // (swizzle * nk)
+    inner = tile % (swizzle * nk)
+    full = group < batch_heads // swizzle
+    divisor = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(full.ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(swizzle).ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(max(batch_heads % swizzle, 1)).ir_value()))
+    block = inner // divisor
+    residual = inner % divisor
+    hb = group * swizzle + residual
+    return block, hb % nheads, hb // nheads
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _next_tile(sched, bars, state, nheads, nk, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int], batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    _wait(bars.sched_full[state.idx], state.phase)
+    x, yz, valid = read_clc_payload(sched, state.idx * 8, warp_broadcast=True)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+        block, head, batch = _decode_flat(x, nheads, nk, swizzle, batch_heads)
+    else:
+        block = x
+        head = yz & 0xFFFF
+        batch = (yz >> 16) & 0xFFFF
+    return block, head, batch, valid, advance(state, CFG.SCHED_STAGES)
+
+
+def _tensor_map(tensor, box, swz=CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES):
+    swizzle = tmap.TensorMapSwizzle.s128b if swz == CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES else tmap.TensorMapSwizzle.s64b
+    return tmap.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(tensor, box_dims=(1, CFG.M, 1, box), stride_order=(3, 1, 2, 0), swizzle=swizzle)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _bounds(block, sq, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    lo = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+        lo = block
+    hi = (sq + CFG.N - 1) // CFG.N
+    if cutlass.const_expr(WINDOW > 0):
+        hi = cute.math.min(hi, (block * CFG.M + CFG.M + WINDOW - 1 + CFG.N - 1) // CFG.N)
+    return lo, hi
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, qbase, sq, batch, head, delta_scale, lse_shift):
+    inline_ptx(f"barrier.sync {CFG.SOFTMAX_BARRIER}, {CFG.SOFTMAX_LANES};", write_only_types=[], read_only_args=[])
+    idx = qbase + row
+    valid = idx < sq
+    if group == 0:
+        clamped = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(valid.ir_value(), idx.ir_value(), (sq - 1).ir_value()))
+        val = cutlass.Float32(lse[batch, head, clamped])
+        stat = -cutlass.Float32(LOG2E) * val + lse_shift
+        if val == cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")):
+            stat = lse_shift
+        stat = cutlass.Float32(arith.select(valid.ir_value(), stat.ir_value(), cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")).ir_value()))
+        _view(slab, CFG.STATS, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(row).store(stat)
+    else:
+        stat = -delta_scale * cutlass.Float32(delta[batch, head, idx])
+        _view(slab, CFG.DELTA, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(row).store(stat)
+    inline_ptx(f"barrier.sync {CFG.SOFTMAX_BARRIER}, {CFG.SOFTMAX_LANES};", write_only_types=[], read_only_args=[])
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _masked_scores(
+    scores, row, group, block, qtile, skv, causal_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], key_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], window_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]
+):
+    neg_inf = cutlass.Float32(float("-inf"))
+    kr = block * CFG.M + row
+    key_valid = kr < skv
+    out = []
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(64):
+        v = scores[i]
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal_mask or window_mask):
+            qc = qtile * CFG.N + group * 64 + i
+            if cutlass.const_expr(causal_mask):
+                v = cutlass.Float32(arith.select((kr <= qc).ir_value(), v.ir_value(), neg_inf.ir_value()))
+            if cutlass.const_expr(window_mask):
+                v = cutlass.Float32(arith.select((kr + (WINDOW - 1) >= qc).ir_value(), v.ir_value(), neg_inf.ir_value()))
+        if cutlass.const_expr(key_mask):
+            v = cutlass.Float32(arith.select(key_valid.ir_value(), v.ir_value(), neg_inf.ir_value()))
+        out.append(v)
+    return cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(out), cutlass.Float32)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _p_values(
+    slab,
+    scores,
+    row,
+    group,
+    block,
+    qtile,
+    skv,
+    s_scale,
+    causal_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    key_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    window_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+):
+    if cutlass.const_expr(causal_mask or key_mask or window_mask):
+        scores = _masked_scores(scores, row, group, block, qtile, skv, causal_mask, key_mask, window_mask)
+    p = []
+    scaled = s_scale * cutlass.Float32(LOG2E)
+    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        stat = _view(slab, CFG.STATS, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(group * 64 + chunk * 4).load(vector_size=4, alignment=16)
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            i = chunk * 4 + pair * 2
+            e0, e1 = ffma2(scaled, scaled, scores[i], scores[i + 1], stat[pair * 2], stat[pair * 2 + 1])
+            p0 = cute.math.exp2(e0, fastmath=True)
+            p1 = cute.math.exp2(e1, fastmath=True)
+            p.extend((p0, p1))
+    return cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(p), cutlass.Float32), _pack_fp8(p)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _ds_values(slab, dp, group, p, dp_scale, amax, fold: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    ds = []
+    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        stat = _view(slab, CFG.DELTA, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(group * 64 + chunk * 4).load(vector_size=4, alignment=16)
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            i = chunk * 4 + pair * 2
+            d0, d1 = ffma2(dp_scale, dp_scale, dp[i], dp[i + 1], stat[pair * 2], stat[pair * 2 + 1])
+            d0, d1 = fmul2(d0, d1, p[i], p[i + 1])
+            ds.extend((d0, d1))
+    if cutlass.const_expr(fold):
+        amax = fmax_f32(amax, abs_max_tree(ds))
+    return amax, _pack_fp8(ds)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _store_half_row(slab, base, row, group, words):
+    for vec in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        chunk = group * 4 + vec
+        off = base + row * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES + ((row % 8) ^ chunk) * 16
+        values = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(words[vec * 4 + k] for k in range(4)), cutlass.Int32)
+        Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + off, dtype=cutlass.Int32).store(values, alignment=16)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _softmax_tile(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    tmem_base,
+    lse,
+    delta,
+    row,
+    group,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    hi,
+    qtile,
+    s_scale,
+    dp_scale,
+    delta_scale,
+    lse_shift,
+    phase,
+    ring_idx,
+    ring_phase,
+    amax,
+    fold: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    causal_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    key_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    window_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+):
+    _wait_tcgen(bars.s_done, phase)
+    address = tmem_base + group * 64
+    a = _tmem_load(address, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 32, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    bars.s_free.arrive()
+    scores = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    p, p_words = _p_values(slab, scores, row, group, block, qtile, skv, s_scale, causal_mask, key_mask, window_mask)
+    _wait(bars.p_empty[ring_idx], ring_phase ^ 1)
+    _store_half_row(slab, CFG.P + ring_idx * CFG.RING_BYTES, row, group, p_words)
+    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+    bars.p_full[ring_idx].arrive()
+    _wait_tcgen(bars.dp_done, phase)
+    a = _tmem_load(address + 128, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 160, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    dp = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    amax, ds_words = _ds_values(slab, dp, group, p, dp_scale, amax, fold)
+    _wait(bars.ds_empty[ring_idx], ring_phase ^ 1)
+    _store_half_row(slab, CFG.DS + ring_idx * CFG.RING_BYTES, row, group, ds_words)
+    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+    bars.ds_full[ring_idx].arrive()
+    if qtile + 1 < hi:
+        _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, (qtile + 1) * CFG.N, sq, batch, head, delta_scale, lse_shift)
+    next_idx = ring_idx + 1
+    wrap = next_idx == CFG.P_STAGES
+    ring_idx = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(wrap.ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(0).ir_value(), next_idx.ir_value()))
+    ring_phase = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(wrap.ir_value(), (ring_phase ^ 1).ir_value(), ring_phase.ir_value()))
+    return phase ^ 1, ring_idx, ring_phase, amax
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _softmax_tiles(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    tmem_base,
+    lse,
+    delta,
+    row,
+    group,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    lo,
+    hi,
+    s_scale,
+    dp_scale,
+    delta_scale,
+    lse_shift,
+    phase,
+    ring_idx,
+    ring_phase,
+    amax,
+    fold: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    key_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+):
+    diag_end = lo
+    if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+        diag_end = cute.math.min(lo + 1, hi)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, diag_end, 1, unroll=1):
+            phase, ring_idx, ring_phase, amax = _softmax_tile(
+                slab,
+                bars,
+                tmem_base,
+                lse,
+                delta,
+                row,
+                group,
+                block,
+                head,
+                batch,
+                sq,
+                skv,
+                hi,
+                qtile,
+                s_scale,
+                dp_scale,
+                delta_scale,
+                lse_shift,
+                phase,
+                ring_idx,
+                ring_phase,
+                amax,
+                fold,
+                True,
+                key_mask,
+                WINDOW > 0,
+            )
+    edge_start = hi
+    if cutlass.const_expr(WINDOW > 0):
+        edge_start = cute.math.max(diag_end, cute.math.min(hi, (block * CFG.M + WINDOW + CFG.N) // CFG.N - 1))
+    for qtile in cutlass.range(diag_end, edge_start, 1, unroll=1):
+        phase, ring_idx, ring_phase, amax = _softmax_tile(
+            slab,
+            bars,
+            tmem_base,
+            lse,
+            delta,
+            row,
+            group,
+            block,
+            head,
+            batch,
+            sq,
+            skv,
+            hi,
+            qtile,
+            s_scale,
+            dp_scale,
+            delta_scale,
+            lse_shift,
+            phase,
+            ring_idx,
+            ring_phase,
+            amax,
+            fold,
+            False,
+            key_mask,
+            False,
+        )
+    if cutlass.const_expr(WINDOW > 0):
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(edge_start, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            phase, ring_idx, ring_phase, amax = _softmax_tile(
+                slab,
+                bars,
+                tmem_base,
+                lse,
+                delta,
+                row,
+                group,
+                block,
+                head,
+                batch,
+                sq,
+                skv,
+                hi,
+                qtile,
+                s_scale,
+                dp_scale,
+                delta_scale,
+                lse_shift,
+                phase,
+                ring_idx,
+                ring_phase,
+                amax,
+                fold,
+                False,
+                key_mask,
+                True,
+            )
+    return phase, ring_idx, ring_phase, amax
+

+@cute.jit
+def _softmax_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    lse,
+    delta,
+    descale_q,
+    descale_k,
+    descale_v,
+    descale_s,
+    descale_do,
+    scale_s_t,
+    scale_dp_t,
+    amax_dp: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.SOFTMAX_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.INCREASE)
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    row = tid % CFG.M
+    group = tid // CFG.M
+    s_scale = scale * _scalar(descale_q) * _scalar(descale_k)
+    scale_s = _scalar(scale_s_t)
+    scale_dp = _scalar(scale_dp_t)
+    lse_shift = cute.math.log2(scale_s)
+    delta_scale = scale * _scalar(descale_s) * scale_dp
+    dp_scale = delta_scale * _scalar(descale_v) * _scalar(descale_do)
+    fold = cutlass.const_expr(amax_dp is not None)
+    amax = opaque_f32_zero()
+    phase = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    ring_idx = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    ring_phase = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        if cutlass.const_expr(not causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, lo * CFG.N, sq, batch, head, delta_scale, lse_shift)
+        if (block + 1) * CFG.M > skv:
+            phase, ring_idx, ring_phase, amax = _softmax_tiles(
+                slab,
+                bars,
+                tmem_base,
+                lse,
+                delta,
+                row,
+                group,
+                block,
+                head,
+                batch,
+                sq,
+                skv,
+                lo,
+                hi,
+                s_scale,
+                dp_scale,
+                delta_scale,
+                lse_shift,
+                phase,
+                ring_idx,
+                ring_phase,
+                amax,
+                fold,
+                causal,
+                True,
+            )
+        else:
+            phase, ring_idx, ring_phase, amax = _softmax_tiles(
+                slab,
+                bars,
+                tmem_base,
+                lse,
+                delta,
+                row,
+                group,
+                block,
+                head,
+                batch,
+                sq,
+                skv,
+                lo,
+                hi,
+                s_scale,
+                dp_scale,
+                delta_scale,
+                lse_shift,
+                phase,
+                ring_idx,
+                ring_phase,
+                amax,
+                fold,
+                causal,
+                False,
+            )
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(fold):
+        _fold_amax(amax * (cutlass.Float32(1.0) / scale_dp), amax_dp)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _store_chunks(slab, byte_offset, row, words, first: cutlass.Constexpr[int], count: cutlass.Constexpr[int], swz: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 128):

+@cute.jit
+def _native_epilogue(
+    slab,
+    tmem_base,
+    bars,
+    row,
+    live,
+    empty_phase,
+    grad_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    dk: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    factor,
+    out_scale,
+    amax,
+    fold: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+):
+    plane = CFG.TMEM_DK if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else CFG.TMEM_DV
+    fp8_out = cutlass.const_expr(grad_dtype == FP8)
+    base = CFG.ALIAS + (_dk_stage(grad_dtype) if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 0)
+    last_slice = (base - CFG.ALIAS + CFG.M * CFG.D * _bpe(grad_dtype) - 1) // CFG.SLICE_BYTES
+    true_values = []
+    for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.D // 64):
+        vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(64)), cutlass.Float32)
+        if live:
+            vals = _tmem_load(tmem_base + plane + half * 64, 64)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+        scaled = _scale_pairs([vals[i] for i in range(64)], factor)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(fold):
+            amax = fmax_f32(amax, abs_max_tree(scaled))
+        if cutlass.const_expr(fp8_out):
+            true_values.extend(scaled)
+        else:
+            words = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(fp32_to_fp16(scaled[2 * i], scaled[2 * i + 1], dtype=grad_dtype) for i in range(32)), cutlass.Int32)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(half == 0):
+                _wait(bars.dq_empty[last_slice], empty_phase)
+            _store_words(slab, base + half * CFG.SLICE_BYTES, row, words)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(fp8_out):
+        words = _pack_fp8(_scale_pairs(true_values, out_scale))
+        _wait(bars.dq_empty[last_slice], empty_phase)
+        _store_chunks(slab, base, row, words, 0, CFG.D // 16, _out_swz(FP8))
+    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(dk):
+        bars.dk_full.arrive()
+    else:
+        bars.dv_full.arrive()
+    return amax
+

+@cute.jit
+def _epilogue_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    descale_q,
+    descale_s,
+    descale_do,
+    descale_dp,
+    scale_dk_t,
+    scale_dv_t,
+    amax_dk: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    amax_dv: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    grad_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.EPILOGUE_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.INCREASE)
+    row = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.M
+    dk_factor = _scalar(descale_dp) * _scalar(descale_q)
+    dv_factor = _scalar(descale_s) * _scalar(descale_do)
+    dk_out = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    dv_out = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(grad_dtype == FP8):
+        dk_out = _scalar(scale_dk_t)
+        dv_out = _scalar(scale_dv_t)
+    fold_k = cutlass.const_expr(amax_dk is not None)
+    fold_v = cutlass.const_expr(amax_dv is not None)
+    amax_k = opaque_f32_zero()
+    amax_v = opaque_f32_zero()
+    dq_state = PipelineState.start()
+    empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        for _ in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dq_done, dq_state.phase)
+            halves = []
+            for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.D // 64):
+                halves.append(_tmem_load(tmem_base + 128 + half * 64, 64))
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.dp_empty.arrive()
+            vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(h[i] for h in halves for i in range(64)), cutlass.Float32)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.DQ_SLICES):
+                _wait(bars.dq_empty[i], empty_state.phase)
+                _store_dq_slice(slab, row, vals, i)
+                nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+                bars.dq_full[i].arrive()
+            dq_state = advance(dq_state, 1)
+            empty_state = advance(empty_state, 1)
+        if lo >= hi:
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dq_done, dq_state.phase)
+            dq_state = advance(dq_state, 1)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.DQ_SLICES):
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[i], empty_state.phase)
+        amax_v = _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, empty_state.phase, grad_dtype, False, dv_factor, dv_out, amax_v, fold_v)
+        amax_k = _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, empty_state.phase, grad_dtype, True, dk_factor, dk_out, amax_k, fold_k)
+        empty_state = advance(empty_state, 1)
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(fold_v):
+        _fold_amax(amax_v, amax_dv)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(fold_k):
+        _fold_amax(amax_k, amax_dk)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _mma_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+):
+    score = _mma_desc(CFG.M, CFG.N, CFG.D)
+    grad = _mma_desc(CFG.M, CFG.D, CFG.N, btranspose=True)
+    dqdesc = _mma_desc(CFG.N, CFG.D, CFG.M, atranspose=True, btranspose=True)
+    kd = _operand(slab, CFG.K, FP8, CFG.M, CFG.D, swz=CFG.IN_SWZ).desc()
+    vd = _operand(slab, CFG.V, FP8, CFG.M, CFG.D, swz=CFG.IN_SWZ).desc()
+    dod = _operand(slab, CFG.DO, FP8, CFG.N, CFG.D, swz=CFG.IN_SWZ).desc()
+    dot = _operand(slab, CFG.DO, FP8, CFG.N, CFG.D, transpose=True, swz=CFG.IN_SWZ).desc()
+    kt = _operand(slab, CFG.K, FP8, CFG.M, CFG.D, transpose=True, swz=CFG.IN_SWZ).desc()
+    s = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base, cutlass.Float32)
+    dp = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + 128, cutlass.Float32)
+    dv = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DV, cutlass.Float32)
+    dk = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DK, cutlass.Float32)
+    q_state = PipelineState.start()
+    do_state = PipelineState.start()
+    kv_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ring = PipelineState.start()
+    sfree_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dp_empty = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    out_empty = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.k_full, kv_state.phase)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.q_full[q_state.idx], q_state.phase)
+            qd = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_state.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, FP8, CFG.N, CFG.D, swz=CFG.IN_SWZ).desc()
+            mma_ss(score, kd, qd, s)
+            _commit(bars.s_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.v_full, kv_state.phase)
+        _wait_tcgen(bars.dvk_empty, out_empty.phase)
+        out_empty = advance(out_empty, 1)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dp_empty, dp_empty.phase)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.do_full, do_state.phase)
+            mma_ss(score, vd, dod, dp)
+            _commit(bars.dp_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.p_full[ring.idx], ring.phase)
+            pd = _operand(slab, CFG.P + ring.idx * CFG.RING_BYTES, FP8, CFG.M, CFG.N).desc()
+            mma_ss(grad, pd, dot, dv, accumulate=qtile > lo)
+            _commit(bars.do_empty)
+            _commit(bars.p_empty[ring.idx])
+            q_next = advance(q_state, CFG.Q_STAGES)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.s_free, sfree_state.phase)
+            sfree_state = advance(sfree_state, 1)
+            if qtile + 1 < hi:
+                _wait_tcgen(bars.q_full[q_next.idx], q_next.phase)
+                qd_next = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_next.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, FP8, CFG.N, CFG.D, swz=CFG.IN_SWZ).desc()
+                mma_ss(score, kd, qd_next, s)
+                _commit(bars.s_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.ds_full[ring.idx], ring.phase)
+            dsd = _operand(slab, CFG.DS + ring.idx * CFG.RING_BYTES, FP8, CFG.M, CFG.N).desc()
+            dst = _operand(slab, CFG.DS + ring.idx * CFG.RING_BYTES, FP8, CFG.M, CFG.N, transpose=True).desc()
+            mma_ss(dqdesc, dst, kt, dp)
+            if qtile + 1 < hi:
+                _commit(bars.dq_done)
+            qt = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_state.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, FP8, CFG.N, CFG.D, transpose=True, swz=CFG.IN_SWZ).desc()
+            mma_ss(grad, dsd, qt, dk, accumulate=qtile > lo)
+            if qtile + 1 == hi:
+                _commit(bars.dq_done)
+            _commit(bars.q_empty[q_state.idx])
+            _commit(bars.ds_empty[ring.idx])
+            q_state = q_next
+            do_state = advance(do_state, 1)
+            dp_empty = advance(dp_empty, 1)
+            ring = advance(ring, CFG.P_STAGES)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _commit(bars.k_empty)
+            _commit(bars.v_empty)
+            kv_state = advance(kv_state, 1)
+        else:
+            _commit(bars.dq_done)
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)
+
