+    partner = lane ^ cutlass.Int32(1)
+    other_row = nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, row, partner, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.IDX)
+    other_head = nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, head, partner, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.IDX)
+    live_i = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(row_live.ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(1).ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(0).ir_value()))
+    other_live = nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, live_i, partner, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.IDX)
+    row0 = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(odd.ir_value(), other_row.ir_value(), row.ir_value()))
+    row1 = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(odd.ir_value(), row.ir_value(), other_row.ir_value()))
+    head0 = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(odd.ir_value(), other_head.ir_value(), head.ir_value()))
+    head1 = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(odd.ir_value(), head.ir_value(), other_head.ir_value()))
+    live0 = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(odd.ir_value(), other_live.ir_value(), live_i.ir_value()))
+    live1 = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(odd.ir_value(), live_i.ir_value(), other_live.ir_value()))
+    op = cutlass.make_array_view(o)
+    for blk in cutlass.range_constexpr(tile_o // chunk):
+        vals = nvvm.tcgen05_ld("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + cutlass.Int32(offset + blk * chunk), cutlass.Float32), num=chunk)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+        scaled = vals * inv_sum
+        for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(chunk // 8):
+            lo = [cutlass.Float32(arith.select(row_dead.ir_value(), cutlass.Float32(0.0).ir_value(), scaled[group * 8 + j].ir_value())) for j in range(4)]
+            hi = [cutlass.Float32(arith.select(row_dead.ir_value(), cutlass.Float32(0.0).ir_value(), scaled[group * 8 + 4 + j].ir_value())) for j in range(4)]
+            # Each lane sends only the half that its partner will write.
+            send = [cutlass.Float32(arith.select(odd.ir_value(), a.ir_value(), b.ir_value())) for a, b in zip(lo, hi)]
+            received = [nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, x, partner, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.IDX) for x in send]
+            first = [cutlass.Float32(arith.select(odd.ir_value(), b.ir_value(), a.ir_value())) for a, b in zip(lo, received)]
+            second = [cutlass.Float32(arith.select(odd.ir_value(), b.ir_value(), a.ir_value())) for a, b in zip(received, hi)]
+            col = cutlass.Int32(blk * chunk + group * 8) + (lane & cutlass.Int32(1)) * cutlass.Int32(4)

+            if live1 != cutlass.Int32(0):
+                ptr = op.data_ptr((batch, row1, head1, 0)).toint(cutlass.Int64)

+def _quad_stage_and_merge_stats(sMerge, quad_buf, tid_in_wg, tmem_base, m_w, l_w, bars, bounds, lane_live):
+    """Quadrant softmax (QUAD), the correction warps' first half of a unit's epilogue.  Every lane stages its (max, sum) and its O row -- this quadrant's
+    partial over its own keys -- in SMEM, hands the TMEM accumulators back to the softmax (``mb_o_empty``: the next unit's first PV overwrites them), and once
+    all four quadrants' rows are staged merges the four (max, sum) of its row.  Returns the merged (max, sum) in the base epilogue's terms -- the log2-unit
+    max, 0-substituted when no quadrant saw a live key -- and the four O weights 2 ** (m_w - M), zero for a quadrant without one."""
+    lane = tid_in_wg % cutlass.Int32(QUAD_ROWS)
+    warp_c = tid_in_wg // cutlass.Int32(QUAD_ROWS)
+    row_base = ((quad_buf * cutlass.Int32(4) + warp_c) * cutlass.Int32(QUAD_ROWS) + lane) * cutlass.Int32(QUAD_STRIDE)
+    if lane_live:
+        st_shared_v2(sMerge.subview(row_base + cutlass.Int32(QUAD_O_COLS)).data_ptr(), (m_w, l_w), cutlass.Float32)
+    # An empty unit never wrote the accumulator (its sum is 0 in every quadrant, so the merge never reads the staged O).
+    if cutlass.const_expr(not MAY_BE_EMPTY) or (bounds.right > bounds.left):
+        quad_loaded = load_o_chunks_grouped(tmem_base, LAYOUT.O0_OFF, QUAD_O_COLS, 16, 4)
+        for blk in cutlass.range_constexpr(QUAD_O_COLS // 16):
+            vals = quad_loaded[blk]
+            if lane_live:
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    st_shared_v4(
+                        sMerge.subview(row_base + cutlass.Int32(blk * 16 + 4 * j)).data_ptr(),
+                        (vals[4 * j], vals[4 * j + 1], vals[4 * j + 2], vals[4 * j + 3]),
+                        cutlass.Float32,
+                    )
+    bars.mb_o_empty[0].arrive()
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync(barrier_id=3, thread_count=32 * CFG.CORRECTION_WARPS)
+
+    neg_inf = cutlass.Float32(float("-inf"))
+    zero = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    ms = []
+    ls = []
+    alive = []
+    for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        sv = ld_shared_v2(
+            sMerge.subview(
+                ((quad_buf * cutlass.Int32(4) + cutlass.Int32(w)) * cutlass.Int32(QUAD_ROWS) + lane) * cutlass.Int32(QUAD_STRIDE) + cutlass.Int32(QUAD_O_COLS)
+            ).data_ptr(),
+            cutlass.Float32,
+        )
+        ms.append(cutlass.Float32(sv[0]))
+        ls.append(cutlass.Float32(sv[1]))
+        alive.append(ls[w] > zero)
+    m_max = neg_inf
+    for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        m_max = cute.math.max(m_max, cutlass.Float32(arith.select(alive[w].ir_value(), ms[w].ir_value(), neg_inf.ir_value())))
+    any_alive = m_max > neg_inf
+    wgt = []
+    total = zero
+    for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        e = cute.math.exp2(ms[w] - m_max, fastmath=True)
+        wgt.append(cutlass.Float32(arith.select(alive[w].ir_value(), e.ir_value(), zero.ir_value())))
+        total = total + cutlass.Float32(arith.select(alive[w].ir_value(), (wgt[w] * ls[w]).ir_value(), zero.ir_value()))
+    merged_max = cutlass.Float32(arith.select(any_alive.ir_value(), m_max.ir_value(), zero.ir_value()))
+    return merged_max, total, wgt[0], wgt[1], wgt[2], wgt[3]

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+"""The ONE visible-set helper of the SM107 index-list sparse forwards -- shared by the tcgen05 tile (``sparse_d256_f16.py``) and the
+lean ``mma.sync`` decode tile (``sparse_lean_d256_f16.py``).
+
+Not a template: nothing here reads ``FROST_TEMPLATE_PARAMS``.  Every config knob the arithmetic depends on is a ``cutlass.Constexpr``
+parameter the calling template passes from ITS ``CFG`` (a constexpr parameter folds exactly like a module-global constant: the tcgen05
+module's cubins are byte-identical before and after this lift, the md5 record in ``test_sdpa_fwd_sparse_lean_sm107.py``), so the two
+kernel bodies cannot drift apart on what a row may see (sdpa-invariants: "one helper for the visible set").
+
+WHAT A ROW SEES (the sparse tile's header, ``sparse_d256_f16.py``): for query row ``tok`` of sequence ``batch`` at key-space position
+``pos`` with ``n_vis = clamp(min(pos + 1, L_b), 0)`` visible tokens and the list row ``item_row`` (``[.., block_topk]`` int32, a valid prefix
+then -1, blocks of ``block_size`` tokens):
+
+    pos           = tok  (top-left)  |  tok + (L_b - S_q_b)  (bottom_right: the row sits at the END of the sequence)
+    anchor        = pos  |  L_b - S_q_b = pos_0, the step-0 position  (list_per_sequence: ONE list per sequence)
+    n_sel_default = min(block_topk, floor(clamp(anchor + 1, 0) / block_size))
+    count         = clamp(block_lens[item_row], 0, n_sel_default)  when given, else n_sel_default      (device values, never a host read)
+    tail_lo       = floor(n_anchor / block_size)                   the first block NOT complete at the anchor
+    n_tail        = max(0, ceil(n_vis / block_size) - tail_lo)     0 / 1 (anchor = pos), 0..2 under the shared list at S_q <= 4;
+                                                                   0 when include_open_block = 0 (the pure-list test arm)
+    dead          = (pos < 0) | (padded row) | (L_b <= 0) | (count + n_tail == 0)
+    blk(idx)      = ids[item_row, idx]  for idx < count;  tail_lo + (idx - count)  for idx in [count, count + n_tail);  -1 past that;
+                    -1 for every index of a dead item, a negative id, or an id above (2^31 - 1) / block_size (a large id must not
+                    wrap into a live key once multiplied by block_size)
+
+The tile / chunk cut (``n_tiles``, the split chunk) is NOT here: it is each body's own geometry (the tcgen05 tile's 128-key tiles and
+``SPLIT_KV`` chunks in its ``_item_bounds``; the lean tile's 32-key sub-tiles and ``SUB_TILES_PER_CTA`` chunks in its own body).
+"""
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import arith
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+
+__all__ = ["_select_f32", "_select_i32", "block_id_at", "visible_bounds"]
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _select_i32(cond, a, b):
+    return cutlass.Int32(arith.select(cond.ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(a).ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(b).ir_value()))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _select_f32(cond, a, b):
+    return cutlass.Float32(arith.select(cond.ir_value(), a.ir_value(), b.ir_value()))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def visible_bounds(
+    tok,
+    batch,
+    item_row,
+    eff_seqlen_q,
+    block_lens_tensor: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    seq_kv_lens_tensor,
+    seqlen_kv,
+    *,
+    seq_kv_lens_present: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    bottom_right: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    list_per_sequence: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    include_open_block: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    block_size: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    block_topk: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    """The row's key-space position, the entries read from the item's list, the appended tail block(s), the dead flag, the
+    listed-block total, the sequence's KV length and the visible-token count -- ``(pos, count, n_tail, tail_lo, dead, n_listed,
+    eff_seqlen_kv, n_vis)`` -- from the SAME inputs in every role and every body (the module docstring's arithmetic; ``n_vis`` is
+    returned so a body's per-key mask derives from the helper's value, never from a copy of its line).  Every knob is a constexpr parameter so each arm
+    folds at trace time (the dense rendering traces exactly the prefill form's program)."""
+    eff_seqlen_kv = seqlen_kv
+    if cutlass.const_expr(seq_kv_lens_present == 1):
+        eff_seqlen_kv = cutlass.Int32(cutlass.make_array_view(seq_kv_lens_tensor)[batch])
+    zero = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    one = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    bs = cutlass.Int32(block_size)
+    # Every arm below is a const_expr fold spelled so the dense rendering (no arm) traces EXACTLY the prefill form's program.
+    pos = tok
+    if cutlass.const_expr(bottom_right == 1):
+        pos = tok + (eff_seqlen_kv - eff_seqlen_q)
+    n_vis = cute.math.max(cute.math.min(pos + one, eff_seqlen_kv), zero)
+    anchor = pos
+    n_anchor = n_vis
+    if cutlass.const_expr(list_per_sequence == 1):
+        anchor = eff_seqlen_kv - eff_seqlen_q  # pos_0: the step-0 position (BOTTOM_RIGHT is forced by the config)
+        n_anchor = cute.math.max(cute.math.min(anchor + one, eff_seqlen_kv), zero)
+    n_sel_default = cute.math.min(cutlass.Int32(block_topk), cute.math.max(anchor + one, zero) // bs)
+    count = n_sel_default
+    if cutlass.const_expr(block_lens_tensor is not None):
+        given = cutlass.Int32(cutlass.make_array_view(block_lens_tensor)[item_row])
+        count = cute.math.min(cute.math.max(given, zero), n_sel_default)
+    tail_lo = n_anchor // bs
+    n_tail = zero
+    if cutlass.const_expr(include_open_block == 1):
+        if cutlass.const_expr(list_per_sequence == 1):
+            n_tail = cute.math.max((n_vis + bs - one) // bs - tail_lo, zero)
+        else:
+            # anchor = pos: the same count spelled as the prefill form's has_open
+            n_tail = _select_i32((n_vis % bs) != zero, 1, 0)
+    n_listed = count + n_tail
+    dead = (pos < zero) | (pos >= eff_seqlen_q) | (eff_seqlen_kv <= zero) | (n_listed == zero)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(bottom_right == 1):
+        # the padded-row term is on the Q ROW, not the key-space position (identical when the diagonal is top-left)
+        dead = (pos < zero) | (tok >= eff_seqlen_q) | (eff_seqlen_kv <= zero) | (n_listed == zero)
+    return pos, count, n_tail, tail_lo, dead, n_listed, eff_seqlen_kv, n_vis
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def block_id_at(idx, loaded, count, n_tail, tail_lo, dead, *, list_per_sequence: cutlass.Constexpr[int], block_size: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    """The block id at list index ``idx`` of the current item: the loaded word while ``idx < count``, the tail blocks
+    ``tail_lo .. tail_lo + n_tail - 1`` at ``idx == count .. count + n_tail - 1`` (0, 1 or 2 of them), -1 past that -- and -1
+    for every index of a dead item.  ``loaded`` is the word the caller read unconditionally at an in-bounds address; this
+    SELECT decides whether it means anything."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(list_per_sequence == 1):
+        rel = idx - count
+        tail = _select_i32((rel >= cutlass.Int32(0)) & (rel < n_tail), tail_lo + rel, cutlass.Int32(-1))
+    else:
+        # one tail id at most (n_tail in {0, 1}): the prefill form's spelling, so the dense rendering traces its own program
+        tail = _select_i32((idx == count) & (n_tail != cutlass.Int32(0)), tail_lo, cutlass.Int32(-1))
+    blk = _select_i32(idx < count, loaded, tail)
+    # Bound the block domain BEFORE forming block_size * blk + lane: a large positive Int32 id must not wrap into a live key.
+    invalid = dead | (blk < cutlass.Int32(0)) | (blk > cutlass.Int32((2**31 - 1) // block_size))
+    return _select_i32(invalid, cutlass.Int32(-1), blk)

+"""Decode-shaped SDPA forward for the SM107 (Rubin) d256 f16/bf16 flavor: the swap-AB tile.
+
+Why a second template.  The prefill tile (sm100/prefill_d256_f16.py) issues
+BMM1 / BMM2 over a 256-row collective Q tile per 128-key KV tile whatever the
+number of LIVE Q rows, and its softmax warpgroup exponentiates the full
+128 x 128 score tile.  A decode step of a 32/2-head d256 model has 16 live
+rows per (batch, KV head), so 15/16 of that work is spent on TMA-OOB zero rows
+and the kernel runs at half the HBM rate (67 us for b=32, s_kv=4096 on a B200;
+the KV bytes alone take 34 us at 8 TB/s).  Shrinking the Q tile does not help
+on this hardware: a 64-row UMMA runs at half rate per SM, so the MMA time per
+key is unchanged, and the 64-row TMEM layouts scatter the rows across the
+sub-partitions.
+
+This tile transposes the problem instead (the "swap-AB" decode form):
+
+    S^T[128 keys, N_Q] = K[128 keys, d_qk] . Q^T[d_qk, N_Q]      (BMM1, M = keys)
+    O^T[d_v, N_Q]     += V^T[d_v, 128 keys] . P^T[128 keys, N_Q]  (BMM2, M = d_v)
+
+The KV tokens are the MMA M axis (M = 128, the standard TMEM lane == row
+layout) and the packed Q rows are the N axis (N_Q = 16, 32 or 64, a multiple of
+the f16 UMMA N granule), so the tensor-core and exp work scale with the live
+rows: 8x less MMA and 8x fewer exponentials per key than the prefill tile at
+N_Q = 16.  The online softmax reduces over LANES (a column of S^T is one Q
+row's scores for the tile's 128 keys): a 5-step butterfly inside each warp
+and, once per KV tile, a shared-memory max across the 4-warp group (red.shared.max
+on order-preserving int32 keys into one 16-word slot per group).  A group owns
+16 columns; N_Q = 32 runs two groups (8 softmax warps) and N_Q = 64 four (16)
+over the same 128 TMEM lanes, so the per-thread exp / shuffle / register load
+is the same at every tile width (one 4-warp group over 32 columns was
+issue-bound and lost to the prefill tile on the S_q = 2 MTP shape).  On B200
+the 32-column tile streams a KV tile 1.6x slower per CTA than the 16-column
+one (2.8 vs 1.75 us; 90 us unsplit at b=32 x 2 KV heads x 4096 keys where the
+prefill tile takes 66 us), so the Blackwell adapter compiles and tests it at
+the template level but does not route it (config_sm100.D256_DECODE_ROUTED_MAX_Q_ROWS);
+the Rubin adapter ROUTES it (config_sm107.decode_d256_q_tile, measured on cc 10.7
+against the prefill body at the 24/2 geometry; the other geometries inside the
+route ride the same rule unmeasured): rows in (16, 32] in one unit, and a packed
+MTP step of up to four tokens (24/2: 48 rows) as TWO token units of two tokens x
+12 heads on the 32-column tile, each streaming the KV range once.
+P^T is stored to a small swizzled SMEM tile (the B operand of BMM2 is
+MN-major: the N_Q values of one key are contiguous), V is consumed in place
+as an MN-major A operand (d_v contiguous), and O^T accumulates in TMEM with
+lane = d_v (two 128-lane blocks for d_v = 256).
+
+Roles (6 warps at N_Q = 16, 10 at N_Q = 32, 18 at N_Q = 64; cta_group::1, one CTA per
+(KV-head group, batch, split, TOKEN UNIT) unit -- a token unit is one Q box of
+Q_BOX_TOKENS = N_Q // HEADS_PER_TILE consecutive tokens, and a graph with more
+tokens than one box holds launches ceil(S_q / Q_BOX_TOKENS) units per head
+group, each streaming the unit's KV range once (Q_TOKEN_UNITS; the host entry
+derives the count from the runtime S_q); W = 4 * N_Q / 16 softmax warps):
+
+  * warps 0..W-1  softmax + epilogue, 4 warps per 16-column group: thread ==
+                  key lane (tidx % 128) for S^T / P^T, == d lane for the O^T
+                  rescale and the final store;
+  * warp W        MMA issue + TMEM alloc/dealloc;
+  * warp W+1      TMA loads: Q^T once, then K/V through a 3-slot 64 KiB ring
+                  (K(t), V(t), K(t+1), ...), block-table indirection under PAGED_KV.
+
+SMEM: Q^T N_Q x 512 B (8 / 16 / 32 KiB) + 3 x 64 KiB ring + 2 x P^T (4 / 8 /
+16 KiB) = 208 / 224 / 256 KiB at N_Q = 16 / 32 / 64 (plus the max-key slots, the
+sum scratch and the barriers).  TMEM: 2 S^T slots + 2 O^T blocks = 4 * N_Q
+columns (64 / 128 / 256).  The KV loop, per-batch lengths, masks (padding / bottom-right causal
+/ SWA / right band), sink, Stats (natural or base-2), dense padded-Q trim and
+split-KV partials follow the prefill tile's contract exactly: a split writes
+fp32 O / natural-log LSE partials into the split-major workspace that
+sm100/split_combine.py reduces, and an empty range yields O := 0 / LSE := -inf
+(with a sink, LSE := the sink logit: the row's one live column).
+Nothing reaches the host (python/cudnn/AGENTS.md Rule 3): lengths, page
+tables and the split chunking are all resolved on device. The host uses the
+explicit pointer ABI: extents and Int64 strides are runtime arguments, while
+head dimensions, Stats presence and the paged in-page layout specialize compile().
+

+def _unit_bounds(seq_kv_lens_tensor, seq_q_lens_addr, batch_idx, split_idx, seqlen_q, seqlen_kv, tok0):
+    """This unit's KV-tile range ``[lo, hi)`` plus the per-batch lengths.

+    the barrier handshakes stay in lockstep.  The masks narrow the range the
+    way the prefill tile does (compute_kv_loop_bounds over the unit's token
+    span, which starts at ``tok0`` = the token unit's first Q token), the dense
+    padded-Q trim collapses a dead batch to an empty range, and the split
+    chunking mirrors _common_blackwell's _split_chunk.
+    """

+    if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.SEQ_KV_LENS_PRESENT == 1):
+        eff_seqlen_kv = cutlass.Int32(cutlass.make_array_view(seq_kv_lens_tensor)[batch_idx])

+        eff_seqlen_q,
+        eff_seqlen_kv,
+        CFG.WINDOW_LEFT,
+        CFG.MASK_FLAGS,
+        TILE_N,
+        Q_BOX_TOKENS,
+        bottom_right=bool(CFG.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
+        window_right=int(CFG.WINDOW_RIGHT),
+    )

+    right = cute.math.max(bounds.right, left)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.SEQ_Q_LENS_PRESENT == 1):
+        right = _select_i32(q_len_b <= cutlass.Int32(0), left, right)
+    n_tiles = right - left
+    per = n_tiles // cutlass.Int32(SPLIT_KV)
+    rem = n_tiles % cutlass.Int32(SPLIT_KV)

+@cute.jit
+def _paged_load_tile(
+    smem_tile,
+    tma,
+    block_table_tensor,
+    batch_idx,
+    kv_head_idx,
+    n_pages_b,
+    kv_tile,
+    mbar,
+    box_rows: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    n_boxes: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    granu_elems: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    """One paged K or V tile as ``n_boxes`` row boxes through the block table
+    (same contract as prefill_d256_f16._paged_load_tile: boxes past the batch's
+    live pages take page -1 = TMA-OOB zeros, bytes still credited)."""
+    bt = cutlass.make_array_view(block_table_tensor)
+    last_live = cute.math.max(n_pages_b - cutlass.Int32(1), cutlass.Int32(0))
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(n_boxes):
+        g = kv_tile * cutlass.Int32(TILE_N) + cutlass.Int32(j * box_rows)
+        slot = g // cutlass.Int32(PAGE_SIZE)
+        row_in_page = g % cutlass.Int32(PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_live = cutlass.Int32(bt[batch_idx, cute.math.min(slot, last_live)])
+        in_range = slot < n_pages_b
+        page = _select_i32(in_range, page_live, cutlass.Int32(-1))
+        tma_load_tile(
+            smem_tile.shifted(j * box_rows * granu_elems),
+            tma(cutlass.Int32(0), kv_head_idx, row_in_page, page),
+            mbar,
+            cta_group=1,
+        )

+    """Ring slot and full-barrier parity of the ``seq``-th load of the unit's

+    K(n) precedes it)."""
+    slot = seq % cutlass.Int32(STAGES)
+    phase = (seq // cutlass.Int32(STAGES)) & cutlass.Int32(1)

+    sKV,
+    bars,
+    seq_kv_lens_tensor,

+    seqlen_kv,

+        _tk, _tv = GmemTileTma(tma_k_desc), GmemTileTma(tma_v_desc)

+        # write-through filled them) -- sits BELOW this wait; the descriptor prefetches above it are the prologue it overlaps.
+        wait_on_dependent_grids()

+        # still blocks on this grid's completion and memory flush, wherever this trigger sits).

+@cute.jit
+def _mma_warp_group(
+    sQ,
+    sK,
+    sVt,
+    sP,
+    tmem_ptr_i32,
+    bars,
+    seq_kv_lens_tensor,
+    seq_q_lens_addr,
+    seqlen_q,
+    seqlen_kv,
+    batch_idx,
+    split_idx,
+    tok0,
+    use_pdl: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+):
+    tmem_alloc(tmem_ptr_i32, TMEM_COLS, CTA_GROUP_KIND)
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_arrive(_BAR_TMEM, 32 * (SOFTMAX_WARPS + 1))
+
+    tmem_raw = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_ptr_i32.load(), cutlass.Int8)
+
+    idesc_qk = prims.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+        c_dtype=cutlass.Float32,
+        a_dtype=STORAGE_DTYPE,
+        b_dtype=STORAGE_DTYPE,
+        n_dim=N_Q,
+        m_dim=TILE_N,
+        k_dim=0,
+        a_negate=int(PARAMS.negate_scores),
+    )
+    idesc_pv = prims.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+        c_dtype=cutlass.Float32,
+        a_dtype=STORAGE_DTYPE,
+        b_dtype=STORAGE_DTYPE,
+        n_dim=N_Q,
+        m_dim=128,
+        a_major=1,
+        b_major=1,
+        k_dim=0,
+    )
+    # BMM1: S^T = K . Q^T -- K [128 keys x TILE_K] K-major, Q^T [N_Q x TILE_K] K-major.
+    bmm1_desc = MmaDesc(
+        M=TILE_N,
+        N=N_Q,
+        K=TILE_K,
+        bpe_a=BPE,
+        bpe_b=BPE,
+        tile_k_hw=CFG.TILE_K_HW,
+        btranspose=False,
+        cta_group=1,
+        idesc=idesc_qk,
+        kind=MMA_KIND,
+    )
+    # BMM2: O^T = V^T . P^T -- V^T [128 d x 128 keys] MN-major (d contiguous),
+    # P^T [N_Q x 128 keys] MN-major (the N_Q values of one key contiguous).
+    bmm2_desc = MmaDesc(
+        M=128,
+        N=N_Q,
+        K=TILE_N,
+        bpe_a=BPE,
+        bpe_b=BPE,
+        tile_k_hw=CFG.TILE_K_HW,
+        atranspose=True,
+        btranspose=True,
+        cta_group=1,
+        idesc=idesc_pv,
+        kind=MMA_KIND,

+    if cutlass.const_expr(use_pdl):

+    n_tiles = hi - lo
+
+    # Barrier bookkeeping is arithmetic in the tile index (no loop-carried
+    # pipeline state inside a data-dependent branch):
+    #   ring load seq (K(0), K(1), V(0), K(2), V(1), ...): slot seq % STAGES, phase (seq // STAGES) & 1;
+    #   S slot t % 2: the softmax releases it once per tile that used it, so
+    #   BMM1(t) waits completion #(t // 2) of s_empty[t % 2], i.e. parity
+    #   ((t // 2) - 1) & 1 -- which is 1 for t < 2 and passes a fresh barrier;
+    #   p_full[t % 2] / bmm2_done[t % 2]: parity (t // 2) & 1.
+    if n_tiles > cutlass.Int32(0):
+        bars.mb_q_full.wait(cutlass.Int32(0))
+        desc_Q = sQ[0].desc()
+
+        # Prologue: BMM1(0).
+        slot0, phase0 = _kv_slot(cutlass.Int32(0), n_tiles)
+        bars.mb_kv_full[slot0].wait(phase0, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+        bars.mb_s_empty[0].wait(cutlass.Int32(1), spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        mma_ss(bmm1_desc, sK[slot0].desc(), desc_Q, tmem_raw.subview(cutlass.Int32(S_ACC_OFF[0])))
+        elect_p = nvvm.elect_sync()
+        bars.mb_s_full[0].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p)
+        bars.mb_kv_empty[slot0].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p)
+
+        for i in cutlass.range(0, n_tiles, 1, unroll=1):
+            # BMM1(i + 1) ahead of BMM2(i): the softmax of tile i overlaps the next
+            # score tile, and the K slot is released as early as possible.
+            if i + cutlass.Int32(1) < n_tiles:
+                t_next = i + cutlass.Int32(1)
+                slot_k, phase_k = _kv_slot(cutlass.Int32(2) * t_next - cutlass.Int32(1), n_tiles)
+                par_next = t_next & cutlass.Int32(1)
+                phase_s_empty = ((t_next // cutlass.Int32(2)) - cutlass.Int32(1)) & cutlass.Int32(1)
+                bars.mb_kv_full[slot_k].wait(phase_k, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+                bars.mb_s_empty[par_next].wait(phase_s_empty, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+                nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+                s_off_next = _select_i32(par_next == cutlass.Int32(0), S_ACC_OFF[0], S_ACC_OFF[1])
+                mma_ss(bmm1_desc, sK[slot_k].desc(), desc_Q, tmem_raw.subview(s_off_next))
+                elect_p1 = nvvm.elect_sync()
+                bars.mb_s_full[par_next].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p1)
+                bars.mb_kv_empty[slot_k].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p1)
+
+            seq_v = _select_i32(i + cutlass.Int32(1) < n_tiles, cutlass.Int32(2) * i + cutlass.Int32(2), cutlass.Int32(2) * n_tiles - cutlass.Int32(1))
+            slot_v, phase_v = _kv_slot(seq_v, n_tiles)
+            par_cur = i & cutlass.Int32(1)
+            phase_p = (i // cutlass.Int32(2)) & cutlass.Int32(1)
+            bars.mb_kv_full[slot_v].wait(phase_v, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+            bars.mb_p_full[par_cur].wait(phase_p, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+            desc_P = sP[par_cur].desc()
+            accum = cutlass.Boolean(i > cutlass.Int32(0))
+            for blk in cutlass.range_constexpr(O_BLOCKS):
+                mma_ss(
+                    bmm2_desc,
+                    sVt[slot_v].shifted(blk * 2 * TILE_N * GRANU_ELEMS).desc(),
+                    desc_P,
+                    tmem_raw.subview(cutlass.Int32(O_OFF[blk])),
+                    accumulate=accum,
+                )
+            elect_p2 = nvvm.elect_sync()
+            bars.mb_bmm2_done[par_cur].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p2)
+            bars.mb_kv_empty[slot_v].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p2)
+
+    bars.mb_tmem_dealloc.wait(cutlass.Int32(0))
+    tmem_dealloc(tmem_ptr_i32, TMEM_COLS, CTA_GROUP_KIND)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _warp_reduce_max(x):
+    # ftz=True (the FMNMX intrinsic, as tile_dsl's row_max_reduction and the sparse sibling spell it): the bare
+    # cute.math.max lowers to compare + select -- FSETP.NAN + FSETP.GTU + two FSEL per max, every predicate register busy
+    # -- which tipped the 18-warp (N_Q = 64) tile's KV loop over ptxas's 96-register cap; the inline-asm max.f32 form
+    # pins its operands around each asm block and spilled more.  Softmax maxima are finite or -inf, so only a score below
+    # the fp32 normal range (|s| < 2^-126) could read differently (flushed to 0).
+    for off in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        x = cute.math.max(x, cutlass.Float32(nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, x, 16 >> off, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY)), ftz=True)
+    return x
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _warp_reduce_sum(x):
+    for off in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        x = x + cutlass.Float32(nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, x, 16 >> off, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY))
+    return x

+    mred_smem,
+    sP_raw,
+    o_tensor,

+    G = cutlass.Int32(HEADS_PER_TILE)
+    tmem_base = tmem_ptr_i32.load()
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(use_pdl):
+        # PDL: the TMEM handshake above is this role's prologue; its first global read (the lengths) is below.
+        wait_on_dependent_grids()
+    lo, hi, eff_seqlen_kv, eff_seqlen_q, q_len_b = _unit_bounds(seq_kv_lens_tensor, seq_q_lens_addr, batch_idx, split_idx, seqlen_q, seqlen_kv, tok0)
+    n_tiles = hi - lo
+    causal_diag = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.BOTTOM_RIGHT):
+        causal_diag = eff_seqlen_kv - eff_seqlen_q
+
+    NEG_INF = cutlass.Float32(float("-inf"))
+    ZERO = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    ONE = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    # Running column state: max in the scaled log2 domain (-inf = no live key
+    # yet), this lane's partial sum (the lane sum is reduced once, at the end).
+    m_vec = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(NEG_INF for _ in range(COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    l_vec = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(ZERO for _ in range(COLS)), cutlass.Float32)

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Triangle attention (AlphaFold-class attention with a pair bias and a key mask) on the FROST SDPA engine.
+
+The attention core is the shipped ``sdpa`` graph node served by the FROST ``sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm107`` engine row -- its additive
+bias and per-key mask on the 32- / 64-wide head-dim tiles -- so nothing here is a kernel: this package is the API layer that
+flattens cuEquivariance's 5-D ``(B, N, H, S, D)`` tensors onto the graph's 4-D vocabulary, hands the mask to the kernel in the
+form the caller chose (right-padded lengths or a dense boolean mask), caches one compiled plan per declaration and launches
+it on the caller's stream.
+
+Public surface (``api.py``; cuEquivariance's ``triangle_attention`` signature, pinned to 0.12.0):
+
+  ``triangle_attention(q, k, v, bias, mask=None, scale=None, return_aux=False, kv_lengths=None)``      the drop-in function
+  ``mask_to_kv_lengths(mask)``                                                                            prefix-shaped mask -> lengths (or None); ONE host sync
+  ``prefix_mask_to_kv_lengths(mask, out=None, *, workspace=None, check=None, stream=None)``             an ASSERTED prefix mask -> lengths on the device, no sync
+  ``TriangleAttentionFwd``                                                                                 the prepared class API
+  ``triangle_attention_reference``                                                                         the fp64 reference (``reference.py``)
+  ``copy_counters`` / ``reset_copy_counters``                                                              the counted layout fallbacks of the function
+
+Every name resolves lazily (``import cudnn.triangle_attention`` pulls no torch), and this package module is itself CALLABLE:
+``cudnn.triangle_attention(q, ...)`` runs the function whether the attribute resolved to the function (the lazy export) or to this
+package (Python binds an imported submodule on its parent, bypassing the lazy table -- a same-named function and package).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib
+import sys
+from types import ModuleType
+from typing import Any
+
+_LAZY_EXPORTS = {
+    "TriangleAttentionFwd": (".api", "TriangleAttentionFwd"),
+    "triangle_attention": (".api", "triangle_attention"),
+    "mask_to_kv_lengths": (".api", "mask_to_kv_lengths"),
+    "prefix_mask_to_kv_lengths": (".api", "prefix_mask_to_kv_lengths"),
+    "copy_counters": (".api", "copy_counters"),
+    "reset_copy_counters": (".api", "reset_copy_counters"),
+    "CUEQ_SIGNATURE_VERSION": (".api", "CUEQ_SIGNATURE_VERSION"),
+    "ENGINE_ROW": (".api", "ENGINE_ROW"),
+    "triangle_attention_reference": (".reference", "triangle_attention_reference"),
+}
+
+__all__ = sorted(_LAZY_EXPORTS)
+
+
+def __getattr__(name: str) -> Any:
+    target = _LAZY_EXPORTS.get(name)
+    if target is None:
+        raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__!r} has no attribute {name!r}")
+    module_name, attr_name = target
+    try:
+        value = getattr(importlib.import_module(module_name, __name__), attr_name)
+    except ImportError as error:
+        from cudnn import _optional_dependency_message
+
+        raise ImportError(_optional_dependency_message(name, error)) from error
+    globals()[name] = value
+    return value
+
+
+def __dir__():
+    return sorted(set(globals()) | set(__all__))
+
+
+class _CallablePackage(ModuleType):
+    """``cudnn.triangle_attention(...)`` calls the function even when the attribute is this package (see the docstring)."""
+
+    def __call__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        return self.triangle_attention(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+sys.modules[__name__].__class__ = _CallablePackage

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""``cudnn.triangle_attention`` -- AlphaFold-class triangle attention (a pair bias and a key mask on every row) on the FROST
+SDPA engine, behind cuEquivariance's ``triangle_attention`` signature (pinned to cuequivariance-ops-torch 0.12.0).
+
+    q, k, v  (B, N, H, S, D)        o = softmax_k( scale * q_i . k_j + bias[b, h, i, j] )  v_j      over the keys the mask keeps
+    bias     (B, 1, H, S_q, S_kv)   the pair bias, one per outer batch entry, SHARED by the N rows of that entry
+    mask     (B, N, 1, 1, S_kv)     a dense boolean key mask (False = the key is masked for every query of that row)
+    kv_lengths (B, N, 1, 1, 1)      the right-padded alternative: keys ``j < kv_lengths[b, n]`` are live
+    mask + mask_is_prefix=True      the SAME boolean mask ASSERTED prefix-shaped (every row True on ``[0, len)``, False after): its row
+                                    lengths are derived on the DEVICE (ONE small kernel -- a row count into the caller's workspace, no
+                                    cast pass, no host synchronisation, captured by a CUDA graph) and the call rides the ``kv_lengths`` route
+    -> o (B, N, H, S_q, D), and with ``return_aux`` the fp32 row statistics (lse, max) (B, N, H, S_q)
+
+This module writes no attention kernel (its one kernel is the prefix-length derivation, ``kernels/prefix_lengths.py``).  The attention
+core is the shipped ``sdpa`` graph node served by the FROST row ``sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm107``
+on its 32- / 64-wide head-dim tiles -- the additive bias held as a resident SMEM row-block or streamed per kv tile, the boolean
+key mask folded into the kernel's bit-word mask, the right-padded lengths through the graph's padding path (``seq_len_kv`` = the
+caller's lengths; the ``seq_len_q`` the graph contract requires beside it is the constant ``S_q`` -- every Q row live -- written into the
+caller's workspace on the launch stream; zero kernel cost).  The API layer flattens ``(B, N)`` onto the graph's batch axis (``N`` rows
+per outer entry, the bias broadcast over them -- the graph's existing ``[1, H, S_q, S_kv]`` bias contract, one launch per outer batch
+entry), caches ONE compiled plan per declaration (shape, dtype, layout, mask form, outputs, scale) and launches it on the caller's stream.
+
+Two surfaces:
+
+* :class:`TriangleAttentionFwd` -- the prepared form (``check_support`` / ``get_workspace_size`` / ``compile`` / ``execute``): the
+  five tensors' shapes, dtype AND strides are declared once (the kernel's TMA descriptors are built from them), the mask form and the
+  outputs are compile-time choices, ``execute`` validates and launches (no allocation, no conversion, no synchronisation: a captured
+  CUDA graph replays it).  Every tensor handed to ``execute`` must match the declaration -- a layout the kernel does not bind without
+  a copy is a typed decline here, never a hidden repack.
+* :func:`triangle_attention` -- the drop-in function with cuEquivariance's parameter names, order and defaults.  It caches one plan per
+  declaration, allocates the output and -- where the caller's layout is not the kernel's -- repacks into it with a COUNTED copy
+  (:func:`copy_counters`, one warning per layout naming the permutation), so a model's transposed tensors neither silently copy nor
+  fail; the zero-copy layout is documented (the "layout_left" form ``(B, N, S, H, D)`` in memory, the bias head-major with a
+  16-byte row stride).  Under grad mode with an input that requires grad the call runs through a ``torch.autograd.Function`` that
+  saves ``(q, k, v, bias, o, lse)`` for the backward; the backward itself is a later item of this API and raises a typed
+  ``NotImplementedError`` today.
+
+Served today: compute capability 10.7 (Rubin), bf16 / fp16 (the bias in the same dtype; an fp32 bias is cast once per call by the
+function, counted), ``D % 8 == 0`` with ``D <= 64`` (the row's small tiles; ``D < 32`` / ``32 < D < 64`` by TMA zero fill), any
+``S_q`` / ``S_kv`` the bias form fits (resident up to the row's budget, streamed above it), ``B >= 1`` (one launch per outer batch
+entry until the engine carries a bias batch group), the four key-mask forms (none / lengths / dense boolean / a prefix-asserted boolean
+mask served as lengths), the forward only.
+Everything else is a typed decline quoting the ENGINE's own reason (``NotImplementedError`` for a valid-but-unserved declaration,
+``ValueError`` for a malformed one) -- including ``return_aux=True``: the row max is a side output the small-tile bias arm does not
+store yet, so the request is declined rather than served by a second pass.
+
+Masked-row conventions (documented, not chosen in code -- see ``docs/operations/attention/triangle_attention.md``): a row whose every key is
+masked reads ``o = 0``, ``lse = max = -inf`` here (the FROST SDPA invariant for an empty key range, on BOTH mask forms);
+cuEquivariance's ``kv_lengths`` route zeroes such a row (``o = lse = max = 0``) and its dense-mask route folds a finite ``-1e9``
+(``o`` = the uniform average of ``v``, ``lse = max = -1e9``).  :func:`mask_to_kv_lengths` therefore changes what a fully masked row
+reads only on cuEquivariance; here both forms agree -- and so does the ``mask_is_prefix`` form, which IS the lengths route.
+
+The prefix-mask contract (``mask_is_prefix=True`` on both surfaces, :func:`prefix_mask_to_kv_lengths` for a caller with a plan of its own):
+the CALLER asserts the mask is prefix-shaped; the API computes each row's True count on the device -- one launch of the row-popcount
+kernel ``kernels/prefix_lengths.py`` (a warp per row, byte loads, ``popc(ballot)``, one int32 store into the caller's memory) -- and
+binds it as that row's length, reading the mask on the host NEVER.  The count of a non-prefix row is still a length: such a row is served as the prefix of its True
+count -- the WRONG keys, no error.  :data:`CHECK_PREFIX_MASK_ENV` ``= 1`` (or ``check_prefix_mask=True`` per call) turns on the debug
+check, the device-wide prefix test with its ONE host synchronisation, which raises a typed ``ValueError`` naming the rows that violate
+the contract; it is off by default and never runs inside a CUDA-graph capture.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import os
+import threading
+import warnings
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+
+from cudnn.api_base import APIBase, TensorDesc, check_buffers_disjoint
+from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_arch_requirement_error, cutedsl_requirement_error
+from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import WorkspaceCarver, ws_align
+
+#: The cuEquivariance release whose ``triangle_attention`` signature (names, order, defaults) this module mirrors.
+CUEQ_SIGNATURE_VERSION = "0.12.0"
+#: The FROST engine row that serves the graph; its ``Capabilities`` row and ``mismatch()`` are the source of every typed decline.
+ENGINE_ROW = "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm107"
+#: The key-mask forms a plan is declared with (``prefix_mask`` = ``mask=True, mask_is_prefix=True``: the boolean mask asserted prefix-shaped,
+#: its lengths derived on the device and served through the ``kv_lengths`` graph form).
+MASK_FORMS = ("none", "kv_lengths", "mask", "prefix_mask")
+#: ``=1`` turns on the prefix-mask DEBUG check on every call that does not pass ``check_prefix_mask`` explicitly: the device-wide prefix test
+#: (one host synchronisation per call) that raises a typed ``ValueError`` on a mask the caller asserted prefix-shaped but is not.
+CHECK_PREFIX_MASK_ENV = "CUDNN_FRONTEND_TRIANGLE_ATTENTION_CHECK_PREFIX_MASK"
+_RUBIN = (10, 7)
+_ELEM_BYTES = 2  # bf16 / fp16
+_TMA_ALIGN = 16  # the TMA-read operands (q, k, v, bias, o): the binder's `_ALIGN_TMA`
+_ALIGN_WORD = 4  # the int32 lengths and the fp32 lse: the binder's `_ALIGN_F32` (`prepared.lens`, `_dense_lse`)
+_ALIGN_BYTE = 1  # the boolean key mask: the kernel loads ONE BYTE per lane (`tile_dsl.mask.kv_mask_keep_words`) -- no alignment rule
+_FROST_ENV = "CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES"
+_DTYPES = (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+_dense_bind_strides = None  # the engine's layout predicate, imported on first use
+

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Declarations
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _declaration(t, name: str) -> Tuple[Tuple[int, ...], Tuple[int, ...], torch.dtype, torch.device]:
+    """``(shape, stride, dtype, device)`` of a torch tensor or a :class:`TensorDesc`."""
+    if isinstance(t, TensorDesc):
+        dev = t.device if isinstance(t.device, torch.device) else torch.device(t.device)
+        return tuple(int(s) for s in t.shape), tuple(int(s) for s in t.stride), t.dtype, dev
+    if isinstance(t, torch.Tensor):
+        return tuple(int(s) for s in t.shape), tuple(int(s) for s in t.stride()), t.dtype, t.device
+    raise TypeError(f"{name} must be a torch.Tensor or a cudnn.api_base.TensorDesc, got {type(t).__name__}")
+
+
+def _row_strides(shape5: Tuple[int, ...], stride5: Tuple[int, ...]) -> Tuple[Tuple[int, ...], Tuple[int, ...]]:
+    """The per-outer-batch-entry 4-D ``(N, H, S, D)`` geometry of a 5-D ``(B, N, H, S, D)`` declaration (what one launch binds)."""
+    return tuple(shape5[1:]), tuple(stride5[1:])
+
+
+def activation_binds_zero_copy(shape4: Tuple[int, ...], stride4: Tuple[int, ...]) -> bool:
+    """Whether a logical ``(N, H, S, D)`` activation binds to the kernel's TMA descriptors without a copy -- the engine row's own
+    predicate (``config_sm100.dense_bind_strides``): the head dim contiguous, the token / head / batch strides 16-byte multiples,
+    the nest token-major (``stride(S) >= H * stride(H)``) -- the "layout_left" ``(B, N, S, H, D)`` memory form, compact or padded.
+    A torch-contiguous ``(B, N, H, S, D)`` tensor is head-major and returns False."""
+    global _dense_bind_strides
+    if _dense_bind_strides is None:
+        from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.config_sm100 import dense_bind_strides
+
+        _dense_bind_strides = dense_bind_strides
+    return _dense_bind_strides(tuple(shape4), tuple(stride4), _ELEM_BYTES) is not None
+
+
+def bias_binds_zero_copy(shape4: Tuple[int, ...], stride4: Tuple[int, ...]) -> bool:
+    """Whether a logical ``(1|B, 1|H, S_q, S_kv)`` bias binds without a copy: the key dim contiguous and every stride of an axis
+    with extent > 1 a 16-byte multiple (the TMA global-stride rule: ``S_kv % 8 == 0`` for a compact bias, else a padded row
+    stride) -- the engine row's own rule, spelled once more here so the function can decide a repack BEFORE the plan exists."""
+    if len(shape4) != 4 or stride4[3] != 1:
+        return False
+    return all(not (n > 1 and (s * _ELEM_BYTES) % _TMA_ALIGN) for n, s in zip(shape4[:3], stride4[:3]))
+
+
+def _stream_int(stream, device) -> int:
+    """A raw CUDA stream handle (int) from None / int / a torch stream / a driver ``CUstream``.  None = torch's current stream on
+    ``device`` (the plan's device, not the process's current one)."""
+    if stream is None:
+        from cudnn._torch_stream import _raw_current_stream
+
+        raw = _raw_current_stream(torch, device)
+        return int(raw) if raw is not None else torch.cuda.current_stream(device).cuda_stream
+    if isinstance(stream, int):
+        return stream
+    if isinstance(stream, torch.cuda.Stream):
+        return stream.cuda_stream
+    try:
+        return int(stream)
+    except TypeError:
+        return int(stream.getPtr())
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The caller's workspace -- the SDPA adapters' recipe (`ws_align` chunks dealt in order by `WorkspaceCarver`), never a local carve
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def workspace_bytes(plan_bytes: int, n_q_lens: int, n_kv_lens: int = 0, n_mask_stage: int = 0) -> int:
+    """Bytes ``execute`` needs: the plan's own ``plan_bytes`` and, on the ``kv_lengths`` form (``n_q_lens > 0``), ``n_q_lens`` int32
+    words for the Q-side lengths -- two chunks of the SDPA adapters' shared carve (``ws_align``: 128-byte chunks dealt in order), so the
+    lengths start at ``ws_align(plan_bytes)``.  The ``prefix_mask`` form adds one more chunk: ``n_kv_lens`` int32 words (the KV lengths
+    the device derives, ``B * N``).  ``n_mask_stage`` (appended) sizes a fourth chunk after it -- the int32 mask staging of the two-kernel
+    derivation this form shipped with first; the fused kernel stages nothing, the plan requests 0 words, and the parameter stays so a
+    caller sizing by the four-chunk arithmetic still carves.  The other forms need exactly the plan's own bytes."""
+    if n_q_lens <= 0 and n_kv_lens <= 0 and n_mask_stage <= 0:
+        return int(plan_bytes)
+    total = ws_align(plan_bytes)
+    for n in (n_q_lens, n_kv_lens, n_mask_stage):
+        if n > 0:
+            total += ws_align(_ALIGN_WORD * int(n))
+    return total
+
+
+def carve_workspace_chunks(
+    workspace, plan_bytes: int, n_q_lens: int, n_kv_lens: int, n_mask_stage: int, owner: str
+) -> Tuple[Optional[torch.Tensor], Optional[torch.Tensor], Optional[torch.Tensor], Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
+    """``(the plan's own chunk, the Q-side lengths, the derived KV lengths, the int32 mask staging)`` -- each an int32 / uint8 view of the
+    caller's ``workspace`` or None when its count is 0 -- carved in :func:`workspace_bytes`'s order by the shared ``WorkspaceCarver``: a
+    missing, undersized, non-tensor or misaligned buffer raises ITS error (the SDPA adapters' text; its base rule is 16-byte alignment,
+    which a torch allocation satisfies, while the lengths' reader needs 4)."""
+    carver = WorkspaceCarver(workspace, workspace_bytes(plan_bytes, n_q_lens, n_kv_lens, n_mask_stage), owner)
+    plan_ws = carver.take(int(plan_bytes), torch.uint8) if plan_bytes else None
+    q_lens = carver.take(int(n_q_lens), torch.int32) if n_q_lens > 0 else None
+    kv_lens = carver.take(int(n_kv_lens), torch.int32) if n_kv_lens > 0 else None
+    stage = carver.take(int(n_mask_stage), torch.int32) if n_mask_stage > 0 else None
+    return plan_ws, q_lens, kv_lens, stage
+
+
+def carve_workspace(workspace, plan_bytes: int, n_q_lens: int, owner: str) -> Tuple[Optional[torch.Tensor], Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
+    """``(the plan's own chunk or None, the Q-side lengths as an int32 view or None)`` -- :func:`carve_workspace_chunks` for the forms
+    without a derived-lengths chunk (the ``kv_lengths`` form and the plain ones)."""
+    plan_ws, q_lens, _kv_lens, _stage = carve_workspace_chunks(workspace, plan_bytes, n_q_lens, 0, 0, owner)
+    return plan_ws, q_lens
+
+
+def prefix_check_enabled() -> bool:
+    """Whether :data:`CHECK_PREFIX_MASK_ENV` turns the prefix-mask debug check on for the calls that do not decide it themselves."""
+    return os.environ.get(CHECK_PREFIX_MASK_ENV, "").strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")
+
+
+def _check_mask_arg(mask) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """``(B, N, S_kv)`` of a boolean ``(B, N, 1, 1, S_kv)`` mask, else the typed ``ValueError``."""
+    if not isinstance(mask, torch.Tensor) or mask.dtype != torch.bool:
+        raise ValueError(f"mask must be a boolean torch.Tensor, got {type(mask).__name__} {getattr(mask, 'dtype', None)}")
+    if mask.ndim != 5 or mask.shape[2] != 1 or mask.shape[3] != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"mask must be (B, N, 1, 1, S_kv), got {tuple(mask.shape)}")
+    b, n, _, _, s_kv = mask.shape
+    return int(b), int(n), int(s_kv)
+
+
+def _row_counts_on_device(mask: torch.Tensor, lens: torch.Tensor, stream) -> None:
+    """Each row's True count of the boolean ``(B, N, 1, 1, S_kv)`` ``mask`` into ``lens`` -- ``B * N`` contiguous int32 words of memory the
+    caller owns (any view of them, row-major over ``(b, n)``) -- on ``stream`` (a raw handle, a torch stream or None = torch's current
+    stream on the mask's device).  On a CUDA mask this is ONE launch of the row-popcount kernel (``kernels/prefix_lengths.py``: a warp per
+    row, byte loads, ``popc(ballot)``, one int32 store): no cast pass, no staging, no allocation, nothing read on the host, and a CUDA
+    graph captures it like any launch (a replay re-derives the lengths from the mask's contents at replay time).  The count is bitwise
+    ``mask.sum(-1, dtype=torch.int32)`` on every mask and every layout (a batch slice, a padded row, a strided key view): a non-prefix
+    row counts its True keys -- the asserted form's documented behaviour -- and a row with no True key reads 0.  A CPU mask takes torch's
+    reduction (the GPU-free contract tests; no kernel, no stream).  A DSL below the floor, or one without this device's target, is a
+    typed ``NotImplementedError`` naming the version (the kernel module's own gate)."""
+    global _launch_prefix_lengths
+    shape = mask.shape
+    b, n, s_kv = shape[0], shape[1], shape[4]
+    if not mask.is_cuda:
+        torch.sum(mask.reshape(b, n, s_kv), dim=-1, dtype=torch.int32, out=lens.view(b, n))
+        return
+    if _launch_prefix_lengths is None:
+        from .kernels.prefix_lengths import launch_prefix_lengths
+
+        _launch_prefix_lengths = launch_prefix_lengths
+    strides = mask.stride()
+    # a unit axis carries an arbitrary stride in torch; it is never walked, so it is passed as 0
+    _launch_prefix_lengths(
+        mask.data_ptr(),
+        lens.data_ptr(),
+        b,
+        n,
+        s_kv,
+        strides[0] if b > 1 else 0,
+        strides[1] if n > 1 else 0,
+        strides[4] if s_kv > 1 else 0,
+        stream if isinstance(stream, int) else _stream_int(stream, mask.device),
+        mask.get_device(),
+    )
+
+
+_launch_prefix_lengths = None  # the kernel module's launcher, imported on the first CUDA derivation (the package import stays torch- and DSL-free)
+
+
+def assert_prefix_mask(mask: torch.Tensor, lengths: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """The prefix-mask DEBUG check: every row of ``mask`` must be True exactly on ``[0, lengths[b, n])`` -- a device-wide test with ONE host
+    synchronisation; a violation is a typed ``ValueError`` naming the rows.  Never call it inside a CUDA-graph capture."""
+    b, n, s_kv = _check_mask_arg(mask)
+    prefix = torch.arange(s_kv, device=mask.device, dtype=torch.int32).view(1, 1, 1, 1, s_kv) < lengths.view(b, n, 1, 1, 1)
+    bad = (mask != prefix).view(b, n, s_kv).any(dim=-1)
+    n_bad = int(bad.sum().item())  # the host synchronisation of the check
+    if n_bad:
+        rows = bad.nonzero()[:8].tolist()
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"triangle_attention: mask_is_prefix asserts a PREFIX-shaped mask (every row True on [0, len) and False after), but {n_bad} of the "
+            f"{b * n} (b, n) rows violate it, e.g. (b, n) = {rows}: served as the prefix of its True count such a row attends the WRONG keys. "
+            "Pass the mask without mask_is_prefix (the in-kernel dense mask) or repair it; mask_to_kv_lengths(mask) returns None for it."
+        )
+
+
+def prefix_mask_workspace_bytes(b: int, n: int, s_kv: int) -> int:
+    """Bytes of the ``workspace`` :func:`prefix_mask_to_kv_lengths` needs: **0** -- the fused kernel reads the mask's bytes and writes the
+    counts, staging nothing.  (The two-kernel form this function sized for staged the mask as int32, ``4 * B * N * S_kv`` bytes; the
+    function and the ``workspace`` keyword stay so a caller written against it keeps working.)"""
+    return 0
+
+
+def prefix_mask_to_kv_lengths(
+    mask: torch.Tensor, out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None, *, workspace: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None, check: Optional[bool] = None, stream=None
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``(B, N, 1, 1, 1)`` int32 right-padded lengths of a boolean mask ``(B, N, 1, 1, S_kv)`` the CALLER asserts prefix-shaped, computed on
+    the device with no host synchronisation -- for a caller that holds a mask and a plan of its own (``TriangleAttentionFwd(...,
+    kv_lengths=True)``, the graph's ``seq_len_kv``, cuEquivariance's ``kv_lengths``).  The sync-free twin of :func:`mask_to_kv_lengths`:
+    that one TESTS the shape (and returns None when it fails) at the price of one synchronisation; this one TRUSTS the assertion.
+
+    ONE launch of the row-popcount kernel (``kernels/prefix_lengths.py``: a warp per row, byte loads, ``popc(ballot)``, one int32 store):
+    no cast pass, no staging, no allocation beyond ``out``, nothing read on the host.  ``out`` -- the int32 ``(B, N, 1, 1, 1)`` contiguous
+    tensor to write (allocated when None); with it given the call allocates nothing and a CUDA graph captures it (a replay re-derives
+    the lengths from the mask's contents).  ``workspace`` -- accepted for compatibility with the two-kernel form this function shipped
+    with first and UNUSED: the fused kernel stages nothing (:func:`prefix_mask_workspace_bytes` is 0); a value must still be a contiguous
+    uint8 tensor on the mask's device.  ``stream`` -- the raw handle or torch stream the launch is ordered on (None = torch's current
+    stream).  ``check`` -- run :func:`assert_prefix_mask` after the count (ONE host synchronisation; a typed ``ValueError`` on a non-prefix
+    mask); None = :data:`CHECK_PREFIX_MASK_ENV` decides.  Without the check a non-prefix row yields its True count, i.e. the prefix of
+    that length (documented, not detected).  A row with no True key yields 0 -- the ``kv_lengths`` route's fully masked row (``o = 0``,
+    ``lse = max = -inf`` on this provider).  Any mask layout is served (a batch slice, a padded row stride, a strided key view); a CPU
+    mask takes torch's reduction.  A DSL below the floor is a typed ``NotImplementedError`` naming the version."""
+    b, n, s_kv = _check_mask_arg(mask)
+    dev = mask.device
+    if out is None:
+        out = torch.empty((b, n, 1, 1, 1), dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    else:
+        if not isinstance(out, torch.Tensor) or out.dtype != torch.int32 or tuple(out.shape) != (b, n, 1, 1, 1):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"out must be an int32 (B, N, 1, 1, 1) = {(b, n, 1, 1, 1)} tensor, got {type(out).__name__} {getattr(out, 'dtype', None)} {tuple(getattr(out, 'shape', ()))}"
+            )
+        if not out.is_contiguous() or out.device != dev:
+            raise ValueError(f"out must be contiguous and on the mask's device {dev}, got strides {tuple(out.stride())} on {out.device}")
+    if workspace is not None and (
+        not isinstance(workspace, torch.Tensor) or workspace.dtype != torch.uint8 or not workspace.is_contiguous() or workspace.device != dev
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"workspace must be a contiguous uint8 tensor on the mask's device {dev} (unused by the fused derivation; accepted for compatibility), "
+            f"got {type(workspace).__name__} {getattr(workspace, 'dtype', None)} on {getattr(workspace, 'device', None)}"
+        )
+    _row_counts_on_device(mask, out, stream)
+    if check if check is not None else prefix_check_enabled():
+        assert_prefix_mask(mask, out)
+    return out
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The prepared API
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+class TriangleAttentionFwd(APIBase):
+    """Triangle attention, forward: one declaration, one compiled plan, one launch per outer batch entry on one stream.
+
+    Declaration (the constructor): ``sample_q`` / ``sample_k`` / ``sample_v`` ``(B, N, H, S, D)`` and ``sample_bias``
+    ``(1|B, 1, 1|H, S_q, S_kv)`` (tensors or :class:`cudnn.api_base.TensorDesc`; their dtype AND strides are compile-time facts --
+    the kernel's TMA descriptors are built from them), the key-mask form (``kv_lengths=True`` -> right-padded int32 lengths
+    ``(B, N, 1, 1, 1)``; ``mask=True`` -> a dense boolean mask ``(B, N, 1, 1, S_kv)``; ``mask=True, mask_is_prefix=True`` -> the same
+    boolean mask ASSERTED prefix-shaped, its row lengths derived on the device at ``execute`` and served through the ``kv_lengths`` graph
+    form; neither -> every key live; both is a ``ValueError``, as in cuEquivariance), the outputs (``lse=True`` adds the fp32 log-sum-exp ``(B, N, H, S_q)``; ``score_max=True``
+    requests the fp32 row max -- declined by the engine today), the softmax ``scale`` (None = ``1 / sqrt(D)``) and optionally
+    ``sample_o`` (the output's layout; None = the kernels' compact BSHD form presented as ``(B, N, H, S, D)``).
+
+    ``check_support`` raises the typed declines (malformed -> ``ValueError``; unserved -> ``NotImplementedError`` quoting the
+    engine row's own reason), ``compile`` builds the plan (the FROST engine row's lowering, selected by name and pinned),
+    ``get_workspace_size`` is the plan's requirement (0 on most declarations) plus, on the ``kv_lengths`` form, ``N`` int32 words for the
+    Q-side lengths the graph's padding contract requires (``execute`` writes ``S_q`` there on its stream) and, on the ``prefix_mask`` form,
+    ``B * N`` int32 words for the derived KV lengths plus ``B * N * S_kv`` int32 words the mask is staged in, ``execute(q, k, v, bias,
+    kv_lengths, o, lse, score_max, workspace, current_stream, *, mask, check_prefix_mask)`` validates (device, dtype, shape, stride, the
+    base alignment each operand's reader needs, form) and launches -- no allocation, no conversion, no synchronisation (the prefix-mask
+    debug check, off by default, is the documented exception); a captured CUDA graph replays it.
+    ``B > 1`` is served as ``B`` launches of the one plan on the per-entry slices (the bias of entry ``b`` is broadcast over its ``N``
+    rows), ``launches_per_call`` says how many.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        sample_q,
+        sample_k,
+        sample_v,
+        sample_bias,
+        *,
+        kv_lengths: bool = False,
+        mask: bool = False,
+        lse: bool = False,
+        score_max: bool = False,
+        scale: Optional[float] = None,
+        sample_o=None,
+        mask_is_prefix: bool = False,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self._warn_experimental_api()
+        if kv_lengths and mask:
+            raise ValueError("pass either mask or kv_lengths, not both")
+        if mask_is_prefix and not mask:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "mask_is_prefix=True requires mask=True: it is the prefix-asserted form of the boolean mask (pass kv_lengths=True when you hold lengths)"
+            )
+        q_shape, q_stride, q_dtype, q_dev = _declaration(sample_q, "sample_q")
+        k_shape, k_stride, k_dtype, k_dev = _declaration(sample_k, "sample_k")
+        v_shape, v_stride, v_dtype, v_dev = _declaration(sample_v, "sample_v")
+        b_shape, b_stride, b_dtype, b_dev = _declaration(sample_bias, "sample_bias")
+        for name, shape in (("sample_q", q_shape), ("sample_k", k_shape), ("sample_v", v_shape)):
+            if len(shape) != 5:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be rank 5 (B, N, H, S, D), got shape {shape}")
+        if len(b_shape) != 5:
+            raise ValueError(f"sample_bias must be rank 5 (B, 1, H, S_q, S_kv), got shape {b_shape}")
+        self.batch, self.n, self.h, self.s_q, self.d = q_shape
+        _, _, self.h_kv, self.s_kv, d_k = k_shape
+        if k_shape[:2] != q_shape[:2] or v_shape[:2] != q_shape[:2]:
+            raise ValueError(f"q, k, v must agree on (B, N): q {q_shape}, k {k_shape}, v {v_shape}")
+        if v_shape[2] != self.h_kv or v_shape[3] != self.s_kv:
+            raise ValueError(f"k and v must agree on (H, S_kv): k {k_shape}, v {v_shape}")
+        if d_k != self.d or v_shape[4] != self.d:
+            raise ValueError(f"q, k, v must share the head dim D: q {q_shape}, k {k_shape}, v {v_shape} (D_qk == D_v on this row)")
+        if self.h_kv < 1 or self.h % self.h_kv:
+            raise ValueError(f"the KV head count must divide the Q head count (GQA), got H={self.h}, H_kv={self.h_kv}")
+        if b_shape[0] not in (1, self.batch) or b_shape[1] != 1 or b_shape[2] not in (1, self.h) or b_shape[3:] != (self.s_q, self.s_kv):
+            raise ValueError(f"bias must be (B|1, 1, H|1, S_q, S_kv) = ({self.batch}|1, 1, {self.h}|1, {self.s_q}, {self.s_kv}), got {b_shape}")
+        if q_dtype != k_dtype or q_dtype != v_dtype:
+            raise ValueError(f"q, k, v must share one dtype, got {q_dtype}, {k_dtype}, {v_dtype}")
+        if not all(dev == q_dev for dev in (k_dev, v_dev, b_dev)):
+            raise ValueError(f"q, k, v, bias must live on one device, got {q_dev}, {k_dev}, {v_dev}, {b_dev}")
+        if scale is not None and not (float(scale) > 0.0 and math.isfinite(float(scale))):
+            raise ValueError(f"scale must be a positive finite float, got {scale!r}")
+        self.dtype = q_dtype
+        self.bias_dtype = b_dtype
+        self.device = torch.device(q_dev)
+        self.scale = float(scale) if scale is not None else 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.d)
+        self.mask_form = "kv_lengths" if kv_lengths else (("prefix_mask" if mask_is_prefix else "mask") if mask else "none")
+        self.want_lse = bool(lse)
+        self.want_score_max = bool(score_max)
+        # The 4-D geometry ONE launch binds (the per-outer-entry slice), plus the outer stride that steps the slices.
