+"""The triangle multiplicative update's performance knobs and their MEASURED defaults -- the one place the API reads a tile or a tile order from.
+
+Every axis here is performance-only: a plan computes the same function (bitwise, the tests pin it) under any value of its domain, so a caller
+or an autotuner may pick freely.  Numerics modes (``affine_fold``, ``fuse_residual`` of the output stage) are NOT knobs: they change the
+function and stay op attributes the API never sets.
+
+  ``k2_tile``        the FROST GEMM tile config of the contraction (:data:`K2_TILE_DOMAIN`, catalog names): the 2-CTA 256 x 256 pair tile,
+                     the same with the A operand multicast across 2 / 4 CTAs, the 1-CTA 128 x 128 tile, the same with B multicast across 2.
+  ``k1_pass_order``  the projection stage's tile order (``"interleaved"``: both passes of a row block adjacent, the second ``x`` read an L2 hit;
+                     ``"major"``: every row block of pass 0 before pass 1).
+  ``k3_prologue``    the output stage's MN-major LayerNorm form (``"mn_major"`` in place; ``"transpose"`` into the K-major layout).
+  ``clc_stages``     the two LayerNorm-prologue stages' scheduler ring depth.
+  ``k_block``        the two LayerNorm-prologue stages' row tile: k's per 256-row pair tile (:data:`K_BLOCK_DOMAIN`; the substrate's rule
+                     ``default_k_block`` when a record leaves it unset -- 256 from N = 256, else the next power of two >= N).  At N = 384 the
+                     rule's 256 pads 25 % of every pair tile's rows; 128 pads none (the lever measured in the perf campaign).
+  ``ln_pass_form``   the two stages' LayerNorm pass form (:data:`LN_PASS_FORMS`: ``"registers"`` = the row held in registers between the passes;
+                     ``"smem"`` / ``"smem_rolled"`` = the row re-read from the SMEM stage in every pass, unrolled / rolled chunk loops -- the
+                     rolled form has no K = 256 spills; ``"smem_rolled_pf"`` = the rolled form with the next chunk's loads pipelined one
+                     iteration ahead; all bitwise the same output.  ``"smem_rolled_tree"`` = the pipelined form with four partial sums per
+                     statistics pass: a different fp32 summation order (:data:`LN_PASS_FORMS_REORDERED`), admitted as a caller's knob, never
+                     a pick of this table).
+  ``epi_math``       the two stages' gated-epilogue arithmetic form (:data:`EPI_MATHS`: ``"scalar"`` / ``"packed"`` fp32x2 pairs; bitwise).
+  ``min_blocks_per_mp``  the two stages' ``.minnctapersm`` launch hint (:data:`MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP_DOMAIN`: 0 = the rendering as shipped, its
+                     register split dropped by ptxas; 1 = the hint under which ptxas honours the split -- bitwise the same output).  An OVERRIDE
+                     axis only: ``None`` (the table never sets it) means the per-RENDERING rule :func:`register_split_hint`, applied at compile
+                     time with each stage's bias flag, because the fact it answers -- does this rendering spill at the flat allocation? -- is a
+                     property of (kernel, width, bias arm, LayerNorm / epilogue form), not of N or B.
+  ``ln_once``        the two LayerNorm-prologue stages' work item (:data:`LN_ONCE_FORMS`: ``""`` = one GEMM tile, the row block's A rows re-streamed
+                     and re-normalised per (pass, N tile); ``"block"`` = the whole row block held resident in SMEM and LayerNormed ONCE across its
+                     passes x N tiles; ``"passes"`` = (row block, one N tile) across the passes -- the finer persistent tail for small N; bitwise the
+                     same output).  The output stage runs one pass, so it takes ``"block"`` at c = 256 only (two N tiles) and keeps today's item
+                     elsewhere (the substrate's typed decline of a one-tile item, resolved in the API's stage-parameter builder, stated); a geometry
+                     axis of the table (the persistent tail is a function of N and B), OFF in every pick until its A/B/A lands a per-bucket default.
+
+:func:`recommend` is the table -- the best MEASURED configuration per geometry on the 212-SM Rubin perf-node class, keyed by hidden width ``c``,
+N bucket, batch bucket and direction (and, appended, the device's compute capability ``cc``: the SM100 COLUMN below is its own MEASURED table --
+every axis swept on a 152-SM GB200 perf node (lock 1830 MHz) as a single-axis arm against the seeded pick, in-process control twins, graph replay
+>= 100 x 3, the fp64 oracle on every arm, for N >= 256 at B 1 / 4 in both directions; the N < 256 floors carry the Rubin picks with the recorded
+contraction tile until measured there, and the register-split hint rows are per column): a bucket table (width, N) carries the complete knob set, and a short refinement table overrides ONE axis
+where a cell of the measured grid (B in {1, 4}, both directions) beat the bucket's pick decisively in every pass that measured it.  A geometry
+nobody timed takes the nearest measured bucket's pick (N: the first floor at or below it; B: 4 from B >= 4, else 1), never a guess outside the
+domain.  :func:`resolve` merges a caller's ``k2_tile`` / ``knobs`` over it -- a :class:`TriMulKnobs` is a PARTIAL record: an axis left ``None``
+takes the table's value, so ``TriMulKnobs(clc_stages=4)`` changes the ring depth and keeps the geometry's measured tile, tile order and
+prologue.  :func:`validate_knobs` is the typed vocabulary check ``check_support`` runs on the resolved record.
+
+The vocabulary is not mirrored into the graph API's ``KnobType_t`` band: this API is a standalone cuEquivariance-signature surface, not a graph
+engine, so no autotune record of the form ``(engine_id, {knob_type: int})`` exists for it.  Should it become a graph op, the four axes join the
+frontend-only knob band (append-only) and the dataclass converts at that boundary.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple
+
+from cudnn.gemm.frost.ln_prologue import (
+    A0_PROLOGUES,
+    EPI_MATHS,
+    EPI_MATHS_PACKED,
+    LN_ONCE_FORMS,
+    LN_PASS_FORMS,
+    MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP_DOMAIN,
+    MIN_K_BLOCK_MN_MAJOR,
+    PAIR_TILE_ROWS,
+    PASS_ORDERS,
+)
+from cudnn.gemm.frost.ln_prologue import default_k_block as _substrate_default_k_block
+
+from .kernels import contraction as k2
+
+#: The contraction tile configs the heuristics may pick and ``check_support`` admits (every one a FROST GEMM catalog name; every one measured).
+K2_TILE_DOMAIN: Tuple[str, ...] = (
+    k2.DESIGN_TILE_CONFIG,
+    k2.MULTICAST_A2_TILE_CONFIG,
+    k2.MULTICAST_A4_TILE_CONFIG,
+    k2.SMALL_N_TILE_CONFIG,
+    k2.SMALL_N_MULTICAST_B2_TILE_CONFIG,
+)
+#: The scheduler ring depths of the LayerNorm-prologue stages that were measured (the substrate admits 1..8).
+CLC_STAGES_DOMAIN: Tuple[int, ...] = (1, 2, 4)
+#: The row tiles (k's per 256-row pair tile) BOTH stages serve for every N the API admits: the output stage's MN-major box needs >= 64, the pair
+#: tile is 256 -- the powers of two between (the projection stage alone admits 8).
+K_BLOCK_DOMAIN: Tuple[int, ...] = tuple(1 << i for i in range(MIN_K_BLOCK_MN_MAJOR.bit_length() - 1, PAIR_TILE_ROWS.bit_length()))
+#: The batch sizes the table was measured at; :func:`batch_bucket` maps any B onto the nearest one below (B >= 4 -> 4, else 1).
+BATCH_BUCKETS: Tuple[int, ...] = (1, 4)
+#: The c = 128 geometry's knob values below N = 256 (the API's K1 tile-order pin reads the first; from N = 256 the c = 128 picks take the pass-major
+#: order with the LayerNorm-once item); :func:`recommend` is the table that decides.
+DEFAULT_K1_PASS_ORDER = "interleaved"
+DEFAULT_K3_PROLOGUE = "mn_major"
+DEFAULT_CLC_STAGES = 2
+
+
+#: The LayerNorm-once item's B-ring depth vocabulary (0 = the shipped ring; the substrate declines a depth past the arch body's ring).
+LN_ONCE_B_STAGES_DOMAIN = tuple(range(0, 10))
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TriMulKnobs:
+    """One knob assignment -- COMPLETE when every axis is set (what a plan runs; :func:`recommend` returns one), PARTIAL when an axis is ``None``
+    (a caller's override: the unset axes take the measured table's values in :func:`resolve`).  Performance only: the output is the same function
+    under every member of every domain."""
+
+    k2_tile: Optional[str] = None
+    k1_pass_order: Optional[str] = None
+    k3_prologue: Optional[str] = None
+    clc_stages: Optional[int] = None
+    k_block: Optional[int] = None  # appended (2026-10-09): the row tile of the two LayerNorm-prologue stages
+    #: appended axes (the two LayerNorm-prologue stages share them): the LayerNorm pass form and the epilogue arithmetic form
+    ln_pass_form: Optional[str] = None
+    epi_math: Optional[str] = None
+    #: appended (2026-10-13): the two stages' ``.minnctapersm`` launch hint -- an OVERRIDE axis the table never sets: ``None`` = the per-rendering
+    #: rule :func:`register_split_hint` (keyed by each stage's bias flag at compile time), so it is not one of the geometry axes ``is_complete`` names
+    min_blocks_per_mp: Optional[int] = None
+    #: appended (2026-10-13, wave 2): the two stages' LayerNorm-once-per-row-block work item (:data:`LN_ONCE_FORMS`; "" = today's per-tile item) -- a
+    #: GEOMETRY axis (the persistent tail it coarsens is a function of N and B), so ``is_complete`` names it and every pick carries a value
+    ln_once: Optional[str] = None
+    #: appended (2026-10-14, the SM100 lever B-TriMul-1): the two stages' B-RING depth under the LayerNorm-once item (the substrate's
+    #: ``LnDualGemmParams.ln_once_b_stages``: honoured only where the shallower ring buys the second resident A slot -- the SM100 body's projection
+    #: stage at c 256; a no-op elsewhere) -- an OVERRIDE axis the table may set per bucket: ``None`` = 0 = the shipped ring, so it is not one of the
+    #: geometry axes ``is_complete`` names
+    ln_once_b_stages: Optional[int] = None
+
+    def is_complete(self) -> bool:
+        return None not in (self.k2_tile, self.k1_pass_order, self.k3_prologue, self.clc_stages, self.k_block, self.ln_pass_form, self.epi_math, self.ln_once)
+
+    def merged_over(self, base: "TriMulKnobs") -> "TriMulKnobs":
+        """This record's SET axes over ``base`` (the unset ones keep the base's values)."""
+        return TriMulKnobs(
+            k2_tile=self.k2_tile if self.k2_tile is not None else base.k2_tile,
+            k1_pass_order=self.k1_pass_order if self.k1_pass_order is not None else base.k1_pass_order,
+            k3_prologue=self.k3_prologue if self.k3_prologue is not None else base.k3_prologue,
+            clc_stages=self.clc_stages if self.clc_stages is not None else base.clc_stages,
+            k_block=self.k_block if self.k_block is not None else base.k_block,
+            ln_pass_form=self.ln_pass_form if self.ln_pass_form is not None else base.ln_pass_form,
+            epi_math=self.epi_math if self.epi_math is not None else base.epi_math,
+            min_blocks_per_mp=self.min_blocks_per_mp if self.min_blocks_per_mp is not None else base.min_blocks_per_mp,
+            ln_once=self.ln_once if self.ln_once is not None else base.ln_once,
+            ln_once_b_stages=self.ln_once_b_stages if self.ln_once_b_stages is not None else base.ln_once_b_stages,
+        )
+
+
+def validate_knobs(knobs: TriMulKnobs) -> None:
+    """Typed vocabulary check (``ValueError`` names the axis and its domain); a performance knob outside its domain is a malformed declaration.
+    An axis left ``None`` is a partial record's "take the table's value" and passes; the record a plan runs is complete (``resolve`` fills it)."""
+    if not isinstance(knobs, TriMulKnobs):
+        raise TypeError(f"knobs must be a TriMulKnobs, got {type(knobs).__name__}")
+    if knobs.k2_tile is not None and knobs.k2_tile not in K2_TILE_DOMAIN:
+        raise ValueError(f"k2_tile must be one of the measured contraction tile configs {K2_TILE_DOMAIN}, got {knobs.k2_tile!r}")
+    if knobs.k1_pass_order is not None and knobs.k1_pass_order not in PASS_ORDERS:
+        raise ValueError(f"k1_pass_order must be one of {PASS_ORDERS}, got {knobs.k1_pass_order!r}")
+    if knobs.k3_prologue is not None and knobs.k3_prologue not in A0_PROLOGUES:
+        raise ValueError(f"k3_prologue must be one of {A0_PROLOGUES}, got {knobs.k3_prologue!r}")
+    if knobs.clc_stages is not None and knobs.clc_stages not in CLC_STAGES_DOMAIN:
+        raise ValueError(f"clc_stages must be one of {CLC_STAGES_DOMAIN}, got {knobs.clc_stages!r}")
+    if knobs.k_block is not None and (isinstance(knobs.k_block, bool) or knobs.k_block not in K_BLOCK_DOMAIN):
+        raise ValueError(f"k_block must be one of {K_BLOCK_DOMAIN} (k's per 256-row pair tile of the two LayerNorm-prologue stages), got {knobs.k_block!r}")
+    if knobs.ln_pass_form is not None and knobs.ln_pass_form not in LN_PASS_FORMS:
+        raise ValueError(f"ln_pass_form must be one of {LN_PASS_FORMS}, got {knobs.ln_pass_form!r}")
+    if knobs.epi_math is not None and knobs.epi_math not in EPI_MATHS:
+        raise ValueError(f"epi_math must be one of {EPI_MATHS}, got {knobs.epi_math!r}")
+    if knobs.min_blocks_per_mp is not None and (isinstance(knobs.min_blocks_per_mp, bool) or knobs.min_blocks_per_mp not in MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP_DOMAIN):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"min_blocks_per_mp must be one of {MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP_DOMAIN} (the two LayerNorm-prologue stages' .minnctapersm launch hint: 0 = the rendering "
+            f"as shipped, 1 = ptxas honours the body's register split), got {knobs.min_blocks_per_mp!r}"
+        )
+    if knobs.ln_once is not None and knobs.ln_once not in LN_ONCE_FORMS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"ln_once must be one of {LN_ONCE_FORMS} (the two LayerNorm-prologue stages' work item: '' = one GEMM tile, 'block' = the row block "
+            f"LayerNormed once across its passes x N tiles, 'passes' = across its passes at one N tile), got {knobs.ln_once!r}"
+        )
+    if knobs.ln_once_b_stages is not None and (isinstance(knobs.ln_once_b_stages, bool) or knobs.ln_once_b_stages not in LN_ONCE_B_STAGES_DOMAIN):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"ln_once_b_stages must be one of {LN_ONCE_B_STAGES_DOMAIN} (the LayerNorm-once item's B-ring depth: 0 = the body's shipped ring; a shallower "
+            f"ring is honoured only where it buys the second resident A slot), got {knobs.ln_once_b_stages!r}"
+        )
+
+
+# THE TABLE, part 1 -- the BUCKET picks.  Per hidden width ``c``: descending N floors, each with the COMPLETE knob set measured best over the bucket's
+# four cells (B in {1, 4} x both directions; the first floor <= N wins; below the last floor the last entry serves).  Measured on the 212-SM Rubin
+# perf-node class (lock 2376 MHz, sampled 2364), with a control pair per cell, in three passes: a discovery pass varying one axis at a time over the
+# previous defaults, a verification pass with the composed table as the base re-measuring every alternative, and a table-of-record pass with the
+# refined table as the base.  An axis flips only where its alternative beat the base in every cell of the bucket by more than max(0.5 %, 2 x the
+# control-pair spread); the tile is the one with the smallest worst-case regret over the bucket when it beats the base tile by that margin.  Two
+# interactions the one-axis pass could not see came out of the verification pass: at c = 128 from N >= 512 the projection stage's pass-MAJOR order
+# wins +1.3..+1.5 % once the ring is 1 deep and the output prologue is the transpose form (interleaved had won +4 % standalone at the 2-deep ring),
+# and at N <= 128 the transpose prologue adds +3.1..+4.3 % on top of the 1-CTA tile (three of four cells decisive, the fourth +0.84 % under a 1.19 %
+# control spread -- adopted by judgment).
+#
+# The two substrate FORMS (the LayerNorm pass form and the epilogue arithmetic form; both bitwise the register / scalar rendering) were measured as
+# a separate pass on the two LayerNorm-prologue kernels STANDALONE (the projection stage K1 and the output stage K3, graph replay, 100-400 x 3,
+# control pair, every arm bitwise equal to the base) over N in {128, 217, 256, 384, 512, 768, 1024} x B in {1, 4} per width; the per-width signs:
+#   c = 256: the row RE-READ with ROLLED chunk loops (``ln_pass_form="smem_rolled"``) is the whole register-residency story -- K1 +178..+199 %
+#            and K3 +140..+146 % over the register form on every N >= 256 cell of both passes (K1 N = 512: 683 -> 234 us; the K = 256 renderings
+#            spilled 240 / 241 and 499 / 504 words per lane, the rolled form 0 / 0 at REG 112-114), and the packed epilogue ON TOP of it adds
+#            +1.4..+2.3 % (K1) / +0.4..+0.9 % (K3) more, outside every such cell's control spread -- although packed ALONE loses 1.1..2.9 % against
+#            the register form (the epilogue is not the binding stage until the spills are gone).  Every c = 256 pick: rolled + packed.
+#   c = 128: the packed epilogue (``epi_math="packed"``) wins or ties on every cell of both kernels (K1 +4.8..+37 %; K3 +2.0..+11.9 % with two
+#            neutral cells, +0.0 / -0.1 % at N 217 / 384 B = 1 on the second pass: no spills here, half the ALU issue of the gated epilogue); the
+#            rolled re-read form is a per-BUCKET sign on K1 (K3 runs the transpose prologue at c = 128, under which the substrate serves the
+#            register form only, so the knob reaches the projection stage alone): over the packed-only pick it is +3.7 / +3.7 % at N = 256 B = 1
+#            (-1.8 / -1.7 % at B = 4: the refinement below), +17.1 / +12.4 % at N = 384 B = 1 (the second pass at the 128-row tile the API runs
+#            there) and +9.7 / +2.1 % at B = 4, -1.8 / -1.4 % at N = 512 B = 1 (+0.7 / +0.7 % at B = 4: the second refinement below), +0.1 /
+#            +0.1 % at N = 768 (neutral: the register form stays) and +0.68 / +0.66 % at N = 1024 B = 1 (the 0.5 % threshold met only barely)
+#            with +1.3 % at B = 4 (both cells of the bucket, two passes: the rolled form), and a LOSS of 3.8 / 4.0 and 8.6 / 6.5 % at N = 217 /
+#            128 (three SMEM passes with nothing to buy) -- two passes on two nodes of the class, the same sign on every cell.  The unrolled re-read form
+#            ("smem") is not in the table: -4.5..-12.7 % at c = 128 and a third of the rolled form's gain at c = 256 (its normalise pass
+#            still spills half).
+#
+# The PIPELINED rolled form (`ln_pass_form="smem_rolled_pf"`: the rolled re-read with chunk (q + 1)'s loads carried one loop iteration ahead -- the same
+# words into the same additions in the same order, bitwise), measured STANDALONE on both LayerNorm-prologue kernels over the heuristics' complete pick
+# (graph replay, 100 x 3, control pair <= 0.4 %, every arm bitwise the pick, the 212-SM Rubin class at the 2376 lock; bias off AND on):
+#   c = 256: K1 +2.9 / +2.9 / +3.0 / +3.2 % (bias off) and +5.2 / +5.1 / +5.2 / +5.6 % (bias on) at N 512 x 1 / 384 x 1 / 256 x 4 / 1024 x 1, K3
+#            +32.3 / +30.2 / +32.5 / +33.5 % (bias off: the shipped rolled K3 rendering spills at REG 80 without the biases, 298 -> 226 us at N 512)
+#            and +21.9 / +20.2 / +21.9 / +22.5 % (bias on, no spill in either: 278 -> 228 us) -- every cell of every measured bucket, the same sign in
+#            both bias arms, outside 10x the control spread.  Every c = 256 pick: pipelined rolled + packed.
+#   c = 128: MIXED by cell and by bias arm on K1 (the only stage the knob reaches there; K3's transpose prologue keeps the register form): -1.4 % (off) /
+#            +0.6 % (on) at N 1024 x 1, +0.9 / +2.6 % at N 384 x 1, and -11 / -0.4 % against the REGISTER picks at N 512 x 1 and 256 x 4 (the register
+#            form + packed epilogue leads every rolled form there by 9-11 % without the biases) -- no bucket flips; the register / rolled picks stand.
+# The tree form (`"smem_rolled_tree"`: the pipelined form with four partial sums per statistics pass -- a different fp32 ORDER, LN_PASS_FORMS_REORDERED)
+# adds +0.2..+3.5 % on top (K3 c 256 +25.0..+25.3 % vs the pick with the biases, +32.5..+36.0 % without; K1 c 256 +5.3..+6.1 %) and is NEVER a pick of
+# this table: a caller's knob, reported with its oracle distance.
+#
+# The LayerNorm-ONCE work item (`ln_once="block"`: the row block's A operand(s) resident in SMEM across its passes x N tiles, LayerNormed once; the
+# per-tile B ring unchanged; bitwise the per-tile item), measured STANDALONE on both stages over the heuristics' complete pick (graph replay 300 x 3,
+# control pair <= 0.2 %, every arm bitwise the pick, the 212-SM Rubin class at the 2376 lock; bias off AND on; the busy clock sampled per cell, the
+# 1.0-1.5 %-under-the-lock windows read as LOWER bounds):
+#   c = 256: K1 +118 / +118 / +139 / +98 / +72 % (bias off) and +105 / +105 / +120 / +88 / +64 % (bias on) at N 512 x 1 / 256 x 4 / 1024 x 1 / 384 x 1 /
+#            256 x 1 (219 -> 101 us at 512 x 1 off); K3 +60 / +60 / +68 / +48 / +31 % (off) and +60 / +60 / +68 / +49 / +32 % (on) (223 -> 139 us) --
+#            every cell of every bucket, both bias arms, decisively; the small-N tail of the coarser item (256 x 1: 2.4 item-waves) costs less than the
+#            LayerNorm it removes.  Every c = 256 pick: ln_once="block" (the "passes" item, LN 4 -> 2 per block, takes roughly half the gain: K1 +46..+80 %).
+#   c = 128: K1 only (the output stage's one-tile item is the substrate's typed decline there), on the buckets whose pick is the pass-MAJOR order:
+#            +43 / +44 / +53 / +53 % (bias off) and +45 / +45 / +49 / +53 % (bias on) at N 512 x 1 / 256 x 4 / 1024 x 4 / 768 x 1 (65 -> 45 us at 512 x 1
+#            off; 1000 x 3, CLEAN windows) -> ln_once="block" on the 512 / 768 / 1024 floors and on the (256, B >= 4) refinement (whose order is major);
+#            the buckets picking the INTERLEAVED order (256 x 1, 384) cannot take the lever as is (the pass must live inside the item: a typed decline);
+#            their candidate ln_once="block" + the major order, measured against the interleaved pick WITH the major order alone as the control: K1
+#            standalone +16.7 / +15.0 % at 256 x 1, +30.4 / +32.4 % at 384 x 1, +44.5 / +41.9 % at 384 x 4 (bias off / on) where the major order alone
+#            reads -0.3..-2.6 % (the lever carries it); the whole call +8.1 / +8.1 % at 256 x 128 x 1 and +12.5 / +13.4 % at 384 x 128 x 1 -> the 256
+#            and 384 floors take ("major", ln_once="block"); the 129 and 0 floors (N < 256: 0.6-1.2 tile-waves at B 1, the coarser item most exposed)
+#            stay as shipped until measured.
+def _pick(
+    k2_tile: str,
+    k1_pass_order: str,
+    k3_prologue: str,
+    clc_stages: int,
+    ln_pass_form: str,
+    epi_math: str,
+    ln_once: str = "",
+    ln_once_b_stages: Optional[int] = None,
+) -> TriMulKnobs:
+    """One COMPLETE bucket pick in axis order (the row tile ``k_block`` is left to :func:`default_k_block`; the LayerNorm-once item ``ln_once`` is OFF
+    unless a bucket's A/B/A set it; ``ln_once_b_stages`` (appended) = the item's B-ring depth where a bucket's A/B/A set it, else the shipped ring)."""
+    return TriMulKnobs(
+        k2_tile=k2_tile,
+        k1_pass_order=k1_pass_order,
+        k3_prologue=k3_prologue,
+        clc_stages=clc_stages,
+        ln_pass_form=ln_pass_form,
+        epi_math=epi_math,
+        ln_once=ln_once,
+        ln_once_b_stages=ln_once_b_stages,
+    )
+
+
+# THE BIAS-PATH EPILOGUE FORM (`epi_math="packed_biasfold"`: the gate bias staged halved and folded into the tanh argument's fma, -16 FADD2 per
+# 32-channel subtile per lane on the renderings WITH biases; OUTPUT-BITWISE the packed form; byte-identical to it WITHOUT biases), measured as a
+# whole-call A/B/A on one exclusive GPU of the 212-SM Rubin perf-node class (lock 2376; in-process arm + control twins, slots shuffled, graph
+# replay >= 100 x 3, the arm bitwise the base on every cell, the fp64 oracle within its element budget).  Its sign follows the projection
+# stage's RENDERING, not N or B: a WIN wherever K1 runs the `registers` LayerNorm form (the epilogue-bound rendering), a LOSS of ~0.7 % wherever
+# K1 runs a rolled form -- so the pick below follows the LayerNorm form per (bucket, batch): the 768 bucket (both batches) and the 512 bucket
+# at B = 1 take the fold, the (512, B >= 4) refinement (rolled K1) keeps `packed`, the (256, B >= 4) refinement (register K1) takes the fold;
+# the 1024 and 384 buckets (rolled K1), the 256 bucket at B = 1 (interleaved rolled, neutral) and the unmeasured N < 256 buckets keep `packed`.
+# the fold vs the shipped pick (whole call, bias ON, one exclusive GPU of the 212-SM Rubin perf-node class): 512:128:1 +1.08 % outgoing / +0.98 % incoming, 768:128:1 +1.62 %, 256:128:4 +1.07 %, 768:128:4 +1.73 % (register-form K1: WIN); 1024:128:1 -0.68 %, 512:128:4 -0.68 %, 1024:128:4 -0.63 %, 384:128:4 -0.91 % (rolled-form K1: LOSS -- the CUPTI split puts it in K1, 260 -> 268 us at 1024:128:1, K3 gains 222 -> 218); 256:128:1 +0.06 %, 384:128:1 +0.23 % (interleaved: NEUTRAL); the 11 bias-OFF twins -0.12..+0.07 % (byte-identical renderings)
+# the hoisted-load half alone (packed_hoist) -0.16..+0.47 % everywhere: neutral
+_PICKS: Dict[int, Tuple[Tuple[int, TriMulKnobs], ...]] = {
+    128: (
+        (1024, _pick(k2.MULTICAST_A4_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "transpose", 1, "smem_rolled", "packed", ln_once="block")),
+        (768, _pick(k2.DESIGN_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "transpose", 1, "registers", "packed_biasfold", ln_once="block")),
+        (512, _pick(k2.MULTICAST_A2_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "transpose", 1, "registers", "packed_biasfold", ln_once="block")),
+        (384, _pick(k2.SMALL_N_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "transpose", 1, "smem_rolled", "packed", ln_once="block")),
+        (256, _pick(k2.DESIGN_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "transpose", 2, "smem_rolled", "packed", ln_once="block")),
+        (129, _pick(k2.DESIGN_TILE_CONFIG, "interleaved", "transpose", 1, "registers", "packed")),
+        (0, _pick(k2.SMALL_N_TILE_CONFIG, "interleaved", "transpose", 2, "registers", "packed")),
+    ),
+    256: (
+        (1024, _pick(k2.MULTICAST_A4_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "mn_major", 1, "smem_rolled_pf", "packed", ln_once="block")),
+        (768, _pick(k2.DESIGN_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "mn_major", 1, "smem_rolled_pf", "packed", ln_once="block")),
+        (512, _pick(k2.MULTICAST_A2_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "mn_major", 1, "smem_rolled_pf", "packed", ln_once="block")),
+        (384, _pick(k2.SMALL_N_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "mn_major", 1, "smem_rolled_pf", "packed", ln_once="block")),
+        (256, _pick(k2.DESIGN_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "mn_major", 1, "smem_rolled_pf", "packed", ln_once="block")),
+        (129, _pick(k2.DESIGN_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "mn_major", 1, "smem_rolled_pf", "packed", ln_once="block")),
+        (0, _pick(k2.SMALL_N_TILE_CONFIG, "major", "mn_major", 2, "smem_rolled_pf", "packed", ln_once="block")),
+    ),
+}
+
+# THE TABLE, part 2 -- the per-CELL refinements: (N floor of the bucket, batch bucket, direction or None = both) -> ONE axis of the bucket pick
+# overridden per row.  A refinement exists where one single-axis alternative beat the bucket pick DECISIVELY (> max(0.5 %, 2 x the control-pair
+# spread)) in that cell of the table-of-record pass AND with the same sign in every earlier pass that measured both knob sets, and whose gain
+# REPRODUCED when the refined table was measured as the base; the bucket keeps its pick where the other batch or direction lost.  Keys may repeat
+# across rows only for different axes (pinned by the tests).  Margins: +X % = t_bucket_pick / t_refined - 1 (the pass that found it; as the base).
+#   c = 128, N <= 128, B = 1, incoming:       ring depth 1   +1.87 % (as base +1.75 %; the outgoing twin -0.34 %, B = 4 -0.5..-0.6 %)
+#   c = 128, 256 <= N < 384, B >= 4:          ring depth 1   +1.95 / +1.87 % (as base +1.97 / +2.01 %; B = 1 loses 1.5 %), and ON TOP of it
+#                                             the REGISTER LN form: the rolled re-read form loses 1.8 / 1.7 % against the packed-only pick on

+    stage: str, channels: int, has_bias: bool, ln_pass_form: str, epi_math: str, pass_order: Optional[str] = None, ln_once: str = "", cc=None
+) -> int:
+    """The ``.minnctapersm`` hint a bare declaration hands the ``stage`` (``"k1"`` = the projection, ``"k3"`` = the output stage) rendering at this
+    hidden width, bias arm, LayerNorm / epilogue form, (K1) tile order and LayerNorm work item (``ln_once``; the stage's OWN item -- the output stage's
+    is ``""`` where the substrate declines a one-tile item): the MEASURED rows of :data:`_REGISTER_SPLIT_HINTS`, else 0 (the rendering as shipped;
+    every row names the per-tile item -- under the LayerNorm-once item the honoured split spills and the whole call runs faster unhinted).  A
+    caller's ``TriMulKnobs(min_blocks_per_mp=...)`` overrides it for both stages.  ``cc`` (appended) selects the column: the Rubin rows for 10.7 /
+    ``None``, :data:`_REGISTER_SPLIT_HINTS_SM100` (the rows measured on a GB200 for the SM100 column's own register-form renderings) for 10.0 / 10.3."""
+    if stage not in ("k1", "k3"):
+        raise ValueError(f"stage must be 'k1' or 'k3', got {stage!r}")
+    table = _REGISTER_SPLIT_HINTS if arch_column_for_cc(cc) == "sm107" else _REGISTER_SPLIT_HINTS_SM100
+    order = (str(pass_order) if pass_order is not None else None) if stage == "k1" else None
+    # the rows are keyed by RENDERING: the three packed epilogue forms differ only under `has_bias` and render ONE cubin without biases, so a
+    # bias-off lookup reads the family's row (`EPI_MATHS_PACKED`); a bias-on rendering is hinted only by a row naming its EXACT form
+    epm = "packed" if (not has_bias and str(epi_math) in EPI_MATHS_PACKED) else str(epi_math)
+    return table.get((stage, _nearest_width(channels), bool(has_bias), str(ln_pass_form), epm, order, str(ln_once or "")), 0)
+
+
+def recommend(n_res: int, channels: int = 128, batch: int = 1, direction: str = "outgoing", cc=None) -> TriMulKnobs:
+    """The measured default knob set for this geometry: the (width, N bucket) pick with the (batch bucket, direction) refinements applied, the
+    row tile from :func:`default_k_block` unless a pick or refinement sets it -- complete (every axis set).  ``cc`` (appended) selects the arch
+    column (:func:`arch_column_for_cc`: the SM100 column on compute capability 10.0 / 10.3, the Rubin table otherwise and for ``None``)."""
+    if direction not in k2.DIRECTIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"direction must be one of {k2.DIRECTIONS}, got {direction!r}")
+    n_res = int(n_res)
+    width = _nearest_width(channels)
+    column = arch_column_for_cc(cc)
+    floor, knobs = _bucket_floor(n_res, _PICKS_BY_ARCH[column][width])
+    bb = batch_bucket(batch)
+    for r_floor, r_batch, r_direction, override in _REFINEMENTS_BY_ARCH[column].get(width, ()):
+        if r_floor == floor and r_batch == bb and (r_direction is None or r_direction == direction):
+            knobs = override.merged_over(knobs)
+    if knobs.k_block is None:
+        knobs = replace(knobs, k_block=default_k_block(n_res))
+    return knobs
+
+
+def resolve(
+    n_res: int, channels: int, batch: int, direction: str, *, k2_tile: Optional[str] = None, knobs: Optional[TriMulKnobs] = None, cc=None
+) -> TriMulKnobs:
+    """The knob set a plan runs: :func:`recommend` for the geometry (and the device's ``cc``, appended), then the caller's ``knobs`` (its SET axes)
+    and ``k2_tile`` (one axis) over it -- always a complete record.  No validation here: ``check_support`` runs :func:`validate_knobs` so an
+    out-of-vocabulary name is a typed decline at the usual place (a ``knobs`` of the wrong type raises there too)."""
+    out = recommend(n_res, channels, batch, direction, cc=cc)
+    if knobs is not None and isinstance(knobs, TriMulKnobs):
+        out = knobs.merged_over(out)
+    elif knobs is not None:
+        return knobs  # not a TriMulKnobs: handed through for validate_knobs to raise the TypeError
+    if k2_tile is not None:
+        out = replace(out, k2_tile=str(k2_tile))
+    return out
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "BATCH_BUCKETS",
+    "arch_column_for_cc",
+    "CLC_STAGES_DOMAIN",
+    "DEFAULT_CLC_STAGES",
+    "DEFAULT_K1_PASS_ORDER",
+    "DEFAULT_K3_PROLOGUE",
+    "K2_TILE_DOMAIN",
+    "K_BLOCK_DOMAIN",
+    "LN_ONCE_B_STAGES_DOMAIN",
+    "MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP_DOMAIN",
+    "TriMulKnobs",
+    "batch_bucket",
+    "default_k_block",
+    "k2_tile_for",
+    "recommend",
+    "register_split_hint",
+    "resolve",
+    "validate_knobs",
+]

@@ -0,0 +1,234 @@
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""K2 -- the per-channel contraction of the triangle multiplicative update as ONE batched GEMM (batch = C * B, M = N = N_res, K = N_res).
+
+Per channel ``c`` (and batch entry ``b``) of the channel-major planes ``a``, ``b`` written by K1 (``[2, C, B * N, n_pad]``, bf16; the
+``[N, N]`` matrix of channel ``c`` / batch ``b`` sits at rows ``b * N ..`` with row stride ``n_pad``, the inner index padded to a
+multiple of 8 and the pad written as exact zeros):
+
+  outgoing   ``y[c][i, j] = sum_k a[c][i, k] * b[c][j, k]``   -> A = ``a[c]`` K-major, B = ``b[c]`` K-major  (the GEMM's TN form)
+  incoming   ``y[c][i, j] = sum_k a[c][k, i] * b[c][k, j]``   -> A = ``a[c]`` M-major, B = ``b[c]`` N-major  (MN-major operands)
+
+Both directions are the SAME storage read through different strides, so the graph below declares the operand majors on the tensor
+strides and the FROST GEMM engine's dense template serves either without a copy or a transpose kernel.  The output is the channel-major
+``y`` (``[C, B * N, n_pad]``, the ``j`` axis padded like the planes -- K3's ``y_shape``), accumulated in fp32.
+
+The channel and the batch fold into ONE uniform GEMM batch: block ``(c, b)`` is at element offset ``(c * B + b) * N * n_pad`` in every
+plane, so the kernel sees ``C * B`` batches of stride ``N * n_pad`` (:func:`contraction_geometry`).  The pad plays two roles:
+
+* **outgoing** -- the padded ``k`` axis is the GEMM's K.  Declaring ``K = n_pad`` is exact (the pad is zero in BOTH operands) and
+  satisfies the engine's TMA rule that a K-major operand's K extent is a multiple of 8 elements (16 bytes); ``M`` and ``N`` stay ``N_res``
+  (TMA zero-fills the loads and clips the stores past them).
+* **incoming** -- the contiguous axis of both operands is the ``i`` / ``j`` extent ``N_res`` itself (an M-major A, an N-major B), so the
+  same TMA rule needs ``N_res % 8 == 0``; :func:`incoming_supported` is the typed decline the API raises otherwise (a transposed-store
+  K1 arm lifts it later).
+
+The graph is a plain ``cudnn.pygraph`` matmul with a 3-D batch: it reaches the ``frost_gemm`` engine through the ordinary graph
+lifecycle, and :func:`cudnn.gemm.frost.compiler.jit_from_cudnn_graph` compiles it directly for a pinned tile config
+(:func:`tile_config_for`: the per-N pick of the measured prototype; :data:`DESIGN_TILE_CONFIG` where nothing was measured).  The
+kernel-order operand views the compiled instance takes are :func:`k2_operand_views` (planes) / :func:`kernel_operand_views` (dense).
+
+Byte / FLOP model (the roofline every measurement of this stage is read against): the compulsory traffic reads ``a`` and ``b`` once and
+writes ``y`` once -- :func:`contraction_bytes` = ``6 N^2 C`` at 2 B per element -- and :func:`contraction_flop` = ``2 C N^3``; the
+arithmetic intensity is ``N / 3`` FLOP per byte, so the stage is bandwidth-bound up to ``N ~ 3 x (peak FLOP/s) / (HBM B/s)``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional, Tuple
+
+DIRECTIONS = ("outgoing", "incoming")
+
+#: The default tile config of the contraction (DESIGN_TILE_CONFIG): a 2-CTA (cta_group::2) pair computing a 256 x 256 output tile (128 x 256
+#: per CTA), 128-byte K tiles (64 bf16 elements), cluster 2x1 (no operand multicast).  The small-N alternative is the 1-CTA 128 x 128 tile.
+DESIGN_TILE_CONFIG = "CONFIG_sm100_128x256x128_128x256x32_cluster2x1_2ctamma"
+SMALL_N_TILE_CONFIG = "CONFIG_sm100_128x128x128_128x128x32_cluster1x1_1ctamma"
+#: The 2-CTA 256x256 pair tile with the A operand multicast across 2 / 4 CTAs along the output's N axis (cluster 2x2 / 2x4).
+MULTICAST_A2_TILE_CONFIG = "CONFIG_sm100_128x256x128_128x256x32_cluster2x2_2ctamma"
+MULTICAST_A4_TILE_CONFIG = "CONFIG_sm100_128x256x128_128x256x32_cluster2x4_2ctamma"
+#: The 1-CTA 128 x 128 tile with the B operand multicast across the 2 CTAs of a cluster 2x1.
+SMALL_N_MULTICAST_B2_TILE_CONFIG = "CONFIG_sm100_128x128x128_128x128x32_cluster2x1_1ctamma"
+
+# The per-N tile picks live in ``cudnn.triangle_multiplicative_update.heuristics`` (the measured table, by hidden width and batch);
+# :func:`tile_config_for` reads them from there.
+
+#: A TMA-fed operand's CONTIGUOUS extent must be a multiple of 8 bf16 elements (16 bytes) -- the GEMM engine's rule; the planes' inner
+#: pad satisfies it for the outgoing direction, the incoming direction needs ``N_res`` itself to.
+CONTIGUOUS_EXTENT_MULTIPLE = 8
+
+_BF16_BYTES = 2
+
+
+def operand_majors(direction: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
+    """``(a_major, b_major)`` of the GEMM operands for one direction: ``("k", "k")`` outgoing, ``("m", "n")`` incoming."""
+    if direction not in DIRECTIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"direction must be one of {DIRECTIONS}, got {direction!r}")
+    return ("k", "k") if direction == "outgoing" else ("m", "n")
+
+
+def n_pad(n_res: int) -> int:
+    """The padded inner extent of the channel-major planes (a multiple of 8: a 16-byte-aligned TMA row stride) -- K1's rule."""
+    return -(-int(n_res) // CONTIGUOUS_EXTENT_MULTIPLE) * CONTIGUOUS_EXTENT_MULTIPLE
+
+
+def incoming_supported(n_res: int) -> bool:
+    """The incoming direction reads MN-major operands whose contiguous extent is ``N_res``: the TMA rule needs it to be a multiple of 8."""
+    return int(n_res) % CONTIGUOUS_EXTENT_MULTIPLE == 0
+
+
+def contraction_geometry(channels: int, batch: int, n_res: int) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """``(batch_count, block_stride, n_pad)`` of the folded GEMM batch over the planes: ``C * B`` blocks of ``N * n_pad`` elements."""
+    npd = n_pad(n_res)
+    return int(channels) * int(batch), int(n_res) * npd, npd
+
+
+def k_extent(n_res: int, direction: str) -> int:
+    """The GEMM's K extent: the padded ``n_pad`` for the outgoing direction (the pad is zero in both operands), ``N_res`` for incoming."""
+    operand_majors(direction)
+    return n_pad(n_res) if direction == "outgoing" else int(n_res)
+
+
+def operand_strides(n_res: int, direction: str, *, batch: int = 1, padded: bool = False) -> Tuple[Tuple[int, int, int], Tuple[int, int, int]]:
+    """The strides of the graph tensors ``A [C*B, M, K]`` and ``B [C*B, K, N]`` that spell the operand majors over the channel-major storage.
+
+    ``padded=False`` (the dense ``[C, N, N]`` planes of the prototype): block stride ``N^2``, row stride ``N``.  ``padded=True`` (K1's
+    planes): block stride ``N * n_pad``, row stride ``n_pad``.  ``batch`` only names the fold (the strides are per block either way)."""
+    a_major, b_major = operand_majors(direction)
+    n_res = int(n_res)
+    row = n_pad(n_res) if padded else n_res
+    block = n_res * row
+    a_stride = (block, row, 1) if a_major == "k" else (block, 1, row)
+    b_stride = (block, 1, row) if b_major == "k" else (block, row, 1)
+    return a_stride, b_stride
+
+
+def contraction_graph(cudnn_module, channels: int, n_res: int, direction: str, *, batch: int = 1, padded: bool = False, io_data_type=None):
+    """The batched-matmul graph of the contraction: ``A [C*B, N, K]`` and ``B [C*B, K, N]`` with the direction's strides, ``Y`` bf16.
+
+    ``cudnn_module`` is the imported ``cudnn`` package (passed in so this module stays import-cheap).  The io dtype defaults to bf16;
+    intermediate / compute dtypes are fp32.  ``padded=True`` declares K1's planes (``K = n_pad`` outgoing; incoming needs ``N % 8 == 0``).
+    Returns the graph; the operand tensors are its ``A`` / ``B`` names, the output ``Y``.
+    """
+    io = io_data_type if io_data_type is not None else cudnn_module.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    if padded and direction == "incoming" and not incoming_supported(n_res):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"the incoming contraction reads MN-major operands whose contiguous extent is N = {n_res}; the GEMM engine's TMA rule needs a "
+            f"multiple of {CONTIGUOUS_EXTENT_MULTIPLE} (16 bytes of bf16)"
+        )
+    g = cudnn_module.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn_module.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn_module.data_type.FLOAT)
+    a_stride, b_stride = operand_strides(n_res, direction, batch=batch, padded=padded)
+    k = k_extent(n_res, direction) if padded else int(n_res)
+    cb = int(channels) * int(batch)
+    a = g.tensor(name="A", dim=[cb, int(n_res), k], stride=list(a_stride))
+    b = g.tensor(name="B", dim=[cb, k, int(n_res)], stride=list(b_stride))
+    y = g.matmul(A=a, B=b, name="Y")
+    y.set_output(True)
+    return g
+
+
+def kernel_operand_views(a, b, direction: str):
+    """The operand views a compiled FROST instance of :func:`contraction_graph` takes, in kernel axis order (``A [batch, M, K]``,
+    ``B [batch, N, K]``) with the declared contiguity: the channel-major tensors as stored for the outgoing direction, their transposed
+    views (no copy) for the incoming one."""
+    operand_majors(direction)
+    if direction == "outgoing":
+        return a, b
+    return a.transpose(1, 2), b.transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def k2_slack_bytes(n_res: int, elem_bytes: int = _BF16_BYTES) -> int:
+    """Bytes the caller must keep readable right after the ``b`` plane: the outgoing GEMM at ``N % 8 != 0`` reads the ``B`` operand as
+    ``n_pad`` rows per block (:func:`k2_operand_views`), so the LAST block over-reads ``(n_pad - N) * n_pad`` elements past the plane."""
+    npd = n_pad(n_res)
+    return (npd - int(n_res)) * npd * elem_bytes
+
+
+def k2_operand_views(plane_a, plane_b, y, *, channels: int, batch: int, n_res: int, direction: str):
+    """The kernel-order views over K1's planes and K3's ``y`` (all ``[C, B * N, n_pad]`` contiguous): ``(A, B, Y)`` for the compiled instance.
+
+    ``A`` is ``[C*B, M = N, K]`` and ``B`` ``[C*B, N', K]`` with the direction's contiguity (outgoing: ``K = n_pad`` contiguous; incoming:
+    the transposed views, ``M`` / ``N`` contiguous), ``Y`` the ``[C*B, N, N']`` view of ``y`` with row stride ``n_pad``.  No copy, no allocation.
+
+    ``N' = n_pad`` for the outgoing direction (``N' = N`` where ``N % 8 == 0``): the engine stores its output in 16-byte vectors and needs the
+    output's contiguous extent to be a multiple of 8 elements, so the GEMM's N covers the padded columns -- ``B`` is read as ``n_pad`` ROWS
+    per block (the extra rows are the NEXT block's first rows, or the workspace slack after the last block: :func:`k2_slack_bytes`) and
+    their products land ONLY in the pad columns ``j in [N, n_pad)`` of ``y``, which K3 never consumes (its row statistics and stores cover
+    ``j < N``; its tests prove it with NaN-filled pad columns).  The valid output ``y[:, :, :N]`` is the exact contraction over ``K = n_pad``
+    (the pad is zero in both planes)."""
+    operand_majors(direction)
+    if direction == "incoming" and not incoming_supported(n_res):
+        raise ValueError(f"the incoming contraction needs N % {CONTIGUOUS_EXTENT_MULTIPLE} == 0, got N={n_res}")
+    cb, block, npd = contraction_geometry(channels, batch, n_res)
+    n_res = int(n_res)
+    a3 = plane_a.view(cb, n_res, npd)
+    if direction == "incoming":
+        b3 = plane_b.view(cb, n_res, npd)
+        y3 = y.view(cb, n_res, npd)  # n_pad == n_res here
+        return a3.transpose(1, 2), b3.transpose(1, 2), y3
+    y3 = y.view(cb, n_res, npd)
+    if npd == n_res:
+        return a3, plane_b.view(cb, n_res, npd), y3
+    flat = plane_b.view(-1)
+    need = (cb - 1) * block + npd * npd  # elements the over-read view spans from the plane's first element
+    room = flat.untyped_storage().nbytes() // flat.element_size() - flat.storage_offset()
+    if room < need:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"the outgoing contraction at N={n_res} reads the b plane as {npd} rows per block: its storage must extend k2_slack_bytes(N) = "
+            f"{k2_slack_bytes(n_res)} bytes past the plane (the API's workspace does; a standalone plane needs that slack allocated after it)"
+        )
+    b3 = flat.as_strided((cb, npd, npd), (block, npd, 1))  # n_pad rows per block: the over-read of the docstring
+    return a3, b3, y3
+
+
+def reference_views(a, b, direction: str):
+    """The ``(A, B)`` views such that ``y = A @ B`` (``torch.bmm``) is the contraction: outgoing ``(a, b^T)``, incoming ``(a^T, b)``."""
+    operand_majors(direction)
+    if direction == "outgoing":
+        return a, b.transpose(1, 2)
+    return a.transpose(1, 2), b
+
+
+def tile_config_for(n_res: int, override: Optional[str] = None, *, channels: int = 128, batch: int = 1, direction: str = "outgoing") -> str:
+    """The contraction's tile config name for ``(N_res, c, B, direction)``: the measured per-geometry pick of the heuristics table (keyed by
+    hidden width, N bucket, batch bucket and direction); ``override`` names a catalog config instead (a performance knob: every config computes
+    the same function; the API validates the name in ``check_support``)."""
+    if override is not None:
+        return str(override)
+    from ..heuristics import k2_tile_for
+
+    return k2_tile_for(int(n_res), int(channels), int(batch), direction)
+
+
+def contraction_bytes(channels: int, n_res: int, elem_bytes: int = _BF16_BYTES, *, batch: int = 1) -> int:
+    """Compulsory HBM traffic of the stage: ``a`` and ``b`` read once, ``y`` written once (``6 N^2 C`` at bf16, per batch entry)."""
+    return 3 * int(batch) * channels * n_res * n_res * elem_bytes
+
+
+def contraction_flop(channels: int, n_res: int, *, batch: int = 1) -> int:
+    """``2 C N^3`` multiply-adds counted as two FLOP each (per batch entry)."""
+    return 2 * int(batch) * channels * n_res**3
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "CONTIGUOUS_EXTENT_MULTIPLE",
+    "DESIGN_TILE_CONFIG",
+    "DIRECTIONS",
+    "MULTICAST_A2_TILE_CONFIG",
+    "MULTICAST_A4_TILE_CONFIG",
+    "SMALL_N_MULTICAST_B2_TILE_CONFIG",
+    "SMALL_N_TILE_CONFIG",
+    "contraction_bytes",
+    "contraction_flop",
+    "contraction_geometry",
+    "contraction_graph",
+    "incoming_supported",
+    "k2_operand_views",
+    "k2_slack_bytes",
+    "k_extent",
+    "kernel_operand_views",
+    "n_pad",
+    "operand_majors",
+    "operand_strides",
+    "reference_views",
+    "tile_config_for",
+]

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""K1 -- LayerNorm of the pair representation + the gated dual projections + the pair mask -> the channel-major planes ``a``, ``b``.
+
+For every pair row ``(b, i, k)`` of ``z`` (``[B, N, N, c_z]`` bf16) and each pass ``p`` in (``a``, ``b``)::
+
+    z_in      = LayerNorm_{c_z}(z[b, i, k, :]; norm_in_weight, norm_in_bias, eps)             fp32 statistics, bf16 operand
+    pass a    a[b, i, k, :] = sigmoid(z_in W_ag^T + b_ag) * (z_in W_ap^T + b_ap) * mask[b, i, k]
+    pass b    b[b, i, k, :] = sigmoid(z_in W_bg^T + b_bg) * (z_in W_bp^T + b_bp) * mask[b, i, k]
+
+stored CHANNEL-major as ``planes[p][c][b * N + i][k]`` with the ``k`` axis padded to a multiple of 8 (``n_pad``) -- the contract the
+contraction (K2, ``kernels.contraction``) consumes: per channel ``c`` and batch ``b`` the ``[N, N]`` matrix at rows ``b * N ..``
+with row stride ``n_pad``.  The per-row ``(mean, rstd)`` of the LayerNorm are written once for the backward.
+
+This module writes no kernel: it is the triangle multiplicative update's instance of the LayerNorm-prologue gated dual GEMM
+substrate ``cudnn.gemm.frost.ln_prologue`` (one persistent launch whose tile list is (pass, row block); the mask is
+applied in fp32 before the one bf16 rounding; a masked row is exactly ``+0.0``; a 256-row tile whose rows are all masked skips its
+MMA by a warp vote).  The weight convention is cuEquivariance's: ``p_in_weight, g_in_weight`` are ``[2 c, c_z]`` with rows
+``[a; b]`` -- :func:`stack_projection_weights` turns them into the substrate's ``[2, 2 c, c_z]`` interleaved stack ONCE (plan time).
+
+Traffic model (:func:`proj_bytes`): read ``z`` (2 B per pair-channel), write ``a`` and ``b`` (2 + 2 B per pair-channel), plus the
+mask (2 B per pair) and the statistics (8 B per pair); FLOPs (:func:`proj_flop`): ``2 * B N^2 * c_z * 4 c``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional, Tuple
+
+from cudnn.gemm.frost.ln_prologue import (
+    K_PAD_MULTIPLE,
+    LnDualGemmParams,
+    LnDualGemmPlan,
+    RowBlockGeometry,
+    build_ln_dual_gemm,
+    interleave_value_gate,
+    interleave_value_gate_bias,
+    row_block_geometry,
+    run_ln_dual_gemm,
+)
+
+#: The two projections (``a``, ``b``) are the substrate's two passes over one LayerNormed activation.
+PASSES = 2
+_BF16_BYTES = 2
+
+
+def proj_params(
+    c_z: int,
+    c: int,
+    *,
+    has_bias: bool,
+    has_mask: bool,
+    want_stats: bool = True,
+    skip_masked_tiles: bool = True,
+    eps: float = 1e-5,
+    clc_stages: Optional[int] = None,
+    diag: str = "",
+    pass_order: Optional[str] = None,
+    ln_pass_form: Optional[str] = None,
+    epi_math: Optional[str] = None,
+    min_blocks_per_mp: Optional[int] = None,
+    ln_once: Optional[str] = None,
+    ln_once_b_stages: Optional[int] = None,
+) -> LnDualGemmParams:
+    """The substrate's compile-time parameters for the ``(c_z, c)`` geometry (K = ``c_z``, ``c`` output channels per pass);
+    ``clc_stages``, ``pass_order``, ``ln_pass_form``, ``epi_math`` and ``min_blocks_per_mp`` (performance only, bitwise the same planes; the
+    last one is the launch's ``.minnctapersm`` hint under which ptxas honours the body's register split) default to the substrate's."""
+    kw = {} if clc_stages is None else {"clc_stages": int(clc_stages)}
+    if diag:
+        kw["diag"] = str(diag)
+    if pass_order is not None:
+        kw["pass_order"] = str(pass_order)
+    if ln_pass_form is not None:
+        kw["ln_pass_form"] = str(ln_pass_form)
+    if epi_math is not None:
+        kw["epi_math"] = str(epi_math)
+    if min_blocks_per_mp is not None:
+        kw["min_blocks_per_mp"] = (
+            min_blocks_per_mp if isinstance(min_blocks_per_mp, bool) else int(min_blocks_per_mp)
+        )  # a bool reaches the typed decline as itself
+    if ln_once is not None:
+        kw["ln_once"] = str(ln_once)
+    if ln_once_b_stages is not None:
+        kw["ln_once_b_stages"] = (
+            ln_once_b_stages if isinstance(ln_once_b_stages, bool) else int(ln_once_b_stages)
+        )  # the LN-once item's B-ring depth (appended; a bool reaches the typed decline as itself)  # the LayerNorm-once-per-row-block lever (performance only, bitwise; the substrate's typed vocabulary)
+    return LnDualGemmParams(
+        k=int(c_z),
+        c_out=int(c),
+        passes=PASSES,
+        has_bias=bool(has_bias),
+        want_stats=bool(want_stats),
+        has_mask=bool(has_mask),
+        skip_masked_tiles=bool(skip_masked_tiles),
+        eps=float(eps),
+        **kw,
+    )
+
+
+def n_pad(n_res: int) -> int:
+    """The padded ``k`` extent of the channel-major planes (a multiple of 8: a 16-byte-aligned TMA row stride)."""
+    return -(-int(n_res) // K_PAD_MULTIPLE) * K_PAD_MULTIPLE
+
+
+def planes_shape(c: int, batch: int, n_res: int) -> Tuple[int, int, int, int]:
+    """``[2, c, B * N, n_pad]`` -- the ``a`` / ``b`` workspace planes K1 writes and K2 reads."""
+    return (PASSES, int(c), int(batch) * int(n_res), n_pad(n_res))
+
+
+def plane_strides(batch: int, n_res: int) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """Per channel and batch, the ``[N, N]`` matrix ``plane[c][b * N + i][k]``: ``(channel, row i, col k)`` element strides
+    ``(B * N * n_pad, n_pad, 1)`` -- what the contraction graph declares over these planes (the batch ``b`` is a row offset)."""
+    npd = n_pad(n_res)
+    return (int(batch) * int(n_res) * npd, npd, 1)
+
+
+def stack_projection_weights(p_in_weight, g_in_weight):
+    """cuEquivariance's ``p_in_weight, g_in_weight`` (``[2 c, c_z]``, rows ``[a; b]``) -> the substrate's ``[2, 2 c, c_z]`` stack:
+    pass 0 = (W_ap, W_ag), pass 1 = (W_bp, W_bg), each interleaved per 128-channel block (``interleave_value_gate``).  A copy; plan time."""
+    import torch
+
+    if p_in_weight.shape != g_in_weight.shape or p_in_weight.ndim != 2 or p_in_weight.shape[0] % 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"p_in_weight / g_in_weight must both be [2 c, c_z], got {tuple(p_in_weight.shape)} and {tuple(g_in_weight.shape)}")
+    c = p_in_weight.shape[0] // 2
+    w_a = interleave_value_gate(p_in_weight[:c], g_in_weight[:c])
+    w_b = interleave_value_gate(p_in_weight[c:], g_in_weight[c:])
+    return torch.stack([w_a, w_b], dim=0).contiguous()
+
+
+def stack_projection_biases(p_in_bias, g_in_bias):
+    """The ``[2 c]`` biases (rows ``[a; b]``) in the ``[2, 2 c]`` interleaved order of :func:`stack_projection_weights`."""
+    import torch
+
+    if p_in_bias.shape != g_in_bias.shape or p_in_bias.ndim != 1 or p_in_bias.shape[0] % 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"p_in_bias / g_in_bias must both be [2 c], got {tuple(p_in_bias.shape)} and {tuple(g_in_bias.shape)}")
+    c = p_in_bias.shape[0] // 2
+    return torch.stack([interleave_value_gate_bias(p_in_bias[:c], g_in_bias[:c]), interleave_value_gate_bias(p_in_bias[c:], g_in_bias[c:])], dim=0).contiguous()
+
+
+def build_trimul_proj(params: LnDualGemmParams, arch: str = "sm107") -> LnDualGemmPlan:
+    """Compile (cached per (params, arch)) -- shapes are runtime.  ``arch`` names the substrate's rendered body (``"sm107"`` Rubin, ``"sm100"``
+    Blackwell; ``cudnn.gemm.frost.ln_prologue.body_arch_for_cc`` picks it from the device's compute capability)."""
+    if params.passes != PASSES:
+        raise ValueError(f"the triangle multiplicative update's K1 has exactly {PASSES} passes (a, b), got params.passes={params.passes}")
+    return build_ln_dual_gemm(params, arch)
+
+
+def run_trimul_proj(
+    plan: LnDualGemmPlan,
+    z,  # [B, N, N, c_z] bf16 contiguous
+    w_stacked,  # [2, 2 c, c_z] bf16 from stack_projection_weights
+    planes,  # [2, c, B * N, n_pad] bf16 contiguous (planes_shape)
+    norm_in_weight,  # [c_z] bf16
+    norm_in_bias,  # [c_z] bf16
+    *,
+    bias_stacked=None,  # [2, 2 c] bf16 from stack_projection_biases, iff params.has_bias
+    mask=None,  # [B, N, N] bf16 pair mask, iff params.has_mask
+    stats=None,  # [B * N * N, 2] fp32 (mean, rstd), iff params.want_stats
+    stream,
+    k_block=None,  # k's per 256-row pair tile (the substrate's rule when None; a performance knob, bitwise the same planes)
+) -> RowBlockGeometry:
+    """Launch K1.  No allocation, no conversion (the mask must already be bf16 ``[B, N, N]``; the planes are the caller's workspace)."""
+    if z.ndim != 4 or z.shape[1] != z.shape[2]:
+        raise ValueError(f"z must be [B, N, N, c_z], got {tuple(z.shape)}")
+    batch, n_res, _, c_z = (int(s) for s in z.shape)
+    if c_z != plan.params.k:
+        raise ValueError(f"z has c_z={c_z} but the plan was compiled for K={plan.params.k}")
+    if mask is not None and tuple(mask.shape) != (batch, n_res, n_res):
+        raise ValueError(f"mask must be [B, N, N] = {(batch, n_res, n_res)}, got {tuple(mask.shape)}")
+    return run_ln_dual_gemm(
+        plan,
+        z.view(batch * n_res * n_res, c_z),
+        w_stacked,
+        planes,
+        norm_in_weight,
+        norm_in_bias,
+        n_res=n_res,
+        bn=batch * n_res,
+        bias=bias_stacked,
+        mask=mask.reshape(-1) if mask is not None else None,
+        stats=stats,
+        stream=stream,
+        k_block=k_block,
+    )
+
+
+def proj_bytes(c_z: int, c: int, batch: int, n_res: int, *, with_mask: bool = True, with_stats: bool = True) -> int:
+    """Compulsory HBM traffic of K1: read ``z`` once, write ``a`` and ``b`` once (bf16), plus the mask read and the statistics write."""
+    pairs = int(batch) * int(n_res) ** 2
+    total = pairs * (int(c_z) * _BF16_BYTES + 2 * int(c) * _BF16_BYTES)
+    if with_mask:
+        total += pairs * _BF16_BYTES
+    if with_stats:
+        total += pairs * 8
+    return total
+
+
+def proj_flop(c_z: int, c: int, batch: int, n_res: int) -> int:
+    """``2 * (B N^2) * c_z * (4 c)`` -- two passes of a ``[rows, c_z] x [c_z, 2 c]`` GEMM."""
+    return 2 * int(batch) * int(n_res) ** 2 * int(c_z) * 4 * int(c)
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "PASSES",
+    "LnDualGemmParams",
+    "LnDualGemmPlan",
+    "RowBlockGeometry",
+    "build_trimul_proj",
+    "n_pad",
+    "plane_strides",
+    "planes_shape",
+    "proj_bytes",
+    "proj_flop",
+    "proj_params",
+    "row_block_geometry",
+    "run_trimul_proj",
+    "stack_projection_biases",
+    "stack_projection_weights",
+]

+"""K3 -- LayerNorm of the contraction output ``y`` (over the channel), LayerNorm of the pair representation ``z`` (recomputed, the K1 operand),
+the dual GEMM (output projection of ``u = LN(y)`` ‖ output gate of ``z_in = LN(z)``), sigmoid * mul -> the pair-major update.
+
+For every pair row ``(b, i, j)`` (the contraction wrote ``y`` CHANNEL-major, ``y[c][b * N + i][j]``, with the ``j`` axis padded like K1's planes)::
+
+    u      = LayerNorm_c(y[:, b N + i, j]; norm_out_weight, norm_out_bias, eps)      fp32 statistics, bf16 operand   (MN-major rows)
+    z_in   = LayerNorm_{c_z}(z[b, i, j, :]; norm_in_weight, norm_in_bias, eps)        the same arithmetic as K1       (K-major rows)
+    out[b, i, j, :] = bf16( sigmoid(z_in W_g^T + b_g) * (u W_o^T + b_o) )             pair-major [B, N, N, c_z]; the caller adds the residual
+
+(AlphaFold 3 Algorithm 12 / 13 steps 5-6; cuEquivariance's ``p_out_weight`` [c_z, c], ``g_out_weight`` [c_z, c_z], optional biases.)  The
+output is not masked -- the pair mask acted on ``a`` and ``b`` inside K1 and is already inside ``y``.  The per-row ``(mean, rstd)`` of ``u``
+(LayerNorm 2) are written once for the backward (K1 wrote LayerNorm 1's).
+
+This module writes no kernel: it is the triangle multiplicative update's SECOND instance of the LayerNorm-prologue dual GEMM substrate
+``cudnn.gemm.frost.ln_prologue`` -- the ``pairing = "accumulators"`` arm (two GEMMs of N = c_z, the value from the MN-major ``y`` operand,
+the gate from the K-major ``z`` operand, the pairing across the two accumulators, a pair-major store); K1 is the ``"columns"`` arm of the same
+body.  Two NUMERICS MODES -- op attributes, never performance knobs (they change the function, so no heuristic or autotuner sets them; both OFF):
+``affine_fold`` (gamma_out / beta_out folded into ``W_o`` / ``b_o`` on the host by :func:`cudnn.gemm.frost.ln_prologue.fold_output_affine`; the
+kernel's LayerNorm 2 is the pure ``(y - mean) * rstd``; a second bf16 rounding of the weights and the bias, measured ~2.3x the unfolded max-abs
+error) and ``fuse_residual`` (``out = bf16(z + update)`` in one rounding -- the fused block form; the cuEquivariance-signature API rounds twice
+like the reference).  Performance knobs (the same function, bitwise, under every value): ``a0_prologue`` (``"mn_major"`` normalises ``y`` in
+its MN-major SMEM layout; ``"transpose"`` writes the normalised row K-major -- the fallback form), ``clc_stages``, ``prefetch_a_l2`` (a measured
+dead end, kept as the control of that experiment).
+
+Traffic model (:func:`tail_bytes`): read ``y`` (2 B per pair-channel) and ``z`` (2 B), write the update (2 B), plus the statistics (8 B per
+pair); FLOPs (:func:`tail_flop`): ``2 * B N^2 * (c * c_z + c_z * c_z)``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional, Tuple
+
+from cudnn.gemm.frost.ln_prologue import (
+    K_PAD_MULTIPLE,
+    MIN_N_RES_MN_MAJOR,
+    LnDualGemmParams,
+    LnDualGemmPlan,
+    RowBlockGeometry,
+    build_ln_dual_gemm,
+    fold_output_affine,
+    interleave_value_gate_bias,
+    row_block_geometry,
+    run_ln_dual_gemm_tail,
+)
+
+_BF16_BYTES = 2
+
+
+def tail_params(
+    c_z: int,
+    c: int,
+    *,
+    has_bias: bool,
+    want_stats: bool = True,
+    a0_prologue: str = "mn_major",
+    affine_fold: bool = False,
+    fuse_residual: bool = False,
+    prefetch_a_l2: bool = False,
+    eps: float = 1e-5,
+    clc_stages: Optional[int] = None,
+    diag: str = "",
+    ln_pass_form: Optional[str] = None,
+    epi_math: Optional[str] = None,
+    min_blocks_per_mp: Optional[int] = None,
+    ln_once: Optional[str] = None,
+    ln_once_b_stages: Optional[int] = None,
+) -> LnDualGemmParams:
+    """The substrate's compile-time parameters of K3 for the ``(c_z, c)`` geometry.  Both GEMMs share one K (the ring stage is one k-tile of
+    every operand), so ``c == c_z`` for now -- the Protenix-v2 ``c_z = 256, c = 128`` geometry is a typed decline until the per-GEMM k-tile
+    count lands.  ``ln_pass_form`` / ``epi_math`` / ``min_blocks_per_mp`` (performance only, bitwise the same output; the last one is the
+    launch's ``.minnctapersm`` hint under which ptxas honours the body's register split) default to the substrate's."""
+    if int(c) != int(c_z):
+        raise ValueError(f"K3 on the substrate needs c == c_z (one K for the value GEMM over y and the gate GEMM over z), got c={c}, c_z={c_z}")
+    kw = {} if clc_stages is None else {"clc_stages": int(clc_stages)}
+    if diag:
+        kw["diag"] = str(diag)
+    if ln_pass_form is not None:
+        kw["ln_pass_form"] = str(ln_pass_form)
+    if epi_math is not None:
+        kw["epi_math"] = str(epi_math)
+    if min_blocks_per_mp is not None:
+        kw["min_blocks_per_mp"] = (
+            min_blocks_per_mp if isinstance(min_blocks_per_mp, bool) else int(min_blocks_per_mp)
+        )  # a bool reaches the typed decline as itself
+    if ln_once is not None:
+        kw["ln_once"] = str(ln_once)
+    if ln_once_b_stages is not None:
+        kw["ln_once_b_stages"] = (
+            ln_once_b_stages if isinstance(ln_once_b_stages, bool) else int(ln_once_b_stages)
+        )  # the LN-once item's B-ring depth (appended; a bool reaches the typed decline as itself)  # the LayerNorm-once-per-row-block lever (performance only, bitwise; the substrate's typed vocabulary)
+    return LnDualGemmParams(
+        k=int(c),
+        c_out=int(c_z),
+        passes=1,
+        has_bias=bool(has_bias),
+        want_stats=bool(want_stats),
+        has_mask=False,
+        skip_masked_tiles=False,
+        eps=float(eps),
+        pairing="accumulators",
+        a0_major="mn",
+        a0_prologue=str(a0_prologue),
+        affine_fold=bool(affine_fold),
+        fuse_residual=bool(fuse_residual),
+        prefetch_a_l2=bool(prefetch_a_l2),
+        **kw,
+    )
+
+
+def n_pad(n_res: int) -> int:
+    """The padded inner extent of the channel-major ``y`` (the same rule as K1's planes: a multiple of 8)."""
+    return -(-int(n_res) // K_PAD_MULTIPLE) * K_PAD_MULTIPLE
+
+
+def y_shape(c: int, batch: int, n_res: int) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """``[c, B * N, n_pad]`` -- the channel-major contraction output K3 reads (K2's output has the planes' row geometry)."""
+    return (int(c), int(batch) * int(n_res), n_pad(n_res))
+
+
+def stack_tail_biases(p_out_bias, g_out_bias):
+    """cuEquivariance's ``p_out_bias``, ``g_out_bias`` (``[c_z]``) -> the substrate's interleaved ``[2 c_z]`` (value block, gate block per 128)."""
+    return interleave_value_gate_bias(p_out_bias, g_out_bias).contiguous()
+
+
+def fold_tail_affine(p_out_weight, p_out_bias, norm_out_weight, norm_out_bias):
+    """``affine_fold``: the folded ``(W_o', b_o')`` (bf16) for ``tail_params(..., affine_fold=True)``; ``p_out_bias`` may be None
+    (the fold then yields the bias ``W_o beta_out`` alone, which the artifact must take with ``has_bias=True``)."""
+    return fold_output_affine(p_out_weight, p_out_bias, norm_out_weight, norm_out_bias)
+
+
+def build_trimul_tail(params: LnDualGemmParams, arch: str = "sm107") -> LnDualGemmPlan:
+    """Compile (cached per (params, arch)) -- shapes are runtime.  ``arch`` names the substrate's rendered body (``"sm107"`` Rubin, ``"sm100"``
+    Blackwell; ``cudnn.gemm.frost.ln_prologue.body_arch_for_cc`` picks it from the device's compute capability)."""
+    if not params.dual:
+        raise ValueError("the triangle multiplicative update's K3 is the accumulators arm of the substrate; build it from tail_params(...)")
+    return build_ln_dual_gemm(params, arch)
+
+
+def run_trimul_tail(
+    plan: LnDualGemmPlan,
+    y,  # [c, B * N, n_pad] bf16 contiguous (channel-major; y_shape)
+    z,  # [B, N, N, c_z] bf16 contiguous
+    p_out_weight,  # [c_z, c] bf16 (cuEquivariance's convention; the FOLDED W_o' under affine_fold)
+    g_out_weight,  # [c_z, c_z] bf16
+    out,  # [B, N, N, c_z] bf16 contiguous -- the update (the caller adds the residual unless fuse_residual)
+    norm_out_weight,  # [c] bf16 (LayerNorm 2; bound but ignored by the kernel under affine_fold)
+    norm_out_bias,  # [c] bf16
+    norm_in_weight,  # [c_z] bf16 (LayerNorm 1, as K1)
+    norm_in_bias,  # [c_z] bf16
+    *,
+    biases=None,  # [2 c_z] bf16 from stack_tail_biases, iff params.has_bias
+    stats=None,  # [B * N * N, 2] fp32 (mean, rstd) of LayerNorm 2, iff params.want_stats
+    residual=None,  # [B, N, N, c_z] bf16, iff params.fuse_residual (normally z itself)
+    stream,
+    k_block=None,  # k's per 256-row pair tile (the substrate's rule when None; >= 64 here -- the MN-major box; bitwise the same output)
+) -> RowBlockGeometry:
+    """Launch K3.  No allocation, no conversion."""
+    if z.ndim != 4 or z.shape[1] != z.shape[2]:
+        raise ValueError(f"z must be [B, N, N, c_z], got {tuple(z.shape)}")
+    batch, n_res, _, c_z = (int(s) for s in z.shape)
+    if c_z != plan.params.c_out or plan.params.k != c_z:
+        raise ValueError(f"z has c_z={c_z} but the plan was compiled for c_out={plan.params.c_out}, K={plan.params.k}")
+    if n_res < MIN_N_RES_MN_MAJOR:
+        raise ValueError(f"K3 needs N >= {MIN_N_RES_MN_MAJOR} (the MN-major 64-row TMA box of one pair row block), got N={n_res}")
+    if tuple(y.shape) != y_shape(plan.params.k, batch, n_res):
+        raise ValueError(f"y must be {y_shape(plan.params.k, batch, n_res)} (channel-major, inner index padded), got {tuple(y.shape)}")
+    if tuple(out.shape) != (batch, n_res, n_res, c_z):
+        raise ValueError(f"out must be [B, N, N, c_z] = {(batch, n_res, n_res, c_z)}, got {tuple(out.shape)}")
+    if residual is not None and tuple(residual.shape) != (batch, n_res, n_res, c_z):
+        raise ValueError(f"residual must be [B, N, N, c_z] = {(batch, n_res, n_res, c_z)}, got {tuple(residual.shape)}")
+    rows = batch * n_res * n_res
+    return run_ln_dual_gemm_tail(
+        plan,
+        y,
+        z.view(rows, c_z),
+        p_out_weight,
+        g_out_weight,
+        out.view(rows, c_z),
+        norm_out_weight,
+        norm_out_bias,
+        norm_in_weight,
+        norm_in_bias,
+        n_res=n_res,
+        bn=batch * n_res,
+        bias=biases,
+        stats=stats,
+        residual=residual.view(rows, c_z) if residual is not None else None,
+        stream=stream,
+        k_block=k_block,
+    )
+
+
+def tail_bytes(c_z: int, c: int, batch: int, n_res: int, *, with_stats: bool = True) -> int:
+    """Compulsory HBM traffic of K3: read ``y`` and ``z`` once, write the update once (bf16), plus the statistics write."""
+    pairs = int(batch) * int(n_res) ** 2
+    total = pairs * (int(c) * _BF16_BYTES + 2 * int(c_z) * _BF16_BYTES)
+    if with_stats:
+        total += pairs * 8
+    return total
+
+
+def tail_flop(c_z: int, c: int, batch: int, n_res: int) -> int:
+    """``2 * (B N^2) * (c c_z + c_z c_z)`` -- the value GEMM over ``y`` and the gate GEMM over ``z``."""
+    return 2 * int(batch) * int(n_res) ** 2 * (int(c) * int(c_z) + int(c_z) * int(c_z))
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "LnDualGemmParams",
+    "LnDualGemmPlan",
+    "MIN_N_RES_MN_MAJOR",
+    "RowBlockGeometry",
+    "build_trimul_tail",
+    "fold_tail_affine",
+    "n_pad",
+    "row_block_geometry",
+    "run_trimul_tail",
+    "stack_tail_biases",
+    "tail_bytes",
+    "tail_flop",
+    "tail_params",
+    "y_shape",
+]

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""fp64 reference of the triangle multiplicative update (AlphaFold 3 Algorithms 12 / 13), cuEquivariance's parameter convention.
+
+For a pair representation ``x`` of shape ``[B, N, N, c_z]`` (``[N, N, c_z]`` is read as ``B = 1``), ``direction`` in
+``("outgoing", "incoming")`` and an optional pair mask ``m`` of shape ``[B, N, N]`` (``None`` = all valid)::
+

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Example 00: gated attention block, TRAINING forward (``save_for_backward=True``).
+
+One ``GatedAttentionBlockFwd`` runs the whole sub-layer -- QKV + GATE projection,
+QK-RMSNorm + partial RoPE, causal GQA SDPA, sigmoid gate, out projection -- and,
+declared with ``save_for_backward=True``, writes every tensor the backward needs
+into a caller-owned ``SavedForBackward`` record instead of its workspace: the
+projection GEMM writes ``saved.proj_slab``, the SDPA writes the PRE-gate
+``saved.o`` and ``saved.lse``, norm + RoPE writes ``saved.rstd_q`` / ``rstd_k``.
+``saved_slab_views`` spells the slab's four column bands (``q_pre``, ``gate``,
+``k_pre``, ``v``) as zero-copy ``[B, S, heads, D]`` views.  This is the
+``proj_slab`` save mode (the declaration default); ``saved_gate_copy=True``
+keeps the slab in the workspace and copies the GATE band into a compact
+``saved.gate`` instead.
+
+Self-checks, torch fp32 math on the record alone: ``proj_slab`` is ``h @ W_qkvg^T``;
+``rstd_q`` / ``rstd_k`` are the RMSNorm statistics of the PRE-norm ``q_pre`` /
+``k_pre`` bands; ``out`` is ``(o * sigmoid(gate)) @ W_o^T``, i.e. ``saved.o`` is
+the pre-gate attention output and ``gate`` the GATE band the block gated with.
+
+Rubin (compute capability 10.7) only; prints SKIP on any other device.  The
+block's two projections ride the opt-in FROST GEMM engine, so
+``CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`` must be in the environment before
+``import cudnn`` (set below if unset).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+os.environ.setdefault("CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES", "1")  # opt-in FROST engines; read at `import cudnn`
+
+import torch  # noqa: E402
+
+from cudnn.gated_attention_block import GatedAttentionBlockFwd, GatedAttentionBlockGeometry, SavedForBackward, saved_slab_views  # noqa: E402
+
+_RUBIN = (10, 7)
+
+
+def _rope_tables(batch: int, seq_len: int, rope_dim: int, *, base: float = 1_000_000.0, device, dtype):
+    """``cos, sin`` of shape ``[B, S, rope_dim]`` in the rotate-half convention (the two halves duplicated) --
+    what HF ``apply_rotary_pos_emb`` and vLLM's ``RotaryEmbedding`` hand a RoPE kernel."""
+    inv_freq = 1.0 / (base ** (torch.arange(0, rope_dim, 2, device=device, dtype=torch.float32) / rope_dim))
+    freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(seq_len, device=device, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)  # [S, rope_dim // 2]
+    emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1).expand(batch, seq_len, rope_dim)
+    return emb.cos().to(dtype).contiguous(), emb.sin().to(dtype).contiguous()
+
+
+def _rel_err(got: torch.Tensor, ref: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    got, ref = got.float().flatten(), ref.float().flatten()
+    return ((got - ref).norm() / ref.norm().clamp_min(1e-12)).item()
+
+
+def main(batch: int = 1, seq_len: int = 512) -> None:
+    cc = tuple(torch.cuda.get_device_capability()) if torch.cuda.is_available() else None
+    if cc != _RUBIN:
+        print(f"[00] SKIP  gated attention block training forward: needs Rubin (compute capability 10.7), found {cc}")
+        return
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    dev, dtype = torch.device("cuda"), torch.bfloat16
+    geom = GatedAttentionBlockGeometry(d_model=512, h_q=8, h_kv=2, d_head=256, rope_dim=64)  # causal, QK-norm on (the defaults)
+    B, S, T = batch, seq_len, batch * seq_len
+
+    # Inputs in the block's declared layouts: nn.Linear-shaped weights ([out, in]); W_qkvg's column blocks are Q | GATE | K | V.
+    h = torch.randn(B, S, geom.d_model, device=dev).to(dtype)
+    w_qkvg = (torch.randn(geom.n_qkvg, geom.d_model, device=dev) * 0.02).to(dtype)
+    w_o = (torch.randn(geom.d_model, geom.h_q * geom.d_head, device=dev) * 0.02).to(dtype)
+    w_q_norm = torch.ones(geom.d_head, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+    w_k_norm = torch.ones(geom.d_head, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+    cos, sin = _rope_tables(B, S, geom.rope_dim, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+    out = torch.empty(B, S, geom.d_model, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+
+    # Declare the TRAINING forward, compile once, size the workspace (no slab and no O in it: the record holds them).
+    blk = GatedAttentionBlockFwd(h, w_qkvg, w_q_norm, w_k_norm, cos, sin, w_o, out, geom, save_for_backward=True)
+    try:
+        blk.check_support()  # a typed decline (an engine or feature this device / build does not serve) is a SKIP, not a failure
+    except NotImplementedError as exc:
+        print(f"[00] SKIP  gated attention block training forward: declined by check_support(): {exc}")
+        return
+    blk.compile()
+    workspace = torch.empty(blk.get_workspace_size(), dtype=torch.uint8, device=dev)
+
+    # The caller-owned record.  The projection GEMM writes proj_slab; q_pre / gate / k_pre / v are its column bands.
+    proj_slab = torch.empty(T, geom.n_qkvg, dtype=dtype, device=dev)  # [B*S, n_qkvg], contiguous
+    q_pre, gate, k_pre, v = saved_slab_views(proj_slab, geom, B, S)
+    saved = SavedForBackward(
+        h=h,  # the SAME tensor execute() runs on (verified)
+        gate=gate,  # views of proj_slab -- or None, and the backward derives them from the slab
+        q_pre=q_pre,
+        k_pre=k_pre,
+        o=torch.empty(B, S, geom.h_q, geom.d_head, dtype=dtype, device=dev),  # PRE-gate attention output, compact
+        lse=torch.empty(B, geom.h_q, S, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev),  # natural-log softmax stats
+        rstd_q=torch.empty(B, S, geom.h_q, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev),  # RMSNorm 1/rms per head (None iff qk_norm=False)
+        rstd_k=torch.empty(B, S, geom.h_kv, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev),
+        proj_slab=proj_slab,
+        seq_lens=None,  # dense forward; under padding, the very tensor passed to execute(seq_lens=)
+    )
+    blk.execute(h, w_qkvg, w_q_norm, w_k_norm, cos, sin, w_o, out, workspace, saved=saved)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    mib = lambda t: t.numel() * t.element_size() / 2**20  # noqa: E731
+    print(f"[00] out {tuple(out.shape)} {out.dtype}   workspace {mib(workspace):.1f} MiB   saved.proj_slab {tuple(proj_slab.shape)} ({mib(proj_slab):.1f} MiB)")
+    for name, t in (("q_pre", q_pre), ("gate", gate), ("k_pre", k_pre), ("v", v)):
+        print(f"[00]   saved_slab_views -> {name:6s} {str(tuple(t.shape)):18s} strides {tuple(t.stride())}   (a view of proj_slab)")
+    for name in ("o", "lse", "rstd_q", "rstd_k"):
+        t = getattr(saved, name)
+        print(f"[00]   saved.{name:7s} {str(tuple(t.shape)):18s} {t.dtype}")
+
+    # Self-checks against torch (fp32 math), on the record alone.
+    e_slab = _rel_err(proj_slab, h.view(T, geom.d_model).float() @ w_qkvg.float().T)
+    assert e_slab < 1e-2, f"proj_slab vs h @ W_qkvg^T: rel err {e_slab:.3g}"
+    e_rq = _rel_err(saved.rstd_q, torch.rsqrt(q_pre.float().pow(2).mean(-1) + geom.qk_norm_eps))  # rstd of the PRE-norm band
+    e_rk = _rel_err(saved.rstd_k, torch.rsqrt(k_pre.float().pow(2).mean(-1) + geom.qk_norm_eps))
+    assert max(e_rq, e_rk) < 1e-2, f"rstd vs rsqrt(mean(pre^2) + eps): rel err {e_rq:.3g} / {e_rk:.3g}"
+    assert torch.isfinite(saved.lse).all() and torch.isfinite(saved.o.float()).all()
+    o_gated = saved.o.float() * torch.sigmoid(gate.float())  # saved.o is PRE-gate; the gated O lands in the workspace
+    e_out = _rel_err(out, o_gated.reshape(T, geom.h_q * geom.d_head) @ w_o.float().T)
+    assert e_out < 2e-2, f"out vs (o * sigmoid(gate)) @ W_o^T: rel err {e_out:.3g}"
+    print(
+        f"[00] PASS  training forward  B={B} S={S} h_q={geom.h_q} h_kv={geom.h_kv} d_head={geom.d_head} d_model={geom.d_model}  "
+        f"(slab rel {e_slab:.1e}, rstd rel {max(e_rq, e_rk):.1e}, out rel {e_out:.1e})"
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
