+def _mxfp8_graph(b=4, hq=8, hk=2, sq=1, skv=2048, d=128, dv=128, bshd=True, stats=False, sink=False, unaligned_k=False):
+    """A dense graph.sdpa_mxfp8 forward declared as test/python/sdpa/mxfp8.py declares it (BSHD or BHSD strides)."""
+    ceil_div = lambda a, m: -(-a // m)  # noqa: E731
+    itype = cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3
+    g = pygraph(io_data_type=itype, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    d_scale_pad = ceil_div(ceil_div(d, 32), 4) * 4
+    dv_pad = ceil_div(dv, 128) * 128
+    s_q_pad, s_kv_pad, s_kv_scale_pad = ceil_div(sq, 128) * 128, ceil_div(skv, 128) * 128, ceil_div(ceil_div(skv, 32), 4) * 4
+
+    def sf(dims, name):
+        return g.tensor(
+            dim=dims,
+            stride=(dims[1] * dims[2] * dims[3], dims[2] * dims[3], dims[3], 1),
+            data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0,
+            reordering_type=cudnn.tensor_reordering.F8_128x4,
+            name=name,
+        )
+
+    q_stride = (sq * hq * d, d, hq * d, 1) if bshd else (hq * sq * d, sq * d, d, 1)
+    o_stride = (sq * hq * dv, dv, hq * dv, 1) if bshd else (hq * sq * dv, sq * dv, dv, 1)
+    k_stride = (skv * hk * d, d, hk * d, 1) if bshd else (hk * skv * d, skv * d, d, 1)
+    if unaligned_k:
+        k_stride = (hk * skv * (d + 1), skv * (d + 1), d + 1, 1)
+    v_stride = (skv * hk * dv, dv, hk * dv, 1) if bshd else (hk * skv * dv, skv * dv, dv, 1)
+    q = g.tensor(dim=(b, hq, sq, d), stride=q_stride, data_type=itype, name="q")
+    k = g.tensor(dim=(b, hk, skv, d), stride=k_stride, data_type=itype, name="k")
+    v = g.tensor(dim=(b, hk, skv, dv), stride=v_stride, data_type=itype, name="v")
+    kw = dict(
+        q=q,
+        k=k,
+        v=v,
+        descale_q=sf((b, hq, s_q_pad, d_scale_pad), "sf_q"),
+        descale_k=sf((b, hk, s_kv_pad, d_scale_pad), "sf_k"),
+        descale_v=sf((b, hk, s_kv_scale_pad, dv_pad), "sf_v"),
+        attn_scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(d),
+        generate_stats=stats,
+    )
+    if sink:
+        kw["sink_token"] = g.tensor(dim=(1, hq, 1, 1), stride=(hq, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="sink")
+    o, st, amax = g.sdpa_mxfp8(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim((b, hq, sq, dv)).set_stride(o_stride).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16)
+    if stats:
+        st.set_output(True).set_dim((b, hq, sq, 1)).set_stride((hq * sq, sq, 1, 1)).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    amax.set_output(True).set_dim((1, 1, 1, 1)).set_stride((1, 1, 1, 1)).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    return g
+
+
+def _plan_names(g):
+    return [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(g.get_execution_plan_count())]

+
+"""The ROW-MAX FORM of the bias / kv_mask softmax body on the Rubin (SM107) f16/bf16 small head-dim tiles --
+``TemplateParams.bias_max_form`` (``CFG.BIAS_MAX_FORM``) of ``sm107/prefill_d128_f16.py``: 0 = the SOFTWARE row max over the biased,
+-inf-masked scores (the body as built), 1 = the HARDWARE UPPER BOUND -- the plain body's fused ``tcgen05.ld.red...max`` over the RAW
+scores plus the thread's per-ROW bias-tile max in the packed 16-bit domain (``max.bf16x2`` / ``max.f16x2`` over the words the FFMA
+reads), the online softmax on ``max_k S + max_k bias >= max_k (S + bias)``.  Any m >= the true row max is valid for the online softmax
+(P <= 2^RESCALE_THRESHOLD as before; the LSE ``m + log(sum)`` and O = acc / sum are shift-invariant); the per-row bound's slack is the row's
+RAW score range inside the tile -- tens of log2 units against the fp32 flush at -126 -- so a column is lost only when its true weight is
+below 2^-(126 - slack): invisible in a bf16 O and in the fp32 LSE.  The bit-word kv_mask is ignored by the bound (masked columns can
+only lower the true max); the additive kv_mask vector has no per-tile max to bound and is a typed decline with the form.
+
+The hardware bound is the DEFAULT on the kv_mask-ONLY form (run knob-less by every ``mask_only`` cell of test_sdpa_bias_sm107.py: the
+ring wrap, the fully masked row, the degenerate matrix); WITH a bias it is a public ``bias_max_form=1`` option with a documented numerics
+limit, so the option keeps one dense and one masked-band oracle cell, one composition with the mask, one protocol-range pin and the
+limit itself.
+
+Three tiers: (1) CPU contract -- the appended TemplateParams / Cfg fields, the config factory's accept / raise table, the pick and its
+request, the adapter's typed declines; (2) host rendering pins (sm_107a trace-compile) -- the SOFTWARE renderings of every bias /
+kv_mask arm byte-identical to the committed record (THE byte pin of the bias / kv_mask renderings), the two shipped hardware
+renderings (the kv_mask-only defaults at both widths) with NO software max tree (FMNMX3 0), the fused loads (LDTM count unchanged), the
+register split kept, no cluster drain and no new spills; (3) GPU cells on a Rubin device -- the option against the fp64 oracle AND
+against the software form (dense, the masked band, with the mask and a zero-length batch), the -1e4 masked fold of the numerics protocol
+with the worst-case slack |m_upper - m_true| documented; the MEASURED per-form default (``config_sm107.sm107_bias_max_form_default``: the
+hardware bound on the kv_mask-only form, the software tree with a bias) evidenced on the executed plan's record, the default kv_mask-only
+plan's identity property (a mask of all True is bitwise the plain kernel) once per width; and the DOCUMENTED LIMIT of the hardware bound
+WITH a bit-word kv_mask -- the bound ignores the mask, so a row whose masked-out columns carry a bias more than the fp32 exp2 range above
+its kept columns underflows every kept P and ends with O = 0 / Stats = -inf (finite, silent, wrong) -- pinned as the reason the measured
+default keeps the software tree with a bias.
+"""

+# The hardware form against the software form: both are the same function up to the fp32 rounding of the exp2 arguments (a different m
+# per step), so O agrees within atol = rtol = 1.6e-2 -- 2 bf16 ulps at UNIT magnitude (the bf16 quantum at 1.0 is 2^-7 = 7.8e-3), which for an
+# O element of magnitude 0.05 admits ~60 ulps of that element -- and the LSE within atol = rtol = 2e-5 (a few fp32 ulps of a value ~ 6..10):
+# pinned HERE, tighter than the oracle tolerances of the sibling module (`_TOL_O`: atol 5e-2 / rtol 3e-2).
+_TOL_O_VS_SW = dict(atol=1.6e-2, rtol=1.6e-2)  # bf16: 8 mantissa bits; 2 ulps at unit scale
+_TOL_LSE_VS_SW = dict(atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-5)
+
+# the option's oracle cells: dense, and the masked band (where the hardware bound meets -inf columns)

+def _run_both(q, k, v, kw, monkeypatch):
+    """The software and the hardware form on the SAME inputs (the seam flipped between the two builds)."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import config_sm107 as c
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_BIAS_MAX_FORM_OVERRIDE_FOR_SWEEPS", 0)
+    sw = _s13._run(q, k, v, **kw)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_BIAS_MAX_FORM_OVERRIDE_FOR_SWEEPS", 1)
+    hw = _s13._run(q, k, v, **kw)
+    return sw, hw
+
+
+def _check_hw(sw, hw, ref):
+    _s13._check(hw, ref)
+    live = ~ref["empty"]
+    torch.testing.assert_close(hw["o"][live].double(), sw["o"][live].double(), **_TOL_O_VS_SW)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(hw["stats"].squeeze(-1)[live].double(), sw["stats"].squeeze(-1)[live].double(), **_TOL_LSE_VS_SW)
+    assert torch.equal(hw["o"][ref["empty"]], sw["o"][ref["empty"]]) and torch.equal(
+        hw["stats"].squeeze(-1)[ref["empty"]], sw["stats"].squeeze(-1)[ref["empty"]]
+    )

+def _slack(q, k, bias, scale, kv_mask=None, tile_n=128):
+    """Host model of the bound: per (row, kv tile) ``m_upper - m_true`` in log2 units -- the hardware raw max + the per-row bias-tile max
+    against the true max of the biased (and masked) scores.  Returns (max slack, the raw range it is bounded by)."""
+    k_ref = k.repeat_interleave(q.shape[1] // k.shape[1], dim=1) if k.shape[1] != q.shape[1] else k  # GQA: the shared KV head per Q head
+    s = torch.matmul(q.double(), k_ref.double().transpose(-1, -2))  # (b, h, s_q, s_kv) raw
+    b_ = (bias.double() if bias is not None else torch.zeros_like(s)).expand_as(s)
+    worst, worst_range = 0.0, 0.0
+    for t0 in range(0, s.shape[-1], tile_n):
+        sr, br = s[..., t0 : t0 + tile_n], b_[..., t0 : t0 + tile_n]
+        m_upper = sr.max(-1).values * scale + br.max(-1).values
+        true = sr * scale + br
+        if kv_mask is not None:
+            true = true.masked_fill(~kv_mask.view(kv_mask.shape[0], 1, 1, -1)[..., t0 : t0 + tile_n], float("-inf"))
+        m_true = true.max(-1).values
+        live = torch.isfinite(m_true)
+        if live.any():
+            worst = max(worst, float(((m_upper - m_true)[live] * math.log2(math.e)).max()))
+            worst_range = max(worst_range, float(((sr.max(-1).values - sr.min(-1).values) * scale)[live].max() * math.log2(math.e)))
+    return worst, worst_range

+def _spy_loaded_forms(monkeypatch):
+    """Record ``params.bias_max_form`` of every kernel module the adapter loads (the record the EXECUTED plan carries; a memoised load
+    still passes through the spy)."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import api_dsl, config_sm107 as c
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_BIAS_MAX_FORM_OVERRIDE_FOR_SWEEPS", None)  # no seam: the adapter's own pick
+    seen = []
+    real = api_dsl._load_sm100_kernel_module
+
+    def spy(flavor, params, *a, **kw):
+        seen.append(int(getattr(params, "bias_max_form", -1)))
+        return real(flavor, params, *a, **kw)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(api_dsl, "_load_sm100_kernel_module", spy)
+    return seen

+def _spy_row_picks(monkeypatch):
+    """Record every ``sm107_bias_mode_pick`` call the ENGINE ROW makes (it imports the name at call time) with its result."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import config_sm107 as c
+
+    seen = []
+    orig = c.sm107_bias_mode_pick
+
+    def spy(*a, **kw):
+        r = orig(*a, **kw)
+        seen.append((a, kw, r))
+        return r
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "sm107_bias_mode_pick", spy)
+    return seen
+

+        (1000, False, False, 2),  # a DENSE tail: the lowering synthesizes per-batch lengths (seq_kv_lens_present=True) -> the cga1 ring
+        (1024, True, False, 2),  # real per-batch lengths -> the cga1 ring

+    through the kernel's padded path with SYNTHESIZED per-batch lengths (``engines._synth_kv_padding``; ``lower_dsl_prefill`` passes
+    ``seq_kv_lens_present=True``), so the row passes ``global_lengths=False`` there and computes the cga1 ring -- the form the adapter's

+"""The (n, n+1) PAIR work item of the resident-bias arm on the Rubin (SM107) f16/bf16 small head-dim tiles --
+``TemplateParams.n_chunk >= 1`` on ``sm107/prefill_d128_f16.py``.

+A work item is (a 128-row q tile, a head, a CHUNK of up to ``n_chunk`` consecutive entries of the flattened batch axis); the two
+softmax sub-tiles are rows nb / nb + 1 of the SAME q tile, so the bias row-block shrinks to the q tile's 128 rows (twice the kv
+columns fit: S_kv <= 768 at the 32-wide tile, <= 384 at the 64-wide one, from 384 / 128) and is loaded ONCE per item for every
+row of the chunk -- the per-item fixed cost and the bias feed divided by ``n_chunk``.  The form needs a batch-BROADCAST bias
+(``[1, 1|H, S_q, S_kv]``: two rows share one block), at least two rows and cga1; a per-batch bias, a single row or a cga2 plan keeps
+the one-batch-entry item (``n_chunk = 0``, every one-batch-entry cell and cubin record unchanged).  Nothing numerically changes: every row's
+kv loop runs the same tiles in the same order, so O / Stats are BITWISE identical across ``n_chunk`` values, against the
+one-batch-entry item and (bias = 0) against the plain kernel.

+accept / decline table (the widened cells and the cells that keep the one-batch-entry budget), the config factory's couplings,
+the adapter twin; (2) host rendering pins -- every pair rendering keeps the register split, no cluster drain, no spills above
+the one-batch-entry bias rendering, the packed bias add and the bit-word mask where a mask is on; (3) GPU cells on a Rubin

+of the tile, a zero-length row inside a chunk, mixed lengths, the padded-Q trim, the band + padding, the budget edges of both tiles, the
+sink, the rule's own pick; the magnitude / head-broadcast forms are pinned on the one-batch-entry arm), the bitwise pins across n_chunk in

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- tier 3: the GPU cells (a cc 10.0 / 10.3 device)
+
+# The Rubin module's degenerate-input matrix INSIDE the SM100 resident budget (S_kv <= 256 at the 32-wide tile, <= 128 at the 64-wide one):
+# the KV ring sweep n_kv 1 / 2 with B*H > 1, ONE CTA / one tile in the whole launch (S_kv 128 and 64), a tail tile with a padded bias row
+# stride (217 / 100), GQA, a zero-length KV batch (an EMPTY work item: no bias barrier is touched), a zero-key batch WITH a sink and the
+# padded-Q trim, the bias in its four broadcast forms, the magnitude cells, the 64-wide tile at cga2 (one tile).  (D 24 rides the 32-wide
+# tile by the zero-fill contract, bitwise-pinned on the plain body in test_sdpa_small_d_sm100.py; the bias arm does not read D.)
+_IN_BUDGET = [
+    "dense_one_tile_bh1",
+    "dense_nkv1",
+    "dense_nkv2",
+    "causal_gqa_8_2",
+    "padded_kv_zero_batch",
+    "causal_sink_padded_q_trim",
+    "bias_head_broadcast",
+    "bias_per_batch",
+    "bias_per_batch_head_broadcast",
+    "bias_x10",
+    "bias_neg1e9_key_fold",
+    "d64_dense_128",
+    "d64_padded_zero_batch_128",
+    "dense_one_tile_64",
+    "tail_217_padded_stride_bias",
+    "causal_tail_100_padded_stride_bias",
+]
+# Above the SM100 resident budget (the Rubin module streams or pairs these): a typed decline of the row on a real graph -- no FROST plan.
+# The one-batch-entry item ABOVE the resident budget at the 32-wide tile: the 2-stage STREAMED ring (n_kv 3 = one stage past the ring, 4 = two
+# wraps, 5, 8 with a tail; the causal band; a padded zero-length batch on the ring: an empty item touches no ring row).  One (form x ring class)
+# each, with and without the word where the body differs; the magnitude / head-broadcast forms are pinned on the resident arm (the ring feeds
+# the same FFMA).
+_RING_CASES = {
+    "ring_dense_nkv3_384": dict(b=2, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=384, s_kv=384),
+    "ring_dense_nkv4_512": dict(b=2, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=512, s_kv=512),
+    "ring_causal_nkv5_640": dict(b=2, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=640, s_kv=640, causal=True),
+    # S_kv 904 (not 900): a COMPACT bias needs S_kv % 8 == 0 for its TMA row stride (the row declines 900 typed; the Rubin module runs 900 on the mask-only arm)
+    "ring_padded_nkv8_tail_904_zero_batch": dict(b=3, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=904, s_kv=904, kv_lens=[904, 0, 500]),
+    # the D 64 flavor's knob-less default above its cga-1 resident budget: the 64-wide tile's 3-stage ring at cga1 (the measured preference over the cga-2 block)
+    "ring_d64_nkv4_256_t64": dict(b=2, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=256, s_kv=256, d=64),
+}
+# No form at any width of the flavor's domain: the 64-wide tile's cga2 holds one tile and no ring; cga1 none -- a typed decline on real graphs.
+_ABOVE_BUDGET = ["d64_dense_256_cga2"]
+
+
+def _expected_cga(case):
+    c = _t7._CASES[case]
+    return 2 if c.get("d", 32) == 64 else 1  # the 64-wide tile's bias block lives at cga2 on this line; the 32-wide tile at its cga1
+
+
+def _run(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    scale,
+    bias=None,
+    kv_mask=None,
+    sdpa_kwargs=None,
+    seq_len_kv=None,
+    seq_len_q=None,
+    sink=None,
+    stats=True,
+    cga=None,
+    tile_n=None,
+    two_launch_assert=True,
+):
+    """The Rubin module's ``_run`` against the SM100 row: build the graph, pin the row's unsplit plan (the heuristics' pick; a cga / tile_n
+    request through the public autotune record), launch TWICE on sentinel-filled outputs (the two-launch delta) and return O, Stats and
+    the plan's knobs.  ``two_launch_assert=False`` leaves the two-launch identity to the caller (the first launch rides along as
+    ``o_first`` / ``stats_first``), so a cell can report a NaN residue as what it is before the identity check."""
+    import cudnn
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    g, vp, o, o_gpu, stats_gpu = _t7._build(
+        q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, seq_len_kv=seq_len_kv, seq_len_q=seq_len_q, sink=sink, stats=stats
+    )
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    ours = [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n == _ROW or n.startswith(_ROW + "[")]
+    idx = next((i for i in ours if g.plans[i].knobs.split_kv in (None, 1)), None)
+    assert idx is not None, f"no unsplit {_ROW} plan in {names}"
+    picked = g.plans[idx].knobs
+    picked_cga, picked_tile_n = picked.cga, picked.tile_n
+    want_cga = picked_cga if cga is None else cga
+    want_tile_n = picked_tile_n if tile_n is None else tile_n
+    if (want_cga, want_tile_n) != (picked_cga, picked_tile_n):
+        engine_id, record = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(idx)
+        record = dict(record)
+        if want_cga != picked_cga:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_CGA_M] = want_cga
+        if want_tile_n != picked_tile_n:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_N] = want_tile_n
+        g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, record)
+        idx = g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1
+        picked_cga, picked_tile_n = want_cga, want_tile_n
+    g.select_plan(idx)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    vp[o] = o_gpu
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def launch():
+        o_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))  # sentinel: an unwritten live row stays NaN
+        if stats_gpu is not None:
+            stats_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return o_gpu.clone(), (stats_gpu.clone() if stats_gpu is not None else None)
+
+    o1, st1 = launch()
+    o2, st2 = launch()
+    if two_launch_assert:
+        assert torch.equal(o1, o2) and (st1 is None or torch.equal(st1, st2)), "two-launch delta on O / Stats"
+    return dict(o=o_gpu, stats=stats_gpu, knobs=SimpleNamespace(cga=picked_cga, tile_n=picked_tile_n), names=names, o_first=o1, stats_first=st1)
+
+
+def _frost_plan_names(q, k, v, kw):
+    import cudnn
+
+    g, *_ = _t7._build(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        scale=kw["scale"],
+        bias=kw["bias"],
+        kv_mask=kw["kv_mask"],
+        sdpa_kwargs=kw["sdpa_kwargs"],
+        seq_len_kv=kw["seq_len_kv"],
+        seq_len_q=kw["seq_len_q"],
+        sink=kw["sink"],
+    )
+    try:
+        g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 -- the typed graph-level decline
+        if type(exc).__name__ == "cudnnGraphNotSupportedError":
+            # no engine at all proposed a plan (a kv_mask graph has no backend lowering): the row's decline IS the whole answer
+            return []
+        raise
+    return [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+
+
+# (case, dtype) pairs: every in-budget case in bf16; the fp16 member on the dense base and on the fp16 O cast of keyless rows under the sink
+# and the padded-Q trim (the same two cells as the Rubin module).
+_BIAS_CELLS = [(c, torch.bfloat16) for c in _IN_BUDGET] + [("dense_nkv2", torch.float16), ("causal_sink_padded_q_trim", torch.float16)]
+

+tile) in ONE bit-word pass with the true -inf, so a row whose every key is masked ends the item with ``total_sum == 0`` exactly
+and the correction epilogue SELECTs O = 0 / Stats = -inf.  The block's budget is what the carveout leaves beside the Q / O slabs

+def _desc(shape, dtype, name, stride=None):
+    """A standalone-adapter descriptor.  The ACTIVATIONS (``q`` / ``k`` / ``v`` / ``o``, shape (B, H, S, D)) default to the row's
+    envelope, BSHD-physical (stride order 3, 1, 2, 0) -- the layout the prepared launch binds zero-copy, so the adapter cells are the
+    row's twin; a (B, H, S, D)-contiguous activation would take the adapter's staging-copy path, which carries neither the bias nor the
+    kv_mask and is therefore a typed decline in ``check_support`` with a resident-arm operand bound.  Every other tensor (the bias, the
+    kv_mask, the lengths) defaults to its contiguous strides."""
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+
+    if stride is None and name in ("q", "k", "v", "o") and len(shape) == 4:
+        b, h, s, d = (int(x) for x in shape)
+        stride = (s * h * d, d, h * d, 1)
+    stride = tuple(int(x) for x in torch.empty(shape).stride()) if stride is None else tuple(stride)
+    return TensorDesc(
+        dtype=dtype, shape=tuple(shape), stride=stride, stride_order=TensorDesc._compute_stride_order(tuple(shape), stride), device="cuda", name=name
+    )

+# The existing f16 row tolerances (test_sdpa_fwd_dsl_sm107.py / test_sdpa_fwd_head_dim_sm107.py): O against the fp64 oracle (an
+# fp32 accumulation, one 16-bit rounding at the store), the LSE pair at 1e-4 / 1e-4 (the bias enters the fp32 score by ONE
+# FFMA of bias * (1 / scale), then the scale multiply: one more fp32 rounding than the eager s * scale + bias -- pinned by the
+# bias-magnitude cells, not widened for them).
+_TOL_O = dict(atol=5e-2, rtol=3e-2)
+_TOL_LSE = dict(atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-4)

+def _bhsd(b, h, s, d, dtype):
+    return torch.randn(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _ref(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    scale,
+    bias=None,
+    kv_mask=None,
+    causal=False,
+    bottom_right=False,
+    seq_q_lens=None,
+    seq_kv_lens=None,
+    sinks=None,
+    window_left=None,
+    right_bound=None,
+):
+    """fp64 oracle of the whole contract: softmax_k(scale * q.k + bias + maskbias) with the key mask, the padding and the band;
+    a row without a live key reads O = 0 / LSE = -inf (the empty-row contract); the bias enters in its 16-bit value."""
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    _, h_kv, s_kv, _ = v.shape
+    dev = q.device
+    g = h_q // h_kv
+    k_ref = k.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    v_ref = v.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    scores = torch.matmul(q.double(), k_ref.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+    if bias is not None:
+        scores = scores + bias.double()  # broadcast over the dims declared 1
+    q_lens = seq_q_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_q_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    kv_lens = seq_kv_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_kv_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_kv, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    i = torch.arange(s_q, device=dev).view(1, 1, s_q, 1)
+    j = torch.arange(s_kv, device=dev).view(1, 1, 1, s_kv)
+    diag = i + (kv_lens - q_lens).view(b, 1, 1, 1) if bottom_right else i
+    dead_q = i >= q_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    masked = dead_q | (j >= kv_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1))
+    if kv_mask is not None:
+        masked = masked | (~kv_mask.view(kv_mask.shape[0], 1, 1, s_kv))
+    if causal:
+        masked = masked | (j > diag)
+    if right_bound is not None:
+        masked = masked | (j > diag + right_bound)
+    if window_left is not None:
+        masked = masked | (j < diag - window_left)
+    scores = scores.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+    full = scores if sinks is None else torch.cat([scores, sinks.view(1, h_q, 1, 1).double().expand(b, h_q, s_q, 1)], dim=-1)
+    smax = full.max(dim=-1).values
+    ssum = torch.exp(full - smax.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)
+    lse = smax + torch.log(ssum)
+    o = torch.matmul(torch.softmax(full, dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)[..., :s_kv], v_ref)
+    dead = dead_q.squeeze(-1)
+    return dict(o=o, lse=lse.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf")), empty=torch.isneginf(lse) | dead)
+

+def _build(q, k, v, *, scale, bias=None, kv_mask=None, sdpa_kwargs=None, seq_len_kv=None, seq_len_q=None, sink=None, stats=True):
+    """The graph with its variant pack (bias / kv_mask bound through ``tensor_like``: the bias as the classic ``bias`` operand,
+    the mask as the python-only ``kv_mask`` input)."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    d_v = v.shape[-1]
+    dtype = q.dtype
+    o_gpu = torch.empty(b, s_q, h_q, d_v, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    io = cudnn.data_type.HALF if dtype == torch.float16 else cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    tq, tk, tv = g.tensor_like(q), g.tensor_like(k), g.tensor_like(v)
+    kw = dict(name="sdpa", q=tq, k=tk, v=tv, generate_stats=stats, attn_scale=scale)
+    vp = {tq: q, tk: k, tv: v}
+    if bias is not None:
+        tb = g.tensor_like(bias)
+        kw["bias"] = tb
+        vp[tb] = bias
+    if kv_mask is not None:
+        tm = g.tensor_like(kv_mask)
+        kw["kv_mask"] = tm
+        vp[tm] = kv_mask
+    if seq_len_kv is not None:
+        slk = g.tensor_like(seq_len_kv)
+        kw.update(seq_len_kv=slk, use_padding_mask=True)
+        vp[slk] = seq_len_kv
+        slq_t = seq_len_q if seq_len_q is not None else torch.full((b, 1, 1, 1), s_q, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+        slq = g.tensor_like(slq_t)
+        kw["seq_len_q"] = slq
+        vp[slq] = slq_t
+    if sink is not None:
+        st = g.tensor_like(sink)
+        kw["sink_token"] = st
+        vp[st] = sink
+    kw.update(sdpa_kwargs or {})
+    o, stats_t = g.sdpa(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim(o_gpu.shape).set_stride(o_gpu.stride())
+    stats_gpu = None
+    if stats:
+        stats_gpu = make_dense_stats(b, h_q, s_q, "contiguous")
+        stats_t.set_output(True).set_dim(stats_gpu.shape).set_stride(stats_gpu.stride()).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+        vp[stats_t] = stats_gpu
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    return g, vp, o, o_gpu, stats_gpu

+def _frost_plans(g):
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    return names, [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n == _ROW or n.startswith(_ROW + "[")]

+def _run(q, k, v, *, scale, bias=None, kv_mask=None, sdpa_kwargs=None, seq_len_kv=None, seq_len_q=None, sink=None, stats=True, cga=None, tile_n=None):
+    """Build the graph, pin the Rubin f16 row (optionally a cga and / or a KV tile width through the public autotune record;
+    ``tile_n=None`` keeps the heuristics' pick), launch TWICE on sentinel-filled outputs (the two-launch delta) and return O,
+    Stats and the plan's knobs (``knobs.tile_n`` = the width the executed plan carries)."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    g, vp, o, o_gpu, stats_gpu = _build(
+        q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, seq_len_kv=seq_len_kv, seq_len_q=seq_len_q, sink=sink, stats=stats
+    )
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names, ours = _frost_plans(g)
+    idx = next((i for i in ours if g.plans[i].knobs.split_kv in (None, 1)), None)
+    assert idx is not None, f"no unsplit {_ROW} plan in {names}"
+    picked = g.plans[idx].knobs
+    picked_cga, picked_tile_n = picked.cga, picked.tile_n
+    want_cga = picked_cga if cga is None else cga
+    want_tile_n = picked_tile_n if tile_n is None else tile_n
+    if (want_cga, want_tile_n) != (picked_cga, picked_tile_n):
+        engine_id, record = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(idx)
+        record = dict(record)
+        if want_cga != picked_cga:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_CGA_M] = want_cga
+        if want_tile_n != picked_tile_n:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_N] = want_tile_n
+        g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, record)
+        idx = g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1
+        picked_cga, picked_tile_n = want_cga, want_tile_n
+    g.select_plan(idx)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    assert (g.plans[idx].knobs.cga, g.plans[idx].knobs.tile_n) == (picked_cga, picked_tile_n), (g.plans[idx].knobs, picked_cga, picked_tile_n)
+    vp[o] = o_gpu
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def launch():
+        o_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))  # sentinel: an unwritten live row stays NaN
+        if stats_gpu is not None:
+            stats_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return o_gpu.clone(), (stats_gpu.clone() if stats_gpu is not None else None)
+
+    o1, st1 = launch()
+    o2, st2 = launch()
+    assert torch.equal(o1, o2) and (st1 is None or torch.equal(st1, st2)), "two-launch delta on O / Stats"
+    return dict(o=o_gpu, stats=stats_gpu, knobs=SimpleNamespace(cga=picked_cga, tile_n=picked_tile_n), names=names)

+def _check(out, ref, *, has_stats=True):
+    """Keyless rows EXACTLY 0 / -inf (never NaN, never a residue); live rows against the fp64 oracle."""
+    empty = ref["empty"]
+    o = out["o"]

+        bottom_right=bool(c.get("bottom_right")), seq_q_lens=kw["seq_len_q"], seq_kv_lens=kw["seq_len_kv"],
+        sinks=kw["sink"].flatten() if kw["sink"] is not None else None, window_left=c.get("window_left"), right_bound=c.get("right_bound"),
+    )  # fmt: skip

+def _case_inputs(case, dtype, *, seed=0, kv_mask_p=None, table=None):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    c = (_CASES if table is None else table)[case]
+    d = c.get("d", 32)
+    q = _bhsd(c["b"], c["h"], c["s_q"], d, dtype)
+    k = _bhsd(c["b"], c["h_kv"], c["s_kv"], d, dtype)
+    v = _bhsd(c["b"], c["h_kv"], c["s_kv"], d, dtype)
+    form = c.get("bias", "h")
+    bb = c["b"] if form in ("b", "b1") else 1
+    bh = c["h"] if form in ("h", "b") else 1
+    # A padded row stride (`bias_row_stride`: the TMA 16-byte rule at an S_kv % 8 != 0) makes the bias a strided VIEW; compact otherwise.
+    row = c.get("bias_row_stride", c["s_kv"])
+    bias = (torch.randn(bb, bh, c["s_q"], row, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32) * c.get("bias_scale", 1.0)).to(dtype)[..., : c["s_kv"]]
+    if c.get("neg_fold"):
+        # the models' finite key fold: 0 on a live key, -1e9 on a masked one (rounded to the io dtype like the models' bias)
+        keep = torch.rand(bb, 1, 1, c["s_kv"], device="cuda") > 0.3
+        bias = torch.where(keep, torch.zeros_like(bias), torch.full_like(bias, -1e9))
+    kv_mask = None
+    if kv_mask_p is not None:
+        kv_mask = torch.rand(c["b"], 1, 1, c["s_kv"], device="cuda") > kv_mask_p
+    kv_lens = torch.tensor(c["kv_lens"], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(c["b"], 1, 1, 1) if "kv_lens" in c else None
+    q_lens = torch.tensor(c["q_lens"], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(c["b"], 1, 1, 1) if "q_lens" in c else None
+    sink = torch.randn(1, c["h"], 1, 1, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda") if c.get("sink") else None
+    causal = bool(c.get("causal") or c.get("bottom_right"))
+    sdpa_kwargs = dict(use_causal_mask_bottom_right=True) if c.get("bottom_right") else (dict(use_causal_mask=True) if causal else {})
+    window_left = c.get("window_left")
+    if window_left is not None:
+        sdpa_kwargs["sliding_window_length"] = window_left + 1  # the graph's length L keeps L keys up to the diagonal: W = L - 1
+    right_bound = c.get("right_bound")
+    if right_bound is not None:
+        sdpa_kwargs["diagonal_band_right_bound"] = right_bound
+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(d) if not c.get("bottom_right") else 0.75
+    run_kw = dict(scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, seq_len_kv=kv_lens, seq_len_q=q_lens, sink=sink, cga=c.get("cga"))
+    return q, k, v, run_kw, _ref_of(c, q, k, v, run_kw)

+# The SIGN of attn_scale against the additive arms: a plan with a NEGATIVE attn_scale runs with
+# negate_scores (#1435) -- BMM1 negates S and the kernel runs at |scale| -- and the pre-scale additive FMA of the bias / kv_mask arms
+# (``S_raw + bias * inv_scale``, then the exp2 scale) must take the SAME effective positive magnitude.  The prepared dense template used to
+# bind the SIGNED 1 / scale in that slot, so on such a plan the bias entered with its sign flipped (scale * Q.K - bias) on the graph route
+# (the standalone adapter re-derives the slot per call from |scale| and was right).  The inputs make the whole answer one number: Q = K = 0
+# (the scale multiplies nothing but the additive term), +2 on the first half of the keys and -2 on the other half -- per key, in the io
+# dtype, as the resident [1, H, S, S] block or as the ADDITIVE kv_mask vector [1, 1, 1, S] -- and V = +1 / -1 on the same halves, so
+# softmax_k(bias) . V = tanh(2) on every row and lane at EITHER sign of the scale; the flipped binding reads -tanh(2).  The signed fp64
+# oracle is the detector, and the NEGATED oracle (what the flipped binding computes) is pinned to be what the plan does NOT compute.  Both
+# arch modules run the cells on their row; the HOST pin below reads the template itself off ``build_dense_spec`` without a device.
+_SIGNED_SCALE_S, _SIGNED_SCALE_D, _SIGNED_SCALE_MAG = 128, 32, 0.125
+_SIGNED_SCALE_FORMS = ("bias", "additive_kv_mask")
+
+
+def _signed_scale_inputs(sign, form, dtype):
+    """``(q, k, v, run_kw, ref)`` of the signed-scale cell: ``form`` = "bias" (the resident block) or "additive_kv_mask" (the per-key additive
+    vector through the python-only kv_mask input); ``sign`` = +1 / -1 picks attn_scale = sign * 0.125."""
+    assert form in _SIGNED_SCALE_FORMS, form
+    b, h, s, d = 1, 2, _SIGNED_SCALE_S, _SIGNED_SCALE_D
+    q = torch.zeros(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    k = torch.zeros(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    v = torch.empty(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    v[:, :, : s // 2] = 1.0
+    v[:, :, s // 2 :] = -1.0
+    additive = torch.full((1, h, s, s) if form == "bias" else (b, 1, 1, s), -2.0, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    additive[..., : s // 2] = 2.0
+    scale = sign * _SIGNED_SCALE_MAG
+    run_kw = dict(
+        scale=scale,
+        bias=additive if form == "bias" else None,
+        kv_mask=None if form == "bias" else additive,
+        sdpa_kwargs={},
+        seq_len_kv=None,
+        seq_len_q=None,
+        sink=None,
+    )
+    return q, k, v, run_kw, _ref(q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=additive)  # the vector broadcasts over (B, H, S_q) in the oracle like a bias
+
+
+def _check_signed_scale(out, ref):
+    """O and Stats against the signed oracle, the closed form tanh(2) on every lane, and the negated oracle rejected."""
+    _check(out, ref)
+    o = out["o"].double()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(o, torch.full_like(o, math.tanh(2.0)), **_TOL_O)
+    assert not torch.allclose(
+        o, -ref["o"], **_TOL_O
+    ), "the NEGATED oracle (the flipped-bias binding, scale * Q.K - bias) must be what the plan does NOT compute"

+def test_signed_attn_scale_keeps_the_additive_arms_sign(sign, form):
+    """attn_scale = +0.125 and -0.125 on the Rubin row's resident bias and on its additive kv_mask vector, on the public graph route: the
+    negated plan (BMM1 negates S, |scale| in the kernel) must bind the additive arms' 1 / scale at the same effective magnitude -- O = tanh(2)
+    on every lane at either sign; the positive cell is the control."""
+    q, k, v, kw, ref = _signed_scale_inputs(sign, form, torch.bfloat16)
+    _check_signed_scale(_run(q, k, v, **kw), ref)

+def _dense_plan_stand_in(kernel_file, *, scale):
+    """A device-free stand-in for what ``prepared.build_dense_spec`` reads off an adapter: the host slot order parsed from the kernel file's
+    ``_host`` signature (as the native-binding fixtures read it), a positional entry that launches nothing, and the declared facts of a dense
+    unsplit bf16 [1, 2, 128, 32] plan with the resident bias; ``_score_negated`` follows the scale's sign exactly as the adapter sets it."""
+    import ast
+    import inspect
+    import types
+
+    host = next(n for n in ast.parse(kernel_file.read_text()).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "_host")
+    order = [a.arg for a in host.args.args if a.annotation is None or "Constexpr" not in ast.unparse(a.annotation)]
+
+    def entry(*args):
+        raise AssertionError("the host pin never launches")
+
+    entry.__signature__ = inspect.Signature([inspect.Parameter(n, inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD) for n in order])
+    km = types.ModuleType(f"stand_in_{kernel_file.parent.name}_prefill_d128_f16")
+    km._host = entry
+
+    def desc():
+        return SimpleNamespace(dtype="torch.bfloat16", device=SimpleNamespace(index=0))
+
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        _k_mod=km, _compiled_kernel=SimpleNamespace(_compiled_cache_raw=entry),
+        batch_size=1, h_q=2, h_kv=2, head_dim_qk=_SIGNED_SCALE_D, head_dim_v=_SIGNED_SCALE_D, s_q_max=_SIGNED_SCALE_S, s_k_max=_SIGNED_SCALE_S,
+        paged=False, paged_page_size=None, split_kv=1, q_desc=desc(), k_desc=desc(), v_desc=desc(), o_desc=desc(), lse_desc=None, has_sink=False,
+        bias_desc=desc(), kv_mask_desc=None, seq_kv_lens_present=False, seq_q_lens_present=False, gate_desc=None,
+        is_causal=False, window_size_right=0, causal_bottom_right=False, scale_softmax=float(scale), _score_negated=float(scale) < 0,
+    )  # fmt: skip

+def test_prepared_dense_template_binds_the_additive_arms_inverse_scale_at_the_effective_magnitude(arch, sign):
+    """HOST pin, no device: the argument template ``build_dense_spec`` writes for a resident-bias plan at attn_scale = sign * 0.125 -- the
+    template every graph-route launch copies (``PreparedDenseLaunch.execute`` -> ``bind_dense`` -> ``spec.frame()``).  On the negated plan
+    ``scale_softmax_log2`` AND ``inv_scale_softmax`` are both bound at |scale| -- the exp2 scale 0.125 log2 e and the FMA's 1 / 0.125 = +8 --
+    so the kernel's ``S_raw + bias * inv_scale`` keeps the bias's sign; the signed 1 / scale (-8) is pinned absent."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import prepared as prep
+
+    scale = sign * _SIGNED_SCALE_MAG
+    spec = prep.build_dense_spec(_dense_plan_stand_in(_D128_HOST_FILES[arch], scale=scale), scale_softmax=None)
+    assert spec.has_bias and spec.native is None, "a bias plan binds through the python frame (no native binder): the template IS the launch's constants"
+    t, ix = spec.template, spec.index
+    assert t[ix["scale_softmax_log2"]] == pytest.approx(abs(scale) * math.log2(math.e))
+    assert t[ix["inv_scale_softmax"]] == pytest.approx(1.0 / abs(scale)), (arch, sign, t[ix["inv_scale_softmax"]])
+    # the per-call frame copies the slot unchanged: the graph route binds no scale of its own

+"""
+_COUNTS = {
+    "USETMAXREG": ("USETMAXREG",),

+def _record():

+  ``config_sm107.SM107_TILE_NS_BY_D_SHAPE``): the one-chunk softmax arm the body folds to at ``N_BMM2_CHUNKS == 1`` -- the S
+  accumulator 64 columns per sub-tile, P in its 32-column tail, a K/V ring tile of 64 rows, two mask words per tile, one
+  bias chunk.  Trace-compiled (the host pins) and run on cc 10.7 (the GPU cells) at n_kv = 1 / 2 / 4 (the ring depth) / 6,
+  plain / bias / bool mask / additive mask / causal / padded tail, d32 and d64 at cga1 / cga2, against the fp64 oracle and

+    assert probe.stats["MUFU_EX2"] * 2 <= base.stats["MUFU_EX2"] + 8, (probe.stats, base.stats)

+# The fp32 vector WITH the bias at TILE_N 128 spills (MEASURED on cutlass-dsl 4.8.0 + the CUDA 13.5 ptxas, sm_107a: STL / LDL 23 / 27
+# dense, 15 / 15 padded, 16 / 16 at d64 cga2 against the bit word's 3 / 3): the sixteen 128-bit granule loads of a 64-column chunk are 64
+# fp32 registers beside the 128 live S values, the 32 pre-loaded bias words and the band words -- over the softmax role's 192 -- where the
+# io-dtype form packs two values per register and stays at the bit word's count.  Neither named lever moves it (BIAS_PRELOAD_CHUNKS = 0
+# leaves the counts unchanged; a streamed one-granule-at-a-time fold makes it worse: ptxas hoists the loads anyway).  So the rendering is
+# NOT SERVED: the heuristics pick TILE_N 64 for the fp32 vector WITH a bias and the adapter defaults to it, the row and the adapter
+# decline an EXPLICIT 128 typed (the accept / reject tables above, the real-graph cell below), and the io-dtype vector stays the fast
+# path.  The shipped renderings pinned here: one per (vector dtype x bias) class -- the fold is per row and width-blind.
+_ADDITIVE_ARMS = [
+    # (d, cta, extra, the bool-form twin's extra) -- the additive rendering is pinned against the SAME arm with kv_mask_form = 1
+    (32, 1, {"kv_mask_form": 2}, {"kv_mask_form": 1}),
+    (32, 1, {"kv_mask_form": 3}, {"kv_mask_form": 1}),
+    (
+        32,
+        1,
+        {"kv_mask_form": 2, "bias_mode": 1, "tile_n": 64, "seq_kv_lens_present": True},
+        {"kv_mask_form": 1, "bias_mode": 1, "tile_n": 64, "seq_kv_lens_present": True},
+    ),
+    (
+        32,
+        1,
+        {"kv_mask_form": 3, "bias_mode": 1, "tile_n": 64, "seq_kv_lens_present": True},
+        {"kv_mask_form": 1, "bias_mode": 1, "tile_n": 64, "seq_kv_lens_present": True},
+    ),
+]
+_ADDITIVE_IDS = ["d32_add16", "d32_addf32", "d32_t64_add16_bias_padded", "d32_t64_addf32_bias_padded"]

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("d, cta, extra, twin", _ADDITIVE_ARMS, ids=_ADDITIVE_IDS)
+def test_additive_kv_mask_renderings_fold_the_vector_as_packed_ffma_from_128_bit_loads(tmp_path, d, cta, extra, twin):
+    """Each shipped additive-vector rendering against the bit-word rendering of the SAME arm: the register split kept, no cluster drain,
+    no new spills, MORE packed FFMA (the vector fold, one per pair), 128-bit granule loads present (never scalarised), the ballots gone
+    (no bit word) -- and a different cubin."""
+    base_params = {"__d": d, "cta_mma": cta, "dtype_qkv": 2, **twin}
+    base = _probe(tmp_path, base_params, f"bool_{d}_{cta}_{'_'.join(sorted(twin))}")
+    params = {"__d": d, "cta_mma": cta, "dtype_qkv": 2, **extra}
+    probe = _probe(tmp_path, params, f"add_{d}_{cta}_{'_'.join(sorted(extra))}")
+    assert probe.expect["KV_MASK_FORM"] == extra["kv_mask_form"] and base.expect["KV_MASK_FORM"] == 1
+    assert probe.cubin_md5 != base.cubin_md5
+    assert probe.stats["USETMAXREG"] > 0 and probe.stats["CGAERRBAR"] == 0, probe.stats
+    assert_no_new_spills(probe.stats, base.stats, tag=f"additive d{d} cga{cta} {sorted(extra)} vs the bit word: ")
+    assert probe.stats["FFMA2"] > base.stats["FFMA2"], (probe.stats, base.stats)
+    assert probe.stats["LDG_128"] > 0, probe.stats
+    assert probe.stats["VOTE"] < base.stats["VOTE"], (probe.stats, base.stats)

+def _executed_tile_n(g, idx):
+    """The KV tile width the EXECUTED plan was compiled with -- never the record the test asked for, so a 64-wide cell is evidenced by
+    the rendering that ran, not inferred from the adapter tier.  Read from the compiled kernel module's own ``CFG.TILE_N`` through the
+    prepared launch spec (``prepared.DenseLaunchSpec.tile_n``); a plan the lowering built WITHOUT a prepared launch (one KV tile, S_kv
+    64) exposes the adapter it compiled through the executor closure, whose ``template_params().tile_n`` is the width the kernel
+    module was loaded with (``_load_sm100_kernel_module((d, d), params)``)."""
+    plan = g._compiled_plans[idx]
+    spec = getattr(getattr(plan, "_prepared", None), "spec", None)
+    if spec is not None and hasattr(spec, "tile_n"):
+        return int(spec.tile_n)
+    cells = getattr(plan._compiled, "__closure__", None) or ()
+    api = next((c.cell_contents for c in cells if type(c.cell_contents).__name__.startswith("SdpaFwdDsl")), None)
+    assert api is not None, f"the compiled plan carries neither a prepared launch spec nor the adapter it compiled: {type(plan).__name__}"
+    return int(api.template_params().tile_n)
+
+
+def _run2(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    scale,
+    bias=None,
+    kv_mask=None,
+    sdpa_kwargs=None,
+    seq_len_kv=None,
+    seq_len_q=None,
+    sink=None,
+    stats=True,
+    cga=None,
+    tile_n=None,
+    two_launch_assert=True,
+):
+    """``test_sdpa_bias_sm107._run`` with the TILE_N knob: build the graph, pin the Rubin f16 row (a cga and / or a TILE_N through
+    the public autotune record), launch TWICE on sentinel-filled outputs (the two-launch delta) and return O, Stats, the plan's OWN
+    knob record and the width the compiled kernel actually carries (``executed_tile_n``).  ``two_launch_assert=False`` leaves the
+    two-launch identity to the caller (the first launch rides along as ``o_first`` / ``stats_first``)."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    g, vp, o, o_gpu, stats_gpu = _build(
+        q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, seq_len_kv=seq_len_kv, seq_len_q=seq_len_q, sink=sink, stats=stats
+    )
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names, ours = _frost_plans(g)
+    idx = next((i for i in ours if g.plans[i].knobs.split_kv in (None, 1)), None)
+    assert idx is not None, f"no unsplit {_ROW} plan in {names}"
+    picked = g.plans[idx].knobs
+    want_cga = picked.cga if cga is None else cga
+    want_tile_n = picked.tile_n if tile_n is None else tile_n
+    if (want_cga, want_tile_n) != (picked.cga, picked.tile_n):
+        engine_id, record = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(idx)
+        record = dict(record)
+        record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_CGA_M] = want_cga
+        record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_N] = want_tile_n
+        g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, record)
+        idx = g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1
+    g.select_plan(idx)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    knobs = g.plans[idx].knobs
+    assert knobs.tile_n == want_tile_n and knobs.cga == want_cga, (knobs, want_tile_n, want_cga)
+    # The EXECUTED rendering's width from the compiled kernel's CFG (a knob-less plan runs the row's default 128).
+    executed_tile_n = _executed_tile_n(g, idx)
+    assert executed_tile_n == (want_tile_n if want_tile_n is not None else 128), (executed_tile_n, want_tile_n, knobs)
+    vp[o] = o_gpu
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def launch():
+        o_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))
+        if stats_gpu is not None:
+            stats_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return o_gpu.clone(), (stats_gpu.clone() if stats_gpu is not None else None)
+
+    o1, st1 = launch()
+    o2, st2 = launch()
+    if two_launch_assert:
+        assert torch.equal(o1, o2) and (st1 is None or torch.equal(st1, st2)), "two-launch delta on O / Stats"
+    return dict(o=o_gpu, stats=stats_gpu, knobs=knobs, executed_tile_n=executed_tile_n, names=names, o_first=o1, stats_first=st1)
+
+
+def _ref_add(q, k, v, *, scale, bias=None, add=None, kv_mask=None, causal=False, seq_kv_lens=None):
+    """The fp64 oracle with an ADDITIVE per-key vector folded as the eager models fold it: fp32 scores + the fp32 vector (a
+    |s| < 100 score against -1e9 is swamped in fp32 exactly as the kernel's fma swamps it), then the fp64 softmax; the other
+    terms through ``_ref``."""
+    if add is None:
+        return _ref(q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, causal=causal, seq_kv_lens=seq_kv_lens)
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    s_kv = k.shape[2]
+    scores = (torch.matmul(q.double(), k.double().transpose(-1, -2)) * scale).float()
+    if bias is not None:
+        scores = scores + bias.float()
+    scores = (scores + add.float().view(add.shape[0], 1, 1, s_kv)).double()
+    dev = q.device
+    i = torch.arange(s_q, device=dev).view(1, 1, s_q, 1)
+    j = torch.arange(s_kv, device=dev).view(1, 1, 1, s_kv)
+    masked = torch.zeros(1, 1, s_q, s_kv, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev) | (j > i if causal else False)
+    if seq_kv_lens is not None:
+        masked = masked | (j >= seq_kv_lens.flatten().to(torch.int64).view(b, 1, 1, 1))
+    if kv_mask is not None:
+        masked = masked | (~kv_mask.view(kv_mask.shape[0], 1, 1, s_kv))
+    scores = scores.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+    smax = scores.max(dim=-1).values
+    ssum = torch.exp(scores - smax.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=-1)
+    lse = smax + torch.log(ssum)
+    o = torch.matmul(torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0), v.double())
+    return dict(o=o, lse=lse, empty=torch.isneginf(lse))
+
+
+def _inputs(c, dtype=torch.bfloat16, *, seed=0):
+    """Inputs of one cell: BSHD-physical activations (``layout`` = "bhsd" for contiguous (B, H, S, D), "headpad" for a 16-byte
+    padded head stride), an optional bias (per-head; ``bias_perm`` = the [B, S_q, H, S_kv]-physical view; ``bias_row`` = a
+    padded row stride), a bool / additive kv_mask (``add`` = "bf16" / "f32" / "inf" / "full"; ``mask_pad`` = a padded batch stride)."""
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    b, h, s, d = c.get("b", 2), c.get("h", 4), c["s"], c.get("d", 32)
+    layout = c.get("layout", "bshd")
+    if layout == "bhsd":
+        mk = lambda: torch.randn(b, h, s, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)  # noqa: E731
+    elif layout == "headpad":
+        mk = lambda: torch.randn(b, s, h, d + 8, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)[..., :d].transpose(1, 2)  # noqa: E731
+    else:
+        mk = lambda: _bhsd(b, h, s, d, dtype)  # noqa: E731
+    q, k, v = mk(), mk(), mk()
+    bias = None
+    if c.get("bias"):
+        if c.get("bias_perm"):
+            bias = torch.randn(b, s, h, s, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32).to(dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+        else:
+            row = c.get("bias_row", s)
+            bias = torch.randn(1, h, s, row, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32).to(dtype)[..., :s]
+    kv_mask = add = None
+    pad = c.get("mask_pad", 0)
+    keep = torch.rand(b, 1, 1, s + pad, device="cuda") > 0.3
+    if c.get("mask"):
+        kv_mask = keep[..., :s].contiguous() if not pad else keep[..., :s]
+    form = c.get("add")
+    if form is not None:
+        vdt = torch.float32 if form == "f32" else dtype
+        # the finite fold: -1e9 where the dtype holds it (fp32, bf16), the dtype's most negative finite value where it does not (fp16: 65504)
+        fill = float("-inf") if form == "inf" else (-1e9 if torch.finfo(vdt).max > 1e9 else float(torch.finfo(vdt).min))
+        vec = torch.where(keep, torch.zeros((), device="cuda", dtype=vdt), torch.full((), fill, device="cuda", dtype=vdt))
+        if form == "full":
+            vec[1] = -1e9  # batch 1: every key -1e9 -> the eager uniform average, NOT the empty-row contract
+        add = vec[..., :s]
+    kv_lens = torch.tensor(c["kv_lens"], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(b, 1, 1, 1) if "kv_lens" in c else None
+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(d)
+    sdpa_kwargs = dict(use_causal_mask=True) if c.get("causal") else {}
+    return (
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        dict(scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, add=add, keep=keep[..., :s], kv_lens=kv_lens, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, causal=bool(c.get("causal"))),
+    )
+
+
+def _run_cell(c, io, *, tile_n=None, add_as_mask=True):
+    """Run one cell; the additive vector travels as the graph's ``kv_mask`` (``add_as_mask``), the bool one otherwise."""
+    q, k, v, kw = _inputs(c, io)
+    mask_arg = kw["add"] if (kw["add"] is not None and add_as_mask) else kw["kv_mask"]
+    out = _run2(
+        q, k, v, scale=kw["scale"], bias=kw["bias"], kv_mask=mask_arg, sdpa_kwargs=kw["sdpa_kwargs"], seq_len_kv=kw["kv_lens"], cga=c.get("cga"), tile_n=tile_n
+    )
+    ref = _ref_add(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        scale=kw["scale"],
+        bias=kw["bias"],
+        add=kw["add"] if add_as_mask else None,
+        kv_mask=kw["kv_mask"],
+        causal=kw["causal"],
+        seq_kv_lens=kw["kv_lens"],
+    )
+    return out, ref, kw
+
+
+# TILE_N = 64 cells: n_kv = 1 and 6 (bracketing the 64-wide ring) with B*H > 1, a padded tail (200 / 150 of 256: a partial 64-wide
+# tile), the bool mask, both arms under the band + padding, d64 at cga1 and cga2 (the bias at S_kv 256 at cga2 = the 128-wide budget's
+# edge, served at 64 too), the fp16 graph.  (The bias-only 64-wide body is the knob-less pick of test_sdpa_bias_sm107.py's
+# ``dense_nkv1`` / ``d64_dense_128`` cells.)
+_T64_CASES = {
+    "t64_dense_64_nkv1": dict(s=64),
+    "t64_dense_384_nkv6": dict(s=384, h=2),
+    "t64_padded_tail_256": dict(s=256, kv_lens=[200, 150]),
+    "t64_mask_256": dict(s=256, mask=True),
+    "t64_both_causal_padded_384": dict(s=384, h=2, bias=True, mask=True, causal=True, kv_lens=[384, 300]),
+    "t64_d64_both_128_cga1": dict(d=64, s=128, bias=True, mask=True),
+    "t64_d64_both_256_cga2": dict(d=64, s=256, h=2, bias=True, mask=True, cga=2),
+    "t64_f16_both_256": dict(s=256, bias=True, mask=True, io=torch.float16),  # the 64-wide rendering on an fp16 graph
+}

+    rows exactly 0 / -inf, two launches bitwise -- and within the same tolerance of the 128-wide rendering of the same graph

+def test_additive_fully_masked_row_is_the_eager_uniform_average_not_the_empty_row():
+    """A batch whose vector is -1e9 on EVERY key (the models' fold on a padding-only row): the kernel keeps the finite value, so
+    the row is the uniform average of V with Stats ~ -1e9 + ln(S_kv) -- eager math -- while the BOOLEAN all-False twin reads the
+    empty-row contract (O = 0, Stats = -inf); the other batch matches the oracle."""
+    c = dict(s=256, add="full")
+    q, k, v, kw = _inputs(c, torch.bfloat16)
+    out = _run2(q, k, v, scale=kw["scale"], kv_mask=kw["add"])
+    s = 256
+    uniform = v[1].double().mean(dim=-2, keepdim=True).expand(-1, s, -1)  # (H, S_q, D): every row the mean of V over the keys
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out["o"][1].double(), uniform, atol=5e-2, rtol=3e-2)
+    lse1 = out["stats"][1].squeeze(-1).double()
+    folded = kw["add"][1].flatten()[0].double().item()  # the vector's VALUE in its dtype: bf16(-1e9) = -998244352, what the kernel folds
+    assert torch.isfinite(lse1).all() and ((lse1 - (folded + math.log(s))).abs() < 512).all(), f"Stats ~ {folded} + ln(S_kv): the finite fold, not -inf"
+    ref = _ref_add(q, k, v, scale=kw["scale"], add=kw["add"])
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out["o"][0].double(), ref["o"][0], **_TOL_O)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out["stats"][0].squeeze(-1).double(), ref["lse"][0], **_TOL_LSE)
+    keep = kw["keep"].clone()

+def _no_frost_service(g):
+    """Assert the graph is NOT served by the FROST row and say where the typed decline fell: at plan-list time (no FROST plan, or no
+    plan at all) or at check_support / build time (the plan list offered the row, the build refused it).  A plan that BUILDS fails
+    the test -- the kernel must never run on these operands."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    try:
+        g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    except cudnn.cudnnGraphNotSupportedError as exc:
+        return f"list: {exc}"
+    names, ours = _frost_plans(g)
+    if not ours:
+        return f"list: no FROST plan in {names}"
+    g.select_plan(ours[0])
+    with pytest.raises((cudnn.cudnnGraphNotSupportedError, NotImplementedError, ValueError, RuntimeError)) as excinfo:
+        g.check_support()
+        g.build_plans()

+# The padding leg's measured pathology: at TILE_N 128 the padded PLAIN rendering runs the tail kv tile through a SECOND, software-max

+# the per-SM instruction-cache cliff), so an S_kv off the tile multiple costs MORE than the dense next size up and more than the same
+# shape WITH a kv_mask (whose -inf body is one body).  Form 1 = the pre-masked tail: ONE loop with the HW-max body, the tail tile's
+# out-of-range S columns rewritten as -inf in TMEM before the fused max load.  The pins: the eligibility (one arithmetic for the
+# config pick, the factory and the adapter), the typed declines, the rendering (one body: the dense rendering's exp count, no
+# software row max, the bit-word pre-mask, no new spills), and the GPU cells against the fp64 oracle and the legacy form.

+        cfg_mod._DEAD_SUBTILE_QUIET_OVERRIDE_FOR_SWEEPS = 0
+        out0, _, _ = _run_cell(cc, io)
+    finally:
+        cfg_mod._DEAD_SUBTILE_QUIET_OVERRIDE_FOR_SWEEPS = saved_q
+    _check(out1, ref)
+    _check(out0, ref)
+    assert torch.equal(out1["o"], out0["o"]), f"{case}: the quiet body changed a stored O row"
+    assert torch.equal(out1["stats"], out0["stats"]), f"{case}: the quiet body changed a stored Stats row"
+
+
+# The per-batch Q TRIM under the quiet body, knob-less (the Rubin twin of the SM100 line's detector, test_sdpa_bias_sm100.py).  Under
+# bottom-right causal -- the one form under which the per-batch Q length reaches the softmax's dead-sub-tile decision -- the rows in
+# [seq_len_q[b], S_q) of a dead sub-tile ARE stored, and the trim must write them as EXACT zeros through a SELECT after the scale (this
+# file's epilogue selects ``_kv_empty | row_trim``; a zero folded into ``inv_sum`` would be ``NaN x 0 = NaN`` wherever the quiet sub-tile's
+# BMM2 read a NaN residue out of the S slot).  On this line the quiet body is the PLAIN padded body's default (the kv_mask + padded
+# 128-wide plan keeps the full body: ``SM107_DEAD_SUBTILE_QUIET_DEFAULT_KV_MASK_PADDED_WIDE``), so the cell is the plain body at the
+# heuristics' own width and pick: D 32, S_q = S_kv = 640, per-batch Q = KV lengths [640, 300] -- item 1 (rows 256..511) keeps sub-tile 0
+# live and sub-tile 1 (rows 384..511) dead AND stored; item 2 collapses.
+_TRIM_CASE = dict(b=2, h=2, s=640, q_lens=[640, 300], kv_lens=[640, 300])
+_TRIM_DEAD_ROWS = (1, 384, 512)  # (batch, lo, hi): the quiet sub-tile's STORED rows
+
+
+@requires_rubin
+def test_quiet_body_under_per_batch_q_lengths_stores_zero_on_trimmed_rows_sm107(monkeypatch):
+    """The knob-less plan takes the quiet body (the spy on the pick reads 1 for the executed width) and the quiet sub-tile's stored rows
+    read finite, exactly +0 / -inf; every trimmed row 0 / -inf; the whole tensor against the fp64 oracle; two launches bitwise --
+    asserted in that order, so a residue would be reported as what it is."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import api_dsl
+
+    calls = []
+    real = api_dsl._sm107_dead_subtile_quiet_pick
+
+    def spy(*a, **kw):
+        r = real(*a, **kw)
+        calls.append((int(kw.get("tile_n", 128)), int(r)))
+        return r
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(api_dsl, "_sm107_dead_subtile_quiet_pick", spy)
+    c = _TRIM_CASE
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    b, h, s, d = c["b"], c["h"], c["s"], 32
+    q, k, v = (_bhsd(b, h, s, d, torch.bfloat16) for _ in range(3))
+    q_lens = torch.tensor(c["q_lens"], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    kv_lens = torch.tensor(c["kv_lens"], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(d)
+    out = _run2(q, k, v, scale=scale, sdpa_kwargs=dict(use_causal_mask_bottom_right=True), seq_len_kv=kv_lens, seq_len_q=q_lens, two_launch_assert=False)
+    assert any(r == 1 and t == out["executed_tile_n"] for t, r in calls), f"the knob-less plan did not take the quiet body: {calls}"
+    o, st = out["o"], out["stats"].squeeze(-1)
+    bb, lo, hi = _TRIM_DEAD_ROWS
+    rows = o[bb, :, lo:hi, :]
+    n_bad = int((~torch.isfinite(rows)).sum())
+    assert n_bad == 0, f"{n_bad} non-finite elements in the quiet sub-tile's stored rows O[{bb}, :, {lo}:{hi}] (a residue reached the store)"
+    assert bool((rows.view(torch.int16) == 0).all()), f"the quiet sub-tile's stored rows O[{bb}, :, {lo}:{hi}] are not exactly +0"
+    q_len = c["q_lens"][bb]
+    assert bool((o[bb, :, q_len:, :].view(torch.int16) == 0).all()) and bool(torch.isneginf(st[bb, :, q_len:]).all()), "the trimmed rows: O = +0, Stats = -inf"
+    _check(out, _ref(q, k, v, scale=scale, causal=True, bottom_right=True, seq_q_lens=q_lens, seq_kv_lens=kv_lens))
+    assert torch.equal(out["o"], out["o_first"]) and torch.equal(out["stats"], out["stats_first"]), "two-launch delta on O / Stats"

+"""Prevent production forward fallback and implicit backward binder ownership."""
+
+import ast
+import inspect
+from dataclasses import replace
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import prepared
+from test_sdpa_native_bwd_binding import _fixture
+
+pytestmark = [pytest.mark.L0]
+
+
+# The dense python frame (``bind_dense`` / ``bind_dense_split``) is production code for exactly the plans the native binder has
+# no slots for -- the score side outputs and the resident-block bias / ``kv_mask`` arms, where ``build_dense_spec`` leaves
+# ``native`` None -- and for nothing else: a plan with a native binder takes it and returns before the frame is reached.
+_PYTHON_FRAME_FOR_UNBOUND_ARMS = ("bind_dense", "bind_dense_split")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["bind_dense", "bind_dense_split", "bind_thd", "_bind_thd_python", "execute_thd", "execute_quantized"])
+def test_forward_python_framing_is_test_only(name):
+    if name in _PYTHON_FRAME_FOR_UNBOUND_ARMS:
+        src = inspect.getsource(prepared.PreparedDenseLaunch.execute)
+        native_first = src.index("if self.spec.native is not None:")
+        native_return = src.index("return", src.index("self.spec.native.execute(", native_first))
+        assert src.index(name + "(") > native_return, f"{name} must sit behind the native binder, never beside it (no production fallback)"
+        return
+    assert not hasattr(prepared, name), f"{name} must remain a test-only oracle"
+
+
+def test_production_does_not_import_binding_oracles():
+    for path in Path(prepared.__file__).parents[1].rglob("*.py"):
+        for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(path.read_text())):
+            if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+                assert "binding_reference" not in (node.module or ""), path
+            elif isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+                assert all("binding_reference" not in alias.name for alias in node.names), path
+
+
+def test_backward_host_must_explicitly_choose_its_binder():
+    spec, _, _, _, _ = _fixture()
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.prepared import BwdLaunchSpec
+
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="native_binding"):
+        BwdLaunchSpec(spec.artifact, spec.fn, spec.operands, spec.workspace_bytes, spec.device_index, spec.scale)
+    assert spec.native_binding is False and spec.native is None
+    assert replace(spec, native_binding=True).native is not None

+"""Build-all must prepare both providers without losing the selected plan."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from cudnn.engines import is_backend_engine
+from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.engines import engine_name
+from frost_test_utils import _SM, requires_dsl, select_engine
+
+pytestmark = [pytest.mark.L0, requires_dsl, pytest.mark.skipif(_SM not in (90, 100, 103), reason="native/FROST SDPA parity on Hopper and Blackwell")]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("selected_provider", ["backend", "frost"])
+def test_build_all_preserves_selection_and_executes_both_providers(selected_provider, monkeypatch):
+    import cudnn
+
+    # Hopper exposes the d512 FROST template; Blackwell also serves d128.
+    head_dim = 512 if _SM == 90 else 128
+    q = torch.zeros(1, 128, 2, head_dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16).transpose(1, 2)
+    k = torch.zeros_like(q)
+    # With zero logits, the exact answer is the mean of each V head.
+    v = ((torch.arange(q.numel(), device="cuda") % 7).reshape(1, 128, 2, head_dim) / 8).half().transpose(1, 2)
+    o = torch.empty_like(q)
+    expected = v.float().mean(dim=2, keepdim=True).expand_as(o)
+
+    def make_graph():
+        g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.HALF, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+        qt, kt, vt = [g.tensor_like(t) for t in (q, k, v)]
+        ot, _ = g.sdpa(q=qt, k=kt, v=vt, generate_stats=False, attn_scale=1.0)
+        ot.set_output(True).set_dim(list(o.shape)).set_stride(list(o.stride()))
+        g.validate()
+        g.build_operation_graph()
+        return g, {qt: q, kt: k, vt: v, ot: o}
+
+    source, _ = make_graph()
+    source.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    native = None
+    for i in range(source.get_execution_plan_count()):
+        record = source.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(i)
+        if not is_backend_engine(record[0]):
+            continue
+        try:
+            source.build_plan_at_index(i)
+        except cudnn.cudnnGraphNotSupportedError:
+            continue
+        native = record
+        break
+    assert native is not None, "the representative graph must offer a buildable backend plan"
+    select_engine(source, engine_name(arch="sm90" if _SM == 90 else "sm100"))
+    frost = source.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(source._plan_index)
+    source.build_plans()
+
+    # Put the selected provider second so ALL must go back to the first entry.
+    records = [native, frost] if selected_provider == "frost" else [frost, native]
+    graph, bindings = make_graph()
+    for engine, knobs in records:
+        graph.create_execution_plan(engine, knobs)
+    graph.select_plan(1)
+    graph.build_plans(cudnn.build_plan_policy.ALL)
+    assert graph._plan_index == 1
+    assert graph.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(1) == records[1]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(graph, "_build_plan_at", lambda *a, **kw: pytest.fail("ALL left a candidate unbuilt"))
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(1, *(graph.get_workspace_size_plan_at_index(i) for i in range(2))), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    for index in (0, 1):
+        o.fill_(float("nan"))
+        graph.execute_plan_at_index(bindings, workspace, index=index)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(o.float(), expected, atol=5e-4, rtol=0)
+    # At-index execution must not change the caller's selection either.
+    assert graph._plan_index == 1
+    o.fill_(float("nan"))
+    graph.execute(bindings, workspace)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(o.float(), expected, atol=5e-4, rtol=0)

+def _run(case, body, repeats=2, **fields):
+    api = _BODIES[body](case, **fields)
+    workspace = make_workspace(api.scratch_workspace_bytes())
+    for _ in range(repeats):
+        poison(case, workspace)

+def _grads(case):
+    return {role: case.tensors[role][0].detach().clone() for role in ("dq", "dk", "dv")}

+def _max_err(case, grads, role):
+    """(max abs error, max error in bf16 ulps at the reference magnitude) of ``role`` over the live rows against the fp64 oracle sequences."""
+    worst_abs, worst_ulp = 0.0, 0.0
+    lens = case.lens_q if role == "dq" else case.lens_kv
+    for i, (start, length) in enumerate(zip(case.origins[role], lens, strict=True)):
+        if not length:
+            continue
+        got, ref = grads[role][start : start + length].float().cpu(), case.sequences[i][role].float()
+        err = (got - ref).abs()
+        ulp = torch.ldexp(torch.ones_like(ref), torch.floor(torch.log2(ref.abs().clamp_min(2.0**-126))) - 7)  # one bf16 ulp at |ref|
+        worst_abs = max(worst_abs, float(err.max()))
+        worst_ulp = max(worst_ulp, float((err / ulp).max()))
+    return worst_abs, worst_ulp

+"""BF16 grouped d128 backward: native partial storage and FP32 group reduction.
+
+Graph cases pin engine 20609. Regular numerics use the unchanged independent
+FP64 gates; the exact-P cancellation test separately pins documented native
+partial rounding. GPU KV carriers contain Hkv heads, never replicated Hq data.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import cudnn
+from d128_grouped_test_utils import (
+    GRADS,
+    adapter_arguments,
+    cancellation_sequences,
+    check_case,

+_DTYPES = [torch.bfloat16]

+def _graph_case(case):
+    graph, refs = make_graph(case)
+    return graph, refs, variant_pack(case, refs), make_workspace(graph.get_workspace_size())
+
+
+def _stable_kv(case, previous=None):
+    current = {role: case.tensors[role].cpu().view(torch.int16) for role in ("dk", "dv")}
+    if previous is not None:
+        for role in current:
+            assert torch.equal(current[role], previous[role]), f"{role}: fixed-order group reduction changed output bits"
+    return current
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "hq,hkv,dtype,causal,thd",
+    [
+        (4, 2, torch.bfloat16, False, False),
+        (6, 2, torch.bfloat16, True, False),
+        (3, 1, torch.bfloat16, False, False),
+        (8, 1, torch.bfloat16, True, False),
+        (4, 2, torch.bfloat16, True, True),
+        (6, 2, torch.bfloat16, False, True),
+        (3, 1, torch.bfloat16, True, True),

+    ],
+)
+def test_grouped_matrix(hq, hkv, dtype, causal, thd):
+    _require_accumulation()
+    # Pair each head ratio with a different storage contract, rather than
+    # repeating the entire MHA storage Cartesian matrix for every ratio.
+    layout, offset_dtype, units = {
+        (4, 2): ("TH1", torch.int32, "tokens"),
+        (6, 2): ("HN", torch.int64, "elements"),
+        (3, 1): ("TH1", torch.int64, "elements"),
+        (8, 1): ("HN", torch.int32, "tokens"),
+    }[hq, hkv]
+    lq, lk = ((129, 0, 127, 1), (65, 128, 0, 3)) if thd else ((128, 128), (256, 256))
+    case = make_case(lq, lk, hq=hq, hkv=hkv, thd=thd, dtype=dtype, causal=causal, stats_layout=layout, offset_dtype=offset_dtype, units=units)
+    graph, _, pack, workspace = _graph_case(case)
+    stable = None
+    for _ in range(2):
+        poison(case, workspace)
+        graph.execute(pack, workspace.tensor)
+        check_case(case, workspace)
+        stable = _stable_kv(case, stable)
+

+        ) from None
+    return proc.returncode, out, err

+def _run(
+    b=2,
+    hq=2,
+    hkv=None,
+    sq=512,
+    skv=512,
+    dt=torch.bfloat16,
+    keep=None,
+    omit_scale=False,
+    seed=0,
+    poison=None,
+    runs=1,
+    seq_lens=None,
+    ws_poison=None,
+    attn_scale=None,
+    **sdpa_kwargs,
+):
+    """The sm107 suite's driver with THIS row pinned: build, pin, execute ``runs`` times, hand back every run's (dQ, dK, dV)
+    plus the fp64 oracle.  Inputs unit-normal on a CPU generator; ``poison`` pre-fills the outputs, ``ws_poison`` (a byte)
+    the WORKSPACE before every run; ``attn_scale`` None = 1/sqrt(d) on graph and oracle alike.  ``omit_scale`` leaves
+    attn_scale off the graph (no scaling, 1.0) and pre-scales Q by 1/sqrt(d) so the logits keep their usual range."""
+    from test_sdpa_bwd_dsl_sm107 import _Run
+
+    hkv = hq if hkv is None else hkv
+    group = hq // hkv
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+
+    def draw(bb, s, h):
+        return torch.randn(bb, s, h, _D, generator=gen).to(device="cuda", dtype=dt).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
+
+    q, do = draw(b, sq, hq), draw(b, sq, hq)
+    k, v = draw(b, skv, hkv), draw(b, skv, hkv)
+    if omit_scale:
+        q.mul_(_D**-0.5)
+    if seq_lens is not None:
+        keep = _padded_keep(sq, skv, *seq_lens) if keep is None else (keep & _padded_keep(sq, skv, *seq_lens))
+    o64, lse64, all_masked, dq_r, dk_r, dv_r = _reference64(q, k, v, do, keep, group, scale=1.0 if omit_scale else attn_scale)
+    o = _bshd_empty(b, sq, hq, _D, dt)
+    o.copy_(o64.to(dt))
+    lse = lse64.float()
+    if all_masked is not None:
+        lse = lse.masked_fill(all_masked, 0.0)
+    if seq_lens is not None:
+        sdpa_kwargs["padded"] = True
+    graph_scale = None if omit_scale else ("default" if attn_scale is None else attn_scale)
+    g, t, (dq_t, dk_t, dv_t) = _build_graph(b=b, hq=hq, hkv=hkv, sq=sq, skv=skv, dt=dt, scale=graph_scale, **sdpa_kwargs)
+    select_engine(g, _ENGINE)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    assert g._compiled_plans[g._plan_index]._prepared is not None, "the row lowers through the prepared-launch contract"
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    dq, dk, dv = _bshd_empty(b, sq, hq, _D, dt), _bshd_empty(b, skv, hkv, _D, dt), _bshd_empty(b, skv, hkv, _D, dt)
+    pack = {t["q"]: q, t["k"]: k, t["v"]: v, t["o"]: o, t["do"]: do, t["stats"]: lse.unsqueeze(-1).contiguous(), dq_t: dq, dk_t: dk, dv_t: dv}
+    if seq_lens is not None:
+        pack[t["seq_len_q"]] = torch.tensor(seq_lens[0], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+        pack[t["seq_len_kv"]] = torch.tensor(seq_lens[1], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    outs = []
+    for _ in range(runs):
+        if poison is not None:
+            for x in (dq, dk, dv):
+                x.fill_(poison)
+        if ws_poison is not None:
+            ws.fill_(ws_poison)
+        g.execute(pack, ws)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        outs.append(tuple(x.clone() for x in (dq, dk, dv)))
+    return _Run(outs, (dq_r, dk_r, dv_r), dt)
+

+def _prepared_case(dt=torch.bfloat16, causal=True, b=2, hq=4, hkv=2, sq=512, skv=512, seed=0):
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    group = hq // hkv
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+
+    def draw(bb, s_, h):
+        return torch.randn(bb, s_, h, _D, generator=gen).to(device="cuda", dtype=dt).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
+
+    q, do, k, v = draw(b, sq, hq), draw(b, sq, hq), draw(b, skv, hkv), draw(b, skv, hkv)
+    keep = _causal_keep(sq, skv) if causal else None
+    o64, lse64, all_masked, dq_r, dk_r, dv_r = _reference64(q, k, v, do, keep, group)
+    o = _bshd_empty(b, sq, hq, _D, dt)
+    o.copy_(o64.to(dt))
+    lse = lse64.float()
+    if all_masked is not None:
+        lse = lse.masked_fill(all_masked, 0.0)
+    kw = dict(use_causal_mask=True) if causal else {}
+    g, t, (dq_t, dk_t, dv_t) = _build_graph(b=b, hq=hq, hkv=hkv, sq=sq, skv=skv, dt=dt, scale="default", **kw)
+    select_engine(g, _ENGINE)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8).fill_(0xBD)
+    tensors = dict(q=q, k=k, v=v, o=o, do=do, stats=lse.unsqueeze(-1).contiguous())
+    tensors.update(
+        dq=_bshd_empty(b, sq, hq, _D, dt, fill=float("nan")),
+        dk=_bshd_empty(b, skv, hkv, _D, dt, fill=float("nan")),
+        dv=_bshd_empty(b, skv, hkv, _D, dt, fill=float("nan")),
+    )
+    refs = dict(q=t["q"], k=t["k"], v=t["v"], o=t["o"], do=t["do"], stats=t["stats"], dq=dq_t, dk=dk_t, dv=dv_t)
+    pack = {refs[name]: value for name, value in tensors.items()}
+    g.execute(pack, ws)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    case = SimpleNamespace(
+        graph=g,
+        refs=refs,
+        tensors=tensors,
+        pack=pack,
+        workspace=ws,
+        keep=keep,
+        group=group,
+        dt=dt,
+        expected=(dq_r, dk_r, dv_r),
+        b=b,
+        hq=hq,
+        hkv=hkv,
+        sq=sq,
+        skv=skv,
+        causal=causal,
+    )
+    assert g._compiled_plans[g._plan_index]._prepared is not None, "the row must lower through the prepared-launch contract"
+    _check_prepared(case)
+    return case
+
+
+def _check_prepared(case, tensors=None, expected=None):
+    tensors = case.tensors if tensors is None else tensors
+    expected = case.expected if expected is None else expected
+    for name, key, want in zip(("dQ", "dK", "dV"), ("dq", "dk", "dv"), expected):
+        _check(name, tensors[key], want, case.dt)
+

+@requires_pre_rubin_blackwell
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dt", _DTYPES, ids=_DTYPE_IDS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("causal", [False, True])
+def test_prepared_rebind_stream_and_replay(dt, causal):
+    """The plan's prepared launch rebinds fresh buffers, follows the HANDLE's stream (not the ambient one) and captures
+    into a CUDA graph whose replay recomputes new inputs -- the contract every prepared backward shares (the sm107 pin,
+    verbatim: the capture runs on the handle's stream, the launch is issued from ANOTHER ambient stream)."""
+    case = _prepared_case(dt=dt, causal=causal)
+    tensors = {name: value.clone() for name, value in case.tensors.items()}
+    pack = {case.refs[name]: value for name, value in tensors.items()}
+    workspace = torch.empty_like(case.workspace).fill_(0xBD)
+    stream, other = torch.cuda.Stream(), torch.cuda.Stream()
+    handle = cudnn.create_handle()
+    cudnn.set_stream(handle, stream.cuda_stream)
+    capture = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+
+    def refresh():
+        tensors["q"].mul_(0.75)
+        tensors["do"].mul_(1.25)
+        o64, lse64, all_masked, dq, dk, dv = _reference64(tensors["q"], tensors["k"], tensors["v"], tensors["do"], case.keep, case.group)
+        tensors["o"].copy_(o64.to(dt))
+        lse = lse64.float()
+        if all_masked is not None:
+            lse = lse.masked_fill(all_masked, 0.0)
+        tensors["stats"].copy_(lse.unsqueeze(-1))
+        for name in ("dq", "dk", "dv"):
+            tensors[name].fill_(float("nan"))
+        workspace.fill_(0xBD)
+        return dq, dk, dv
+
+    try:
+        expected = refresh()
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        other.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(other):
+            case.graph.execute(pack, workspace, handle=handle)
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+        _check_prepared(case, tensors, expected)
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.graph(capture, stream=stream):
+            with torch.cuda.stream(other):
+                case.graph.execute(pack, workspace, handle=handle)
+        expected = refresh()
+        capture.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        _check_prepared(case, tensors, expected)
+    finally:
+        capture.reset()
+        cudnn.destroy_handle(handle)

+    params = TemplateParams(dtype_qkv=DTYPE_BF16, datapath_2x2_profile=profile, **MASKS[mask])
+    mod = load_template(_sm100_kernel_path("bprop_d256_2x2_f16.py"), params, tag=f"sass_2x2_{arch}_p{profile}_" + mask)
+    print("SASS SOFTMAX_REGS", mod.CFG.SOFTMAX_REGS)
+    print("SASS OTHER_REGS", mod.CFG.OTHER_REGS)
+    slot_cols = mod.LAYOUT.S_COLS  # one S / dP accumulator slot = 64 TMEM columns (the 2x2 D atom); dV is a separate base
+    print("SASS SLOT_COLS", slot_cols)
+    mod.compile(b=1, qh=8, kh=8, sq=1024, skv=1024)
+    cubins = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(dump, "*.cubin")), key=os.path.getmtime)
+    if not cubins:
+        print("FAIL no cubin dumped into", dump, os.listdir(dump)); sys.exit(3)
+    nvd = None
+    for c in cands:
+        try:
+            proc = subprocess.run([c, "-c", cubins[-1]], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
+        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
+            print("REJECT", c, "->", repr(exc)); continue
+        if proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout.strip():

+        print("REJECT", c, "->", (proc.stderr.strip().splitlines() or [str(proc.returncode)])[-1])
+    if nvd is None:
+        print("SKIP no nvdisasm candidate decodes the cubin"); sys.exit(0)
+    sass = subprocess.run([nvd, "-c", cubins[-1]], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.splitlines()
+    def cnt(*subs):
+        return sum(1 for ln in sass if all(sb in ln for sb in subs))
+    for k, subs in (("USETMAXREG", ("USETMAXREG",)), ("STL", ("STL",)), ("LDL", ("LDL",)), ("MEMBAR_GPU", ("MEMBAR.ALL.GPU",)), ("CGAERRBAR", ("CGAERRBAR",)),
+                    ("UTCHMMA", ("UTCHMMA",)), ("LDTM", ("LDTM",)), ("STTM", ("STTM",)), ("UTCCP", ("UTCCP",)), ("R2P", (" R2P",)), ("MUFU_EX2", ("MUFU.EX2",))):

+    print("SASS LINES", len(sass))
+    alloc = [int(ln.split(",")[-1].strip(" ;"), 16) for ln in sass if "USETMAXREG.TRY_ALLOC" in ln]
+    dealloc = [int(ln.split()[-2], 16) for ln in sass if "USETMAXREG.DEALLOC" in ln]
+    print("SASS USETMAXREG_ALLOC", alloc[0] if alloc else -1)
+    print("SASS USETMAXREG_DEALLOC", dealloc[0] if dealloc else -1)
+    INS = re.compile(r"^\s+/\*([0-9a-f]+)\*/\s+(?:(@!?U?P[0-9T]+)\s+)?([A-Z][A-Z0-9_.]*)\s*(.*?)\s*;")

+        m = INS.match(ln)

+def _batch_pitch_case(sq, sk, kv_heads, dt, seed):

+    q, k, v = [view(cpu[role], role).double().requires_grad_() for role in ("q", "k", "v")]

+    values = {role: view(base, role) for role, base in bases.items()}
+    values["stats"] = lse.detach().float().unsqueeze(-1).contiguous().cuda()

+        k=refs["k"],
+        v=refs["v"],
+        o=refs["o"],
+        dO=refs["do"],
+        stats=refs["stats"],
+        attn_scale=256**-0.5,
+        use_causal_mask_bottom_right=True,
