+    branch) and never onto the two polled barriers (the three ``poll=_KV_SHARED`` sites stay); the mbarrier init ledger of the
+    SM100 body (every init a named CFG constant); Rule 6 on both kernels; plain launches, no exclusive TMEM, no row reduction."""

+    assert re.search(r"if cutlass\.const_expr\(poll\):\n\s+_poll_wait\(mb, phase\)\n\s+else:\n\s+wait\(mb, phase, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS\)", code)

+    assert sorted(polled) == ["empty", "empty", "full"] and src.count("poll=_KV_SHARED,") == 3, polled

+# The code lines the fork may ADD / REMOVE relative to the SM100 body (strings and comments blanked first, so the docstring
+# and the _require messages do not count).  Any other difference between the two files fails: a fix landed in one sibling
+# only, or an unlisted body delta.
+# The condition lines of the fork's three MULTI-LINE `_require(` blocks (opener / condition / blanked message / `)`): the
+# generic opener, message and paren patterns below are anchored to these in the test, so a fourth three-line
+# `_require(<anything>)` cannot ride in on them.
+_FORK_REQUIRE_CONDITIONS = (
+    r"^    _LAST_DESC_ROOT \+ vBytesPerStage == TCGEN05_V0_ADDR_LIMIT_2X2,$",
+    r"^    CFG\.STAGES_KV == RUBIN_ARM\[",
+    r"^    CFG\.SMEM_CAP_BYTES == SM107_USABLE_DYN_SMEM_2X2 and smem_bytes_2x2\(CFG\) == 320 \* 1024,$",
+)
+_FORK_ADDED = (
+    r"^RUBIN_ARM = dict\(",
+    r"^PARAMS: TemplateParams = globals\(\)\.get\(\s*, TemplateParams2x2\(\*\*RUBIN_ARM\)\)$",  # the string literal is blanked
+    r"^    SM107_USABLE_DYN_SMEM_2X2,$",
+    r"^    TCGEN05_V0_ADDR_LIMIT_2X2,$",
+    r"^    desc_roots_2x2,$",
+    r"^SPIN_RING_WAITS: bool = False$",
+    r"^            wait\(mb, phase, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS\)$",
+    r"^DESC_VERSION: int = 0$",
+    r"^_require\(desc_version_2x2\(CFG\) == DESC_VERSION, ",
+    r"^_LAST_DESC_ROOT = max\(",
+    r"^_require\($",
+    *_FORK_REQUIRE_CONDITIONS,
+    r"^\s*,$",  # the blanked f-string message line of a multi-line _require
+    r"^\)$",
+)
+_FORK_REMOVED = (
+    r"^PARAMS: TemplateParams = globals\(\)\.get\(\s*, TemplateParams2x2\(\)\)$",
+    r"^            wait\(mb, phase\)$",
+    r"^DESC_VERSION: int = desc_version_2x2\(CFG\)$",
+)
+# The fork's whole delta, counted: 22 added / 3 removed code lines (3 imports, RUBIN_ARM, PARAMS, SPIN_RING_WAITS + its one
+# site, DESC_VERSION + its one-line _require, _LAST_DESC_ROOT, three 4-line _require blocks).  A new delta changes the count.
+_FORK_DELTA_LINES = (22, 3)
+
+
+def test_fork_code_diff_is_only_the_listed_deltas():
+    """``diff sm100/ sm107/`` is the review surface: with strings and comments blanked, every added or removed CODE line of the
+    fork matches one allowlisted delta pattern.  A change to either sibling that is not mirrored (or a new body delta that is
+    not listed here and in the fork's docstring) fails this test."""
+    a = [ln.rstrip() for ln in _code_only(_source(_SM100_FILE)).splitlines()]
+    b = [ln.rstrip() for ln in _code_only(_source(_FORK_FILE)).splitlines()]
+    added, removed = [], []
+    for ln in difflib.unified_diff(a, b, lineterm="", n=0):
+        if ln.startswith(("+++", "---", "@@")) or not ln[1:].strip():
+            continue
+        (added if ln[0] == "+" else removed).append(ln[1:])
+    bad_add = [ln for ln in added if not any(re.match(p, ln) for p in _FORK_ADDED)]
+    bad_rm = [ln for ln in removed if not any(re.match(p, ln) for p in _FORK_REMOVED)]
+    assert not bad_add and not bad_rm, f"unlisted deltas between the SM100 body and the fork:\n+ {bad_add}\n- {bad_rm}"
+    assert added and removed, "the fork must differ from the SM100 body in exactly the listed lines (it does not differ at all?)"
+    # Anchor the generic patterns: every `_require(` opener is followed by one of the listed condition lines, a blanked
+    # message line and the closing paren, and the three generic patterns match exactly as many lines as there are openers.
+    openers = [i for i, ln in enumerate(added) if re.match(r"^_require\($", ln)]
+    for i in openers:
+        block = added[i : i + 4]
+        assert len(block) == 4 and any(re.match(p, block[1]) for p in _FORK_REQUIRE_CONDITIONS), f"unanchored multi-line _require: {block}"
+        assert re.match(r"^\s*,$", block[2]) and block[3] == ")", f"unanchored multi-line _require: {block}"
+    assert len(openers) == len(_FORK_REQUIRE_CONDITIONS) == sum(bool(re.match(r"^\s*,$", ln)) for ln in added) == sum(ln == ")" for ln in added), openers
+    assert (len(added), len(removed)) == _FORK_DELTA_LINES, (
+        f"the fork's delta is exactly {_FORK_DELTA_LINES[0]} added / {_FORK_DELTA_LINES[1]} removed code lines, got {len(added)} / {len(removed)}: "
+        "a new delta must be listed in the fork's docstring, in _FORK_ADDED / _FORK_REMOVED and in _FORK_DELTA_LINES"
+    )

+def _ptx_probe(tmp_path, arch, record, timeout=1500):
+    dump = tmp_path / f"{arch}_fork_{record}"
+    dump.mkdir()
+    script = dump / "ptx_probe.py"
+    script.write_text(_STAGE2_PTX_PROBE)
+    kw = dict(dtype_qkv=2, kernel_file=_FORK_FILE, twin=True, **_rubin_arm(), **_S2_MASKS[record])
+    import json
+
+    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script), str(dump), arch, json.dumps(kw)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
+    assert proc.returncode == 0, f"{arch} trace-compile of the fork ({record}) failed:\n{proc.stdout[-3000:]}\n{proc.stderr[-3000:]}"
+    return dict(ln.split(maxsplit=1) for ln in proc.stdout.splitlines() if ln.startswith(("PTX_MD5", "CLUSTER_Q_ROWS", "DESC_VERSION", "N_CHUNKS")))

+def _parse_md5_record_2x2(f):
+    dsl, want = None, {}
+    for ln in f.read_text().splitlines():
+        if ln.startswith("dsl="):
+            dsl = ln[len("dsl=") :].strip()
+        m = re.match(r"stage2_2x2 sm_107a (\S+) rc=0 ptx_md5=([0-9a-f]{32})", ln)
+        if m:
+            want[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
+    return dsl, want

+# =========================================================================== GPU accept: the chain against the fp64 oracle, engine PINNED

+def _run(b=2, hq=2, hkv=None, sq=512, skv=512, d=_D, dt=torch.bfloat16, keep=None, omit_scale=False, seed=0, poison=None, runs=1, **sdpa_kwargs):
+    """The sm107 suite's driver with THIS row pinned: build, pin, execute ``runs`` times, hand back every run's (dQ, dK, dV)
+    plus the fp64 oracle.  Inputs unit-normal on a CPU generator (the dataset does not depend on the GPU's SM count)."""
+    hkv = hq if hkv is None else hkv
+    group = hq // hkv
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+
+    def draw(bb, s, h):
+        return (torch.randn(bb, s, h, d, generator=gen) * 0.5).to(device="cuda", dtype=dt).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
+
+    q, do = draw(b, sq, hq), draw(b, sq, hq)
+    k, v = draw(b, skv, hkv), draw(b, skv, hkv)
+    if omit_scale:  # attn_scale off the graph = no scaling (1.0); pre-scaled Q keeps the logits in their usual range
+        q.mul_(d**-0.5)
+    o64, lse64, all_masked, dq_r, dk_r, dv_r = _reference64(q, k, v, do, keep, group, scale=1.0 if omit_scale else None)
+    o = _bshd_empty(b, sq, hq, d, dt)
+    o.copy_(o64.to(dt))
+    lse = lse64.float()
+    if all_masked is not None:
+        lse = lse.masked_fill(all_masked, 0.0)
+    g, t, (dq_t, dk_t, dv_t) = _build_graph(b=b, hq=hq, hkv=hkv, sq=sq, skv=skv, d=d, dt=dt, scale=None if omit_scale else "default", **sdpa_kwargs)
+    select_engine(g, _ENGINE)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    assert g._compiled_plans[g._plan_index]._prepared is not None, "the row lowers through the prepared-launch contract"
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    dq, dk, dv = _bshd_empty(b, sq, hq, d, dt), _bshd_empty(b, skv, hkv, d, dt), _bshd_empty(b, skv, hkv, d, dt)
+    pack = {t["q"]: q, t["k"]: k, t["v"]: v, t["o"]: o, t["do"]: do, t["stats"]: lse.unsqueeze(-1).contiguous(), dq_t: dq, dk_t: dk, dv_t: dv}
+    outs = []
+    for _ in range(runs):
+        if poison is not None:
+            for x in (dq, dk, dv):
+                x.fill_(poison)
+        g.execute(pack, ws)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        outs.append(tuple(x.clone() for x in (dq, dk, dv)))
+    run = _Run(outs, (dq_r, dk_r, dv_r), dt)
+    # For the launch-count pins: one more execute of the SAME plan over the same pack; ``outputs`` are the live dQ / dK / dV.
+    run.execute = lambda: g.execute(pack, ws)
+    run.outputs = (dq, dk, dv)
+    return run

+def _direct_capture(Adapter, tensors, *, b, hq, hkv, sq, skv, dt, akw):
+    """Construct ``Adapter`` directly (no engine row admits the SM100 body on cc 10.7), compile, execute once into NaN-poisoned
+    outputs and a byte-poisoned workspace; return int16 views of dQ / dK / dV and the S / dS workspace regions + the stage-2
+    file that served."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd import api_dsl
+
+    served = []
+    original = api_dsl.load_template
+
+    def spy(path, params, tag="template"):
+        if "stage2" in tag:
+            served.append(path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
+        return original(path, params, tag)
+
+    with patch.object(api_dsl, "load_template", spy):
+        d = _D
+        dq, dk, dv = _bshd_empty(b, sq, hq, d, dt, float("nan")), _bshd_empty(b, skv, hkv, d, dt, float("nan")), _bshd_empty(b, skv, hkv, d, dt, float("nan"))
+        api = Adapter(
+            sample_q=tensors["q"],
+            sample_k=tensors["k"],
+            sample_v=tensors["v"],
+            sample_o=tensors["o"],
+            sample_do=tensors["do"],
+            sample_stats=tensors["stats"],
+            sample_dq=dq,
+            sample_dk=dk,
+            sample_dv=dv,
+            scale_softmax=1.0 / math.sqrt(d),
+            **akw,
+        )
+        api.check_support()
+        api.compile()
+        ws = torch.empty(api.scratch_workspace_bytes(), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8).fill_(0xBD)
+        api.execute(
+            q_tensor=tensors["q"],
+            k_tensor=tensors["k"],
+            v_tensor=tensors["v"],
+            o_tensor=tensors["o"],
+            do_tensor=tensors["do"],
+            stats_tensor=tensors["stats"],
+            dq_tensor=dq,
+            dk_tensor=dk,
+            dv_tensor=dv,
+            scale_softmax=1.0 / math.sqrt(d),
+            workspace=ws,
+        )
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    align = lambda n: (n + 127) // 128 * 128
+    delta = align(b * hq * (-(-sq // 128) * 128) * 4)
+    region = align(b * api._qh_chunk * api._sq_pad * api._skv_pad * 2)
+    s_ws, ds_ws = ws[delta : delta + region].clone(), ws[delta + region : delta + 2 * region].clone()
+    return [x.contiguous().view(torch.int16).clone() for x in (dq, dk, dv)] + [s_ws, ds_ws], served

+def _captured_kernel_launches(fn):
+    """The kernel launches of ONE call of ``fn``, counted from a CUDA-graph CAPTURE of it.  CUPTI is dead on the cc 10.7
+    board (``CUPTI_ERROR_INVALID_DEVICE``: ``torch.profiler`` records nothing, not even a torch matmul), so the SM100 file's
+    profiler count cannot run here.  The plan launches on torch's current stream (``sdpa/_plan.py``: no handle stream -> the
+    caller's current stream, precisely so a capture is not left empty), which inside ``torch.cuda.graph`` IS the capture
+    stream: every launch of the execute becomes one kernel node and nothing runs (the outputs stay poisoned -- the caller
+    checks that).  Returns ``(kernel nodes, all nodes, names)``; a name is None when the driver cannot resolve it (the count,
+    not the names, is the pin)."""
+    from cuda.bindings import driver
+    from cuda.bindings import runtime as cudart
+
+    cg = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph(keep_graph=True)
+    with torch.cuda.graph(cg, stream=torch.cuda.Stream()):
+        fn()
+    graph = cudart.cudaGraph_t(cg.raw_cuda_graph())
+    err, _nodes, n = cudart.cudaGraphGetNodes(graph, 0)
+    assert err == cudart.cudaError_t.cudaSuccess, err
+    err, nodes, n = cudart.cudaGraphGetNodes(graph, n)
+    assert err == cudart.cudaError_t.cudaSuccess, err
+    kernels, names = 0, []
+    for node in nodes:
+        err, kind = cudart.cudaGraphNodeGetType(node)
+        assert err == cudart.cudaError_t.cudaSuccess, err
+        name = None
+        if kind == cudart.cudaGraphNodeType.cudaGraphNodeTypeKernel:
+            kernels += 1
+            try:
+                err, params = driver.cuGraphKernelNodeGetParams(driver.CUgraphNode(int(node)))
+                func = params.func
+                if int(func) == 0 and int(getattr(params, "kern", 0)) != 0:
+                    _err, func = driver.cuKernelGetFunction(params.kern)
+                _err, raw = driver.cuFuncGetName(func)
+                name = raw.decode() if isinstance(raw, (bytes, bytearray)) else str(raw)
+            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 -- naming is diagnostic; the count is the pin
+                name = None
+        names.append(name)
+    return kernels, len(nodes), names
+

+def _dq_arm(monkeypatch, single, *, hq, hkv, sq, skv, chunks=False, **kw):
+    """One arm of the single-launch pin on THIS row: ``api_dsl.DQ_SINGLE_LAUNCH = single`` (read at compile() time), the row
+    built + pinned + executed through ``_run`` into NaN-poisoned outputs, and what the plan did: the stage-3 records (spied off
+    ``load_template``), the row's adapter (captured off its inherited ``compile``), the host trace's ``_dq_launches`` calls (the
+    compiled-plan cache is switched off for the arm so ``compile_host`` traces ``prepared_host.host`` in-process -- a cache HIT
+    would skip the trace the spy watches; the chunk loop is one ``scf.for`` body, so the spy sees the arithmetic once per trace,
+    not once per launch) and the RUNTIME kernel launches of one execute (``_captured_kernel_launches``).  ``chunks`` forces the
+    head chunk down to the GQA group, so the chain runs ``hq // group`` head chunks (``head_base > 0`` on every launch form)."""
+    from contextlib import nullcontext
+
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd import api_dsl
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.kernels.sm100 import prepared_host
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(api_dsl, "DQ_SINGLE_LAUNCH", single)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CUDNN_FRONTEND_DISABLE_COMPILED_CACHE", "1")
+    # This probe observes host tracing, so bypass both disk reuse and the in-process memo.
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CUDNN_FRONTEND_COMPILED_CACHE_INPROCESS_MEMO", "0")
+    records, apis, dq_calls = {}, [], []
+    original_load = api_dsl.load_template
+
+    def load_spy(path, params, tag="template"):
+        if tag in _MM_TAGS:
+            records[tag] = params
+        return original_load(path, params, tag)
+
+    original_compile = api_dsl.SdpaBwdDslSm100.compile
+
+    def compile_spy(adapter):
+        apis.append(adapter)
+        return original_compile(adapter)
+
+    original_dq = prepared_host._dq_launches
+
+    def dq_spy(group, bhg):
+        n = original_dq(group, bhg)
+        dq_calls.append((group, bhg, n))
+        return n
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(api_dsl, "load_template", load_spy)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(api_dsl.SdpaBwdDslSm100, "compile", compile_spy)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepared_host, "_dq_launches", dq_spy)
+    guard = patch.object(api_dsl, "_sm100_head_chunk", side_effect=lambda *a, group=1, **k: group) if chunks else nullcontext()
+    with guard:
+        run = _run(b=1, hq=hq, hkv=hkv, sq=sq, skv=skv, poison=float("nan"), **kw)
+    assert len(apis) == 1 and type(apis[0]).__name__ == "SdpaBwdDslSm107D512", [type(a).__name__ for a in apis]
+    api = apis[0]
+    for x in run.outputs:
+        x.fill_(float("nan"))
+    kernels, nodes, names = _captured_kernel_launches(run.execute)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    assert all(torch.isnan(x.float()).all().item() for x in run.outputs), "the capture must not execute: the count is of the launches, not a run"
+    facts = dict(
+        lo_bhg=records["sdpa_bwd_sm100_mm_lo"].b_head_group,
+        hi_bhg=records["sdpa_bwd_sm100_mm_hi"].b_head_group,
+        dq_bhg=api._dq_b_head_group,
+        chunk=api._qh_chunk,
+        chunks=hq // api._qh_chunk,
+        dq_calls=list(dq_calls),  # a snapshot: the next arm's spy wraps this one and would append to the same list
+        kernel_launches=kernels,
+        graph_nodes=nodes,
+        gemm_launches_by_name=sum(1 for n in names if n and _STAGE3_GEMM_KERNEL in n) if names and all(names) else None,
+        kernel_names=names,
+    )
+    return run, facts

+    from the host trace's ``_dq_launches`` call (1 vs ``group`` launches per chunk).  MHA renders, traces and launches
+    identically either way (``b_head_group`` stays 1).  The b_head_group arm of the (512, 512) rendering is new on sm_107a:
+    this is its board evidence (the SM100 file's pin never runs here)."""
+    case = dict(case)
+    chunks = case.pop("chunks", False)
+    hq, hkv, sq, skv = (case.pop(k) for k in ("hq", "hkv", "sq", "skv"))
+    group = hq // hkv
+    causal = bool(case.get("use_causal_mask"))
+    keep = _causal_keep(sq, skv) if causal else None
+    single, f_single = _dq_arm(monkeypatch, True, hq=hq, hkv=hkv, sq=sq, skv=skv, chunks=chunks, keep=keep, **case)
+    members, f_members = _dq_arm(monkeypatch, False, hq=hq, hkv=hkv, sq=sq, skv=skv, chunks=chunks, keep=keep, **case)
+    n_chunks = f_single["chunks"]
+    assert f_single["chunk"] % group == 0 and (not chunks or f_single["chunk"] == group) and f_members["chunks"] == n_chunks, (f_single, f_members)
+    # the records and the adapter's copy: dQ takes the group on the shipped arm and 1 on the twin; dV / dK (B per Q head) stay 1
+    assert (f_single["lo_bhg"], f_single["hi_bhg"], f_single["dq_bhg"]) == (1, group, group), f_single
+    assert (f_members["lo_bhg"], f_members["hi_bhg"], f_members["dq_bhg"]) == (1, 1, 1), f_members
+    # the host trace: `_dq_launches(group, b_head_group)` exactly once per trace -> 1 dQ launch per chunk on the shipped arm, `group` on the twin
+    assert f_single["dq_calls"] == [(group, group, 1)], f_single
+    assert f_members["dq_calls"] == [(group, 1, group)], f_members
+    # the runtime launches of one execute: every node a kernel; the chain's fixed launches + the stage-3 GEMMs per chunk
+    base = 1 + n_chunks + (1 if causal else 0) + (1 if group > 1 else 0)  # dot, stage 2 per chunk, causal zero-fill, GQA dK/dV fold
+    assert f_single["kernel_launches"] == f_single["graph_nodes"] == base + 3 * n_chunks, (
+        f"single-launch arm: {f_single['kernel_launches']} kernel launches, expected {base} + 3 * {n_chunks} chunks = {base + 3 * n_chunks} "
+        f"(the per-member loop launches {base} + (2 + {group}) * {n_chunks} = {base + (2 + group) * n_chunks}); facts {f_single}"
+    )
+    assert (
+        f_members["kernel_launches"] == f_members["graph_nodes"] == base + (2 + group) * n_chunks
+    ), f"per-member arm: {f_members['kernel_launches']} kernel launches, expected {base} + (2 + {group}) * {n_chunks} = {base + (2 + group) * n_chunks}; facts {f_members}"
+    if f_single["gemm_launches_by_name"] is not None:
+        assert (f_single["gemm_launches_by_name"], f_members["gemm_launches_by_name"]) == (3 * n_chunks, (2 + group) * n_chunks), (f_single, f_members)
+    print(
+        f"\n{_ENGINE} dQ launches hq={hq} hkv={hkv} s={sq} chunks={n_chunks}: single {f_single['kernel_launches']} kernels, per-member {f_members['kernel_launches']}; "
+        f"GEMMs by name {f_single['gemm_launches_by_name']} / {f_members['gemm_launches_by_name']}; kernels {f_single['kernel_names']}"
+    )
+    # the oracle on both arms, then the bits
+    single.check()
+    members.check()
+    for name, x, y in zip(("dQ", "dK", "dV"), single.outs[0], members.outs[0]):
+        xi, yi = x.contiguous().view(torch.int16), y.contiguous().view(torch.int16)
+        n_diff = (xi != yi).sum().item()
+        assert n_diff == 0, (
+            f"{name}: the single dQ launch vs the per-member launches differ in {n_diff} of {xi.numel()} int16 words "
+            f"(max|diff|={(x.float() - y.float()).abs().max().item():.3e})"
+        )
+

+# =========================================================================== GPU time-slicing: the chain (stage 2 + the stage-3 GEMMs) under a second context (board, L1)
+
+_CONTENTION_CHILD = r"""
+import math, os, sys, time
+role, n, budget_s = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3])
+import torch
+import cudnn
+import cudnn.sdpa  # noqa: F401
+b, hq, s, d = 1, 128, 8192, 512
+torch.manual_seed(0)
+def bshd(fill=True):
+    t = torch.randn(b, s, hq, d, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) if fill else torch.zeros(b, s, hq, d, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    return (t.mul_(0.1) if fill else t).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
+q, k, v, o, do = bshd(), bshd(), bshd(), bshd(), bshd()
+dq, dk, dv = bshd(False), bshd(False), bshd(False)
+stats = torch.full((b, hq, s, 1), math.log(s), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+sh, st_ = [b, hq, s, d], [s * hq * d, d, hq * d, 1]
+t = {name: g.tensor(name=name, dim=sh, stride=st_) for name in ("q", "k", "v", "o", "do")}
+t["stats"] = g.tensor(name="stats", dim=[b, hq, s, 1], stride=[hq * s, s, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+causal = role == "twin"
+tdq, tdk, tdv = g.sdpa_backward(name="bwd", q=t["q"], k=t["k"], v=t["v"], o=t["o"], dO=t["do"], stats=t["stats"], attn_scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(d), use_causal_mask=causal)
+for out in (tdq, tdk, tdv):
+    out.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16).set_stride(st_)
+g.validate(); g.build_operation_graph(); g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+idx = next(i for i in range(g.get_execution_plan_count()) if "sdpa_bwd_sm107_d512" in g.get_plan_name_at_index(i))
+g.select_plan(idx); g.check_support(); g.build_plans()
+ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+feed = {t["q"]: q, t["k"]: k, t["v"]: v, t["o"]: o, t["do"]: do, t["stats"]: stats, tdq: dq, tdk: dk, tdv: dv}
+hist = []  # per-launch seconds: a starved launch (seconds, then the wall) reads differently from a wedged one (ms, ms, never)
+for i in range(n):
+    t0 = time.time()
+    g.execute(feed, ws)
+    ev = torch.cuda.Event(); ev.record()
+    while not ev.query():
+        time.sleep(0.02)
+        if time.time() - t0 > budget_s:
+            import subprocess
+            try:
+                apps = subprocess.run(["nvidia-smi", "--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name", "--format=csv,noheader"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10).stdout
+            except Exception as e:  # a missing or stuck nvidia-smi must not turn the 45 s hang exit into a 40 min one
+                apps = f"<nvidia-smi unavailable: {e!r}>"
+            print(f"[{role}] HANG: launch {i + 1} exceeded {budget_s:.0f} s; history (s): " + " ".join(f"{h:.2f}" for h in hist[-30:]), flush=True)
+            print(f"[{role}] other compute processes on the device at the hang: {apps.strip().splitlines()}", flush=True)
+            os._exit(3)
+    hist.append(time.time() - t0)
+    if i == 0:
+        print(f"[{role}] ready", flush=True)
+torch.cuda.synchronize()
+print(f"[{role}] done {n} launches", flush=True)
+"""
+
+
+@requires_rubin
+@pytest.mark.L1
+@pytest.mark.xdist_group(name="gpu_exclusive")
+def test_chain_survives_gpu_time_slicing(tmp_path):
+    """The 2x2 lessons' detector on this line: a second CUDA context running the same chain (dense, B=1 H=128 S=8192) makes the
+    GPU time-slice; the row's chain (causal: stage 2 with its polled cross-pair ring barriers AND the stage-3 (512, 512) GEMMs
+    with their hinted ``try_wait`` cross-pair waits -- the form that hung stage 2 before the poll) must complete 100 launches,
+    each returning inside 45 s.  A hang exits the child with 3 (the stuck context dies with it), so the suite never wedges."""
+    import os
+    import time
+
+    script = tmp_path / "contention_child.py"
+    script.write_text(_CONTENTION_CHILD)
+    env = dict(os.environ, CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES="1")
+    load_log = tmp_path / "load.log"
+    with open(load_log, "w") as f:
+        load = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, str(script), "load", "100000", "600"], stdout=f, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, env=env)
+    try:

+            if load.poll() is not None:

+    finally:
+        load.kill()
+        load.wait()
+    (tmp_path / "twin.log").write_text(twin.stdout + "\n--- stderr ---\n" + twin.stderr)
+    assert twin.returncode == 0 and "[twin] done 100 launches" in twin.stdout, f"rc={twin.returncode}\n{twin.stdout[-3000:]}\n{twin.stderr[-3000:]}"
+
+

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Shared backward dot helper: physical strides, alignment, rebinding and replay.
+
+These tests call the helper directly; they do not expand graph engine eligibility.
+The large declarations reproduce CP8 AllGather's O/dO storage on both Q halves.
+"""
+
+import re
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from frost_test_utils import _SM, arch_known_to_the_dsl, requires_dsl
+
+pytestmark = [requires_dsl, pytest.mark.skipif(_SM is None or not 100 <= _SM < 130, reason="Shared Blackwell backward helper")]
+
+
+def _case(dim, dtype, layout, origin=0):
+    smoke = dim == 256 and dtype == torch.bfloat16 and layout in ("pitched", "base2", "compact_base2", "compact_o_base2", "compact_do_base2")
+    level = pytest.mark.L0 if smoke else pytest.mark.L1
+    return pytest.param(dim, dtype, layout, origin, id=f"d{dim}-{str(dtype).split('.')[-1]}-{layout}-{origin}", marks=level)
+
+
+_CASES = [_case(dim, dtype, layout) for dim, dtype in ((128, torch.bfloat16), (256, torch.float16), (256, torch.bfloat16)) for layout in ("compact", "pitched")]
+_CASES += [_case(256, torch.bfloat16, layout) for layout in ("asymmetric", "batch_odd", "row_odd", "head_odd", "base2", "padded")]
+_CASES += [_case(256, torch.bfloat16, layout) for layout in ("compact_base2", "compact_o_base2", "compact_do_base2")]
+_CASES += [_case(256, torch.bfloat16, "cp8", origin) for origin in (0, 512)]
+
+
+def _compile(shape, strides, dtype, dim, alignment, arch, dump_dir=None):
+    import cutlass
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream, make_fake_tensor
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.kernels.bprop_chain_common import dot_do_o_host
+
+    batch, seqlen, heads, _ = shape
+    rounded = ((seqlen + 127) // 128) * 128
+    scalar = cutlass.BFloat16 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else cutlass.Float16
+    alignments = (alignment, alignment) if isinstance(alignment, int) else alignment
+    operands = [make_fake_tensor(scalar, shape, stride, assumed_align=align) for stride, align in zip(strides, alignments)]
+    delta = make_fake_tensor(cutlass.Float32, (batch, heads, rounded), (heads * rounded, rounded, 1), assumed_align=16)
+    options = f"--enable-tvm-ffi --gpu-arch {arch}"
+    if dump_dir is not None:
+        options += f" --keep-ptx --dump-dir={dump_dir}"
+    return cute.compile(
+        dot_do_o_host, *operands, delta, None, None, 128, dim, dim, 64, False, False, make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=False), options=options
+    )
+
+
+def _reference(operands):
+    """Full CPU FP64 row sums, with bounded scratch even for the real CP8 shape."""
+    batch, seqlen, heads, _ = operands[0].shape
+    result = torch.empty((batch, heads, seqlen), dtype=torch.float64)
+    for b in range(batch):
+        for begin in range(0, seqlen, 64):
+            left, right = [value[b, begin : begin + 64].cpu().double() for value in operands]
+            result[b, :, begin : begin + 64] = (left * right).sum(-1).transpose(0, 1)
+    return result
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dim,dtype,layout,origin", _CASES)
+def test_backward_dot_physical_layout(dim, dtype, layout, origin):
+    batch, seqlen, heads = (64, 512, 32) if layout == "cp8" else (2, 257, 4)
+    width = 192 if layout == "padded" else dim
+    pitch = seqlen if layout.startswith("compact") else 1024 if layout == "cp8" else seqlen + 127
+    head_stride = width + int(layout == "head_odd")
+    row_stride = heads * head_stride + int(layout == "row_odd")
+    strides = [(pitch * row_stride + int(layout == "batch_odd"), row_stride, head_stride, 1)] * 2
+    if layout == "asymmetric":
+        strides[1] = ((pitch + 128) * row_stride, row_stride, head_stride, 1)
+    alignment = {
+        "base2": (2, 2),
+        "compact_base2": (2, 2),
+        "compact_o_base2": (2, 16),
+        "compact_do_base2": (16, 2),
+    }.get(layout, (16, 16))
+    shape = (batch, seqlen, heads, width)
+    arch = f"sm_{_SM}a"
+    if not arch_known_to_the_dsl(arch):
+        pytest.skip(f"Installed CuTe DSL cannot compile {arch}")
+    torch.manual_seed(358)
+
+    def inputs(extra=0):
+        try:
+            storage, views = [], []
+            for stride, align in zip(strides, alignment):
+                offset = 16 + extra + int(align == 2) + origin * row_stride
+                span = (batch - 1) * stride[0] + (seqlen - 1) * stride[1] + (heads - 1) * stride[2] + width
+                raw = torch.full((offset + span + 16,), 4096.0, dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+                view = raw.as_strided(shape, stride, offset)
+                view.copy_(torch.randn(shape, dtype=dtype, device="cuda"))
+                storage.append(raw)
+                views.append(view)
+            return storage, views, [raw.clone() for raw in storage]
+        except torch.OutOfMemoryError:
+            if layout != "cp8":
+                raise
+            pytest.skip("Insufficient free memory for complete CP8 physical input and read-only canaries")
+
+    storage, operands, snapshots = inputs()
+    rounded = ((seqlen + 127) // 128) * 128
+    count = batch * heads * rounded
+    raw_delta = torch.full((count + 32,), 12345.0, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    delta = raw_delta[16 : 16 + count].view(batch, heads, rounded)
+    fn = _compile(shape, strides, dtype, dim, alignment, arch)
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+
+    def launch():
+        # Both optional tensors remain runtime ABI slots, even when specialized None.
+        fn(*operands, delta, None, None, stream.cuda_stream)
+
+    def check(reference):
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+        actual = delta[:, :, :seqlen].cpu().double()
+        scale = max(float(reference.abs().max()), 1.0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, reference, rtol=0, atol=2e-5 * scale)
+        assert torch.count_nonzero(delta[:, :, seqlen:]) == 0
+        assert torch.all(raw_delta[:16] == 12345.0) and torch.all(raw_delta[-16:] == 12345.0)
+        assert all(torch.equal(raw, saved) for raw, saved in zip(storage, snapshots))
+
+    reference = _reference(operands)
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        launch()
+    check(reference)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    try:
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=stream):
+            launch()
+        for zero in (False, True):
+            if zero:
+                operands[1].zero_()
+            else:
+                operands[0].neg_()
+                operands[1].mul_(0.5)
+            for saved, raw in zip(snapshots, storage):
+                saved.copy_(raw)
+            reference = _reference(operands)
+            delta.fill_(float("nan"))
+            stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+            with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+                graph.replay()
+            check(reference)
+    finally:
+        graph.reset()
+    # Keep old storage alive so the allocator cannot give the rebound frame the same addresses.
+    old_storage = storage
+    storage, operands, snapshots = inputs(extra=16)
+    assert all(new.data_ptr() != old.data_ptr() for new, old in zip(storage, old_storage))
+    reference = _reference(operands)
+    delta.fill_(float("nan"))
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        launch()
+    check(reference)
+
+

+"""FROST SDPA forward past 65535 heads or batch (#1573).
+
+The NATURAL scheduler launches heads and batch on gridDim.y/z, which CUDA caps
+at 65535, so a pinned NATURAL plan is declined when it is built and the
+recommended plans ride the flat LPT grid.
+"""
+
+import math
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import cudnn
+from cudnn.engines import is_python_engine
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.L1
+
+
+def _frost_shape():
+    """(S, D) a FROST forward row serves on this device; the SM90 row serves d512 only."""
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return None
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0)
+    if (major, minor) == (9, 0):
+        return 64, 512
+    if (major, minor) == (8, 0) or (major == 10 and minor <= 6):
+        return 128, 64
+    return None
+
+
+if _frost_shape() is None:
+    pytest.skip("needs an A100, H100 or SM100 device for the FROST forward rows", allow_module_level=True)
+S, D = _frost_shape()
+SCALE = 1.0 / math.sqrt(D)
+
+
+def _graph(b, h):
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.HALF, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    stride = [S * h * D, D, h * D, 1]
+    q, k, v = (g.tensor(name=n, dim=[b, h, S, D], stride=stride, data_type=cudnn.data_type.HALF) for n in "qkv")
+    o, _ = g.sdpa(q, k, v, is_inference=True, attn_scale=SCALE)
+    o.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.HALF).set_dim([b, h, S, D]).set_stride(stride)
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A, cudnn.heur_mode.FALLBACK])
+    return g, (q, k, v, o)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("b,h", [(65536, 1), (1, 65536)], ids=["batch", "heads"])
+def test_frost_forward_past_65535_runs_on_the_flat_grid(monkeypatch, b, h):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES", "1")
+    g, ports = _graph(b, h)
+    frost = [i for i, plan in enumerate(g.plans) if is_python_engine(plan.engine_id)]
+    if not frost:
+        pytest.skip("no FROST forward row claims this graph here")
+    engine_id, knobs = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(frost[0])
+    assert knobs[cudnn.knob_type.SCHED_POLICY] != 0
+
+    natural = {**knobs, cudnn.knob_type.SCHED_POLICY: 0}
+    g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, natural)
+    g.select_plan(g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1)
+    with pytest.raises(Exception, match="65535"):
+        g.check_support()
+        g.build_plans()
+
+    g.select_plan(frost[0])
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    q, k, v = (torch.randn(b, S, h, D, dtype=torch.float16, device="cuda").transpose(1, 2) for _ in range(3))
+    o = torch.full_like(q, float("nan"))
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(int(g.get_workspace_size()), 1), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    g.execute(dict(zip(ports, (q, k, v, o))), workspace)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    for bi, hi in ((0, 0), (b - 1, h - 1), (b // 2, h // 2)):
+        p = torch.softmax((q[bi, hi].double() @ k[bi, hi].double().T) * SCALE, dim=-1)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(o[bi, hi].float(), (p @ v[bi, hi].double()).float(), atol=2e-3, rtol=1e-2)

+"""The small head-dim tiles of the Rubin (SM107) f16/bf16 forward row: ``TILE_K = TILE_O`` in {32, 64} as Cfg flavors of the d128 file.
+
+``sm107/prefill_d128_f16.py`` is one body with three head-dim geometries (``TemplateParams.d_flavor`` 32 / 64 / 128 ->
+``config_sm107.make_cfg_d32`` / ``make_cfg_d64`` / ``make_cfg_d128``).  A graph's head dim lands on the SMALLEST width covering
+max(d_qk, d_v) -- 8 / 16 / 24 -> 32, 40 / 48 / 56 -> 64, the natives on themselves -- and the TMA load zero-fills the columns
+past D (exact zero terms in QK^T and in P.V's padded V columns; the ``expect_tx`` count is the FULL box; the O store clips at
+d_v).  D % 8 != 0 is a typed decline (the TMA 16-byte global-stride rule at 2 B/elem).  Everything coupled to the tile -- the
+swizzle atoms, the TMA iteration counts, the TMEM O slot width, the BMM1 k-step count -- is derived from ``CFG.*`` and pinned by
+``_validate_head_dim_tile``; the d128 rendering is byte-identical to the one-geometry file (``test_sdpa_fwd_score_stats.py``
+holds the cubin md5 records).
+
+D32 carries dense plans. D64 also carries nonpaged, unsplit THD and PackGQA.
+Split-KV and score side outputs use a larger flavor; a cga2 request at D <= 32
+uses the 64-wide tile. THD requires exact native dimensions, and paged D64 THD
+remains declined.
+
+Three tiers: (1) CPU contract -- the row's accept / decline table per D, the ROUTE table per (D, leg) with the three pick
+implementations agreeing on every cell (the row's envelope walk, the adapter's flavor pool, ``sm107_f16_tile_width(leg=, cga=)``),
+the one constant feeding the row's cga domain, the adapter's cga twin and the config factory, the factories' derived facts and
+raising couplings, the loader binding ``d_flavor`` to the flavor, the static expect_tx pin; (2) host rendering pins -- an sm_107a
+trace-compile of each new rendering keeps the register split (``USETMAXREG`` > 0) and spills no more than the d128 rendering of
+the same mask arm; (3) GPU cells on a Rubin device -- the fp64 oracle over the degenerate-input matrix (the shared ``small_tile_cells``,
+one matrix for both arch lines) on the 32- and 64-wide tiles in bf16 with the fp16 member on the degenerate trio, one accept cell at
+D = 16 and at D = 56, the bitwise pin D = 8 / 24 vs an explicitly zero-padded D = 32 (40 / 48 vs 64: the zero-fill contract, one
+TMA mechanism), the d64 tile at cga2, the routed legs (split-KV and the score outputs at D = 24 / 64 on the d128 flavor, cga2 at

+def test_expect_tx_is_the_full_box_and_every_box_is_the_tile():
+    """Static pin of the zero-fill contract (frost-tile-dsl.md s5: an overshooting TMA box delivers the FULL box's bytes): the aggregate boxes cover each tile, every
+    per-tile element count is a TILE product, every transaction byte count is that count x BPE x CTA_MMA, and no head-dim
+    EXTENT (d_qk / d_v) reaches a byte count or a box -- the extents live in the descriptors only."""
+    code = "\n".join(ln for ln in _KERNEL.read_text().splitlines() if not ln.lstrip().startswith("#"))
+    for line in (
+        "qBufferElems = CFG.TILE_M * CFG.TILE_K",
+        "kBufferElems = CFG.TILE_N * CFG.TILE_K // CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "vBufferElems = CFG.TILE_O * CFG.TILE_N // CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "qTmaTransactionBytes = qBufferElems * CFG.BPE * CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "kTmaTransactionBytes = kBufferElems * CFG.BPE * CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "vTmaTransactionBytes = vBufferElems * CFG.BPE * CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "HEADS_PER_TILE = CFG.PACK_G if CFG.PACK_GQA else 1",
+        "TOKENS_PER_TILE = CFG.TILE_M // HEADS_PER_TILE",
+        "qk_box_q = (1, TOKENS_PER_TILE, HEADS_PER_TILE, TMA_QK_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+        "qk_box_k = (1, K_BOX_ROWS, 1, TMA_QK_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+        "vo_box_v = (1, V_BOX_ROWS, 1, TMA_VO_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+        "vo_box_o = (1, TOKENS_PER_TILE, HEADS_PER_TILE, _O_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+    ):
+        assert line in code, line
+    # Evaluate the kernel's box expressions: packing trades token rows for
+    # heads without changing the transfer volume or the unpacked geometry.
+    names = ("HEADS_PER_TILE", "TOKENS_PER_TILE", "qk_box_q", "vo_box_o")
+    expressions = {
+        target.id: node.value
+        for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(code))
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
+        for target in node.targets
+        if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id in names
+    }
+    for packed, pack_g in ((False, 1), (True, 1), (True, 2), (True, 4), (True, 8), (True, 16)):
+        for granularity in (16, 32, 64):
+            env = dict(CFG=SimpleNamespace(TILE_M=128, PACK_GQA=packed, PACK_G=pack_g), TMA_QK_GRANU_ELEMS=granularity, _O_GRANU_ELEMS=granularity)
+            for name in names:
+                env[name] = eval(compile(ast.Expression(expressions[name]), str(_KERNEL), "eval"), {"__builtins__": {}}, env)
+            for name in ("qk_box_q", "vo_box_o"):
+                assert math.prod(env[name]) == 128 * granularity, (packed, pack_g, name, env[name])
+                if not packed or pack_g == 1:
+                    assert env[name] == (1, 128, 1, granularity)
+    # Evaluate the source's page subdivision and byte-count expressions together.
+    # Per-page boxes must still deliver the full expect_tx volume, including
+    # zero-filled head-dim tails; nonpaged boxes retain the original geometry.
+    names = (
+        "_K_TILE_ROWS",
+        "K_BOX_ROWS",
+        "V_BOX_ROWS",
+        "K_BOXES",
+        "V_BOXES",
+        "qk_box_k",
+        "vo_box_v",
+        "kBufferElems",
+        "vBufferElems",
+        "kTmaTransactionBytes",
+        "vTmaTransactionBytes",
+    )
+    expressions = {
+        target.id: node.value
+        for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(code))
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
+        for target in node.targets
+        if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id in names
+    }
+    for cga in (1, 2):
+        for tile_n in (64, 128):
+            for width in (32, 64, 128):
+                for page in (0, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256):
+                    cfg = SimpleNamespace(TILE_N=tile_n, TILE_K=width, TILE_O=width, CTA_MMA=cga, BPE=2)
+                    env = dict(CFG=cfg, PAGED_KV=bool(page), PAGE_SIZE=page, TMA_QK_GRANU_ELEMS=32, TMA_VO_GRANU_ELEMS=16)
+                    for name in names:
+                        env[name] = eval(compile(ast.Expression(expressions[name]), str(_KERNEL), "eval"), {"__builtins__": {"min": min}}, env)
+                    assert math.prod(env["qk_box_k"]) * (width // 32) * env["K_BOXES"] * 2 * cga == env["kTmaTransactionBytes"]
+                    assert math.prod(env["vo_box_v"]) * (width // cga // 16) * env["V_BOXES"] * 2 * cga == env["vTmaTransactionBytes"]
+                    assert env["K_BOX_ROWS"] * env["K_BOXES"] == tile_n // cga
+                    assert env["V_BOX_ROWS"] * env["V_BOXES"] == tile_n
+                    if page:
+                        assert env["K_BOX_ROWS"] <= page and env["V_BOX_ROWS"] <= page
+                    else:
+                        assert env["qk_box_k"] == (1, tile_n // cga, 1, 32)
+                        assert env["vo_box_v"] == (1, tile_n, 1, 16)
+                        assert env["K_BOXES"] == env["V_BOXES"] == 1
+    for bad in (r"TransactionBytes\s*=.*\bd_(qk|v)\b", r"box_[qkvo]\s*=.*\bd_(qk|v)\b", r"BufferElems\s*=.*\bd_(qk|v)\b"):
+        assert not re.search(bad, code), bad
+    assert "_MAKE_CFG = {32: make_cfg_d32, 64: make_cfg_d64, 128: make_cfg_d128}" in code
+    assert "d128_family_tmem_layout(CFG)" in code and not re.search(r"^\s*(S1|O0|O1|STATS)_OFF: int = \d+\s*$", code, re.M), "no TMEM literal survives"
+    assert re.search(r"CHUNK = CFG\.BMM2_CHUNK_SIZE", code) and not re.search(r"^\s*CHUNK = 64\s*$", code, re.M)

+def _desc(shape, dtype, name):
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+
+    b, h, s, d = shape
+    stride = (s * h * d, d, h * d, 1)
+    return TensorDesc(
+        dtype=dtype, shape=tuple(shape), stride=stride, stride_order=TensorDesc._compute_stride_order(tuple(shape), stride), device="cuda", name=name
+    )
+

+def _api(d, *, s=256, h=4, h_kv=None, dtype=torch.bfloat16, score=False, **kw):
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import SdpaFwdDslSm100
+
+    h_kv = h if h_kv is None else h_kv
+    q, o = (_desc((1, h, s, d), dtype, n) for n in ("q", "o"))
+    k, v = (_desc((1, h_kv, s, d), dtype, n) for n in ("k", "v"))
+    if score:  # the two score side outputs, declared like Stats (b, h, s, 1) fp32
+        kw["sample_score_max"] = _desc((1, h, s, 1), torch.float32, "score_max")
+        kw["sample_score_sum_exp"] = _desc((1, h, s, 1), torch.float32, "score_sum_exp")
+    return SdpaFwdDslSm100(q, k, v, o, None, **kw)

+        except AssertionError as e:
+            raise AssertionError(f"sequence {b} of {len(seq_lens_q)} (packed rows {cu}:{cu + s}): {e}") from None

+"""End-to-end tests for the FROST SM120 block-scaled MXFP8 SDPA-forward engine.
+
+Drives ``graph.sdpa_mxfp8`` (FP8 E4M3/E5M2 Q/K/V + per-32-block E8M0 scale

+reference's pre-cast amax and the kernel's own stored O), with O and Amax_O
+NaN-prefilled so an output never written fails. Inputs are quantized with the
+torch-only quantizer in ``test/python/sdpa/mxfp8_quant.py``.
+
+By default every 32-element block of Q, K (along D) and V (along S) is scaled
+by its own power of two before quantization, so the stored block scales differ
+strongly from block to block: a scale read for the wrong row, column, block or
+plane changes O by up to the spread factor instead of hiding behind
+near-uniform scales.

+def _block_spread(shape, axis, lo, hi, generator):

+    exps = torch.randint(lo, hi + 1, blocks, device="cuda", generator=generator).float()

+def _draw(B, H_q, H_kv, S_q, S_kv, d_qk, d_v, fp8):
+    """Random Q/K/V, each 32-element block scaled by its own power of two, quantized: (Q, K, V) as ``_Quantized``."""
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(torch.initial_seed() % (2**31))

+def _bshd(x):
+    """A BHSD view over BSHD storage."""
+    return x.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous().transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _nan_output(shape, dtype):

+    return torch.full(shape, float("nan"), device="cuda").to(dtype)

+    b, h, s, d = x.shape

+

+def _sf_tensor(g, dims):
+    """A compact graph E8M0 scale tensor in the F8_128x4 order."""
+    import cudnn

+    return g.tensor(
+        dim=list(dims),
+        stride=[dims[1] * dims[2] * dims[3], dims[2] * dims[3], dims[3], 1],

+def _rowwise_sf_offsets(b, h, s, d, rows, blocks):
+    """Flat byte offsets of the rowwise (Q/K) scales of ``rows`` x ``blocks`` for every (batch, head):

+    s_tiles, planes = _cdiv(s, 128), _cdiv(_cdiv(d, _BLOCK), 4)

+    return (atom * 512 + (r % 32) * 16 + ((r // 32) % 4) * 4 + c % 4).view(b, h, len(rows), len(blocks))

+def _columnwise_sf_offsets(b, h, s, d, blocks, cols):
+    """Flat byte offsets of the columnwise (V) scales of key ``blocks`` x D ``cols``: atoms ordered
+    (d-plane, b, h, s-tile), byte ``(n % 32) * 16 + ((n // 32) % 4) * 4 + j % 4``."""
+    s_tiles = _cdiv(_cdiv(_cdiv(s, _BLOCK), 4) * 4 * _BLOCK, 128)
+    bh = torch.arange(b * h, device="cuda").view(-1, 1, 1)
+    j = torch.as_tensor(blocks, device="cuda").view(1, -1, 1)
+    n = torch.as_tensor(cols, device="cuda").view(1, 1, -1)
+    atom = (n // 128) * (b * h * s_tiles) + bh * s_tiles + j // 4

+        skv_h = g.tensor(dim=[B, 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+        kw.update(use_padding_mask=True, seq_len_q=sq_h, seq_len_kv=skv_h)
+        vp.update({sq_h: slq, skv_h: slk})
+    if sf_o_layout is not None:
+        from sdpa.block_scale_o_ref import round_up
+
+        # SF_O pre-filled with 0xAA (scale bytes never written stay visible); token-major rows past B*S_q are caller-owned.
+        C = max(4, round_up(d_v // _BLOCK, 4))
+        if sf_o_layout == "planes":
+            R = round_up(S_q, 128)
+            sf_o_buf = torch.full((B, H_q, R, C), 0xAA, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+            sf_o_stride = [H_q * R * C, R * C, C, 1]
+        else:
+            R = S_q
+            sf_o_buf = torch.full((round_up(B * S_q, 128), H_q * C), 0xAA, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+            sf_o_buf[B * S_q :] = 0
+            sf_o_stride = [R * H_q * C, C, H_q * C, 1]
+        kw["sf_o"] = g.tensor(dim=[B, H_q, R, C], stride=sf_o_stride, data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0)
+        vp[kw["sf_o"]] = sf_o_buf
+        if scale_o is not None:
+            kw["scale_o"] = g.tensor(dim=[1, 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+            vp[kw["scale_o"]] = torch.full((1,), scale_o, device=dev)
+    kw.update(sdpa_kwargs)
+    o, stats_t, amax_o = g.sdpa_mxfp8(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim(list(Ob.shape)).set_stride(list(Ob.stride())).set_data_type(getattr(cudnn.data_type, _CUDNN_OTYPE[out_dt]))
+    if with_stats:
+        stats_t.set_output(True).set_dim([B, H_q, S_q, 1]).set_stride(list(lse.stride())).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+        vp[stats_t] = lse
+    amax_o.set_output(True).set_dim([1, 1, 1, 1]).set_stride([1, 1, 1, 1]).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    vp[amax_o] = amax_buf
+
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    chosen = _select_engine(g, _ENGINE, tiles=tiles, pack_gqa=pack_gqa, sched_policy=sched_policy)
+    if split_kv is not None and (chosen.knobs.split_kv or 1) != split_kv:
+        # The ranked plans need not carry this split count: re-plan the engine's own knob set with it.
+        g.create_execution_plan(chosen.engine_id, replace(chosen.knobs, split_kv=split_kv, sched_policy=0))
+        g.select_plan(len(g.plans) - 1)
+    assert split_kv is None or (g.plans[g._plan_index].knobs.split_kv or 1) == split_kv
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    vp[o] = Ob
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    if sync_debug:
+        g.execute(vp, ws)  # warm the plan's lazy state outside the probe
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        prev = torch.cuda.get_sync_debug_mode()
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")
+    try:
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+    finally:
+        if sync_debug:
+            torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode(prev)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    o_ref, lse_ref = _ref(
+        q_op.dequant, k_op.dequant, v_op.dequant, scale=scale, sinks=sinks, seq_lens_q=seq_lens_q, seq_lens_kv=seq_lens_kv, **_ref_kwargs(sdpa_kwargs)
+    )
+    stats = lse.squeeze(-1) if with_stats else None
+    if sf_o_layout is not None:
+        from sdpa.block_scale_o_ref import dequant_block_scaled_o
+
+        o_deq, pad_ok = dequant_block_scaled_o(Ob, sf_o_buf, _BLOCK, sf_o_layout, B, H_q, S_q, d_v, C)
+        return _RunResult(o_deq / (1.0 if scale_o is None else scale_o), o_ref, fp8, amax_buf, stats, lse_ref if with_stats else None, pad_ok)
+    return _RunResult(Ob, o_ref, fp8, amax_buf, stats, lse_ref if with_stats else None)

+def _o_tol(res: _RunResult, d_qk=128):
+    """Half-output tolerance relative to the reference's magnitude; FP8 outputs add three times the
+    output dtype's own quantization floor of the reference."""
+    e5m2 = res.input_dtype == torch.float8_e5m2
+    base = 8e-2 if e5m2 and d_qk > 128 else 7e-2 if e5m2 else 5e-2
+    tol = base * max(1.0, res.reference.abs().max().item())
+    if res.output.dtype in (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e5m2):
+        floor = (res.reference - res.reference.to(res.output.dtype).float()).abs().max().item()
+        tol = max(tol, 3.0 * floor)
+    return tol
+
+
+def _check(res: _RunResult, d_qk=128):
+    out = res.output.float()
+    assert torch.isfinite(out).all(), "non-finite O (NaN = an element never written)"
+    diff = (out - res.reference).abs().max().item()
+    tol = _o_tol(res, d_qk)
+    assert diff <= tol, f"max|O-ref|={diff:.4f} > {tol:.4f}"
+    assert_amax_o(res.amax_o, res.reference.abs().max().item(), torch_itype=res.input_dtype, torch_otype=res.output.dtype, o_gpu=res.output)
+    if res.stats is not None:
+        finite = torch.isfinite(res.reference_stats)
+        assert torch.equal(torch.isfinite(res.stats), finite), "Stats -inf pattern differs from the reference"
+        d = (res.stats[finite] - res.reference_stats[finite]).abs().max().item() if finite.any() else 0.0
+        assert d <= 3e-2, f"max|LSE-ref|={d:.4f} > 0.03"

+# --- THD (ragged) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _SeqQuantized(NamedTuple):
+    """One sequence's MXFP8-quantized operand for the THD packing."""
+
+    data: torch.Tensor  # fp8 [1, h, s, d]
+    dequant: torch.Tensor  # fp32 [1, h, s, d]
+    sf_tiles: torch.Tensor  # [h, ceil(s / 128), tile_bytes], every tile's planes contiguous
+
+
+class _SeqOperands(NamedTuple):
+    q: _SeqQuantized
+    k: _SeqQuantized
+    v: _SeqQuantized
+
+
+def _poison_sf_tail(sf_tiles, s, *, columnwise):
+    """Write the NaN encoding 0xFF into the scales of a sequence's last tile that lie past its length ``s``:
+    rowwise (Q/K) rows ``s .. tiles * 128``, columnwise (V) 32-key blocks wholly past ``s``."""
+    _, tiles, size = sf_tiles.shape
+    dev = sf_tiles.device
+    plane = (torch.arange(size // 512, device=dev) * 512).view(1, -1, 1)
+    if columnwise:
+        blocks = torch.arange(_cdiv(s, _BLOCK), tiles * 4, device=dev)
+        n = torch.arange(128, device=dev)
+        tile = (blocks // 4).view(-1, 1, 1)
+        byte = plane + ((n % 32) * 16 + ((n // 32) % 4) * 4).view(1, 1, -1) + (blocks % 4).view(-1, 1, 1)
+    else:
+        rows = torch.arange(s, tiles * 128, device=dev)
+        rr = rows % 128
+        tile = (rows // 128).view(-1, 1, 1)
+        byte = plane + ((rr % 32) * 16 + ((rr // 32) % 4) * 4).view(-1, 1, 1) + torch.arange(4, device=dev).view(1, 1, -1)
+    sf_tiles[:, tile.expand_as(byte), byte] = 0xFF
+
+
+def _quantize_seq(t, fp8, *, columnwise, poison_tail=False) -> _SeqQuantized:
+    """Per-sequence quantization for the THD packing. Columnwise F8_128x4 is plane-major across a tensor,
+    so its [planes, h, tiles, 512] atoms are regrouped to keep every tile's planes contiguous.
+    ``poison_tail`` writes 0xFF scales past the sequence's length (``_poison_sf_tail``)."""
+    _, h, s, d = t.shape
+    if s == 0:
+        planes = _cdiv(d, 128)
+        return _SeqQuantized(
+            t.new_zeros((1, h, 0, d)).to(fp8), t.new_zeros((1, h, 0, d)), torch.zeros((h, 0, 512 * planes), dtype=torch.uint8, device=t.device)
+        )
+    op = _quantize(t, fp8, columnwise=columnwise)
+    tiles, planes = _cdiv(s, 128), _cdiv(d, 128)
+    sf = op.sf.reshape(planes, h, tiles, 512).permute(1, 2, 0, 3) if columnwise else op.sf
+    sf = sf.contiguous().reshape(h, tiles, -1)
+    if poison_tail:
+        _poison_sf_tail(sf, s, columnwise=columnwise)
+    return _SeqQuantized(op.data, op.dequant, sf)
+
+
+def _run_thd(
+    seq_lens_q,
+    seq_lens_kv,
+    H_q,
+    H_kv,
+    *,
+    d_qk=128,
+    d_v=None,
+    in_key="e4m3",
+    out_dt=torch.float16,
+    sdpa_kwargs=None,
+    sinks=None,
+    stats=None,
+    tiles=None,
+    poison_pad=False,
+):
+    """Packed [T, H, D] Q/K/V/O with ragged offsets in dense-capacity storage whose tail past the packed
+    total is NaN-poisoned, per-batch lengths, and packed per-sequence-tile scale factors. ``stats``:
+    None, "token_major" ((T, H)) or "head_major" ((H, T_capacity)) ragged Stats. ``poison_pad`` writes
+    0xFF scales past every sequence's Q and KV length inside its last scale tile."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    dev = "cuda"
+    d_v = d_qk if d_v is None else d_v
+    sdpa_kwargs = sdpa_kwargs or {}
+    scale = d_qk**-0.5

+"""The softmax warpgroups' top-of-tile ``mb_o_empty`` wait must have a back-edge from EVERY waiter (GitHub #1532, #1525).
+
+``mb_o_empty[qs]`` is a single-phase barrier TMA-STG arrives once per tile per O sub-tile.  Both softmax warpgroups used to wait
+slot 0 at the top of every tile, but slot 0's producer chain -- MMA ``bmm2_done[0]`` -> correction qs=0 epilogue (SM0's stats) ->
+``o_full[0]`` -> TMA-STG -> ``o_empty[0]`` -- never passes through warpgroup 1.  Any delay of warpgroup 1 across a tile boundary longer
+than that chain (shortest on an EMPTY (q-tile, split) unit, supplied by a spinning sibling or GPU time-slicing) let TMA-STG complete a
+second phase before warpgroup 1's parity wait; the wait aliased, warpgroup 1 never published that tile's stats, and the correction
+(``stat_full[1]``) and TMA-STG (``o_full[1]``) deadlocked -- a hang with correct numerics on every tile that did complete.  Observed on
+cc 10.3 at ~80 % of launches on square bottom-right-causal split-KV graphs (#1532) and intermittently on the cc 10.0 paged-THD
+capture/replay CI case (#1525).  Fix: each warpgroup waits ITS OWN slot, whose chain runs through its own stats publish.
+
+Two pins.  (1) Source, no GPU: none of the eleven two-warpgroup forward kernels waits ``mb_o_empty[0]`` at the top of the tile any more.  (2) Device,
+in a SUBPROCESS under a wall budget so a regression can never wedge the suite: the smallest shape that hung deterministically on a
+cc 10.3 part (B=1, H=32, S_q = S_kv = 2048, D=128, bf16, bottom-right causal, TILE_CGA_M=2, SPLIT_KV=16, PACK_GQA=0) runs 20
+back-to-back synchronised executes and matches an fp32 reference.
+A separate D512 MXFP8 probe delays softmax after both Dv slices have their P input: its once-per-tile gate must observe
+a once-per-tile completion, rather than alias two O-empty phases. It checks dense and THD output, Stats and Amax after replay.

+    g.create_execution_plan(engine, pub)

+    print("plan", g.get_plan_name_at_index(idx), flush=True)
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    for i in range(n_exec):

+def test_scheduler_and_credit_target_select_the_same_layouts():
+    """A local scheduler cannot wait for credits routed only to the CLC leader.
+
+    Inspect the layout guards, independently of warp-role dispatch and source
+    formatting. This is a protocol invariant, not a heuristic or timing pin.
+    """
+    import ast
+    from pathlib import Path
+
+    def layouts(node, parents):
+        allowed = {False, True}
+        while node in parents:
+            parent = parents[node]
+            if isinstance(parent, ast.If):
+                test = parent.test
+                if isinstance(test, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(test.func) == "cutlass.const_expr":
+                    test = test.args[0]
+                negate = isinstance(test, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(test.op, ast.Not)
+                value = test.operand if negate else test
+                if ast.unparse(value) in ("CFG.THD_VARLEN", "_THD"):
+                    allowed &= {(node in parent.body) != negate}
+            node = parent
+        return allowed
+
+    scanned = []
+    for path in (Path(_KERNELS).parents[1]).rglob("*.py"):
+        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
+        aliases = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and any(a.name == "read_tile_id_arrive_on_leader" for a in n.names)]
+        clc = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id == "scheduler_warp_loop"]
+        if not (aliases or clc):
+            continue
+        parents = {child: node for node in ast.walk(tree) for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node)}
+        if not aliases:
+            # A literal single-CTA caller has no peers: both helpers elect
+            # one local arrival. It may also use the persistent THD scheduler.
+            credits = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id == "read_tile_id_arrive"]
+            assert credits and all(len(n.args) >= 2 and isinstance(n.args[1], ast.Constant) and n.args[1].value == 1 for n in credits), str(path)
+            assert all(len(n.args) >= 4 and isinstance(n.args[3], ast.Constant) and n.args[3].value == 1 for n in clc), str(path)
+            scanned.append(path)
+            continue
+        assert len(aliases) == len(clc) == 1, str(path)
+        assert layouts(aliases[0], parents) == layouts(clc[0], parents), f"{path}: scheduler/credit layout mismatch"
+        # The default import must still supply broadcasts on the other arm.
+        if layouts(aliases[0], parents) != {False, True}:
+            broadcasts = [
+                n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and any(a.name == "read_tile_id_arrive" and a.asname is None for a in n.names)
+            ]
+            assert any(layouts(n, parents) == {False, True} for n in broadcasts), f"{path}: missing default broadcast credits"
+        scanned.append(path)
+    assert scanned, "no common CLC callers were checked"

+"""The score side outputs (``score_max`` / ``score_sum_exp``) of the FROST f16/bf16 d128 forward engines, SM100 and SM107.
+
+The graph's two optional ports are fp32 ``(B, H_q, S_q, 1)`` row statistics in NATURAL units: ``score_max`` is the
+softmax row max (``scale * max_j s_j``, the sink folded in as one more column) and ``score_sum_exp`` the fp32 row-sum of
+``exp(s - max)`` -- the two operands the LSE is built from, so ``Stats == score_max + ln(score_sum_exp)`` to fp32 rounding
+(``stats_use_log2`` leaves them untouched).  A keyless row reads ``-inf`` / ``0``, with a sink ``sink_logit`` / ``1``, the
+same SELECT and the same OOB-row store guard as the LSE.  Served by the d128 f16/bf16 prefill kernels on dense, unsplit,
+unpaged plans of the 2-CTA tile; every other selection is a typed decline (the engine row's ``mismatch`` and the standalone
+adapter's ``check_support`` read ONE shape constant per arch line).
+
+Three tiers: (1) CPU contract -- the rows' claims, the mismatch accept / reject table, the append-only signature pins and
+the adapter's typed declines; (2) rendering pins -- a host trace-compile of the d128 kernel on sm_100a and sm_107a whose
+no-score arm must stay byte-identical to the committed pre-edit cubin md5 records (``renderings/``) while the score arm
+adds exactly the stores; (3) GPU cells on the Blackwell-line device present (sm100 or sm107 row): the fp64 oracle over the
+degenerate-input matrix (the KV ring sweep n_kv = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8 -- the sm107 KV ring depth 4 and the sm100 depth 2, each
+with its depth + 1 -- all with B*H > 1; tail tiles; a zero-length KV batch; keyless bottom-right rows with and without a sink;
+keyless rows past a left window under padding; GQA) in bf16 with the fp16 member on the dense base and on the ports' documented
+degenerate contract (the keyless row -inf / 0, the sink sink_logit / 1), the base-2 Stats interaction, each output alone,
+strided layouts, and the bitwise identity of O / Stats with the outputs off -- each once, on the 2-CTA tile the arm is wired on.

+def _desc(shape, dtype, name, stride=None):
+    """A BSHD-physical (BHSD-logical) TensorDesc with no storage behind it."""
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+
+    b, h, s, d = shape
+    stride = tuple(stride) if stride is not None else (s * h * d, d, h * d, 1)
+    return TensorDesc(
+        dtype=dtype, shape=tuple(shape), stride=stride, stride_order=TensorDesc._compute_stride_order(tuple(shape), stride), device="cuda", name=name
+    )

+def _fake_cc(monkeypatch, cc):
+    """check_support reads the LIVE device; pin it so both arch arms run on any host."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "is_available", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "get_device_capability", lambda *a, **k: cc)

+def _api(
+    *,
+    b=1,
+    h=8,
+    h_kv=None,
+    s=512,
+    d=128,
+    d_v=None,
+    dtype=torch.float16,
+    fp8=False,
+    score_max=True,
+    score_sum_exp=True,
+    score_stride=None,
+    score_dtype=torch.float32,
+    **kw,
+):
+    """A d128-shaped SdpaFwdDslSm100 built from descriptors only, the score samples declared like Stats."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import SdpaFwdDslSm100
+
+    h_kv = h if h_kv is None else h_kv
+    d_v = d if d_v is None else d_v
+    qkv_dtype = torch.float8_e4m3fn if fp8 else dtype
+    o_dtype = torch.bfloat16 if fp8 else dtype
+    q = _desc((b, h, s, d), qkv_dtype, "q")
+    k = _desc((b, h_kv, s, d), qkv_dtype, "k")
+    v = _desc((b, h_kv, s, d_v), qkv_dtype, "v")
+    o = _desc((b, h, s, d_v), o_dtype, "o")
+    # The Stats geometry: compact (b, h, s, 1) unless a declared (padded / permuted) stride is given.
+    score_stride = score_stride if score_stride is not None else (h * s, s, 1, 1)
+    if score_max:
+        kw["sample_score_max"] = _desc((b, h, s, 1), score_dtype, "score_max", stride=score_stride)
+    if score_sum_exp:
+        kw["sample_score_sum_exp"] = _desc((b, h, s, 1), score_dtype, "score_sum_exp", stride=score_stride)
+    if fp8:
+        kw.update(pertensor_fp8=True, dtype_o=o_dtype)
+    return SdpaFwdDslSm100(q, k, v, o, None, **kw)

+def _stub_compiled(monkeypatch, api):

+def test_adapter_check_support_declines_typed(monkeypatch, cc):
+    """Rule 8b twins of the rows' claims on the STANDALONE adapter: the accept side first, then each decline typed --
+    ValueError for a malformed request, NotImplementedError for "not mine" -- and execute's presence contract both ways."""
+    if cc == (10, 7) and _DSL_FLOOR_WHY:

+    api = _api()

+    assert api._score_strides == {"score_max": None, "score_sum_exp": None}
+    assert _api(score_sum_exp=False).check_support() and _api(score_max=False).check_support()
+    assert _api(dtype=torch.bfloat16, stats_log2=True).check_support()
+    h, s = 8, 512

+    assert strided._score_strides == {"score_max": (h * (s + 7), s + 7, 1), "score_sum_exp": (h * (s + 7), s + 7, 1)}
+    # Malformed requests -> ValueError.
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        _api(score_dtype=torch.bfloat16).check_support()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="non-overlapping"):
+        _api(b=2, score_stride=(0, s, 1, 1)).check_support()
+    # "Not mine" -> NotImplementedError naming the axis.
+    for d, d_v in ((192, 128), (256, 256), (512, 512)):

+    else:
+        # RE-INVERTED 2026-10-08: Rubin routes a d64 graph WITH the outputs past its dense-only 64-wide tile onto the d128

+        api64 = _api(d=64)

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- tier 2: rendering pins (host trace-compile)
+
+# The probe body: TemplateParams from the arm's kwargs (the compile() keys travel as `__has_*` and are popped), the d128
+# module of the arch, compile(...) with only the keys the module accepts -- so the SAME body renders the pre-edit tree
+# (whose compile() had no score keys) and this tree.  Keep byte-identical to the renderer that produced the records.
+_PROBE_BODY = """
+import inspect
+from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_state
+_installed, _version = cutedsl_state()
+print("DSL", " ".join(_version) if _version else "unknown")
+has_lse = params_kw.pop("__has_lse", True)
+score_kw = {k[2:]: params_kw.pop(k) for k in ("__has_score_max", "__has_score_sum_exp") if k in params_kw}
+params = TemplateParams(**params_kw)
+mod = _load_sm100_kernel_module((128, 128), params, rubin=(arch == "sm_107a"))
+accepted = inspect.signature(mod.compile).parameters
+compile_kw = dict(has_lse=has_lse, lse_kind="dense")
+compile_kw.update({k: v for k, v in score_kw.items() if k in accepted})
+print("COMPILE_KW", sorted(compile_kw.items()))
+mod.compile(**compile_kw)
+"""
+_COUNTS = {
+    "STG": (" STG",),
+    "LDTM": ("LDTM",),
+    "FSEL": (" FSEL",),
+    "STL": (" STL",),
+    "LDL": (" LDL",),
+    "USETMAXREG": ("USETMAXREG",),
+}
+_RECORDS = {"dense_bf16": {"dtype_qkv": 2}, "causal_f16": {"dtype_qkv": 3, "window_right": 0}, "dense_bf16_nolse": {"dtype_qkv": 2, "__has_lse": False}}
+_SCORE_ARM = {"dtype_qkv": 2, "__has_score_max": True, "__has_score_sum_exp": True}
+_RENDERINGS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "renderings"
+
+
+def _record(arch):
+    """(dsl line, {record: md5}) of the committed pre-edit record ``renderings/md5_fwd_d128_f16_score_stats_off_<arch>.txt``."""
+    f = _RENDERINGS / f"md5_fwd_d128_f16_score_stats_off_{arch}.txt"
+    assert f.is_file(), f
+    dsl, want = None, {}
+    for ln in f.read_text().splitlines():
+        if ln.startswith("dsl="):
+            dsl = ln[len("dsl=") :].strip()
+        m = re.match(rf"fwd_d128_f16 {arch} (\S+) rc=0 cubin_md5=([0-9a-f]{{32}})", ln)
+        if m:
+            want[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
+    return dsl, want
+
+

+    assert set(want) == set(_RECORDS), (sorted(want), sorted(_RECORDS))

+def _skip_unless_the_record_dsl(dsl):

+    _installed, version = cutedsl_state()

+    if dsl is not None and have != dsl:

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- tier 3: GPU cells (the row of the device present)
+
+# Tolerances DERIVED from the kernel's arithmetic, not from the first passing run:
+#   score_max: S is the fp32 tcgen05 accumulation of exact bf16/f16 products over d = 128 (|err| <= 128 * 2^-24 * sum|q k|,
+#              ~2e-4 at these magnitudes), then one FMUL by scale*log2(e) and one by ln 2 (2 roundings, ~1e-7 relative):
+#              atol 1e-3 is >= 5x that bound; rtol 1e-5 covers the two roundings.
+#   score_sum_exp: a sum of up to S_kv ex2.approx terms (2^-22 relative each) plus the per-KV-tile rescales (one more
+#              ex2.approx each) and the fp32 accumulation (S_kv * 2^-24): < 2e-4 relative at S_kv <= 512, < 4e-4 at the
+#              n_kv = 8 cell's S_kv = 1024 (1024 * 2^-22 + 1024 * 2^-24 + 8 rescales, every term one-sided); rtol 1e-3.
+#   Stats == score_max + ln(score_sum_exp): the kernel evaluates exactly that with lg2.approx (2 ulp): 2e-5 absolute.
+_TOL_MAX = dict(atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-5)
+_TOL_SUM = dict(atol=0.0, rtol=1e-3)
+_TOL_LSE_CONSISTENCY = dict(atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-6)
+_TOL_O = dict(atol=5e-2, rtol=3e-2)  # the suite's half-precision O bound
+
+
+def _bhsd(b, h, s, d, dtype):
+    return torch.randn(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _ref(q, k, v, *, scale, causal=False, bottom_right=False, seq_q_lens=None, seq_kv_lens=None, sinks=None, window_left=None):
+    """fp64 oracle of the whole contract: O, the natural-log LSE, score_max and score_sum_exp per row class."""
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    _, h_kv, s_kv, _ = v.shape
+    dev = q.device
+    g = h_q // h_kv
+    k_ref = k.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    v_ref = v.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    scores = torch.matmul(q.double(), k_ref.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+    q_lens = seq_q_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_q_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    kv_lens = seq_kv_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_kv_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_kv, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    i = torch.arange(s_q, device=dev).view(1, 1, s_q, 1)
+    j = torch.arange(s_kv, device=dev).view(1, 1, 1, s_kv)
+    diag = i + (kv_lens - q_lens).view(b, 1, 1, 1) if bottom_right else i
+    dead_q = i >= q_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    masked = dead_q | (j >= kv_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1))
+    if causal:
+        masked = masked | (j > diag)
+    if window_left is not None:
+        # The left window rides the diagonal: keys j < diag - W are masked, W keys below the diagonal stay (the kernel's
+        # WINDOW_LEFT = W = the graph's sliding_window_length - 1; the same convention as the sm107 suite's references).
+        masked = masked | (j < diag - window_left)
+    scores = scores.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+    full = scores if sinks is None else torch.cat([scores, sinks.view(1, h_q, 1, 1).double().expand(b, h_q, s_q, 1)], dim=-1)
+    smax = full.max(dim=-1).values  # -inf on a row with no finite column
+    ssum = torch.exp(full - smax.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)  # exp(-inf - -inf) = NaN on an empty row -> 0
+    lse = smax + torch.log(ssum)  # -inf + -inf on an empty row
+    o = torch.matmul(torch.softmax(full, dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)[..., :s_kv], v_ref)
+    dead = dead_q.squeeze(-1)
+    return dict(o=o, lse=lse.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf")), smax=smax.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf")), ssum=ssum.masked_fill(dead, 0.0))
+
+
+def _run(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    scale,
+    sdpa_kwargs=None,
+    seq_len_kv=None,
+    seq_len_q=None,
+    sink=None,
+    stats=True,
+    outputs=("score_max", "score_sum_exp"),
+    layout="contiguous",
+    stats_log2=False,
+):
+    """Build the graph with the requested side outputs, pin the arch's f16 row, launch TWICE (sentinel-filled outputs, the
+    two-launch delta) and return the buffers."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    d_v = v.shape[-1]
+    dtype = q.dtype
+    o_gpu = torch.empty(b, s_q, h_q, d_v, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    io = cudnn.data_type.HALF if dtype == torch.float16 else cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    tq, tk, tv = g.tensor_like(q), g.tensor_like(k), g.tensor_like(v)
+    kw = dict(name="sdpa", q=tq, k=tk, v=tv, generate_stats=stats, attn_scale=scale, stats_use_log2=stats_log2)
+    vp = {tq: q, tk: k, tv: v}
+    side = {}
+    for name in outputs:
+        buf = make_dense_stats(b, h_q, s_q, layout)
+        t = g.tensor(dim=list(buf.shape), stride=list(buf.stride()), data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name=name)
+        kw[name] = t
+        vp[t] = buf
+        side[name] = buf
+    if seq_len_kv is not None:
+        slk = g.tensor_like(seq_len_kv)
+        kw.update(seq_len_kv=slk, use_padding_mask=True)
+        vp[slk] = seq_len_kv
+        slq_t = seq_len_q if seq_len_q is not None else torch.full((b, 1, 1, 1), s_q, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+        slq = g.tensor_like(slq_t)
+        kw["seq_len_q"] = slq
+        vp[slq] = slq_t
+    if sink is not None:
+        st = g.tensor_like(sink)
+        kw["sink_token"] = st
+        vp[st] = sink
+    kw.update(sdpa_kwargs or {})
+    o, stats_t = g.sdpa(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim(o_gpu.shape).set_stride(o_gpu.stride())
+    stats_gpu = None
+    if stats:
+        stats_gpu = make_dense_stats(b, h_q, s_q, "contiguous")
+        stats_t.set_output(True).set_dim(stats_gpu.shape).set_stride(stats_gpu.stride()).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+        vp[stats_t] = stats_gpu
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    # The plan: the row's unsplit, unpacked 2-CTA prefill tile -- the tile the score arm is wired on -- PINNED, never inferred from the
+    # ranking: with the ports off the heuristics may rank another tile of the row first (the PackGQA cga1 plan on a 148 / 152-SM part for
+    # the GQA shapes), and the bitwise comparisons below must be like for like.  A cga2 plan not in the ranked list is replayed through the
+    # public autotune record (the way an autotuner replays it).
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    ours = [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n == _ROW or n.startswith(_ROW + "[")]
+    assert ours, f"no {_ROW} plan in {names}"
+
+    def _prefill_tile(i):
+        kn = g.plans[i].knobs
+        return (kn.split_kv or 1) == 1 and not kn.pack_gqa and kn.cga in (None, 2)
+
+    idx = next((i for i in ours if _prefill_tile(i)), None)
+    if idx is None:
+        engine_id, record = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(ours[0])
+        record = dict(record)
+        record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_CGA_M] = 2
+        record[cudnn.knob_type.PACK_GQA] = 0
+        record[cudnn.knob_type.SPLIT_KV] = 1
+        g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, record)
+        idx = g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1
+    g.select_plan(idx)
+    plan = g.plans[idx]
+    assert (plan.knobs.split_kv or 1) == 1 and not plan.knobs.pack_gqa and plan.knobs.cga in (None, 2), plan.knobs
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    vp[o] = o_gpu
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def launch():
+        for buf in side.values():
+            buf.fill_(float("nan"))  # sentinel: an unwritten live row stays NaN
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return {n: buf.clone() for n, buf in side.items()}, o_gpu.clone(), (stats_gpu.clone() if stats_gpu is not None else None)
+
+    first, o1, st1 = launch()
+    second, o2, st2 = launch()
+    assert torch.equal(o1, o2) and (st1 is None or torch.equal(st1, st2)), "two-launch delta on O / Stats"
+    for n in side:
+        assert torch.equal(first[n].nan_to_num(-7.0), second[n].nan_to_num(-7.0)), f"two-launch delta on {n}"

+def _check(out, ref, *, has_stats=True):
+    """The contract on every row: keyless rows EXACTLY -inf / 0 (never NaN), live rows against the fp64 oracle, and the
+    LSE identity Stats == score_max + ln(score_sum_exp) evaluated from the kernel's own fp32 outputs."""
+    smax = out["score_max"].squeeze(-1)
+    ssum = out["score_sum_exp"].squeeze(-1)
+    empty = torch.isneginf(ref["smax"])
+    assert torch.isneginf(smax[empty]).all(), "an empty row's score_max must be exactly -inf"
+    assert (ssum[empty] == 0).all(), "an empty row's score_sum_exp must be exactly 0"
+    assert torch.isfinite(smax[~empty]).all() and torch.isfinite(ssum[~empty]).all(), "a live row was left unwritten (sentinel NaN) or non-finite"
+    torch.testing.assert_close(smax[~empty].double(), ref["smax"][~empty], **_TOL_MAX)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(ssum[~empty].double(), ref["ssum"][~empty], **_TOL_SUM)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out["o"].double(), ref["o"], **_TOL_O)
+    if has_stats:
+        lse = out["stats"].squeeze(-1)
+        assert torch.isneginf(lse[empty]).all()

+"""The Rubin index-list sparse d256 forward (``kernels/sm107/sparse_d256_f16.py``) over PRESCRIBED per-CTA item sequences:
+every ring barrier's slot and parity must come from a pipeline state carried across the work items a persistent CTA runs.
+
+A per-item restart of the parity arithmetic passes every one-item-per-CTA cell and fails on an odd / even MIX of tile counts
+between consecutive items: ``1, 1, 1`` leaves the ``s_empty`` ring a phase behind (a hang), ``3, 1, 2`` reads a stale score
+slot, mixes whose tile counts do not sum to a multiple of the K/V ring depth desynchronise that ring.  ``sparse_item_sequences``
+builds work lists on which those sequences are the typical per-CTA order (waves of the device's SM count along the token
+axis, the tile count set through ``block_lens``), holds the open-tail phase constant through the per-batch KV length, poisons
+the outputs with a sentinel (a surviving one = a row never written), poisons the tensor-memory residue through NaN query rows
+on the item before the sequence, and appends batches of KV length 0 (dead items in a run) next to the dead waves.
+
+Host tier (any box): the builder's arithmetic -- the count that yields a tile count round-trips through the kernel's clamp,
+every designed wave lands its target, a ``0`` wave is dead with no open block and tail-only with one, the natural form
+interleaves the four residues, the filler region costs one tile per item.
+
+Rubin tier (``requires_rubin``): the six sequences x the five tail phases, each with two launches.  Pins: no sentinel on any
+row (every item ran and stored), no non-finite output on a row whose query is finite (NaN residue did not travel), dead rows
+``O = 0`` / ``LSE = -inf`` exactly, the live rows within the sparse module's budget (atol 2e-2 on O and LSE, tighter than the dense sm107 suite's 5e-2 on O -- nothing widened),
+and the two launches bitwise.  A 12-fresh-process census of the same cells is a results-tree driver, not a test.
