+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+"""SM100 nonpaged D128 half THD graphs with one query head per KV head run the single-CTA prefill body.
+
+The plan put first is cga 1, unsplit; its output matches an fp32 reference for short, mixed and full-length live sequences
+under the bottom-right causal, top-left causal and plain masks, with and without Stats, for BF16 and FP16; grouped heads keep
+the pair tile.
+"""
+
+import math
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from test_utils import torch_fork_set_rng
+
+from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.engines import engine_name
+from frost_test_utils import _SM, _dsl_installed, requires_blackwell, select_engine
+
+pytestmark = [requires_blackwell, pytest.mark.skipif(_SM not in (100, 103), reason="the single-CTA THD leg is the SM100 / SM103 line's")]
+
+
+def _ref_thd(q_pk, k_pk, v_pk, cu_q, cu_kv, *, scale, mask, group):
+    o = torch.zeros(q_pk.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=q_pk.device)
+    for b in range(len(cu_q) - 1):
+        q = q_pk[cu_q[b] : cu_q[b + 1]].float().permute(1, 0, 2)
+        k = k_pk[cu_kv[b] : cu_kv[b + 1]].float().permute(1, 0, 2).repeat_interleave(group, dim=0)
+        v = v_pk[cu_kv[b] : cu_kv[b + 1]].float().permute(1, 0, 2).repeat_interleave(group, dim=0)
+        s = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+        if mask != "none":
+            sq, skv = q.shape[1], k.shape[1]
+            i = torch.arange(sq, device=q.device).view(-1, 1)
+            j = torch.arange(skv, device=q.device).view(1, -1)
+            s = s.masked_fill(j > i + ((skv - sq) if mask == "bottom_right" else 0), float("-inf"))
+        o[cu_q[b] : cu_q[b + 1]] = torch.matmul(torch.softmax(s, dim=-1), v).permute(1, 0, 2)
+    return o
+
+
+def _run(q_lens, kv_lens, *, h_q, h_kv, s_max_q, s_max_kv, mask="bottom_right", dtype=torch.bfloat16, stats=False, d=128, gap=0):
+    import cudnn
+
+    dev = "cuda"
+    B = len(q_lens)
+    group = h_q // h_kv
+    cu_q, cu_kv = [0], [0]
+    for lq, lk in zip(q_lens, kv_lens):
+        cu_q.append(cu_q[-1] + lq)
+        cu_kv.append(cu_kv[-1] + lk)
+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(d)
+    q_pk = torch.randn(cu_q[-1], h_q, d, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+    k_pk = torch.randn(cu_kv[-1], h_kv, d, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+    v_pk = torch.randn(cu_kv[-1], h_kv, d, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+
+    # Storage rows: sequence b starts at cu[b] + b * gap; a gap > 0 leaves `gap` rows of NaN canary between sequences.
+    row_q = [c + b * gap for b, c in enumerate(cu_q)]
+    row_kv = [c + b * gap for b, c in enumerate(cu_kv)]
+
+    def _buf(packed, lens, rows, s_max, h):
+        stor = torch.full((B * s_max * h * d + gap * B * h * d,), float("nan"), device=dev, dtype=dtype).view(-1, h, d)
+        start = 0
+        for b, n in enumerate(lens):
+            stor[rows[b] : rows[b] + n] = packed[start : start + n]
+            start += n
+        flat = stor.view(-1)
+        return flat, flat.as_strided((B, h, s_max, d), (s_max * h * d, d, h * d, 1))
+
+    _, q_gpu = _buf(q_pk, q_lens, row_q, s_max_q, h_q)
+    _, k_gpu = _buf(k_pk, kv_lens, row_kv, s_max_kv, h_kv)
+    _, v_gpu = _buf(v_pk, kv_lens, row_kv, s_max_kv, h_kv)
+    o_stor = torch.full((B * s_max_q * h_q * d + gap * B * h_q * d,), float("nan"), device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+    o_gpu = o_stor.as_strided((B, h_q, s_max_q, d), (s_max_q * h_q * d, d, h_q * d, 1))
+    slq = torch.tensor(q_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(B, 1, 1, 1)
+    slk = torch.tensor(kv_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(B, 1, 1, 1)
+    ro_q = (torch.tensor(row_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev) * h_q * d).view(B + 1, 1, 1, 1)
+    ro_kv = (torch.tensor(row_kv, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev) * h_kv * d).view(B + 1, 1, 1, 1)
+    ro_s = (torch.tensor(row_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev) * h_q).view(B + 1, 1, 1, 1)
+
+    io = cudnn.data_type.HALF if dtype == torch.float16 else cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    t_q = g.tensor(dim=[B, h_q, s_max_q, d], stride=[s_max_q * h_q * d, d, h_q * d, 1], data_type=io, name="q")
+    t_k = g.tensor(dim=[B, h_kv, s_max_kv, d], stride=[s_max_kv * h_kv * d, d, h_kv * d, 1], data_type=io, name="k")
+    t_v = g.tensor(dim=[B, h_kv, s_max_kv, d], stride=[s_max_kv * h_kv * d, d, h_kv * d, 1], data_type=io, name="v")
+    t_sq, t_sk = g.tensor_like(slq), g.tensor_like(slk)
+    r_q, r_k, r_v, r_o, r_s = (g.tensor_like(ro_q), g.tensor_like(ro_kv), g.tensor_like(ro_kv), g.tensor_like(ro_q), g.tensor_like(ro_s))
+    t_q.set_ragged_offset(r_q)
+    t_k.set_ragged_offset(r_k)
+    t_v.set_ragged_offset(r_v)
+    kw = {"use_causal_mask_bottom_right": True} if mask == "bottom_right" else ({"use_causal_mask": True} if mask == "top_left" else {})
+    o, lse = g.sdpa(
+        name="sdpa",
+        q=t_q,
+        k=t_k,
+        v=t_v,
+        generate_stats=stats,
+        attn_scale=scale,
+        use_padding_mask=True,
+        seq_len_q=t_sq,
+        seq_len_kv=t_sk,
+        max_total_seq_len_q=cu_q[-1],
+        max_total_seq_len_kv=cu_kv[-1],
+        **kw,
+    )
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim([B, h_q, s_max_q, d]).set_stride([s_max_q * h_q * d, d, h_q * d, 1])
+    o.set_ragged_offset(r_o)
+    vp = {t_q: q_gpu, t_k: k_gpu, t_v: v_gpu, o: o_gpu, t_sq: slq, t_sk: slk, r_q: ro_q, r_k: ro_kv, r_v: ro_kv, r_o: ro_q}
+    if stats:
+        stats_gpu = torch.zeros(B * s_max_q * h_q + gap * B * h_q, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
+        lse.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT).set_dim([B, h_q, s_max_q, 1]).set_stride([s_max_q * h_q, 1, h_q, 1])
+        lse.set_ragged_offset(r_s)
+        vp[lse] = stats_gpu.as_strided((B, h_q, s_max_q, 1), (s_max_q * h_q, 1, h_q, 1))
+        vp[r_s] = ro_s
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    plan = select_engine(g, engine_name(arch="sm100"))
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    ws = torch.zeros(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    g.execute(vp, ws)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    o_ref = _ref_thd(q_pk, k_pk, v_pk, cu_q, cu_kv, scale=scale, mask=mask, group=group)
+    tol = dict(atol=5e-2, rtol=3e-2) if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else dict(atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2)
+    o_rows = o_stor.view(-1, h_q, d)
+    for b, n in enumerate(q_lens):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(o_rows[row_q[b] : row_q[b] + n].float(), o_ref[cu_q[b] : cu_q[b + 1]], **tol)
+        if gap:
+            # The canary rows between sequences stay NaN: no store lands outside the declared origins.
+            assert torch.isnan(o_rows[row_q[b] + n : row_q[b] + n + gap]).all(), f"sequence {b}: a store hit the gap after it"
+    return plan.knobs
+
+
+# Live lengths and the declared per-sequence extent (equal for Q and KV, as a ragged cache declaration is).
+_CASES = {
+    "chunks": ([256] * 4, [4096] * 4, 4096),
+    "mixed": ([64, 1024, 256, 8], [4096, 1024, 2048, 4096], 4096),
+    "full": ([1024] * 4, [1024] * 4, 1024),
+    "one_row": ([1, 300], [2048, 300], 2048),
+}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.L0
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", sorted(_CASES))
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mask", ["bottom_right", "top_left", "none"])
+@torch_fork_set_rng(seed=0)

+
+@pytest.mark.L0
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16], ids=["fp16", "bf16"])

+        offset = graph.tensor(name=f"{name}_ro", dim=(b + 1, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT64)
+        node.set_ragged_offset(offset)
+        vp[offset] = (torch.tensor(cu, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev) * nh * dd).view(b + 1, 1, 1, 1)
+        vp[node] = torch.randn(1, total + cap_extra, nh, dd, dtype=dtype, device=dev)
+        if cap_extra:
+            vp[node][0, total:] = float("nan")
+        return node
+
+    q = port("q", sq, tq, cu_q, h, d)
+    k = port("k", skv, tkv, cu_kv, hkv, d)
+    v = port("v", skv, tkv, cu_kv, hkv, dv)
+    q_is_cu, kv_is_cu = (cu_lens, cu_lens) if isinstance(cu_lens, bool) else cu_lens
+    nq_lens, nkv_lens = b + int(q_is_cu), b + int(kv_is_cu)
+    q_len = graph.tensor(name="cu_seq_len_q" if q_is_cu else "seq_len_q", dim=(nq_lens, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+    kv_len = graph.tensor(name="cu_seq_len_kv" if kv_is_cu else "seq_len_kv", dim=(nkv_lens, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+    vp[q_len] = torch.tensor(cu_q if q_is_cu else lens_q, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(nq_lens, 1, 1, 1)
+    vp[kv_len] = torch.tensor(cu_kv if kv_is_cu else lens_kv, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(nkv_lens, 1, 1, 1)
+    kw = dict(
+        name="sdpa",
+        q=q,
+        k=k,
+        v=v,
+        attn_scale=1 / math.sqrt(d),
+        generate_stats=stats_output,
+        use_padding_mask=True,
+        use_causal_mask=causal,
+        use_causal_mask_bottom_right=bottom_right,
+        stats_use_log2=stats_log2,
+    )
+    if declare_total:
+        kw.update(max_total_seq_len_q=tq, max_total_seq_len_kv=tkv)
+    kw.update({("cu_seq_len_q" if q_is_cu else "seq_len_q"): q_len, ("cu_seq_len_kv" if kv_is_cu else "seq_len_kv"): kv_len})
+    kw.update(sdpa_kwargs or {})
+    o, stats = graph.sdpa(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_data_type(io).set_dim((b, h, sq, dv)).set_stride((sq * h * dv, dv, h * dv, 1))
+    o_ro = graph.tensor(name="o_ro", dim=(b + 1, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT64)
+    o.set_ragged_offset(o_ro)
+    vp[o_ro] = (torch.tensor(cu_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev) * h * dv).view(b + 1, 1, 1, 1)
+    vp[o] = torch.full((1, tq + cap_extra, h, dv), float("nan"), dtype=dtype, device=dev)
+
+    if stats_output:
+        stats.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+        if stats_layout in ("head_major", "head_major_padded"):
+            head_stride = tq if stats_layout == "head_major" else ((tq + 63) // 64) * 64
+            stats.set_dim((b, h, sq, 1)).set_stride((h * head_stride, head_stride, 1, 1))
+        else:
+            assert stats_layout == "token_major"
+            stats.set_dim((b, h, sq, 1)).set_stride((sq * h, 1, h, 1))
+        stats_ro = graph.tensor(name="stats_ro", dim=(b + 1, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT64)
+        stats.set_ragged_offset(stats_ro)
+        vp[stats_ro] = (torch.tensor(cu_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev) * (h if stats_layout == "token_major" else 1)).view(b + 1, 1, 1, 1)
+        vp[stats] = torch.full((tq, h) if stats_layout == "token_major" else (1, h, head_stride), float("nan"), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
+    return graph, vp, (q, k, v, o, stats), (cu_q, cu_kv)
+

+def _plan(graph):
+    _build_plan(graph)
+    return torch.empty(max(graph.get_workspace_size(), 1), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")

+def _build_plan(graph):
+    graph.validate()
+    graph.build_operation_graph()
+    graph.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    select_engine(graph, _ENGINE)
+    graph.check_support()
+    graph.build_plans()

+def test_graph_thd_forward_unequal_lengths(dtype, hkv, d, dv, causal, bottom_right, cu_lens, stats_layout, stats_output, stats_log2):
+    torch.manual_seed(7)
+    graph, vp, nodes, (cu_q, cu_kv) = _make_graph(
+        (144, 96),
+        (160, 128),
+        hkv=hkv,
+        d=d,
+        dv=dv,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        causal=causal,
+        bottom_right=bottom_right,
+        cu_lens=cu_lens,
+        stats_layout=stats_layout,
+        stats_output=stats_output,
+        stats_log2=stats_log2,
+    )
+    q, k, v, o, stats = nodes
+    offset_buffers = {node.get_name(): tensor.view(-1) for node, tensor in vp.items() if node.get_name().endswith("_ro")}
+    for name, cu, heads, width in (("q", cu_q, 2, d), ("k", cu_kv, hkv, d), ("v", cu_kv, hkv, dv), ("o", cu_q, 2, dv)):
+        expected = torch.tensor(cu, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda") * heads * width
+        torch.testing.assert_close(offset_buffers[f"{name}_ro"], expected)
+    facts = ga.analyze(graph)
+    assert facts is not None and facts.thd and facts.packed_layout
+    caps = next(spec.capabilities for spec in fwd_engines.ENGINE_SPECS if spec.name == _ENGINE)
+    assert fwd_engines.mismatch(caps, facts) is None
+
+    workspace = _plan(graph)
+    graph.execute(vp, workspace)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    scale = 1 / math.sqrt(d)
+    for batch in range(2):
+        q_slice = vp[q][0, cu_q[batch] : cu_q[batch + 1]].transpose(0, 1).double()
+        k_slice = vp[k][0, cu_kv[batch] : cu_kv[batch + 1]].transpose(0, 1).double()
+        v_slice = vp[v][0, cu_kv[batch] : cu_kv[batch + 1]].transpose(0, 1).double()
+        if hkv != 2:
+            k_slice = k_slice.repeat_interleave(2 // hkv, dim=0)
+            v_slice = v_slice.repeat_interleave(2 // hkv, dim=0)
+        scores = (q_slice @ k_slice.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+        if causal:
+            masked = torch.ones(scores.shape[-2:], dtype=torch.bool, device="cuda").triu(1)
+            scores = scores.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+        if bottom_right:
+            nq, nkv = scores.shape[-2:]
+            qi = torch.arange(nq, device="cuda").view(nq, 1)
+            ki = torch.arange(nkv, device="cuda").view(1, nkv)
+            scores = scores.masked_fill(ki > qi + (nkv - nq), float("-inf"))
+        ref_o = (scores.softmax(-1) @ v_slice).transpose(0, 1)
+        ref_lse = scores.logsumexp(-1) * (math.log2(math.e) if stats_log2 else 1)
+        got_o = vp[o][0, cu_q[batch] : cu_q[batch + 1]]
+        torch.testing.assert_close(got_o.float(), ref_o.float(), rtol=1e-2, atol=4e-3)
+        if stats_output:
+            got_lse = vp[stats][cu_q[batch] : cu_q[batch + 1]].T if stats_layout == "token_major" else vp[stats][0, :, cu_q[batch] : cu_q[batch + 1]]
+            torch.testing.assert_close(got_lse, ref_lse.float(), rtol=3e-2, atol=5e-2)

+def _check_graph_thd_scale_and_replay(scale, d, dv):
+    torch.manual_seed(13)
+    graph, vp, nodes, (cu_q, cu_kv) = _make_graph((129, 64), (65, 95), hkv=1, d=d, dv=dv, bottom_right=True, cap_extra=32, sdpa_kwargs={"attn_scale": scale})
+    q, k, v, o, stats = nodes
+    workspace = _plan(graph)
+
+    def check():
+        for batch in range(2):
+            qs = vp[q][0, cu_q[batch] : cu_q[batch + 1]].transpose(0, 1).double()
+            ks = vp[k][0, cu_kv[batch] : cu_kv[batch + 1]].transpose(0, 1).double().repeat_interleave(2, dim=0)
+            vs = vp[v][0, cu_kv[batch] : cu_kv[batch + 1]].transpose(0, 1).double().repeat_interleave(2, dim=0)
+            nq, nkv = qs.shape[1], ks.shape[1]
+            qi = torch.arange(nq, device=qs.device).view(nq, 1)
+            ki = torch.arange(nkv, device=qs.device).view(1, nkv)
+            scores = ((qs @ ks.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale).masked_fill(ki > qi + nkv - nq, float("-inf"))
+            expected = (scores.softmax(-1).nan_to_num() @ vs).transpose(0, 1).float()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(vp[o][0, cu_q[batch] : cu_q[batch + 1]].float(), expected, rtol=1e-2, atol=4e-3)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(vp[stats][0, :, cu_q[batch] : cu_q[batch + 1]], scores.logsumexp(-1).float(), rtol=3e-2, atol=5e-2)
+        assert torch.count_nonzero(vp[o][0, :64]) == 0
+        assert torch.isneginf(vp[stats][0, :, :64]).all()
+        assert torch.isnan(vp[o][0, cu_q[-1] :]).all()
+
+    graph.execute(vp, workspace)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    check()
+    captured = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    try:
+        with torch.cuda.graph(captured):
+            graph.execute(vp, workspace)
+        vp[v].mul_(0.5)
+        vp[o].fill_(float("nan"))
+        vp[stats].fill_(float("nan"))
+        captured.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        check()
+    finally:
+        captured.reset()
+

+        def launch_spy(*launch_args):

+
+    before = torch.cuda.memory_stats()["allocation.all.allocated"]

+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    after = torch.cuda.memory_stats()["allocation.all.allocated"]

+    from test_sdpa_bwd_staged_sm80 import _assert_kernel_count

+    lens_q, lens_kv = (33, 0, 17), (41, 3, 23)

+    q, k, v, o, stats = nodes
+    stats_view = vp[stats]
+
+    def bind_stats():
+        # Graph producers also expose packed Stats as (T, H, 1), including
+        # head-major storage with an independent, padded head pitch.
+        vp[stats] = stats_view
+        if stats_carrier == "th1":
+            vp[stats] = stats_view.unsqueeze(-1) if stats_layout == "token_major" else stats_view[0, :, : sum(lens_q)].T.unsqueeze(-1)
+
+    bind_stats()
+    storage = {}
+    for index, node in enumerate((q, k, v, o)):
+        _, heads, _, width = node.get_dim()
+        total = sum(lens_q if node in (q, o) else lens_kv)
+        head_stride = width + 8 * (index + 1)
+        token_stride = heads * head_stride + 8 * (index + 2)
+        span = (total + 4) * token_stride + (heads - 1) * head_stride + width
+        backing = torch.full((span + 24,), 77.0 if node is o else float("nan"), dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+        view = backing.as_strided((1, total + 5, heads, width), (0, token_stride, head_stride, 1), 8)
+        if node is not o:
+            view[:, :total].normal_()
+        node.set_stride((7, head_stride, token_stride, 1))
+        for offset in vp:
+            if offset.get_name() == node.get_name() + "_ro":
+                # The graph still describes adjacent sequences; physical token pitches differ by port.
+                vp[offset].div_(node.get_dim()[1] * width, rounding_mode="floor").mul_(token_stride)
+        vp[node] = view
+        storage[node] = backing

+    output_padding.as_strided(vp[o][:, : sum(lens_q)].shape, vp[o].stride(), 8).fill_(False)
+    workspace = _plan(graph)
+

+        vp[o][:, : sum(lens_q)].fill_(float("nan"))
+        vp[stats].fill_(float("nan"))
+        workspace.fill_(0xA5)

+                kd = vp[k][0, ok : ok + nk].transpose(0, 1).double().repeat_interleave(2, dim=0)
+                vd = vp[v][0, ok : ok + nk].transpose(0, 1).double().repeat_interleave(2, dim=0)
+                if nk:
+                    scores = qd @ kd.transpose(-1, -2) / math.sqrt(d)
+                    ref_o, ref_lse = scores.softmax(-1) @ vd, scores.logsumexp(-1)
+                else:
+                    ref_o = torch.zeros((4, nq, dv), dtype=torch.float64, device="cuda")
+                    ref_lse = torch.full((4, nq), -float("inf"), dtype=torch.float64, device="cuda")
+                torch.testing.assert_close(vp[o][0, oq : oq + nq].transpose(0, 1).float(), ref_o.float(), rtol=1e-2, atol=4e-3)
+                got_lse = stats_view[oq : oq + nq].T if stats_layout == "token_major" else stats_view[0, :, oq : oq + nq]
+                torch.testing.assert_close(got_lse, ref_lse.float(), rtol=1e-3, atol=2e-3)
+            oq += nq
+            ok += nk
+        assert torch.all(storage[o][output_padding] == 77)
+        if stats_layout != "token_major":
+            assert torch.isnan(stats_view[0, :, oq:]).all()

+    poison()
+    graph.execute(vp, workspace)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    check(lens_q, lens_kv)
+    if stats_carrier == "th1":
+        good = vp[stats]
+        token_stride, head_stride, _ = good.stride()
+        for bad in (
+            good[:-1],
+            torch.empty_strided(good.shape, (token_stride + 1, head_stride, 1), dtype=good.dtype, device=good.device),
+            torch.empty_strided(good.shape, (token_stride, head_stride + 1, 1), dtype=good.dtype, device=good.device),

+    for node in (q, k, v, o):
+        storage[node] = storage[node].clone()
+        vp[node] = storage[node].as_strided(vp[node].shape, vp[node].stride(), 8)

+    bind_stats()
+    vp[v][:, : sum(lens_kv)].mul_(0.7)

+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    captured = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph(keep_graph=True)
+    try:
+        handle = cudnn_handle
+        previous_stream = cudnn.get_stream(handle)
+        try:

+        finally:

+        new_q, new_kv = (0, 25, 25), (26, 0, 41)
+        for node in vp:

+                vp[node].copy_(torch.tensor(prefix, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda").view_as(vp[node]) * pitch)

+        check(new_q, new_kv)
+    finally:

+"""``sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm90`` reads the bound ragged offsets of a THD graph.
+
+A ragged graph binds one ragged-offset tensor per port, and a padded THD layout -- TE's
+``cu_seqlens_padded`` -- puts a sequence's rows somewhere other than ``prefix(lengths)``.
+Q/K/V must be read, and O written, where the caller put them, and the O gaps are never written
+(they hold a sentinel). Every port may be padded differently (TE pads the Q side and the KV side
+independently), and the offsets may be element counts or token counts with a multiplier. The
+addressing cases fill the gaps with finite values; a separate case fills them with NaN, which a
+K/V tile that runs past its sequence end into the gap would turn into a NaN output (a masked
+probability of exactly 0 times NaN is NaN), so the gaps must not reach the PV product either.
+The packed case (offsets == prefix(lengths) * token stride) is the existing suite's. Stats rows
+follow their own offsets too, in both packed Stats layouts, and an offset past its buffer stays
+inside it (the setup launch clamps every origin and clips every map).
+"""

+def _starts(lens, pads, lead=0):
+    """Padded start rows: ``lead`` empty rows, then sequence ``b`` occupies ``[start[b], start[b] + lens[b])``,
+    then ``pads[b]`` empty rows."""
+    starts, t = [], lead
+    for n, p in zip(lens, pads, strict=True):
+        starts.append(t)
+        t += n + p
+    return starts, t

+def _run_padded_full(
+    lens_q,
+    lens_kv,
+    pads,
+    *,
+    h_q=2,
+    h_kv=2,
+    mask="none",
+    units="elements",
+    dtype=torch.float16,
+    seed=0,
+    gap="nan",
+    offset_dtype=torch.int64,
+    stats=None,
+    edit_offsets=None,
+    lead=None,
+    slack=0,
+    handles=False,
+):
+    """Build and execute a padded THD forward graph on the SM90 row; returns the packed Q/K/V,
+    the O (and Stats) storage and the per-port geometry. ``stats`` is None, ``"token_major"``
+    (packed (T, H)) or ``"head_major"`` (packed (H, T)); ``edit_offsets(port, values)`` may
+    rewrite a port's offset values after the geometry is laid out; ``lead`` gives a port empty
+    rows before its first sequence; ``slack`` adds spare rows to every buffer. The fourth value
+    is None, or with ``handles`` the graph, its variant pack, workspace, offset and length tensors
+    and token strides, for a caller that re-executes or captures the plan."""
+    dev = "cuda"
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(seed)
+    b = len(lens_q)
+    d = _D
+    io = cudnn.data_type.HALF if dtype == torch.float16 else cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    lead = lead or {}
+    geom = {
+        port: _starts(lens_q if port in ("q", "o", "stats") else lens_kv, pads.get(port, [0] * b), lead.get(port, 0)) for port in ("q", "k", "v", "o", "stats")
+    }
+    # One declared extent per side: the widest port's padded total bounds the views.
+    tot = {port: max(geom[p][1] for p in (("q", "o") if port in ("q", "o", "stats") else ("k", "v"))) for port in geom}
+    heads = {"q": h_q, "o": h_q, "k": h_kv, "v": h_kv}
+    s_max_q, s_max_kv = max(lens_q), max(lens_kv)
+
+    packed, stor = {}, {}
+    for port in ("q", "k", "v"):
+        lens = lens_q if port == "q" else lens_kv
+        packed[port] = torch.randn(sum(lens), heads[port], d, generator=gen, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+        rows = tot[port] + max(s_max_q, s_max_kv) + slack
+        if gap == "nan":
+            buf = torch.full((rows, heads[port], d), float("nan"), device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+        else:
+            buf = torch.randn(rows, heads[port], d, generator=gen, device=dev, dtype=dtype) * 4
+        cu = 0
+        for i, n in enumerate(lens):
+            buf[geom[port][0][i] : geom[port][0][i] + n] = packed[port][cu : cu + n]
+            cu += n
+        stor[port] = buf
+    stor["o"] = torch.full((tot["o"] + s_max_q + slack, h_q, d), _SENTINEL, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    vp, t = {}, {}
+
+    ro_type = {torch.int32: cudnn.data_type.INT32, torch.int64: cudnn.data_type.INT64}[offset_dtype]
+    ro_by_port, ts_by_port = {}, {}
+
+    def ragged(port, x, ts):
+        vals = geom[port][0] + [geom[port][1]]
+        if edit_offsets is not None:
+            vals = edit_offsets(port, vals)
+        vals = torch.tensor(vals, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+        ro_t = (vals if units == "tokens" else vals * ts).to(offset_dtype).view(b + 1, 1, 1, 1)
+        ro = g.tensor(name=f"{port}_ro", dim=[b + 1, 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1, 1], data_type=ro_type)
+        x.set_ragged_offset(ro)
+        if units == "tokens":
+            x.set_ragged_offset_multiplier(ts)
+        vp[ro] = ro_t
+        ro_by_port[port], ts_by_port[port] = ro_t, ts
+
+    for port, s_max in (("q", s_max_q), ("k", s_max_kv), ("v", s_max_kv)):
+        ts = heads[port] * d
+        t[port] = g.tensor(name=port, dim=[b, heads[port], s_max, d], stride=[s_max * ts, d, ts, 1], data_type=io)
+        ragged(port, t[port], ts)
+        vp[t[port]] = stor[port]
+    slq = torch.tensor(lens_q, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    slk = torch.tensor(lens_kv, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    sq, skv = g.tensor_like(slq), g.tensor_like(slk)
+    vp[sq], vp[skv] = slq, slk
+    o, st = g.sdpa(
+        name="sdpa",
+        q=t["q"],
+        k=t["k"],
+        v=t["v"],
+        generate_stats=stats is not None,
+        attn_scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(d),
+        use_padding_mask=True,
+        seq_len_q=sq,
+        seq_len_kv=skv,
+        **_mask_graph_kwargs(mask),
+    )
+    ts_o = h_q * d
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim([b, h_q, s_max_q, d]).set_stride([s_max_q * ts_o, d, ts_o, 1])
+    ragged("o", o, ts_o)
+    vp[o] = stor["o"]
+    if stats is not None:
+        rows = tot["stats"] + s_max_q + slack
+        if stats == "token_major":
+            stor["stats"] = torch.full((rows, h_q), _SENTINEL, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
+            st.set_output(True).set_dim([b, h_q, s_max_q, 1]).set_stride([s_max_q * h_q, 1, h_q, 1]).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+            ragged("stats", st, h_q)
+        else:
+            stor["stats"] = torch.full((h_q, rows), _SENTINEL, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
+            st.set_output(True).set_dim([b, h_q, s_max_q, 1]).set_stride([h_q * rows, rows, 1, 1]).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+            ragged("stats", st, 1)
+        vp[st] = stor["stats"]
+
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    _select_engine(g, engine_name(arch="sm90"))
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    g.execute(vp, workspace)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    if handles:
+        return packed, stor, geom, SimpleNamespace(g=g, vp=vp, workspace=workspace, ro=ro_by_port, ts=ts_by_port, slq=slq, slk=slk)
+    return packed, stor, geom, None
+

+def _run_padded(*args, **kwargs):
+    """``_run_padded_full`` without the handles: the packed Q/K/V, the O (and Stats) storage and the geometry."""
+    return _run_padded_full(*args, **kwargs)[:3]

+def _check(lens_q, lens_kv, packed, stor, geom, mask, stats=None, skip=()):
+    """Every sequence's O (and Stats) rows at its origin; nothing written outside them.
+    Sequences in ``skip`` (deliberately bad offsets) are not compared, but their rows still
+    count as live."""
+    o_starts = geom["o"][0]
+    cu_q, cu_k = 0, 0
+    live = torch.zeros(stor["o"].shape[0], dtype=torch.bool, device=stor["o"].device)
+    st_rows = 0 if stats is None else stor["stats"].shape[0 if stats == "token_major" else 1]
+    st_live = torch.zeros(st_rows, dtype=torch.bool, device=stor["o"].device)
+    for i, (nq, nkv) in enumerate(zip(lens_q, lens_kv)):
+        live[o_starts[i] : o_starts[i] + nq] = True
+        st0 = geom["stats"][0][i]
+        st_live[st0 : st0 + nq] = True
+        if i not in skip and nq:
+            qb = packed["q"][cu_q : cu_q + nq].permute(1, 0, 2).unsqueeze(0)
+            kb = packed["k"][cu_k : cu_k + nkv].permute(1, 0, 2).unsqueeze(0)
+            vb = packed["v"][cu_k : cu_k + nkv].permute(1, 0, 2).unsqueeze(0)
+            ref, lse_ref = _ref_sdpa_full(qb, kb, vb, scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(_D), return_stats=True, **_mask_ref_kwargs(mask))
+            got = stor["o"][o_starts[i] : o_starts[i] + nq].permute(1, 0, 2).unsqueeze(0)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(got, ref, atol=5e-2, rtol=3e-2, msg=f"sequence {i}")
+            if stats is not None:
+                rows = stor["stats"][st0 : st0 + nq].transpose(0, 1) if stats == "token_major" else stor["stats"][:, st0 : st0 + nq]
+                torch.testing.assert_close(rows, lse_ref[0], atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2, msg=f"Stats of sequence {i}")
+        cu_q += nq
+        cu_k += nkv
+    assert (stor["o"][~live] == _SENTINEL).all(), "a gap or tail row of O was written"
+    if stats is not None:
+        dead = stor["stats"][~st_live] if stats == "token_major" else stor["stats"][:, ~st_live]
+        assert (dead == _SENTINEL).all(), "a gap or tail row of Stats was written"

+"""The heuristics TABLE of the Rubin (SM107) f16/bf16 small head-dim tiles for the pair-bias / per-key-mask graphs -- what
+``recommend`` proposes first per (D, S, B, mask form) and the measured basis of every row.
+
+The cells are the knob sweep's grid (bf16, D 32 / 64, S_q = S_kv = N = S in 128..2048 plus the ragged leg 200 / 217 / 300 / 450 /
+600, H = 4, B x N flattened batch rows at B 1 / 4, the bias ``[1, H, S, S]`` batch-broadcast, the kv_mask ``[B_flat, 1, 1, S]`` bool,
+a padding mask with per-batch KV lengths of 0.75 S), measured on a 212-SM cc 10.7 node at the 2376 MHz lock: CUDA-graph replay
+100 x 3 with a control twin per process (replay AND the CUPTI kernel time), every ratio SAME-process, the kernel-only CUPTI time
+where the replay is launch-bound (S <= 256).  Each row carries the public knob record the heuristics now propose (``TILE_N`` /
+``TILE_CGA_M``), the private form axes behind it (``n_chunk`` / ``bias_mode`` / ``bias_stages``: the ``config_sm107`` picks until
+the frontend-band knobs land) and the margin of the best measured arm over the pick the heuristics made BEFORE this table
+(POSITIVE = faster, ``t_old / t_new - 1``); ``0`` = the old pick was the best measured arm.

+    # every proposed set is admissible and names a different knob assignment
+    assert len({(p.knobs.tile_n, p.knobs.cga, p.knobs.sched_policy, p.knobs.split_kv, p.knobs.pack_gqa) for p in plans}) == len(plans)
+    # the private axes: the config picks the engine row, the adapter and the factory read (rule 8b')

+def _fixture(block=16, mx=False, has_scale=True, d=128, arch="sm100"):
+    if mx:
+        s, facts, frames, combined, _ = _mx_fixture(d=d, output="float8_e4m3fn")
+    else:
+        s, facts, frames, combined = _fp8_fixture(d, 128, 1, "float8_e4m3fn", "float8_e4m3fn", arch=arch)
+    pack = 2 if block == 16 else 1
+    rows, cols = (s.s_q_max + 127) // 128 * 128, s.d_v // block
+    plane = rows * cols
+    s.quant = s.quant._replace(block_output=prep.BlockOutputSpec((plane, 0, 0, cols), s.b * s.qh * plane, pack, has_scale))
+    if mx and has_scale:
+        facts["scale_o"] = prep.BufferFacts(0x41000000, "float32", (2, 0), 1, (1,), (1,))
+    f = facts["o"]
+    if pack == 2:
+        s.expect["o"], s.elem_bytes["o"] = "uint8", 1
+        facts["o"] = f._replace(dtype="uint8", shape=(*f.shape[:-1], f.shape[-1] // 2), strides=(*(st // 2 for st in f.strides[:-1]), 1), span=f.span // 2)
+    facts["sf_o"] = prep.BufferFacts(0x70000000, "uint8", (2, 0), s.b * s.qh * plane, (s.b, s.qh, rows, cols), (s.qh * plane, plane, cols, 1))
+    s.native = cudnn._pybind_module._SdpaDenseBinder(s)
+    roles = prep._NATIVE_DENSE_ROLES + prep._native_quant_roles(s.quant)
+    return s, facts, frames, roles
+
+
+def _execute(s, facts, roles, workspace=0x50000000, stream=17):
+    return s.native.execute(prep._native_pack_from_facts(facts, roles), tuple(range(len(roles))), stream, workspace=workspace)

+    spec = replace(spec, name="sdpa_bwd_" + engine)
+    shape = (2, 2, 3, 8)
+    addresses = []
+    ops = list(spec.operands)
+    for role, (dims, layout) in zip(pair, ((shape, strides), (shape, strides) if second_layout is None else second_layout)):
+        offsets = {sum(i * s for i, s in zip(index, layout)) for index in product(*(range(n) for n in dims))}
+        addresses.append(offsets)
+        span = max(offsets) + 1
+        i = spec.roles.index(role)
+        ops[i] = replace(ops[i], shape=dims, strides=layout, span=span)
+        facts[role] = facts[role]._replace(shape=dims, strides=layout, span=span)

+    # disjoint layouts that cannot be separated by a stride-GCD check alone.
+    # Head/batch gaps may be smaller than a row gap; mixed layouts and both
+    # pointer orders must not inherit a shortcut for matching run starts.
+    first, second = pair
+    span = max(map(max, addresses)) + 1
+    limit = (span + 15) // 8 * 8

+    s.gate_expect = s.quant = s.combine = None
+    s.expect = dict.fromkeys(("q", "k", "v", "o"), dtype)
+    host_name = "prefill_d512_f16_2x2.py" if d == 576 else f"decode_d{256 if d == 256 else 128}_f16.py"
+    host_path = Path(prep.__file__).parent / "kernels/sm100" / host_name
+    host = next(n for n in ast.parse(host_path.read_text()).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "_host")
+    s.order = [arg.arg for arg in host.args.args if arg.annotation is None or "Constexpr" not in ast.unparse(arg.annotation)]
+    s.index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(s.order)}
+    s.template = [None] * len(s.order)
+    s.template[s.index["seq_q_lens_addr"]] = 0
+    s.owner = object()
+    frames = []
+    s.fn = lambda *frame: frames.append(frame)
+    facts = {}
+    for i, (role, h, seq) in enumerate((("q", 8, sq), ("k", 2, 128), ("v", 2, 128), ("o", 8, sq))):
+        width = d if role in ("q", "k") else d_v
+        shape, strides = (4, h, seq, width), (seq * h * width, width, h * width, 1)
+        if paged and role in ("k", "v"):
+            shape = (32, h, 16, width)
+            pool_hnd = s.paged_v_hnd if role == "v" else hnd
+            strides = (16 * h * width, 16 * width, width, 1) if pool_hnd else (16 * h * width, width, h * width, 1)
+        span = sum((n - 1) * st for n, st in zip(shape, strides)) + 1
+        facts[role] = prep.BufferFacts(0x1000 * (i + 1), dtype, (2, 0), span, shape, strides)
+    if lengths:
+        for i, role in enumerate(("seq_q_lens", "seq_kv_lens")):
+            facts[role] = prep.BufferFacts(0x10000 + i * 0x1000, "int32", (2, 0), 4, (4,), (1,))
+    if lse:
+        facts["lse"] = prep.BufferFacts(0x20000, "float32", (2, 0), 32 * sq, (4, 8, sq), (8 * sq, 1, 8))
+    if paged:
+        for i, role in enumerate(("block_table", "block_table_v")):
+            facts[role] = prep.BufferFacts(0x30000 + i * 0x1000, "int32", (2, 0), 32, (4, 8), (8, 1))
+    s.native_roles = prep._NATIVE_DENSE_ROLES
+    s.native_indices = prep._NATIVE_DENSE_INDICES
+    s.native = cudnn._pybind_module._SdpaDenseBinder(s)
+    return s, facts, frames
+
+
+def _pack(facts):
+    pack = cudnn._pybind_module.VariantPackNative(len(prep._NATIVE_DENSE_ROLES))
+    for i, role in enumerate(prep._NATIVE_DENSE_ROLES):
+        prep._set_native_fact(pack, i, facts.get(role))
+    return pack
+
+
+def _native(s, facts, stream=17):
+    return s.native.bind(_pack(facts), tuple(range(len(prep._NATIVE_DENSE_ROLES))), stream)
+
+
+def _equal(s, facts, stream=17):
+    actual = _native(s, facts, stream)
+    assert list(actual) == binding_reference.bind_dense(s, facts, stream, stream)
+    return actual

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("paged", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("d,sq", [(64, 1), (128, 1), (256, 1), (256, 4)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype_name", ["bfloat16", "float16"])
+def test_native_dense_graph_fresh_bindings_and_changed_replay(
+    paged,
+    d,
+    sq,
+    dtype_name,
+    monkeypatch,
+    request,
+    wide_tables=False,
+    splits=1,
+    d_v=None,
+    prefill=False,
+    wide_output=False,
+    has_sink=False,
+    hnd=False,
+    cc=(10, 0),
+):
+    import torch
+
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() != cc:
+        pytest.skip(f"native dense test requires SM{cc[0]}{cc[1]}")
+    from frost_test_utils import _dsl_installed
+    from test_sdpa_fwd_decode_d128_sm100 import _SM100_ID, _gather_kv, _ref
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.engines import SdpaFwdKnobs
+
+    if not _dsl_installed():
+        pytest.skip("needs the supported CuTe DSL")
+    d_v = d if d_v is None else d_v
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(107)
+    b, h, kh, sk, page = 2, 8, 2, 256 if d == 256 else 128, 128 if d == 256 else 16
+    dtype = getattr(torch, dtype_name)
+    q = torch.randn((b, sq, h, d), device="cuda", dtype=dtype, generator=gen).transpose(1, 2)
+    if paged:
+        pool_shape = (b * sk // page, page, kh, d)
+        k = torch.randn(pool_shape, device="cuda", dtype=dtype, generator=gen).transpose(1, 2)
+        v = torch.randn((*pool_shape[:-1], d_v), device="cuda", dtype=dtype, generator=gen).transpose(1, 2)
+        if hnd:
+            k, v = k.contiguous(), v.contiguous()
+    else:
+        k = torch.randn((b, sk, kh, d), device="cuda", dtype=dtype, generator=gen).transpose(1, 2)
+        v = torch.randn((b, sk, kh, d_v), device="cuda", dtype=dtype, generator=gen).transpose(1, 2)
+
+    # Padded output storage detects a wrong stride or an accidental compact store.
+    def output_storage():
+        shape = (b, h, sq, d_v + 16)
+        strides = ((2**32 + 16384) if wide_output else sq * h * (d_v + 16), d_v + 16, h * (d_v + 16), 1)
+        try:
+            return torch.empty_strided(shape, strides, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+        except torch.OutOfMemoryError:
+            if wide_output:
+                pytest.skip("insufficient free GPU memory for a physical wide-stride output")
+            raise
+
+    o_storage = output_storage()
+    o = o_storage[..., :d_v]
+    lse = torch.empty((b, h, sq, 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    q_lens = torch.full((b, 1, 1, 1), sq, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    kv_lens = torch.tensor([sk, 63], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    use_lengths = splits == 1 or paged
+    if not use_lengths:
+        kv_lens.fill_(sk)
+    tables = [torch.arange(b * sk // page, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(b, 1, sk // page, 1)]
+    tables.append(tables[0].flip(2).clone())
+    if wide_tables:
+        # Two live batch rows force device address arithmetic to traverse the
+        # wide stride. A singleton only checks the host argument's type.
+        try:
+            wide = [torch.empty_strided(t.shape, (2**32 + 32, 1, 1, 1), device="cuda", dtype=t.dtype) for t in tables]
+        except torch.OutOfMemoryError:
+            pytest.skip("insufficient free GPU memory for two physical wide-stride page tables")
+        for dst, src in zip(wide, tables):
+            dst.copy_(src)
+        tables = wide
+    inputs = [q, k, v, q_lens, kv_lens] + (tables if paged else [])
+    if has_sink:
+        inputs.append(torch.linspace(-2, 6, h, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32).view(1, h, 1, 1))
+    handle = cudnn.create_handle()
+    request.addfinalizer(lambda: cudnn.destroy_handle(handle))
+    graph = cudnn.pygraph(
+        handle=handle,
+        io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else cudnn.data_type.HALF,
+        intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+        compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+        is_override_shape_enabled=True,
+    )
+    desc = [graph.tensor_like(t).set_uid(i + 1) for i, t in enumerate(inputs)]
+    kwargs = dict(paged_attention_k_table=desc[5], paged_attention_v_table=desc[6], paged_attention_max_seq_len_kv=sk) if paged else {}
+    if has_sink:
+        kwargs["sink_token"] = desc[-1]
+    out, stats = graph.sdpa(
+        q=desc[0],
+        k=desc[1],
+        v=desc[2],
+        generate_stats=True,
+        attn_scale=d**-0.5,
+        use_padding_mask=use_lengths,
+        seq_len_q=desc[3] if use_lengths else None,
+        seq_len_kv=desc[4] if use_lengths else None,
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+    out.set_uid(100).set_output(True).set_dim(o.shape).set_stride(o.stride())
+    stats.set_uid(101).set_output(True).set_dim(lse.shape).set_stride(lse.stride()).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    graph.validate()
+    graph.build_operation_graph()
+    # Manifest slot 15 is the distinct Rubin half engine.
+    engine_id = 20505 if cc[0] == 12 else (20515 if cc == (10, 7) else _SM100_ID)
+    if cc[0] == 12:
+        tile_m, tile_n, cga = 64, 32 if d > 256 else 64, 1
+    else:
+        tile_m, tile_n, cga = 128, 128, 2 if prefill or d == 256 else 1
+    graph.create_execution_plan(engine_id, SdpaFwdKnobs(sched_policy=0, tile_m=tile_m, tile_n=tile_n, cga=cga, pack_gqa=cc != (10, 7), split_kv=splits))
+    graph.build_plan_at_index(0)
+    launch = graph._compiled_plans[graph._plan_index]._prepared
+    assert isinstance(launch, prep.PreparedDenseLaunch) and launch.spec.native is not None
+    assert launch.spec.split == splits
+    if paged:
+        assert launch.spec.paged_hnd == hnd
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prep, "facts_of_roles", lambda *args: pytest.fail("native graph rebuilt Python facts"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prep, "bind_dense", lambda *args: pytest.fail("native graph used Python binding"), raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prep, "bind_dense_split", lambda *args: pytest.fail("native graph used Python split binding"), raising=False)
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(graph.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    uids = tuple(range(1, len(inputs) + 1)) + (100, 101)
+    completions = []
+    finish = graph._finish_ordered
+
+    def complete(*args):
+        completions.append(1)
+        return finish(*args)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(graph, "_finish_ordered", complete)
+
+    def call(buffers=None, call_uids=None, call_workspace=None, **overrides):
+        cudnn.set_stream(handle, torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
+        graph.execute(
+            (*inputs, o, lse) if buffers is None else buffers,
+            workspace if call_workspace is None else call_workspace,
+            handle=handle,
+            tensor_uids=uids if call_uids is None else call_uids,
+            **overrides,
+        )
+
+    def check(active_batch=b):
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        for i in range(active_batch):
+            keys, vals = inputs[1][i].transpose(0, 1), inputs[2][i].transpose(0, 1)
+            length = int(inputs[4][i].item())
+            if paged:
+                keys = _gather_kv(inputs[1].transpose(1, 2), inputs[5][i].reshape(-1), length, False)
+                vals = _gather_kv(inputs[2].transpose(1, 2), inputs[6][i].reshape(-1), length, False)
+            expected_o, expected_lse = _ref(
+                inputs[0][i].transpose(0, 1), keys[:length], vals[:length], int(inputs[3][i].item()), d**-0.5, sink=inputs[-1] if has_sink else None
+            )
+            torch.testing.assert_close(o[i].transpose(0, 1).float(), expected_o, atol=0.03, rtol=0.01)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(lse[i, :, :, 0], expected_lse, atol=0.005, rtol=0.001)
+        assert torch.all(o_storage[..., d_v:] == 123).item()
+
+    def poison():
+        o_storage.fill_(123)
+        lse.fill_(float("nan"))
+        if splits > 1:
+            workspace.fill_(37)
+
+    poison()
+    torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")
+    try:
+        call()
+    finally:
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("default")
+    check()
+    assert not completions or splits > 1, "zero-scratch native ordered tensors rebuilt a Python VariantPack"
+    completions.clear()
+
+    class PythonBuffer:
+        # A supported producer without the native exchange protocol must finish
+        # the current observation before calling the same validated binder.
+        def __init__(self, tensor):
+            self.tensor = tensor
+            self.shape, self.dtype, self.device = tensor.shape, tensor.dtype, tensor.device
+
+        def data_ptr(self):
+            return self.tensor.data_ptr()
+
+        def stride(self):
+            return self.tensor.stride()
+
+        def element_size(self):
+            return self.tensor.element_size()
+
+    for wrap_workspace in (False, True):
+        poison()
+        if wrap_workspace:
+            call(call_workspace=PythonBuffer(workspace))
+        else:
+            call(buffers=(PythonBuffer(inputs[0]), *inputs[1:], o, lse))
+        check()
+    assert len(completions) == 2
+    completions.clear()
+
+    # Even a zero-scratch plan validates a workspace supplied by the caller.
+    # Both invalid calls otherwise have valid writable outputs, so poisoning
+    # detects an accidental launch without risking an invalid device address.
+    invalid_calls = ("duplicate_uid", "strided_workspace")
+    if splits > 1:
+        invalid_calls += ("null_workspace", "short_workspace", "cpu_workspace", "short_final_stats")
+    if has_sink:
+        invalid_calls += ("short_sink",)
+    for invalid in invalid_calls:
+        poison()
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+            if invalid == "duplicate_uid":
+                call(call_uids=(uids[1], *uids[1:]))
+            elif invalid == "strided_workspace":
+                call(call_workspace=torch.empty(8, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)[::2])
+            elif invalid == "null_workspace":
+                call(call_workspace=0)
+            elif invalid == "short_workspace":
+                call(call_workspace=workspace[:-1])
+            elif invalid == "cpu_workspace":
+                call(call_workspace=torch.empty(workspace.numel(), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cpu"))
+            elif invalid == "short_sink":
+                call(buffers=(*inputs[:-1], inputs[-1].view(-1)[:1], o, lse))
+            else:
+                call(buffers=(*inputs, o, lse.view(-1)[:1]))
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        assert torch.all(o_storage == 123).item()
+        assert torch.isnan(lse).all().item()
+        if splits > 1:
+            assert torch.all(workspace == 37).item(), "invalid final outputs must reject before the partial kernel"
+        call(buffers=tuple(reversed((*inputs, o, lse))), call_uids=tuple(reversed(uids)))
+        check()
+    completions.clear()
+
+    # Unsplit permits a smaller effective batch. Split partial workspace is
+    # declared-size and must reject that override before either launch.
+    smaller = tuple(t if (paged and i in (1, 2)) or (has_sink and i == len(inputs) - 1) else t[:1] for i, t in enumerate((*inputs, o, lse)))
+    poison()
+    overrides = dict(
+        buffers=smaller, override_uids=uids, override_shapes=tuple(tuple(t.shape) for t in smaller), override_strides=tuple(tuple(t.stride()) for t in smaller)
+    )
+    if splits > 1:
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+            call(**overrides)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        assert torch.all(workspace == 37).item()
+        assert torch.all(o_storage == 123).item()
+    else:
+        call(**overrides)
+        check(active_batch=1)
+        assert torch.all(o_storage[1:] == 123).item()
+    call()
+    check()
+    assert not completions or splits > 1
+
+    owners = (inputs, o_storage, lse, workspace)
+    inputs = [t.clone() for t in inputs]
+    o_storage = output_storage()
+    o = o_storage[..., :d_v]
+    lse, workspace = torch.empty_like(lse), torch.empty_like(workspace)
+    poison()
+    call()
+    check()
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        call()
+    stream.synchronize()

+        sample_q=q,
+        sample_k=k,
+        sample_v=v,
+        sample_o=o,
+        sample_lse=lse if stats_mode != "none" else None,
+        stats_log2=stats_mode == "log2",
+        split_kv=splits,

+    monkeypatch.setattr(prep, "bind_dense_split", lambda *args: pytest.fail("standalone native path used Python split binding"), raising=False)

+        if cc[0] == 12:

+            # SM100's standalone adapter requires exactly B elements.

+            q_lens, kv_lens = (oversized, saved_lens[1]) if role == "q" else (saved_lens[0], oversized)
+            call(d**-0.5)
+            check(d**-0.5)
+            invalid = saved_lens[index][:1]

+        else:

+        q_lens, kv_lens = (invalid, saved_lens[1]) if role == "q" else (saved_lens[0], invalid)
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=message):

+        for workspace in (saved_workspace[:-1], saved_workspace[::2], torch.empty(saved_workspace.shape, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cpu")):
+            o.fill_(123)

+            assert torch.all(o == 123).item()

+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())

+        v.mul_(0.5)
+        if has_sink:
+            sinks.add_(1.0)
+        o.fill_(float("nan"))
+        lse.fill_(float("nan"))
+        capture.replay()
+        check(scale)
+    finally:
+        capture.reset()
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("group", [6, 12, 24, 192])
+def test_native_dense_partial_admission(group, monkeypatch):
+    """A partial-group pin reaches the native tile and keeps other route boundaries."""

+    knobs = engines.SdpaFwdKnobs(cga=2, pack_gqa=True, split_kv=1)
+    for dims in ((128, 128), (64, 64), (96, 80)):

+        assert engines.mismatch(caps, f, knobs) is None
+        assert engines.mismatch(caps, f, dataclasses.replace(knobs, split_kv=2)) is None
+    assert engines.mismatch(caps, facts, dataclasses.replace(knobs, cga=1)) is not None
+    for changed in (dict(attn_scale_prefolded=True), dict(h_q=6), dict(d_qk=256, d_v=256), dict(has_paged_kv=True)):

+    import cudnn
+    import torch
+
+    from test_sdpa_fwd_dsl_sm107 import _dense_mask, _half_oracle, _half_prefold_api, _rubin_only
+

+        "partial12_sink": (12, (96, 80), 257, 257, 1, True, True),

+    if sink:
+        tensors["sinks"] = g.tensor_like(bufs["sinks"]).set_dim([1, 2 * group, 1, 1]).set_stride([2 * group, 1, 1, 1])

+        k=tensors["k"],

+    index = next(i for i in range(g.get_execution_plan_count()) if g.get_plan_name_at_index(i).startswith("sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm107"))
+    engine, knobs = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(index)
+    # Packing/splitting moves the small-D graph to D128. Pin that flavor's
+    # tiles, rather than inheriting the 64-wide native flavor's default.
+    chosen = {

+        cudnn.knob_type.TILE_N: 128,

+    captures, bindings = [], []

+            for n, value in current.items():

+from test_sdpa_native_thd_fp8_binding import _fixture as _thd_fixture

+pytestmark = [pytest.mark.L1]

+def _fixture(thd=False, d=128, dv=128, split=1, output="bfloat16", carrier="uint8"):
+    if thd:
+        s, facts, frames = _thd_fixture(d, dv, output=output)
+        combined = []
+    else:
+        s, facts, frames, combined = _dense_fixture(d, dv, split, "float8_e4m3fn", output)
+    if not thd and d == 512 and split > 1:
+        # MX D512 writes half partials even on SM100; the final FP8 O is separate.
+        partial = "bfloat16" if output == "bfloat16" else "float16"
+        s.fp32_partial = False
+        s.expect["o"] = partial
+        s.elem_bytes["o"] = 2
+        s.combine = s.combine._replace(o=s.combine.o._replace(dtype=partial), lse_offset=s.combine.o.numel * 2)
+        s.quant = s.quant._replace(scratch_offset=s.combine.lse_offset + s.combine.lse.numel * 4)
+    old = dict(zip(s.order, s.template))
+    path = Path(prep.__file__).parent / "kernels/_mxfp8_host.py"
+    host = next(n for n in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "host")
+    s.order = [a.arg for a in host.args.args if "Constexpr" not in ast.unparse(a.annotation)]
+    s.index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(s.order)}
+    s.template = [old.get(name) for name in s.order]
+    sizes = ((d + 127) // 128 * 512,) * 2 + ((dv + 127) // 128 * 512,)
+    s.quant = s.quant._replace(sf_sizes=sizes)
+    for role in prep._QUANT_ROLES[:-1]:
+        facts.pop(role, None)
+    for i, (role, h, size) in enumerate(zip(("sf_q", "sf_k", "sf_v"), (s.qh, s.kh, s.kh), sizes)):
+        count = (2 if i == 0 else 4) if thd else ((s.s_q_max if i == 0 else s.s_k_max) + 127) // 128
+        b = 1 if thd else s.b
+        width = prep._buffers.DTYPE_ITEMSIZE[carrier]
+        size //= width
+        facts[role] = prep.BufferFacts(
+            0x60000000 + i * 0x1000000, carrier, (2, 0), b * h * count * size, (b, h, count, size), (h * count * size, count * size, size, 1)
+        )
+    roles = (prep._NATIVE_THD_ROLES if thd else prep._NATIVE_DENSE_ROLES) + prep._native_quant_roles(s.quant)
+    s.native = (cudnn._pybind_module._SdpaThdBinder if thd else cudnn._pybind_module._SdpaDenseBinder)(s)
+    return s, facts, frames, combined, roles
+
+
+def _execute(s, facts, roles, thd, workspace=0x50000000):
+    pack = prep._native_pack_from_facts(facts, roles)
+    indices = tuple(range(len(roles)))
+    if thd:
+        return s.native.execute(pack, indices, workspace, 17)
+    return s.native.execute(pack, indices, 17, workspace=workspace)
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("thd,split", [(False, 1), (False, 4), (True, 1)])

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("output", ["bfloat16", "float8_e4m3fn"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("carrier", ["uint8", "int32"])
+def test_mxfp8_native_actual_host_frames(thd, split, d, dv, output, carrier):
+    s, facts, frames, combined, roles = _fixture(thd, d, dv, split, output, carrier)
+    for offset in (0, 2**33):
+        fresh = {role: f._replace(ptr=f.ptr + offset) if f is not None else None for role, f in facts.items()}
+        native, s.native = s.native, None
+        try:
+            binding_reference.execute_quantized(s, fresh, 0x50000000 + offset, 17, 17)
+        finally:
+            s.native = native
+        expected, tail = frames.pop(), combined.pop() if split > 1 else None
+        _execute(s, fresh, roles, thd, 0x50000000 + offset)
+        assert frames.pop() == expected
+        if tail is not None:
+            assert combined.pop() == tail

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("thd", [False, True])

+def test_mxfp8_current_scale_rejection_precedes_writes(thd, role, kind, monkeypatch):
+    writes = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prep._buffers, "fill_word_async", lambda *a: writes.append(a))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prep._buffers, "memset_zero_async", lambda *a: writes.append(a))
+    s, facts, frames, combined, roles = _fixture(thd)
+    _execute(s, facts, roles, thd)
+    frames.clear()
+    f = facts[role]
+    changed = dict(
+        missing=None,
+        device=f._replace(device=(1, 0)),
+        alignment=f._replace(ptr=f.ptr + 1),
+        null=f._replace(ptr=0),
+        span=f._replace(span=f.span - 1),
+        hole=f._replace(strides=(*f.strides[:-1], 2)),
+        overlap=f._replace(strides=(f.strides[0], 0, *f.strides[2:])),
+        negative=f._replace(strides=(*f.strides[:-1], -1)),
+        workspace=f._replace(ptr=0x50000000),
+        amax=f._replace(ptr=facts["amax_o"].ptr),
+    )[kind]
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        _execute(s, dict(facts, **{role: changed}), roles, thd)
+    assert frames == combined == writes == []

+def test_mxfp8_wide_geometry_rejects_without_launch(thd, kind):

+    if kind == "int64_product":
+        f = f._replace(shape=(2**62, 8), strides=(8, 1), span=-1)
+    elif kind == "int64_address":
+        f = f._replace(ptr=2**63 - 16)
+    else:

+    s, facts, frames = _fixture(dtype=dtype, paged=paged, hnd=hnd, sq=65)
+    s.d_qk, s.d_v = dq, dv
+    for role in ("q", "k", "v", "o"):
+        f = facts[role]
+        dim = dq if role in ("q", "k") else dv
+        shape = (*f.shape[:-1], dim)
+        strides = tuple(st // 128 * dim for st in f.strides[:-1]) + (1,)
+        span = sum((n - 1) * st for n, st in zip(shape, strides)) + 1
+        facts[role] = f._replace(shape=shape, strides=strides, span=span)

+    path = Path(prep.__file__).parent / "kernels" / arch / (stem + ".py")
+    if arch == "sm120":
+        path = path.with_name("prepared_host.py")
+    host = next(n for n in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == ("host" if arch == "sm120" else "_host"))
+    s.order = [arg.arg for arg in host.args.args if arg.annotation is None or "Constexpr" not in ast.unparse(arg.annotation)]
+    s.index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(s.order)}
+    s.template = [None] * len(s.order)
+    for name in ("seq_q_lens_addr", "lse_ext", "n_thd_units"):
+        if name in s.index:
+            s.template[s.index[name]] = 0
+    combined = []
+    if split > 1:
+        s.split, s.fp32_partial = split, arch != "sm120"
+        s.expect["o"] = "float32" if s.fp32_partial else dtype
+        partial_bytes = 4 if s.fp32_partial else 2
+        rows, h, sq = split * s.b, s.qh, s.s_q_max
+        o_size, lse_size = rows * sq * h * dv, rows * h * sq
+        s.combine = prep.SplitCombineSpec(

+            prep.BufferFacts(0, "float32", (2, 0), lse_size, (rows, h, sq), (h * sq, sq, 1)),
+            o_size * partial_bytes,
+            dtype,
+            True,
+        )

+    b, sq, sk, h, hk = 2, 4, 128, 8, 2

+    graph, desc = _thd_graph(b, sq, sk, h, hk, d, causal=False, has_sink=True, arch=arch)
+    launch = graph._compiled_plans[graph._plan_index]._prepared
+    assert isinstance(launch, prep.PreparedThdLaunch) and launch.spec.native is not None
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prep, "facts_of_roles", lambda *a: pytest.fail("native graph rebuilt Python facts"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prep, "_bind_thd_python", lambda *a: pytest.fail("native graph used Python binding"), raising=False)
+    buf = _buffers(b, sq, sk, h, hk, d)
+    sinks = torch.linspace(-2, 6, h, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32).view(1, h, 1, 1)

+            k = buf["k"][i * sk : (i + 1) * sk].double().transpose(0, 1).repeat_interleave(h // hk, 0)
+            v = buf["v"][i * sk : (i + 1) * sk].double().transpose(0, 1).repeat_interleave(h // hk, 0)
+            scores = q @ k.transpose(-1, -2) * d**-0.5
+            scores = torch.cat((scores, sinks.double().view(h, 1, 1).expand(h, sq, 1)), -1)
+            expected = scores.softmax(-1)[..., :sk] @ v
+            torch.testing.assert_close(buf["o"][i * sq : (i + 1) * sq].double(), expected.transpose(0, 1), atol=0.008, rtol=0.015)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(buf["lse"][i * sq : (i + 1) * sq].double(), scores.logsumexp(-1).T, atol=0.003, rtol=0.001)

+    call()
+    check()
+    old = buf, sinks, ws
+    buf = {name: value.clone() for name, value in buf.items()}
+    sinks, ws = sinks.clone().add_(1), torch.empty_like(ws)
+    call(True)
+    check()
+    good = sinks
+    sinks = good.view(-1)[:1]
+    ws.fill_(37)
+    buf["o"].fill_(123)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        call(True)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    assert torch.all(buf["o"] == 123).item()
+    assert torch.all(ws == 37).item(), "sink rejection must precede the setup kernel"
+    sinks = good
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    capture = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    try:
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):

+        stream.synchronize()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(capture, stream=stream):
+            call(True)
+        sinks.add_(2)
+        buf["q"].add_(0.2)
+        buf["o"].fill_(float("nan"))
+        buf["lse"].fill_(float("nan"))
+        capture.replay()
+        check()
+    finally:

+    del old

+def test_lean_walk_strided_outputs_touch_only_their_elements(_m):
+    """The final O / Stats keep the caller's strides (Rule S5) through the walk's packed and element store paths."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.kernels.sm100 import split_combine as comb

+    ostride, lstride = (batch, token, head, 2), (h * (sq * 2 + 3) + 5, sq * 2 + 3, 2)
+
+    def storage(shape, strides, dtype):
+        span = 1 + sum((n - 1) * s for n, s in zip(shape, strides))

+            dims = [1] * len(shape)
+            dims[axis] = n
+            offsets += torch.arange(n).view(dims) * s
+        used = torch.zeros(store.numel(), dtype=torch.bool)
+        used[offsets.flatten() + 16] = True
+        return view, store, used

+    fn = positional_entry(comb.compile_ptr(dtype_o="bf16", has_lse=True, decode_grid=comb.DECODE_GRID_LEAN_WALK))

+def test_lean_walk_gated_entry(dtype, splits):
+    """The gate in the combine on the walk: ``O = merged_fp32 * sigmoid(G)`` rounded once, the dead row exactly 0 under a NaN gate
+    (the SELECT after the fma), the LSE gate-free, and bitwise the serial walk's gated output (S_q 4)."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.kernels.sm100 import split_combine as comb
+
+    b, h, sq, d = 8, 24, 4, 256
+    tag = "f16" if dtype == torch.float16 else "bf16"
+    op, lp, ref_o, ref_lse = _partials(b, h, sq, d, splits)
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(7 + splits)
+    gate = (torch.randn(b, sq, h, d, generator=gen) * 3.0).to(dtype)
+    gate[:, 0] = torch.nan  # row 0 is the all-dead row: a NaN gate there must never reach the output
+    gate = gate.cuda()
+    ref = ref_o * torch.sigmoid(gate.float().cpu().double()).masked_fill(torch.isnan(gate.float().cpu()), 0.0)
+    fns = _forms(comb, dtype_o=tag, has_lse=True, dtype_partial="f32", gate=True, dtype_gate=tag)
+    outs = {}
+    for name in ("walk", "off"):
+        o, lse = _launch(fns[name], op, lp, b, h, sq, d, splits, dtype=dtype, extra=(gate.data_ptr(), gate.stride()))
+        assert not torch.isnan(o.float()).any()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(o.cpu().float(), ref.float(), atol=0.004, rtol=0.004)

+"""The shared split combine over MANY splits: the grouped walks (the lean forms' up-front loads of at most ``G_S`` splits, the serial and
+decode forms' walks past them) reduce every split count -- a group boundary hit exactly, one short of it, one past it, and a decode-shaped
+row count -- to the float64 reference, with dead splits and dead rows handled as the three-split tests of ``test_sdpa_split_combine_sm100.py``
+pin them -- the decode-shaped case keeps its only row LIVE (a dead split inside the walk and a dead LAST split beside live ones), so the
+grouped accumulation on a live decode row is what it checks; the multi-row shape adds the all-dead row.  Runs on any
+SM100-line part (the combine has no arch-specific lowering; the Rubin d256 decode tile is its heaviest caller at 64 splits)."""

+def test_packed_prefetch_excludes_zero_weight_partials(monkeypatch, group, sink):
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.kernels.sm100 import split_combine as comb
+
+    # Select an explicit reducer specialization, independently of placement.
+    original_compile = comb._compile_cached
+
+    def specialized(fn, *args, cache_key=None, **kwargs):
+        assert fn is comb._host_ptr_packed
+        return original_compile(fn, *args, cache_key=None, prefetch_group=group, **kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(comb, "_compile_cached", specialized)
+    comb.compile_ptr.cache_clear()
+    splits, h, rows, d = max(2, group - 1), 2, 3, 128
+    op = torch.arange(splits * rows * h * d, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32).reshape(splits, rows, h, d) / 1024
+    lp = torch.zeros(splits, h, rows, device="cuda")
+    lp[:, :, 0] = -torch.inf
+    op[:, 0] = torch.nan
+    lp[0, :, 1] = -2048  # Finite LSE, but a zero weight even in the FP64 reference.
+    op[0, 1] = torch.nan
+    sinks = torch.tensor([-torch.inf, 1000.0], device="cuda") if sink else None
+    if sink:
+        op[:, :, 1] = torch.nan  # The sink makes every real split's weight zero on head 1.
+    scores = lp.double()
+    maximum = scores.amax(0)
+    if sink:
+        maximum = torch.maximum(maximum, sinks.double()[:, None])
+    safe_maximum = torch.where(torch.isfinite(maximum), maximum, 0)
+    weights = (scores - safe_maximum).exp()
+    denominator = weights.sum(0)
+    if sink:
+        denominator += (sinks.double()[:, None] - safe_maximum).exp()
+    weighted = weights.permute(0, 2, 1).unsqueeze(-1)
+    safe_o = torch.where(weighted > 0, op.double(), 0)
+    ref_o = (weighted * safe_o).sum(0) / denominator.clamp_min(1).T.unsqueeze(-1)
+    ref_lse = safe_maximum + denominator.log()
+    o = torch.empty(1, rows, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    lse = torch.empty(1, h, rows, device="cuda")
+    total = torch.tensor([rows], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    try:
+        owner = comb.compile_ptr(dtype_o="bf16", packed=True, has_lse=True, has_sink=sink)
+        fn = positional_entry(owner)
+        assert fn is not None
+
+        def run():
+            fn(
+                op.data_ptr(),
+                lp.data_ptr(),
+                o.data_ptr(),
+                lse.data_ptr(),
+                (1, h, rows, d),
+                splits,
+                o.stride(),
+                lse.stride(),
+                total.data_ptr(),
+                torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream,
+                sinks.data_ptr() if sink else None,
+                None,
+                None,
+                0,
+            )
+
+        run()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            run()
+        for live in (rows, 1, 0):
+            total.fill_(live)
+            o.fill_(-31)
+            lse.fill_(-31)
+            graph.replay()
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(o[0, :live].double(), ref_o[:live], atol=0.004, rtol=0.004)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(lse[0, :, :live].double(), ref_lse[:, :live], atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-5)
+            assert torch.all(o[0, live:] == -31) and torch.all(lse[0, :, live:] == -31)
+    finally:
+        graph.reset()
+        comb.compile_ptr.cache_clear()

+def _partials(b, h, sq, d, splits):
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(20261014 + splits)
+    o = torch.randn(splits, b, sq, h, d, generator=generator) * 0.4
+    lse = torch.randn(splits, b, h, sq, generator=generator) * 2.0 + 0.7
+    if sq > 1:
+        lse[:, :, :, 0] = -torch.inf  # every split dead on one row (a multi-row shape); the decode shape keeps its ONLY row live
+    lse[1, :, :, min(1, sq - 1)] = -torch.inf  # a dead split beside live ones
+    lse[splits - 1, :, 0, :] = -torch.inf  # the LAST split dead on one head: the clamped tail slots re-read it
+    dead = torch.isneginf(lse).permute(0, 1, 3, 2).unsqueeze(-1)
+    o.masked_fill_(dead, torch.nan)  # a dead payload must never enter the arithmetic
+    scores = lse.double()
+    maximum = scores.amax(0)
+    safe_maximum = torch.where(torch.isfinite(maximum), maximum, 0)
+    weights = (scores - safe_maximum).exp()
+    denominator = weights.sum(0)
+    safe_o = o.double().masked_fill(dead, 0)
+    ref_o = (weights.permute(0, 1, 3, 2).unsqueeze(-1) * safe_o).sum(0) / denominator.clamp_min(1).permute(0, 2, 1).unsqueeze(-1)
+    ref_lse = safe_maximum + denominator.log()
+    return o.reshape(splits * b, sq, h, d).cuda(), lse.reshape(splits * b, h, sq).cuda(), ref_o, ref_lse
+

+def test_pointer_combine_folds_the_sink_once():
+    """The sink entries: M = max(max_s lse_s, sink), den = sum_s exp(lse_s - M) +
+    exp(sink - M), O = sum_s w_s O_s / den (the sink column has no V row) and
+    LSE = M + log(den).  Row 0 has every split dead, so its whole mass is the
+    sink: O := 0 and LSE := sink exactly (not -inf); the three heads carry a
+    sink far below, inside and above the split LSE range."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.kernels.sm100 import split_combine as comb
+
+    b, h, sq, d, splits = 2, 3, 5, 128, 3
+    op, lp, _, _ = _partials(b, h, sq, d, splits)
+    sinks = torch.tensor([-120.0, 0.7, 4.0], device="cuda")
+    lse = lp.view(splits, b, h, sq).double().cpu()
+    o = op.view(splits, b, sq, h, d).double().cpu()
+    dead = torch.isneginf(lse)
+    sink_col = sinks.double().cpu().view(1, h, 1).expand(b, h, sq)
+    maximum = torch.maximum(lse.amax(0), sink_col)
+    weights = torch.where(dead, torch.zeros_like(lse), (lse - maximum).exp())
+    denominator = weights.sum(0) + (sink_col - maximum).exp()
+    safe_o = o.masked_fill(dead.permute(0, 1, 3, 2).unsqueeze(-1), 0)
+    ref_o = (weights.permute(0, 1, 3, 2).unsqueeze(-1) * safe_o).sum(0) / denominator.permute(0, 2, 1).unsqueeze(-1)
+    ref_lse = maximum + denominator.log()
+    o_out = torch.empty(b, sq, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    lse_out = torch.empty(b, h, sq, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    fn = positional_entry(comb.compile_ptr(dtype_o="bf16", has_lse=True, has_sink=True))
+    assert fn is not None
+    fn(
+        op.data_ptr(),
+        lp.data_ptr(),
+        o_out.data_ptr(),
+        lse_out.data_ptr(),
+        (b, h, sq, d),
+        splits,
+        o_out.stride(),
+        lse_out.stride(),
+        sinks.data_ptr(),
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream,
+    )
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(o_out.cpu().double(), ref_o, atol=0.004, rtol=0.004)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(lse_out.cpu().double(), ref_lse, atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-5)
+    assert torch.count_nonzero(o_out[:, 0]).item() == 0
+    torch.testing.assert_close(lse_out[:, :, 0].cpu(), sinks.cpu().view(1, h).expand(b, h), atol=1e-6, rtol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("sink", [False, True], ids=["plain", "sink"])

+    n_splits <= G_S: every split's LSE and partial-O row is loaded up front through a clamped index, in a group of G_LEAN_SMALL (8) for the common few
+    splits and of G_S (16) beyond that.  Past G_S -- and always for d = 66, whose rows take bounded element loads -- the serial form walks the splits in
+    two legs, sixteen deep and then four deep (``_serial_legs`` and the ``_accumulate_splits`` helper).  2 to 17 splits stay below a full serial group
+    (tail leg only; 2 to 8 are the narrow lean group for d = 128, 9 to 16 the wide one), 21 takes one group plus a remainder, 37 two; 64 to 128 are the long walks of a b = 1 long-KV decode (the decode form's O pass keeps eight splits in flight per warp); row 0 has every
+    split dead and split 1 is dead on row 1, so the dead-split select runs inside every form.  The sink arm seeds the denominator with the sink column
+    and lands the keyless row on ``O := 0 / LSE := sink``.
+    S_q = 1 and 2 are the decode rows: past G_S splits they take the decode form (the block's warps share the split axis), within G_S the
+    one-warp-per-row kernel, so both sides of that dispatch run against the same reference."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.kernels.sm100 import split_combine as comb
+
+    b, h = 2, 3
+    op, lp, ref_o, ref_lse = _partials(b, h, sq, d, splits)
+    sinks = torch.tensor([-120.0, 0.7, 4.0], device="cuda")

+        maximum = torch.maximum(lse.amax(0), sink_col)

+def _sink_partials_with_padding(b, h, sq, d, splits, q_lens, sinks):
+    """Split partials of a sink launch whose batch ``i`` has only ``q_lens[i]`` live query rows: a PADDED row (r >= q_lens[i]) carries every split dead,
+    exactly as the split kernels write it, and so does row 0 of every batch (a valid row with no key in range for q_lens[i] > 0).  Returns the device
+    partials and the float64 reference of the unsplit contract: valid rows fold the sink once (a keyless one lands on O = 0 / LSE = sink), padded rows
+    stay O = 0 / LSE = -inf whatever the sink."""
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(20261015 + splits)
+    o = torch.randn(splits, b, sq, h, d, generator=generator) * 0.4
+    lse = torch.randn(splits, b, h, sq, generator=generator) * 2.0 + 0.7
+    lse[:, :, :, 0] = -torch.inf
+    if sq > 1:
+        lse[1, :, :, 1] = -torch.inf  # a dead split beside live ones
+    padded = torch.zeros(b, sq, dtype=torch.bool)
+    for i, n in enumerate(q_lens):
+        padded[i, n:] = True
+        lse[:, i, :, n:] = -torch.inf
+    dead = torch.isneginf(lse).permute(0, 1, 3, 2).unsqueeze(-1)
+    o.masked_fill_(dead, torch.nan)  # a dead payload must never enter the arithmetic
+    scores = lse.double()
+    sink_col = sinks.double().cpu().view(1, h, 1).expand(b, h, sq)
+    maximum = torch.maximum(scores.amax(0), sink_col)
+    weights = torch.where(torch.isneginf(scores), torch.zeros_like(scores), (scores - maximum).exp())
+    denominator = weights.sum(0) + (sink_col - maximum).exp()
+    safe_o = o.double().masked_fill(dead, 0)
+    ref_o = (weights.permute(0, 1, 3, 2).unsqueeze(-1) * safe_o).sum(0) / denominator.permute(0, 2, 1).unsqueeze(-1)
+    ref_lse = maximum + denominator.log()
+    pad_o = padded.view(b, sq, 1, 1).expand(b, sq, h, d)
+    pad_lse = padded.view(b, 1, sq).expand(b, h, sq)
+    ref_o = ref_o.masked_fill(pad_o, 0.0)
+    ref_lse = ref_lse.masked_fill(pad_lse, -torch.inf)
+    return o.reshape(splits * b, sq, h, d).cuda(), lse.reshape(splits * b, h, sq).cuda(), ref_o, ref_lse, pad_o, pad_lse

+        (2, 33, 128, [2, 1, 0]),
+        (5, 4, 128, [5, 2, 0]),
+        (5, 21, 128, [3, 0, 5]),
+        (1, 33, 66, [0, 1, 1]),

+    ],
+    ids=["lean_narrow", "lean_wide", "decode_64", "decode_33_sq2", "lean_sq5", "serial_21", "decode_d66", "serial_d66"],
+)
+def test_pointer_combine_sink_keeps_padded_query_rows_dead(sq, splits, d, q_lens):
+    """A padded query row (past its batch's Q length: the dense padded-Q trim) and a valid row whose every key is masked reach the combine with the
+    same partials (every split dead).  Folding the sink unconditionally gave both LSE = sink; the sink entry that takes the per-batch Q lengths
+    drops the sink for the padded rows (O := 0 / LSE := -inf) and keeps the unsplit contract for the valid keyless one (O := 0 / LSE := sink) --
+    in the lean, serial and decode forms alike, with the fp32 rows and the element-load rows."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.kernels.sm100 import split_combine as comb
+
+    b, h = 3, 3
+    sinks = torch.tensor([-120.0, 0.7, 4.0], device="cuda")
+    op, lp, ref_o, ref_lse, pad_o, pad_lse = _sink_partials_with_padding(b, h, sq, d, splits, q_lens, sinks)
+    q_lens_t = torch.tensor(q_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    o_out = torch.full((b, sq, h, d), -31.0, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    lse_out = torch.full((b, h, sq), -31.0, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    fn = positional_entry(comb.compile_ptr(dtype_o="bf16", has_lse=True, has_sink=True, has_q_lens=True))
+    assert fn is not None
+    fn(
+        op.data_ptr(),
+        lp.data_ptr(),
+        o_out.data_ptr(),
+        lse_out.data_ptr(),
+        (b, h, sq, d),
+        splits,
+        o_out.stride(),
+        lse_out.stride(),
+        sinks.data_ptr(),
+        q_lens_t.data_ptr(),
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream,

+B, S, H, D = 3, 2048, 4, 128
+CAP = B * S

+
+def _make_case(kv_heads, scale, seed, qlens, klens, d_qk=D, d_v=D):
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+    cpu = [
+        (torch.randn(CAP, heads, d_qk if i < 2 else d_v, generator=gen) * (scale if i < 2 else 0.5)).bfloat16()
+        for i, heads in enumerate((H, kv_heads, kv_heads))
+    ]
+    cuq, cuk = [0], [0]
+    for nq, nk in zip(qlens, klens):
+        cuq.append(cuq[-1] + nq)
+        cuk.append(cuk[-1] + nk)
+    values = {n: t.cuda() for n, t in zip(("q", "k", "v"), cpu)}
+    values.update(
+        sq=torch.tensor(qlens, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(B, 1, 1, 1),
+        sk=torch.tensor(klens, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(B, 1, 1, 1),
+        rq=(torch.tensor(cuq, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int64) * H * d_qk).view(B + 1, 1, 1, 1),
+        rk=(torch.tensor(cuk, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int64) * kv_heads * d_qk).view(B + 1, 1, 1, 1),
+    )
+    values["rv"] = values["rk"] // d_qk * d_v
+    values["ro"] = values["rq"] // d_qk * d_v
+    return values, (cpu, cuq, cuk)
+
+
+def _reference(host, bottom_right):
+    (q, k, v), cuq, cuk = host
+    outputs, stats = [], []
+    for i in range(B):
+        nq, nk = cuq[i + 1] - cuq[i], cuk[i + 1] - cuk[i]
+        if not nq:
+            continue
+        qr, kr, vr = [x.double().transpose(0, 1) for x in (q[cuq[i] : cuq[i + 1]], k[cuk[i] : cuk[i + 1]], v[cuk[i] : cuk[i + 1]])]
+        repeat = H // k.shape[1]
+        scores = qr @ kr.repeat_interleave(repeat, 0).transpose(-1, -2) * q.shape[-1] ** -0.5
+        keep = torch.arange(nk)[None, :] <= torch.arange(nq)[:, None] + (nk - nq if bottom_right else 0)
+        scores.masked_fill_(~keep, -torch.inf)
+        probs = scores.softmax(-1)
+        probs = torch.where(keep.any(-1)[None, :, None], probs, torch.zeros_like(probs))
+        outputs.append((probs @ vr.repeat_interleave(repeat, 0)).transpose(0, 1))
+        stats.append(scores.logsumexp(-1).transpose(0, 1))
+    return torch.cat(outputs), torch.cat(stats)

+def _build_graph(values, kv_heads, bottom_right, layout, cta_mma=2):

+        dim = values[name].shape[-1]
+        nodes[name] = g.tensor(dim=[B, heads, S, dim], stride=[S * heads * dim, dim, heads * dim, 1], data_type=io, name=name)
+    for name in ("sq", "sk", "rq", "rk", "rv", "ro"):
+        nodes[name] = g.tensor_like(values[name], name=name)
+    nodes["q"].set_ragged_offset(nodes["rq"])
+    nodes["k"].set_ragged_offset(nodes["rk"])
+    nodes["v"].set_ragged_offset(nodes["rv"])
+    mask = dict(use_causal_mask_bottom_right=True) if bottom_right else dict(use_causal_mask=True)
+    o, stats = g.sdpa(
+        q=nodes["q"],
+        k=nodes["k"],
+        v=nodes["v"],
+        generate_stats=True,

+    values["rs"] = values["rq"] // d_qk // H * factor
+    nodes["rs"] = g.tensor_like(values["rs"], name="stats_offsets")
+    stats.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT).set_dim([B, H, S, 1])
